2:1 房扑易被误诊为窦性心动过速，因为 F 波可能隐藏在前一个 T 波中。: 2:1 atrial flutter is easily misdiagnosed as sinus tachycardia because the F wave may be hidden in the preceding T wave.
2:1 阻滞既可能是 I 型也可能是 II 型，不能只凭 2:1 分型。: 2:1 block may be type I or type II; do not classify based on 2:1 alone.
24 岁女性，突发心悸、胸闷；窄 QRS 规则心动过速 180 次/分，既往哮喘: 24-year-old woman with sudden palpitations and chest tightness; regular narrow-QRS tachycardia at 180 beats/min, history of asthma.
24h Holter 正常不排除阵发房颤。: Normal 24h Holter does not exclude paroxysmal AF.
ACLS 的第一分叉不是“什么心律”，而是“有没有脉”；有脉/无脉决定电治疗模式: The first branch in ACLS is not "what rhythm" but "is there a pulse"; pulse/no pulse determines the electrical therapy mode.
AI 输出是概率/提示，不是诊断；在筛查、基层与远程监测中有潜力，但需前瞻验证与: AI output is probability/hint, not diagnosis; it has potential in screening, primary care, and remote monitoring, but requires prospective validation and regulation.
ARVC 早期心电图可正常；不能一次正常 ECG 排除，需影像、家族史与随访。: Early ARVC ECG can be normal; a single normal ECG cannot exclude it; imaging, family history, and follow-up are needed.
AVNRT/AVRT 多突发突止，P 波常隐藏或位于 QRS 终末。: AVNRT/AVRT often has sudden onset and offset; P waves are often hidden or located at the end of QRS.
Ashman 与室早鉴别：Ashman 有长-短周期、RBBB 形态、无代偿间歇: Differentiate Ashman from PVC: Ashman has long-short cycle, RBBB morphology, no compensatory pause; PVC has fixed coupling.
Ashman 现象常见于房颤，形态多呈右束支阻滞型；需要与室早鉴别，关键是有无前: Ashman phenomenon is common in atrial fibrillation; morphology often shows a right bundle branch block pattern; it must be differentiated from PVCs, and the key is whether there is a preceding P wave and a long–short cycle.
Brugada 四步法报告敏感性约 98.7%、特异性约 96.5%；其中“所有: The Brugada four-step method reports sensitivity of about 98.7% and specificity of about 96.5%; among these, "absence of RS pattern in all precordial leads" has specificity of 100% and sensitivity of about 21%, and must be combined with RS interval >100 ms, AV dissociation, and morphologic criteria.
COPD 的“假性前壁梗死”可来自导联位置与右室负荷；不能仅凭 Q 波诊断心梗。: Pseudo-anterior infarction in COPD can arise from lead position and right ventricular load; do not diagnose MI by Q waves alone.
CPR 中监护仪上的“室速”不能直接电击；必须确认无脉并停止按压后判读。: A “VT” on the monitor during CPR cannot be shocked directly; confirm pulselessness and stop compressions before interpretation.
CPR 时先看患者、脉搏与按压反馈；电击后立即恢复按压，约 2 秒后再评估心律；: During CPR, first check the patient, pulse, and compression feedback; after a shock, immediately resume compressions and reassess rhythm after about 2 seconds; do not be misled by artifact.
DDD 可出现起搏器介导性心动过速（PMT）；需与室上速鉴别，磁铁或程控可终止。: DDD can cause pacemaker-mediated tachycardia (PMT); distinguish from SVT; magnet or programming can terminate.
ECG ST-T 改变可继发低灌注。: ECG ST-T changes may be secondary to hypoperfusion.
HCM 心电图可模拟前壁/侧壁心梗；不要仅凭 Q 波诊断陈旧性心梗。: HCM ECG can mimic anterior/lateral MI; do not diagnose old MI by Q waves alone.
HCM 心电图可模拟心梗。: HCM ECG can mimic myocardial infarction.
ICD 通过感知心室率与形态识别室速/室颤，按程控顺序进行 ATP 或放电；避免: ICD identifies VT/VF by sensing ventricular rate and morphology and delivers ATP or shock according to programmed sequence; avoid inappropriate shocks by optimizing sensing and discrimination.
ICU 连续监测用于发现心律失常、ST 改变与 QT 延长；多导联、报警设置与每: Continuous ICU monitoring detects arrhythmias, ST changes, and QT prolongation; multi-lead monitoring, alarm settings, and daily review are key.
III>II + V4R 抬高支持右冠；aVR 抬高伴广泛压低提示左主干/前降支: III > II + V4R elevation supports the right coronary artery; aVR elevation with widespread depression suggests left main/proximal LAD.
II、III、aVF P 波振幅 ≥0.25 mV（2.5 mm），P 波窄而尖: P wave amplitude in II, III, and aVF ≥0.25 mV (2.5 mm), with a narrow, peaked P wave; the P wave in V1 may be upright or biphasic.
II、III、aVF ST 抬高、aVL 镜像压低；伴低血压与肺清晰时要想到右室: ST elevation in II, III, aVF with reciprocal depression in aVL; when accompanied by hypotension and clear lungs, consider right ventricular infarction; nitrates are a trap.
II 导联：P 波宽、双峰呈“二尖瓣型 P 波”。: Lead II: wide, bifid P wave forming a mitral P wave.
ILR 适合反复晕厥。: ILR is suitable for recurrent syncope.
I、V5、V6 宽 R 无 q: Wide R in I, V5, V6 without q
I、aVF 均正向：电轴正常（0° 至 +90°）。: I, aVF both positive: normal axis (0° to +90°).
I 导联方向反转，P 波、QRS 主波、T 波均倒置；aVR 与 aVL 互换。: Lead I polarity reversed: P wave, dominant QRS deflection, and T wave all inverted; aVR and aVL swapped. II and III swapped, aVF unchanged.
LAFB 合并 RBBB（双分支阻滞）伴晕厥或 PR 延长，需评估起搏。: LAFB with RBBB (bifascicular block) with syncope or PR prolongation requires pacing evaluation.
LAFB 电轴左偏 + 下壁 rS；LPFB 电轴右偏 + 下壁 qR。: LAFB: left axis deviation + inferior rS; LPFB: right axis deviation + inferior qR.
LBBB + 低 EF + 心衰→评估 CRT。: LBBB + low EF + heart failure → evaluate for CRT.
LQT1 由 KCNQ1 突变导致 IKs 减少，T 波宽大，事件多由运动（尤其: LQT1 is caused by KCNQ1 mutations leading to reduced IKs, broad T waves, and events mostly triggered by exercise (especially swimming).
LQT3 由 SCN5A 突变导致晚钠电流增加，QT 明显延长，事件常在睡眠/心: LQT3 is caused by SCN5A mutation leading to increased late sodium current; QT is markedly prolonged; events often occur during sleep/bradycardia.
Mahaim 纤维多为房束旁路，起搏后经旁路下传至右束支，产生 LBBB 样预激: Mahaim fibers are mostly atriofascicular pathways; after pacing, conduction descends via the pathway to the right bundle branch, producing LBBB-like pre-excitation; they often participate in antidromic atrioventricular reentrant tachycardia.
PMT 是起搏器依赖者的急症；磁铁放置可转为固定频率起搏，随后程控调整。: PMT is an emergency in pacemaker-dependent patients; magnet application can convert to fixed-rate pacing, followed by programming adjustment.
POTS 不是“焦虑症”；量立卧位心率，排除其他原因。: POTS is not 'anxiety disorder'; measure heart rate supine and standing, exclude other causes.
POTS：直立心率增快 + 症状。: POTS: orthostatic heart rate increase + symptoms.
PR 逐搏延长，直到一个 P 波后 QRS 脱漏；脱漏后 PR 缩短，周而复始，: PR lengthens beat by beat until a P wave is not followed by QRS; after the dropped beat, PR shortens, and the cycle repeats, like 'slowing down more and more, then stopping for one beat.'
P 波与 QRS 完全无关、心房率高于心室率、PR 间期逐搏变化，是三度房室阻滞: Complete independence of P waves and QRS complexes, atrial rate higher than ventricular rate, and beat-to-beat variation in PR interval are the most specific clues of third-degree AV block; QRS width and escape rate can suggest the block site.
P 波常不可见或位于 QRS 终末（逆行 P），与 QRS 关系固定。: P waves are often invisible or located at the terminal QRS (retrograde P), with a fixed relationship to the QRS.
P 波消失，代之以大小、形态、间距不一的 f 波，基线细颤。: P waves are absent and replaced by f waves of varying amplitude, morphology, and spacing; fine baseline fibrillation.
QRS 时限 <0.12 s；QT 间期从 QRS 起点到 T 波终点，需按心率: QRS duration <0.12 s; the QT interval runs from QRS onset to T-wave end and must be corrected for heart rate. T-wave direction is usually concordant with the main QRS wave.
QRS 时限 ≥0.12 s，V1 或 V2 呈 rsR′ 或 rSR′，且 R: QRS duration ≥0.12 s, with rsR′ or rSR′ in V1 or V2, and R′ taller than the initial r wave.
QTc = QT / √RR（Bazett）；QTc >450 ms（男）或 >: QTc = QT / √RR (Bazett); QTc >450 ms (men) or >460 ms (women) requires attention.
QTc 男性 <0.44 s、女性 <0.46 s。: QTc <0.44 s in men and <0.46 s in women.
ROSC 后：目标氧合、血流动力学支持、12 导联、目标温度管理、病因处理。: After ROSC: targeted oxygenation, hemodynamic support, 12-lead ECG, targeted temperature management, and treatment of the cause.
RVH 增加向右前向量，后壁 MI 丢失向后向量，两者都使 V1 R 波相对增高: RVH increases the rightward anterior vector, and posterior MI loses the posterior vector; both make the V1 R wave relatively taller, but ST-T and axis differ.
RyR2 突变导致肌浆网钙漏，交感兴奋时触发延迟后除极；结构心脏正常。: RyR2 mutations cause sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium leak, triggering delayed afterdepolarizations during sympathetic activation; structural heart is normal.
S1Q3T3 不特异，但右心负荷图形 + 临床概率高 → 影像学确认；不稳定者考: S1Q3T3 is nonspecific, but right heart strain pattern + high clinical probability → confirm with imaging; consider reperfusion if unstable.
STEMI 看相邻导联；aVR 抬高要警惕左主干。: For STEMI, look at adjacent leads; aVR elevation should raise suspicion of left main disease.
ST 压低伴 T 波低平与 U 波增高，血钾可确诊。: ST depression with T-wave flattening and increased U waves; serum potassium can confirm.
ST 段呈勺状（下垂型）压低，常见于 II、III、aVF、V4–V6。: Scooped (sagging) ST-segment depression, commonly seen in II, III, aVF, V4–V6.
ST 段缩短、QT 间期缩短，T 波可正常；严重时心动过缓、传导阻滞。: Shortened ST segment and shortened QT interval, with T waves possibly normal; in severe cases, bradycardia and conduction block.
Sokolow-Lyon：SV1 + RV5/V6 ≥3.5 mV；Cornel: Sokolow-Lyon: SV1 + RV5/V6 ≥3.5 mV; Cornell: RaVL + SV3 >2.8 mV (men) / 2.0 mV (women).
TCA 中毒的心电图可模拟 RBBB/室速；不要仅凭 QRS 宽诊断室速，结合药: ECG in TCA poisoning can mimic RBBB/VT; do not diagnose VT based only on wide QRS, consider drug history.
T 波与主波反向: T wave opposite to the main QRS deflection
T 波高尖、QRS 增宽、P 波低平，血钾可确诊，无相邻导联分布。: Tall peaked T waves, widened QRS, flattened P waves, serum potassium can confirm, no contiguous lead distribution.
V1 R/S>1、RV1 ≥0.7 mV、电轴右偏 >+90°、V5/V6 深: V1 R/S > 1, RV1 ≥ 0.7 mV, right axis deviation > +90°, deep S in V5/V6; may be accompanied by right atrial enlargement and ST depression in right precordial leads.
V1 高 R 还见于后壁心梗、WPW、RBBB、正常变异；不能只凭 V1 高 R: Tall R in V1 also occurs in posterior MI, WPW, RBBB, and normal variants; RVH cannot be diagnosed by tall R in V1 alone.
V1–V3 T 倒置、epsilon 波、QRS 终末延迟、右室结构/功能异常；: Right ventricular outflow tract epicardial repolarization heterogeneity and conduction delay create reentry; SCN5A mutations are common.
V2–V3 thresholds by age and sex: men ≥40 years ≥2 mm, men <40 years ≥2.5 mm, women ≥1.5 mm; other leads ≥1 mm.
V4R ST 抬高 ≥1 mm（其他右胸导联 V3R–V5R 可辅助）。: V4R ST elevation ≥1 mm (other right precordial leads V3R–V5R may help).
V4R ST 抬高支持诊断。: V4R ST elevation supports the diagnosis.
V4R 抬高提示右室受累，与后壁梗死常为同一罪犯血管。: V4R elevation suggests right ventricular involvement; it often shares the same culprit vessel as posterior infarction.
aVR R 波 ≥3 mm、QRS >100 ms 提示严重中毒；低血压、心律失: aVR R wave ≥3 mm and QRS >100 ms suggest severe poisoning; hypotension, arrhythmia, and seizures are danger signals.
β 受体阻滞剂是基础治疗。: β-blockers are the cornerstone of treatment.
一个年轻人猝死，家族筛查可能救另一个人；但基因报告要专业解读。: When a young person dies suddenly, family screening may save another life; but genetic reports require expert interpretation.
一句话：P 波在 I、II、aVF 直立，aVR 倒置，PR 固定，QRS 窄。: One sentence: P waves are upright in I, II, aVF, inverted in aVR, PR is fixed, and QRS is narrow.
一小格 0.04 s，一大格 0.20 s；心率 300 除以大格数。: One small box is 0.04 s, one large box is 0.20 s; heart rate is 300 divided by the number of large boxes.
一度房室阻滞通常无症状，注意药物与电解质；二度 I 型多为房室结，若症状明显或进: First-degree AV block is usually asymptomatic; monitor drugs and electrolytes. Second-degree type I is mostly at the AV node; if symptoms are marked or it progresses, evaluate for pacing. Second-degree type II and third-degree block with wide QRS, syncope, or heart failure have stronger pacing indications.
三度房室阻滞：P 与 QRS 完全分离，心房率高于心室率，心室由交界区或室性逸搏: Third-degree AV block: complete dissociation of P and QRS; atrial rate is higher than ventricular rate, and the ventricles are driven by a junctional or ventricular escape pacemaker. Narrow QRS suggests a junctional escape and a relatively higher lesion; wide QRS suggests a ventricular escape, a lower lesion, and higher risk.
下壁 STEMI 忽略右室梗死，过量使用硝酸酯导致低血压。: In inferior STEMI, missing right ventricular infarction and excessive nitrates cause hypotension.
下壁导联 J 波 + 高振幅提示高危。: J waves in inferior leads + high amplitude indicate high risk.
不同病因改变的是不同向量成分：RVH 增加向右前向量，后壁 MI 丢失向后向量，: Different etiologies alter different vector components: RVH increases the rightward anterior vector, posterior MI loses the posterior vector, and WPW changes initial depolarization.
不找诱因：再灌注、洋地黄、高钾、心肌炎都可能表现为 AIVR。: Not identifying triggers: reperfusion, digitalis, hyperkalemia, and myocarditis can all present as AIVR.
不要为“常规”而常规。: Do not order tests merely for routine.
不要只停一种药；查所有 QT 延长药物、电解质与肾功能。: Do not stop only one drug; check all QT-prolonging drugs, electrolytes, and renal function.
不要因分析波形延误按压；除颤后立即恢复 CPR 2 分钟。: Do not delay compressions to analyze the waveform; resume CPR immediately for 2 minutes after defibrillation.
不要因监护仪突然“室速”就电击；先看患者与设备位置。: Do not shock just because the monitor suddenly shows “VT”; first look at the patient and device position.
不要把起搏钉误认为 QRS 的一部分；也不要在没有钉时断言“没有起搏”。: Do not mistake pacing spikes for part of QRS; do not assert “no pacing” when no spikes are seen.
不要根据 AI 提示直接治疗；确认 ECG、临床与金标准检查。: Do not treat directly based on AI prompts; confirm ECG, clinical findings, and gold-standard tests.
不要用心电图“排除”肥厚；也不要把高电压直接等同于肥厚。: Do not use ECG to “rule out” hypertrophy; do not equate high voltage directly with hypertrophy.
不要用电压标准排除 LVH；超声左室质量指数才是确诊依据。: Do not use voltage criteria to exclude LVH; echocardiographic LV mass index is the basis for diagnosis.
与多源性房速鉴别看心率。: Differentiate from multifocal atrial tachycardia by rate.
与期前收缩不同，窦性心律不齐没有提前出现的异位 P 波，RR 变化是渐进的。: Unlike premature contractions, sinus arrhythmia has no premature ectopic P waves; RR changes are gradual.
严重高钾先打钙，再降钾；钙剂不降低血钾，只保护心脏。: In severe hyperkalemia, give calcium first, then lower potassium; calcium does not lower serum potassium and only protects the heart.
从离子到导联：四层转换: From ions to leads: four-layer conversion
代偿间歇多不完全，但也可完全。: The compensatory pause is often incomplete, but it can also be complete.
代码是理解起搏心电图的第一步：知道起搏腔和感知腔，才能预测起搏钉、P 波与 QR: The code is the first step to understanding pacing ECGs: knowing the pacing and sensing chambers allows prediction of the relationship between pacing spikes, P waves, and QRS complexes.
任何“恶性心律失常”图形，先确认患者是否有脉；伪差最危险的后果是诱发不必要的电击: For any “malignant arrhythmia” pattern, first confirm whether the patient has a pulse; the most dangerous consequence of artifact is inducing unnecessary shocks.
伪差可以模拟 ST 改变、房颤、室速甚至室颤；处理原则是先确认患者与导联，再判读: Artifacts can mimic ST changes, atrial fibrillation, ventricular tachycardia, or even ventricular fibrillation; the management principle is to first confirm the patient and leads, then interpret the rhythm.
低血压 + 颈静脉怒张 + 肺清晰 = 右室梗死，硝酸酯是陷阱。: Hypotension + jugular venous distension + clear lungs = right ventricular infarction; nitrates are a trap.
低钙伴抽搐、喉痉挛或 QT 显著延长。: Hypocalcemia with tetany, laryngospasm, or marked QT prolongation.
低钙导致 ST 延长与 QT 延长，有血钙证据。: Hypocalcemia causes ST prolongation and QT prolongation, with evidence of serum calcium.
低钙延长动作电位平台期，使 ST 段与 QT 间期延长。: Hypocalcemia prolongs the action potential plateau, lengthening the ST segment and QT interval.
低钙看 ST：ST 拉长导致 QT 延长，T 波却“长得正常”。: For hypocalcemia, look at the ST segment: a lengthened ST leads to prolonged QT, while the T wave “looks normal.”
低钙：ST 段延长、QT 延长，T 波形态多正常。: Hypocalcemia: ST segment prolongation, QT prolongation, T wave morphology usually normal.
低钾、交感兴奋、先天性心脏病也可出现高 P 波；肺型 P 波不是肺栓塞的特异征象: Hypokalemia, sympathetic excitation, and congenital heart disease can also produce tall P waves; P pulmonale is not a specific sign of pulmonary embolism and must be interpreted with the clinical context.
低钾、低镁、心动过缓或多种延长 QT 药物联用。: Hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia, bradycardia, or concomitant use of multiple QT-prolonging drugs.
低钾的 U 波与 QT(U)。: U waves and QT(U) in hypokalemia.
体表电位与心脏源的关系可通过逆问题求解；病态心脏与噪声使重建困难。: The relationship between body surface potentials and cardiac sources can be solved via the inverse problem; diseased hearts and noise make reconstruction difficult.
依赖阿托品而延误起搏；阿托品可能提高心房率，却不改善房室传导。: Relying on atropine and delaying pacing; atropine may increase atrial rate but does not improve AV conduction.
侧壁/下壁导联深窄 Q 波、LVH 电压、T 波倒置；可伴电轴左偏、短 PR 或: Deep narrow Q waves in lateral/inferior leads, LVH voltage, T wave inversion; may be accompanied by left axis deviation, short PR, or pre-excitation-like changes.
侧壁 ST 压低 + T 倒置 + 高电压 = 劳损型 LVH，不一定是缺血。: Lateral ST depression + T-wave inversion + high voltage = strain-pattern LVH, not necessarily ischemia.
儿童发热 + 皮疹 + 心电图 ST 改变，别忘了川崎病和冠脉超声。: Child with fever + rash + ECG ST changes: don't forget Kawasaki disease and coronary ultrasound.
儿童晕厥 + QTc 延长，别只当“生长痛/低血糖”；长 QT 可致命。: Childhood syncope + prolonged QTc: do not just consider "growing pains/hypoglycemia"; long QT can be fatal.
先心病心电图可提示心室肥厚、电轴异常、房室阻滞、预激；不同畸形有不同模式。: Congenital heart disease ECG can suggest ventricular hypertrophy, abnormal axis, AV block, and pre-excitation; different malformations have different patterns.
先排除导联错接；aVR P 波应倒置、I/II P 波应直立。: First exclude lead misplacement; the aVR P wave should be inverted, and the I/II P waves should be upright.
先看 QRS 宽度与 V1 形态：V1 深 S 加 I、V6 宽 R 且无 q，: First look at QRS width and V1 morphology: deep S in V1 plus broad R in I and V6 without q points to LBBB.
先看脉搏、血压、意识与波形同步性；不要仅凭监护仪上的“室速”报警立即电击，必须确: First check pulse, blood pressure, consciousness, and waveform synchronization; do not immediately shock based solely on a monitor “ventricular tachycardia” alarm—must confirm the patient is pulseless.
先确认 QRS 窄，提示冲动经希氏束-浦肯野系统下传，而非心室肌起源。: First confirm the QRS is narrow, suggesting the impulse is conducted via the His-Purkinje system rather than originating in ventricular myocardium.
先确认“正常-异常”交替的模式是否持续存在。: First confirm whether the 'normal-abnormal' alternating pattern persists.
先确认患者有无脉搏与稳定性，再分析图形。: First confirm whether the patient has a pulse and is stable, then analyze the tracing.
关键是找到提前且形态不同的 P 波，常埋在前一 T 波上。: The key is to find a premature P wave with a different morphology, often buried in the preceding T wave.
具体药物与剂量需由临床医生决定，本页仅作教学。: Specific drugs and doses must be decided by the clinician; this page is for teaching only.
典型胸痛、血压下降、严重心律失常。: Typical chest pain, hypotension, severe arrhythmia.
再灌注时间窗：症状 ≤12 小时均应再灌注；12–24 小时仍有缺血证据者可考虑: Reperfusion time window: reperfusion is indicated for symptoms ≤12 hours; consider it for 12–24 hours if ischemic evidence persists; individualize for stable patients beyond 24 hours.
分支阻滞、双分支与三分支: Fascicular block, bifascicular and trifascicular block
前壁：V1–V4；广泛前壁可累及 I、aVL、V5、V6。: Anterior: V1–V4; extensive anterior may involve I, aVL, V5, V6.
