窦房结第四相自动除极由 If 与钙电流驱动。: Phase 4 automatic depolarization of the SA node is driven by If and calcium current.
窦房结细胞具有自律性，第四相缓慢自动除极达到阈值后产生动作电位，是正常心脏的最高: Sinoatrial node cells have automaticity; phase 4 slow spontaneous depolarization reaches threshold and generates an action potential, making it the highest pacemaker of the normal heart.
窦房结自律性下降、窦性停搏或窦房传导阻滞时，交界区作为第二级起搏点被动逸搏，避免: When sinus node automaticity decreases, or in sinus arrest or sinoatrial exit block, the junctional area acts as a secondary pacemaker and passively escapes to prevent ventricular asystole.
窦房结起搏细胞的最大舒张电位约 −60 mV，第四相由 If（funny cur: The maximum diastolic potential of sinoatrial pacemaker cells is about −60 mV; phase 4 involves slow depolarization via If (funny current) and T-type calcium channels; when the membrane potential reaches about −40 mV, L-type calcium channels open, forming the upstroke.
窦速、低电压、ST-T 改变。: Sinus tachycardia, low voltage, ST-T changes.
窦速与发热/低血压程度不相称、新发房颤、缺血性 ST 改变提示病情重；需结合乳酸: Sinus tachycardia disproportionate to fever/hypotension, new-onset AF, and ischemic ST changes suggest severe illness; combine with lactate, infection markers, and ultrasound.
立即评估血流动力学，吸氧、建立静脉通路、持续心电监护；不稳定者按心脏骤停或围停搏: Immediately assess hemodynamics, give oxygen, establish IV access, and provide continuous ECG monitoring; manage unstable patients as cardiac arrest or periarrest.
纠正低钾、低镁、缺氧、甲亢等可逆因素。: Correct reversible factors such as hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia, hypoxia, and hyperthyroidism.
结合宫缩与临床。: Combine with contractions and clinical findings.
结合电轴、右室高电压、S1Q3T3 与窦性心动过速，寻找右心负荷的证据。: Combine axis, right ventricular high voltage, S1Q3T3, and sinus tachycardia to look for evidence of right heart strain.
结合症状、肌钙蛋白与危险评分（GRACE、TIMI）进行分层。: Stratify using symptoms, troponin, and risk scores (GRACE, TIMI).
结合症状、药物和缺血评估；新发宽 QRS 或脱漏比例增加需升级处理。: Assess with symptoms, drugs, and ischemia; new wide QRS or an increased proportion of dropped beats requires escalated management.
结合血钙、肿瘤、甲状旁腺疾病与用药史。: Correlate with serum calcium, tumor, parathyroid disease, and medication history.
继发性 ST-T 改变（与 QRS 主波方向相反）。: Secondary ST-T changes (opposite to the main QRS direction).
老年女性乏力、恶心、上腹不适，查心电图和肌钙蛋白；可能是 ACS。: Older woman with fatigue, nausea, and upper abdominal discomfort: check ECG and troponin; may be ACS.
肌电干扰为高频、不规则细碎波，可掩盖 P 波或模拟房颤；寒战、紧张、甲亢、帕金森: Electromyographic interference consists of high-frequency, irregular, fine fragmented waves that can obscure P waves or mimic atrial fibrillation; it is common in patients with shivering, anxiety, hyperthyroidism, or Parkinson's disease.
肌钙蛋白明显升高伴局部 ST 抬高与镜像压低，需排除心肌梗死。: Markedly elevated troponin with regional ST elevation and reciprocal depression requires exclusion of myocardial infarction.
肥厚心肌动作电位时程延长、复极顺序改变，导致 ST-T 与 QRS 向量不一致；: Hypertrophied myocardium has prolonged action potential duration and altered repolarization sequence, causing ST-T and QRS vectors to be discordant; ischemia may be superimposed.
肥厚心肌复极异常与心内膜下缺血共同导致 ST-T 改变；劳损图形通常与 QRS: Abnormal repolarization in hypertrophied myocardium and subendocardial ischemia together cause ST-T changes; strain patterns usually oppose the main QRS direction.
肺栓塞是血栓阻塞肺动脉导致右心负荷急剧增加，心电图可表现为窦性心动过速、S1Q3: Pulmonary embolism is caused by a thrombus obstructing the pulmonary artery, leading to a sharp increase in right heart load; ECG may show sinus tachycardia, S1Q3T3, right bundle branch block, T-wave inversion in V1–V4, etc., but none have sufficient sensitivity.
肾上腺素增加冠脉与脑灌注压；胺碘酮/利多卡因减少室性心律失常复发。: Epinephrine increases coronary and cerebral perfusion pressure; amiodarone/lidocaine reduce recurrence of ventricular arrhythmias.
胎儿心电图通过母体腹壁或胎儿头皮电极记录胎心电活动，用于产程监测；与成人 12: Fetal ECG records fetal cardiac electrical activity through the maternal abdominal wall or fetal scalp electrodes and is used for labor monitoring; interpretation differs from adult 12-lead ECG.
脓毒症患者的心电图是“灌注的镜子”；先复苏，再解释波形。: The ECG in sepsis patients is a "mirror of perfusion"; resuscitate first, then interpret the waveform.
脱漏后第一个下传搏动的 PR 最短，随后再次延长，呈周期性；PR 增量逐渐减小，: The first conducted beat after the dropped beat has the shortest PR, then it lengthens again cyclically; PR increments gradually decrease, and the RR interval may gradually shorten.
脱漏间歇约 1 个 PP: The dropped beat pause is approximately 1 PP interval
自动心率算法依赖 R 波检测阈值；高 T 波、起搏钉、伪差可触发误计数。: Automatic heart rate algorithms rely on R-wave detection thresholds; tall T waves, pacemaker spikes, and artifacts can trigger false counts.
自身 QRS 后出现起搏钉；钉可能落在 T 波上；起搏器记录显示感知振幅低或感知: Pacing spike occurs after intrinsic QRS; the spike may fall on the T wave; pacemaker records show low sensed amplitude or inappropriate sensing threshold setting.
节律规则，PR 间期可因交感张力而缩短，QRS 多窄。: The rhythm is regular; the PR interval may be shortened by sympathetic tone, and QRS is usually narrow.
若变异极大或伴长间歇、晕厥，需评估窦房结功能。: If variability is extreme or accompanied by long pauses or syncope, sinus node function must be evaluated.
药物过量、甲状腺功能减退、电解质紊乱等按病因处理；病态窦房结综合征反复症状者考虑: For drug overdose, hypothyroidism, electrolyte disturbances, etc., treat according to the cause; consider a pacemaker for recurrent symptoms of sick sinus syndrome.
血管迷走性晕厥是“良性但烦人”；运动中晕厥则不是它，必须查心脏。: Vasovagal syncope is 'benign but bothersome'; syncope during exercise is not it and mandates cardiac evaluation.
血钾 <3.0 mmol/L 时心电图改变更明显，但正常血钾不能完全排除总体缺钾: ECG changes are more obvious when serum potassium <3.0 mmol/L, but normal serum potassium cannot completely exclude total body potassium depletion.
观察 I、aVL、V5、V6 的 ST-T 改变，区分劳损型与缺血。: Observe ST-T changes in I, aVL, V5, and V6 to distinguish strain pattern from ischemia.
观察 QRS 是否宽大，宽 QRS 可能为原有束支阻滞或差异性传导。: Observe whether the QRS is wide; a wide QRS may be due to preexisting bundle branch block or aberrant conduction.
规则、窄 QRS、频率 150–250 次/分，P′ 波形态异常且与窦性 P 不: Regular, narrow QRS, rate 150–250 beats/min, abnormal P′ morphology different from sinus P; often 1:1 or 2:1 AV conduction.
规则窄 QRS 心动过速，心室率约 186 次/分，未见明确 P 波，符合阵发性: Regular narrow QRS tachycardia, ventricular rate about 186 bpm, no clear P waves, consistent with paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia.
解释 Q 波、ST 段与 T 波在不同阶段的演变规律: Explain the evolution of Q waves, ST segments, and T waves at different stages
认为“有洋地黄效应就是中毒”；效应与中毒不同。: Assuming 'digitalis effect means toxicity'; effect and toxicity are different.
评估卒中风险（CHA₂DS₂-VASc）与出血风险（HAS-BLED）。: Assess stroke risk (CHA₂DS₂-VASc) and bleeding risk (HAS-BLED).
识别可逆诱因，并说明急性症状性心动过缓的处理顺序: Identify reversible triggers and explain the management sequence for acute symptomatic bradycardia
说出 X/Y/Z 轴的方向: State the directions of the X/Y/Z axes
说明希氏束-浦肯野系统的同步激动作用: Illustrates synchronized activation by the His-Purkinje system
起搏/室速后 T 波持续倒置。: Persistent T-wave inversion after pacing/ventricular tachycardia.
起搏器患者的心电图异常需结合程控；不要仅凭监护仪报警处理。: ECG abnormalities in pacemaker patients require correlation with programming; do not manage based only on monitor alarms.
起搏钉与宽 QRS 固定关系；自身 QRS 出现时起搏被抑制；下限频率决定起搏频: Pacing spike with a fixed relationship to wide QRS; pacing is inhibited when intrinsic QRS appears; lower rate limit determines pacing rate.
起搏钉很小，可能被滤波器削弱；没有钉不代表没有起搏，需结合起搏器程控。: Pacing spikes are very small and may be attenuated by filters; absence of spikes does not mean absence of pacing; correlate with pacemaker programming.
起搏钉规律、与 QRS 关系固定；过感知时起搏钉消失/心率慢；程控可确认。: Pacemaker spikes are regular and have a fixed relationship with the QRS; with oversensing, pacemaker spikes disappear/heart rate slows; programming can confirm.
起搏阈值升高或导线完整性破坏使电刺激不能激动心肌；高钾、心肌梗死、抗心律失常药可: Elevated pacing threshold or loss of lead integrity prevents electrical stimulation from exciting the myocardium; hyperkalemia, myocardial infarction, and antiarrhythmic drugs can raise the threshold.
运动中晕厥最危险。: Syncope during exercise is the most dangerous.
运动员、睡眠状态或迷走张力高者可见 50–60 次/分的窦性心动过缓，属生理现象: Sinus bradycardia of 50–60 beats/min can be seen in athletes, during sleep, or in those with high vagal tone; this is a physiological phenomenon.
运动员常有窦缓、早期复极、轻度电压增高但无劳损；LBBB 本身使电压标准失效；W: Athletes often have sinus bradycardia, early repolarization, and mildly increased voltage without strain; LBBB itself invalidates voltage criteria; WPW can cause pseudohypertrophy.
运动员心率 40–50 次/分、无头晕且每搏量代偿良好，属生理适应。: Athletes with a heart rate of 40–50 beats/min, no dizziness, and good stroke volume compensation have a physiological adaptation.
远程监测可传输起搏器/ICD 的事件、阻抗、电池与心律失常数据，提早发现设备故障: Remote monitoring can transmit pacemaker/ICD events, impedance, battery, and arrhythmia data, enabling earlier detection of device malfunction and clinical events.
连续 ≥3 个室性搏动、频率 >100 次/分即为室速。: ≥3 consecutive ventricular beats at a rate >100 beats/min is ventricular tachycardia.
迷走张力增高、窦房结自律性下降或药物抑制（β 受体阻滞剂、非二氢吡啶类钙拮抗剂、: Increased vagal tone, decreased sinus node automaticity, or drug suppression (beta-blockers, non-dihydropyridine calcium channel blockers, digoxin, amiodarone) can all cause rate slowing.
适用于复杂房速、室速、疤痕相关心律失常；需结合拖带/起搏标测验证。: Suitable for complex atrial tachycardia, ventricular tachycardia, and scar-related arrhythmias; requires validation with entrainment/pacing mapping.
逆行 P（II、III、aVF 倒置）: Retrograde P wave (inverted in II, III, aVF)
透析患者“透析后心悸/晕厥”，查钾钙镁与 ECG，别只当容量问题。: In dialysis patients with "post-dialysis palpitations/syncope," check potassium, calcium, magnesium, and ECG; do not just treat as a volume problem.
透析患者电解质波动大。: Dialysis patients have large electrolyte fluctuations.
逐搏测量 PR，确认其恒定。: Measure the PR beat by beat to confirm it is constant.
逸搏-夺获心律常出现在高度房室阻滞：心室逸搏维持下限频率，偶尔窦性冲动成功下传形: Escape-capture rhythm often occurs in high-grade AV block: ventricular escape maintains the lower rate limit, and occasionally a sinus impulse conducts successfully to form a captured narrow QRS.
避免仅凭心电图诊断 LVH；超声心动图是确诊与分型关键。: Avoid diagnosing LVH by ECG alone; echocardiography is key for confirmation and classification.
部分 SIDS 与长 QT、离子通道病相关；新生儿 ECG 筛查仍有争议，但家族: Some SIDS is associated with long QT and channelopathies; neonatal ECG screening remains controversial, but infants with family history/syncope need evaluation.
重新做一份定标正确、基线稳定的心电图。: Repeat an ECG with correct calibration and a stable baseline.
钉后无 P/QRS=失夺获；钉后有过早/异常波形=可能感知异常；钉被自身搏动抑制: No P/QRS after spike = loss of capture; premature/abnormal waveform after spike = possible sensing abnormality; spike inhibited by intrinsic beat = normal.
钙剂稳定心肌，透析清除钾。: Calcium stabilizes the myocardium; dialysis removes potassium.
钠通道阻滞剂需专科评估。: Sodium channel blockers require specialist evaluation.
长途飞行 + 呼吸困难 + 窦速，别只看 S1Q3T3；查右心和 CTPA。: Long-haul flight + dyspnea + sinus tachycardia: don't just look at S1Q3T3; assess the right heart and CTPA.
长间歇 >3 s，或伴晕厥、抽搐、低血压。: Key value for “Sinus Arrest / Sinus Standstill”: >2.0–3.0 s (diagnostic threshold)
间歇长度不是判断严重程度的唯一标准，症状与逸搏是否出现同样关键。: Pause length is not the only criterion for severity; symptoms and whether an escape beat occurs are equally critical.
阴性不能完全排除。: A negative result cannot completely exclude it.
陈旧期（数周至数月后）：ST 段回到基线，T 波可恢复正常或持续倒置，遗留病理性: Old stage (weeks to months later): the ST segment returns to baseline, the T wave may normalize or remain inverted, leaving pathologic Q waves or QS waves. Q waves do not always represent transmural necrosis; correlate with imaging and history.
除极朝向电极为正，复极方向相反；T 波通常与 QRS 同向。: Depolarization toward an electrode is positive; repolarization proceeds in the opposite direction; the T wave is usually concordant with QRS.
除颤每延迟 1 分钟，生存率下降约 7–10%。: Each 1-minute delay in defibrillation reduces survival by about 7–10%.
隐匿表现：P 埋在前一 T 波上，T 波变尖、出现切迹或不对称。: Concealed manifestation: P buried in the preceding T wave; the T wave becomes peaked, notched, or asymmetric.
需与 STEMI、早期复极、Takotsubo 心肌病鉴别。: Differentiate from STEMI, early repolarization, and Takotsubo cardiomyopathy.
需与干扰性房室分离鉴别：后者常发生于室速，P 率低于 QRS 率。: Needs differentiation from interference AV dissociation: the latter often occurs in ventricular tachycardia, with a P rate lower than the QRS rate.
预激 delta 波方向、室早 QRS 形态、房速 P 波轴可提示起源；消融成功: Direction of pre-excitation delta wave, PVC QRS morphology, and atrial tachycardia P-wave axis can suggest origin; after successful ablation pre-excitation disappears and PVCs disappear.
预激合并房颤时使用 Adenosine/房室结阻滞剂可能加速旁路传导。: In pre-excitation with atrial fibrillation, Adenosine/AV nodal blockers may accelerate accessory pathway conduction.
预激合并房颤：避免单纯房室结阻滞剂，需紧急电复律或普罗帕酮/胺碘酮等专科处理。: Pre-excitation with atrial fibrillation: avoid AV nodal blockers alone; urgent electrical cardioversion or specialized management with propafenone/amiodarone is needed.
频率 60–100 次/分的交界性节律应称加速性交界性心律，不能与逸搏心律混用。: A junctional rhythm at 60–100 bpm should be called accelerated junctional rhythm and should not be used interchangeably with escape rhythm.
频率 >100–110 次/分且持续存在时考虑室速；频率 <50 次/分为室性逸: Consider VT when rate is >100–110 bpm and persistent; rate <50 bpm is ventricular escape.
额面电轴 −45°～−90°，加 I、aVL 的 qR 与 II、III、aVF: Frontal axis −45° to −90°, plus qR in I and aVL and rS in II, III, and aVF, plus QRS <0.12 s and aVL R peak time ≥45 ms; mild left axis deviation of 0 to −30° alone does not establish the diagnosis.
额面电轴是 QRS 主向量在额面的方向；先用 I 与 aVF 判断象限，再用 I: The frontal plane axis is the direction of the main QRS vector in the frontal plane; first use I and aVF to determine the quadrant, then use II to distinguish physiologic left-axis deviation from pathologic left-axis deviation.
食管导联 P 波振幅大、清晰；可测量房室关系、发现隐藏 P 波；对房室结折返与房: Esophageal lead P waves have large amplitude and are clear; can measure AV relationship and reveal hidden P waves; helpful for distinguishing AV nodal reentry from atrial tachycardia.
食管导联有创、患者不适；不能替代标准 12 导联，需在电生理条件下进行。: Esophageal lead is invasive and uncomfortable; it cannot replace standard 12-lead ECG and requires electrophysiology conditions.
骨骼肌电活动频率高、振幅不定，叠加在心电信号上；帕金森震颤可呈 4–6 Hz 节: Skeletal muscle electrical activity is high-frequency and variable in amplitude, superimposed on the ECG signal; Parkinsonian tremor may show a 4–6 Hz rhythm.
高危：女性、低钾/低镁、心动过缓、心衰、基因易感、联合用药；TdP 前可有 QT: High risk: female sex, hypokalemia/hypomagnesemia, bradycardia, heart failure, genetic susceptibility, and concomitant medications; before TdP, QT prolongation and T-U fusion may occur.
高密度图很漂亮，但靶点要靠拖带与起搏确认；图不等于成功。: High-density maps are beautiful, but target sites must be confirmed by entrainment and pacing; a map does not equal success.
高钾 T 波窄而对称；心梗超急性 T 波宽大不对称。: Hyperkalemic T waves are narrow and symmetric; hyperacute T waves in myocardial infarction are broad and asymmetric.
高钾→T 波高尖/QRS 增宽；低钾→U 波/QT 延长；钠通道阻滞→QRS 增: Hyperkalemia → peaked T waves/QRS widening; hypokalemia → U waves/QT prolongation; sodium channel blockade → QRS widening.
高钾可导致宽 QRS 心动过缓/正弦波，需查血钾。: Hyperkalemia can cause wide-QRS bradycardia/sine wave; check serum potassium.
高钾降低静息膜电位、减慢传导，导致 P 波消失、QRS 增宽；心肌兴奋性先高后低: Hyperkalemia lowers resting membrane potential and slows conduction, causing P wave loss and QRS widening; myocardial excitability is first increased then decreased.
高风险手术/已知心脏病/症状者需评估；低风险手术年轻无症状者不常规做 ECG。: High-risk surgery/known heart disease/symptoms require evaluation; low-risk surgery in young asymptomatic patients does not routinely need ECG.
3 相钾外流增加，细胞复极，形成 T 波。复极顺序从心外膜向心内膜，与除极方向相: Increased potassium efflux during phase 3 repolarizes the cell and forms the T wave. The repolarization sequence runs from epicardium to endocardium, opposite the depolarization direction, so the T wave is usually concordant with the main QRS wave.
22 岁女性，久站后心悸、头晕，躺下缓解；立位心率从 68 升至 108，血压无: 22-year-old woman with palpitations and dizziness after prolonged standing, relieved by lying down; standing heart rate rises from 68 to 108, no significant blood pressure drop.
32 岁男性，心悸、头晕；宽 QRS 不规则心动过速，RR 最短约 220 ms: 32-year-old man with palpitations and dizziness; irregular wide-QRS tachycardia, shortest RR ~220 ms, history of WPW.
35 岁女性，进食后全身荨麻疹、喉紧、低血压；心电图窦速、ST 压低、T 倒置。: Digoxin toxicity can cause slow ventricular rate.
65 岁透析患者，乏力、心悸；心电图 QRS 增宽、P 波消失、正弦波，血钾 7: 65-year-old dialysis patient with fatigue and palpitations; ECG shows widened QRS, absent P waves, sine wave, potassium 7.8 mmol/L.
AH 反映房室结传导，HV 反映希氏-浦肯野传导。: AH reflects AV node conduction; HV reflects His-Purkinje conduction.
AI 是工具，不是替代。: AI is a tool, not a replacement.
AI 是筛查工具，不是诊断。: AI is a screening tool, not diagnosis.
AI 说“低 EF”，下一步是超声，不是直接开药。: If AI says “low EF,” the next step is echocardiography, not directly prescribing medication.
ARVC：右胸 T 倒置 + epsilon + LBBB 型 VT。: V1–V3 T inversion, epsilon wave, terminal QRS delay, right ventricular structural/functional abnormalities; family history and exercise-induced VT.
ASD：右室容量负荷、RBBB；VSD：双室肥厚；TOF：右室肥厚；Ebstei: ASD: right ventricular volume overload, RBBB; VSD: biventricular hypertrophy; TOF: right ventricular hypertrophy; Ebstein: right atrial enlargement, WPW.
Ashman：长-短周期 + RBBB 型宽 QRS。: Ashman: long-short cycle + RBBB-type wide QRS.
Brugada 1 型：穹隆型 ST↑ ≥2 mm + T 倒置，V1–V3。: Brugada type 1: coved ST↑ ≥2 mm + T inversion, V1–V3.
COPD 患者的“奇怪心电图”常是几何与阻抗问题；先看 P 波、电轴与导联位置。: In COPD patients, a 'strange ECG' is often a geometric and impedance issue; first check P waves, axis, and lead position.
COPD：低电压、右偏、右房增大、R 波递增不良。: COPD: low voltage, right axis deviation, right atrial enlargement, poor R wave progression.
CPR 伪差高幅、节律性。: CPR artifact is high-amplitude and rhythmic.
CPR 时监护仪再吓人，也先确认患者；伪差最容易被误当成室颤。: During CPR, no matter how alarming the monitor looks, confirm the patient first; artifact is most easily mistaken for ventricular fibrillation (VF).
DDD 的心电图要按“心房事件—AV 间期—心室事件”读；不要只看 QRS。: Read the DDD ECG as “atrial event—AV interval—ventricular event”; do not look only at QRS.
DDD：房室顺序起搏，A 钉→P→V 钉→QRS。: DDD: AV sequential pacing, A spike → P → V spike → QRS.
HCM 可猝死，尤其运动时。: HCM can cause sudden death, especially during exercise.
HCM：高电压、深窄 Q、T 倒置。: HCM: high voltage, deep narrow Q waves, T wave inversion.
ICD 兼具起搏、ATP、除颤。: ICD provides pacing, ATP, and defibrillation.
II、III、aVF 至少两个相邻导联 ST 抬高 ≥1 mm。: ST elevation ≥1 mm in at least two contiguous leads among II, III, aVF.
II 导联 P 波宽度 ≥0.12 s、双峰间距 ≥0.04 s；V1 P 波终: Lead II P wave width ≥0.12 s, interpeak distance ≥0.04 s; V1 P wave terminal negative portion ≥0.04 s × 0.1 mV (P wave terminal force).
II：P 波高尖且增宽。: II: peaked and widened P wave.
IKr 是复极快速成分；LQT2 复极储备下降，交感兴奋时易发生早期后除极。: IKr is the rapid component of repolarization; in LQT2, repolarization reserve is reduced, and early afterdepolarizations are prone to occur during sympathetic activation.
I、aVL、V5、V6 出现宽钝 S 波，S 波时限 >40 ms 或宽于同导联: Wide, slurred S waves in I, aVL, V5, V6, with S wave duration >40 ms or wider than the R wave in the same lead.
I 正、aVF 正为正常；I 正、aVF 负、II 负为电轴左偏；I 负、aVF: I positive, aVF positive is normal; I positive, aVF negative, II negative is left axis deviation; I negative, aVF positive is right axis deviation; I negative, aVF negative is extreme right axis deviation.
I 正向、aVF 负向：电轴左偏；若 II 也负向，超过 −30°，考虑左前分支: Positive in lead I, negative in aVF: left axis deviation; if lead II is also negative, beyond −30°, consider left anterior fascicular block.
J 点抬高 ≥0.1 mV、ST 凹面向上、J 波切迹；高危特征：J 波高、下壁: J-point elevation ≥0.1 mV, concave upward ST segment, J-wave notch; high-risk features: prominent J wave, inferior leads, syncope/family history of sudden death.
LBBB QRS 宽但 PR 正常，无 delta 波。: LBBB has wide QRS but normal PR, no delta wave.
LQT1 患者不能用“没有晕厥”排除风险；运动前评估与治疗很重要。: LQT1 patients cannot be considered low risk by the absence of syncope; pre-exercise evaluation and treatment are important.
LQT3 与 LQT1/2 的诱因不同；不能统一用运动诱发来筛查。: LQT3 triggers differ from LQT1/2; exercise provocation cannot be used uniformly for screening.
LVH 电压标准只是筛查，超声/心脏 MRI 才是确诊。: LVH voltage criteria are only for screening; echocardiography/cardiac MRI is required for diagnosis.
Mahaim 易被误认为 RBBB 或室速；宽 QRS 心动过速伴 LBBB 形: Mahaim is easily mistaken for RBBB or ventricular tachycardia; consider it in wide QRS tachycardia with LBBB morphology.
NSTEMI 常表现为 ST 段水平/下斜型压低、T 波倒置或动态改变；诊断需结: NSTEMI often presents with horizontal/downsloping ST-segment depression, T-wave inversion, or dynamic changes; diagnosis requires integration of troponin and clinical findings.
PMT：起搏钉 + 宽 QRS 心动过速。: PMT: pacing spike + wide QRS tachycardia.
PR 延长先想房室结；QRS 增宽先想束支/浦肯野或心室肌起源。: PR prolongation: think AV node first; QRS widening: think bundle branch/Purkinje or ventricular myocardial origin first.
P′-R 间期通常 ≥0.12 s，后跟 QRS；QRS 多数窄。: P′-R interval is usually ≥0.12 s, followed by QRS; QRS is mostly narrow.
P′ 常隐藏在前的 T 波中，只看 QRS 会把房早误判为窦性心律不齐。: P′ is often hidden in the preceding T wave; looking only at the QRS can misdiagnose a PAC as sinus arrhythmia.
P 与 QRS 无固定关系、心室率 > 心房率、可见 P 波逐渐“穿行”；常见于: No fixed relationship between P and QRS, ventricular rate > atrial rate, P waves may be seen gradually "marching through"; commonly seen in VT and junctional tachycardia.
P 波为窦性形态，每个 P 后均有 QRS，PR 间期基本恒定。: According to this site’s course, which topic does the following description best fit? RR intervals gradually lengthen and shorten with respiration, but every P wave is sinus and PR is fixed.
QRS ≥0.12 s，I、V5、V6 出现宽钝 R 且无 q 波，V1 呈深: QRS ≥0.12 s, broad slurred R in I, V5, V6 without q waves, deep S in V1, ST-T opposite to the main QRS deflection.
QRS 多窄；伴差异性传导或原有束支阻滞时可宽。: QRS is usually narrow; it may be wide with aberrant conduction or preexisting bundle branch block.
QTc 延长、T 波宽大/双峰；运动或情绪激动诱发晕厥/室颤；家族史常见。: QTc prolongation, broad/bifid T waves; syncope/ventricular fibrillation induced by exercise or emotional stress; family history is common.
QTc 延长、T 波异常、家族猝死史；新生儿筛查可发现部分高危者。: Surgical scars and patches form reentrant circuits; conduction system injury causes AV block.
QTc 显著延长、T 波晚而尖；睡眠/静息时晕厥/猝死；心率慢时风险更高。: Marked QTc prolongation, late and peaked T waves; syncope/sudden death during sleep/rest; higher risk at slow heart rates.
QTc 显著延长、反复晕厥、家族猝死史。: Marked QTc prolongation, recurrent syncope, family history of sudden death.
QT 一定要校正心率；看到 U 波先分清 T 与 U。: QT must be corrected for heart rate; when a U wave is seen, first distinguish T from U.
QT 延长 + 低钾 + 多种药物，是 TdP 的温床；先停罪魁、补镁钾。: Prolonged QT + hypokalemia + multiple drugs is a breeding ground for TdP; first stop the culprit, replace magnesium and potassium.
QT 间期缩短，ST 段缩短，T 波形态多正常。: Shortened QT interval, shortened ST segment, T wave morphology mostly normal.
QT 间期缩短，T 波低平或倒置。: Shortened QT interval, flattened or inverted T waves.
RBBB：V1 rsR′、V6 宽钝 S；LBBB：V1 QS/rS、V6 宽: RBBB: V1 rsR′, V6 wide slurred S; LBBB: V1 QS/rS, V6 wide R, no q. QRS ≥120 ms in both.
RR 变异伴随长间歇 >2.5–3 s、晕厥或黑矇。: RR variation accompanied by long pauses >2.5–3 s, syncope, or amaurosis fugax.
RR 间期绝对不规则（除非伴完全性房室阻滞或起搏心律）。: RR intervals are absolutely irregular (unless accompanied by complete AV block or a paced rhythm).
RVH：V1 高 R + 电轴右偏 + 右胸劳损。: RVH: tall R in V1 + right axis deviation + right precordial strain.
RVH：电轴右偏 + 右房增大 + 右胸劳损。: RVH: right axis deviation + right atrial enlargement + right precordial strain.
RVH：电轴右偏、右房增大、右胸劳损。: RVH: right axis deviation, right atrial enlargement, right precordial strain.
R 波递增不良指 V1–V4 R 波不能逐渐增高，可见于前壁心梗、左室肥厚、肺气: Poor R-wave progression means R waves in V1–V4 fail to progressively increase; it can be seen in anterior MI, LVH, emphysema, or too-high lead placement.
S1Q3T3 不特异，右心负荷更重要。: S1Q3T3 is nonspecific; right heart strain is more important.
S1Q3T3：I 导联深 S 波、III 导联 Q 波与 T 波倒置。: S1Q3T3: deep S wave in lead I, Q wave and T-wave inversion in lead III.
SIDS 是排除性诊断；不能把所有婴儿猝死都归为长 QT。: QTc prolongation, T-wave abnormalities, family history of sudden death; newborn screening can identify some high-risk individuals.
ST-T 改变可为脑心综合征。: ST-T changes may be brain-heart syndrome.
ST 抬高的相邻导联指向梗死部位，镜像压低帮助确认；V1–V3 压低伴高 R、直: ST-elevated adjacent leads point to the infarct site, and reciprocal depression helps confirm; ST depression in V1–V3 with tall R and upright T suggests posterior involvement; add V7–V9 and V3R–V5R to form an 18-lead ECG.
ST 段偏移是损伤电流的体表投影，必须结合相邻导联。: ST-segment shift is the body surface projection of injury current and must be interpreted with adjacent leads.
TCA：QRS 宽 + aVR R 高。: TCA: wide QRS + tall aVR R wave.
T 波高尖→P 消失→QRS 增宽→正弦波。: Peaked T waves → loss of P waves → QRS widening → sine wave.
T 波高尖、对称、基底窄，常见于 V2–V4；血钾 5.5–6.5 mmol/L: Tall, symmetric, narrow-based T waves, commonly in V2–V4; most typical at serum potassium 5.5–6.5 mmol/L.
V1 深 S、V5/V6 高 R，QRS 可增宽，但通常没有宽钝 S 与 R′。: Deep S in V1 and tall R in V5/V6; QRS may be widened, but there is usually no wide, slurred S wave or R′.
V1 高 R、V6 深 S 常见。: Tall R in V1 and deep S in V6 are common.
V1 高 R 的鉴别要结合电轴、右房增大、ST-T 与临床；单导联永远不够。: Differentiating a tall R in V1 requires combining axis, right atrial enlargement, ST-T changes, and clinical context; a single lead is never enough.
V1 高 R：RVH、后壁 MI、WPW、RBBB。: Tall R in V1: RVH, posterior MI, WPW, RBBB.
V1/V2：P 波终末负向深而宽，提示左房增大。: V1/V2: deep and wide terminal negative P wave suggests left atrial enlargement.
V1–V2 穹隆型 ST 抬高 + T 倒置。: Coved-type ST elevation in V1–V2 + T-wave inversion.
V1–V3 穹隆型 ST 抬高，但无镜像改变与心肌损伤标志物升高。: V1–V3 coved ST elevation, but no reciprocal changes and no elevation of myocardial injury markers.
V1–V3 穹隆型 ST 段抬高 ≥2 mm，伴 T 波倒置；发热/药物可诱发，: V1–V3 coved ST-segment elevation ≥2 mm with T-wave inversion; fever/drugs can induce it, with risk of sudden death.
V5/V6 高 R 加 V1 深 S，QRS 多 <0.12 s，ST-T 改变: Tall R in V5/V6 plus deep S in V1, QRS mostly <0.12 s, ST-T changes are strain pattern.
V7–V9 置于左后背，后壁 STEMI 表现为这些导联 ST 抬高；常规 12: V7–V9 are placed on the left back; posterior STEMI shows ST elevation in these leads; standard 12-lead may show only ST depression in V1–V3, increased R waves, and upright T waves.
VVI 的“钉 + 宽 QRS”是夺获；只有钉没有 QRS 是失夺获，必须立即处: In VVI, “spike + wide QRS” is capture; spike without QRS is failure to capture and must be managed immediately.
VVI：心室起搏、心室感知、抑制。: VVI: ventricular pacing, ventricular sensing, inhibition.
VVI：钉后宽 QRS，LBBB 样。: VVI: wide QRS after spike, LBBB-like.
aVR P 直立是错接线索。: Upright P in aVR is a misconnection clue.
aVR 抬高 + 广泛压低→左主干/多支。: aVR elevation + widespread depression → left main/multivessel disease.
一个窦性搏动后跟一个室早，周而复始；成对出现时听诊可似“二音律”。: One sinus beat followed by one PVC, repeating; when they occur in pairs, auscultation may resemble a “two-tone rhythm.”
一度房室阻滞通常不需要起搏，除非 PR 极度延长并引起明显血流动力学症状，或合并: First-degree AV block usually does not require pacing unless the PR is extremely prolonged and causes significant hemodynamic symptoms, or other pacing indications coexist. Second-degree type I is mostly located in the AV node; if asymptomatic and reversible factors are clear, observation can be done first; but if symptoms appear or it progresses, reassess.
一度：PR>0.20 s，无脱落。: First degree: PR >0.20 s, no dropped beats.
一线治疗：NSAID（布洛芬 600 mg 每 8 小时，或阿司匹林 750–1: First-line treatment: NSAIDs (ibuprofen 600 mg every 8 hours, or aspirin 750–1000 mg every 8 hours) plus colchicine 0.5 mg twice daily (once daily for body weight <70 kg), for 3 months, with gastric mucosal protection.
三导联监护常选择 II、V1 与改良 V5；II 导联对 P 波和节律友好，V1: Three-lead monitoring often uses II, V1, and modified V5; lead II is favorable for P waves and rhythm, and V1 helps with SVT and PVC morphology.
三度阻滞有规律的窦性 P 与 QRS 分离；室性逸搏心律是心室被动替代，P 可缺: Third-degree block has regular sinus P waves with AV dissociation from QRS; ventricular escape rhythm is passive ventricular replacement, and P waves may be absent.
下壁 STEMI 伴低血压、肺清时应加做 V4R 评估右室梗死；V1–V3 ST: Inferior STEMI with hypotension and clear lungs should add V4R to assess RV infarction; ST depression in V1–V3 with upright T waves should raise suspicion of posterior infarction.
下壁心梗不是“只做 12 导联”就结束；临床不稳定时，扩展导联能改变处理方向。: Inferior MI does not end with 12-lead only; when clinically unstable, extended leads can change management direction.
下壁心梗出现深 Q 波时，平均向量向上偏移，也可造成电轴左偏；需结合 ST-T: When inferior MI has deep Q waves, the mean vector shifts upward and can also cause left axis deviation; correlate with ST-T and history.
下壁：II、III、aVF；常伴 I、aVL 镜像压低。: Inferior: II, III, aVF; often with reciprocal depression in I, aVL.
不要仅凭“ST 抬高”诊断 STEMI；也不要仅凭“年轻”忽略持续胸痛与危险因素: Do not diagnose STEMI based solely on ST elevation; do not ignore persistent chest pain and risk factors based solely on young age.
不要只凭“心率 <60”诊断病态窦房结综合征；运动员与睡眠中的 40–50 次/: Interpretation steps for “Sinus Bradycardia”: Confirm P wave morphology and the P-QRS relationship, and exclude AV block.
不要把早期复极一律当良性，也不要一律当高危；结合症状、家族史与动态变化。: Do not treat early repolarization uniformly as benign or uniformly as high risk; correlate with symptoms, family history, and dynamic changes.
不要根据消费级设备的“房颤”提示直接启动抗凝；需 12 导联或专业监测确认。: Do not start anticoagulation directly based on an “AF” alert from a consumer-grade device; confirmation with 12-lead ECG or professional monitoring is needed.
不要用单个导联振幅代替电轴；看净面积/主波方向。: Do not use the amplitude of a single lead instead of the axis; look at net area/dominant deflection direction.
与二度房室阻滞的区别：房早的 P 波提前且形态异常。: Difference from second-degree AV block: the P wave of a PAC is premature and abnormal in morphology.
与旧图对比判断新旧；新发 RBBB 伴胸痛、呼吸困难或术后状态，临床意义与慢性: Compare with old ECGs to determine new versus old; new-onset RBBB with chest pain, dyspnea, or postoperative status has completely different clinical significance from chronic RBBB.
与旧图对比并动态复查；单次“正常”心电图不能排除早期心肌梗死。: Compare with old ECGs and repeat dynamically; a single 'normal' ECG cannot exclude early myocardial infarction.
与运动同步的高幅不规则波。: High-amplitude irregular waves synchronous with movement.
两个起搏点频率相近但独立，形成“看似有关系、实际分离”的现象。: Two pacemakers with similar rates but independent, creating a phenomenon that “appears related but is actually dissociated.”
严重低钙增加神经肌肉兴奋性，引起手足抽搐、喉痉挛、癫痫；也可延长 QT 致尖端扭: Severe hypocalcemia increases neuromuscular excitability, causing tetany, laryngeal spasm, and seizures; it can also prolong QT and cause torsades de pointes.
严重高钾正弦波、预激伴极快房颤。: Severe hyperkalemic sine wave, pre-excitation with very fast AF.
主动脉夹层累及心包可表现为心包炎或填塞，漏诊后果严重。: Aortic dissection involving the pericardium can present as pericarditis or tamponade; missed diagnosis has serious consequences.
事件记录器由患者触发记录，植入式循环记录器（ILR）连续记录并自动/手动保存，适: Event recorders are patient-triggered for recording; implantable loop recorders (ILRs) record continuously and save automatically/manually, suitable for infrequent paroxysmal syncope.
二度 I 型 PR 渐长后脱漏；二度 II 型 PR 恒定、脱漏突然。: Second-degree Type I: PR gradually lengthens then dropped beat; Second-degree Type II: PR constant with sudden dropped beats.
二度 I 型房室传导阻滞是房室结传导逐渐延迟，PR 间期逐搏延长，直至一个心房冲: Second-degree type I AV block is gradual delay of AV nodal conduction, with the PR interval lengthening beat by beat until one atrial impulse fails to conduct and QRS dropout occurs; then PR shortens and a new cycle begins. The dropout makes the ventricular rate lower than the atrial rate; typical cases show 4:3 or 3:2 conduction, QRS is usually narrow, and it mostly involves intranodal AV block, often related to increased vagal tone or drugs.
二度 I 型有 PR 渐长和 QRS 脱漏；一度每个 P 均下传。: First-degree AV block mechanism: delayed AV nodal conduction is the most common mechanism; increased vagal tone, drugs, and ischemia reduce AV nodal cell depolarization and conduction velocity, prolonging PR.
二级预防：高强度他汀、ACEI/ARB、β 受体阻滞剂、戒烟与心脏康复。: Secondary prevention: high-intensity statin, ACEI/ARB, β-blockers, smoking cessation, and cardiac rehabilitation.
交感加快、迷走减慢；呼吸性心律不齐是生理现象。: Sympathetic activity accelerates and vagal activity slows; respiratory sinus arrhythmia is a physiologic phenomenon.
交感神经提高窦房结自律性并缩短房室结传导时间，迷走神经则相反；因此频率与 PR: Sympathetic nerve increases sinus node automaticity and shortens AV node conduction time; vagal nerve does the opposite; therefore rate and PR interval change dynamically with respiration, exercise, and emotion.
交界区起搏细胞固有频率约 40–60 次/分；冲动沿希氏束-浦肯野系统下传，QR: Intrinsic rate of junctional pacemaker cells is about 40–60 beats/min; impulses conduct down the His-Purkinje system with narrow QRS, and may also conduct retrogradely to the atria to form retrograde P waves.
交界性心律是持续的交界区起搏节律，频率较慢。: Junctional rhythm is a continuous junctional pacing rhythm with a slower rate.
交界性逸搏心律，心室率约 48 次/分，QRS 0.08 s，窦性 P 波消失，: Junctional escape rhythm, ventricular rate about 48 beats/min, QRS 0.08 s, sinus P waves absent, retrograde P waves visible after QRS.
从离子流到体表波形：四层转换缺一不可；任何一层改变都会写在最终曲线上。: From ion currents to body surface waveforms: all four levels of conversion are essential; changes at any level are written on the final tracing.
以治疗病因为主：退热、镇痛、补液、纠正贫血/缺氧、处理甲亢或肺栓塞。: Mainly treat the cause: antipyresis, analgesia, fluid replacement, correct anemia/hypoxia, and manage hyperthyroidism or pulmonary embolism.
伪差常见，需复核。: Artifacts are common and require review.
低电压、肥胖、肺气肿、心包积液会降低振幅，影响电压标准；束支阻滞、起搏、预激会使: Low voltage, obesity, emphysema, and pericardial effusion reduce amplitude and affect voltage criteria; bundle branch block, pacing, and preexcitation complicate QRS/QT measurement.
低血压、颈静脉怒张、肺部清晰，或右心衰表现。: Hypotension, jugular venous distension, clear lungs, or signs of right heart failure.
低血压对补液反应差、颈静脉怒张而肺清晰，提示右室梗死合并休克。: Poor response of hypotension to fluids, jugular venous distension with clear lungs suggests right ventricular infarction with shock.
低钾 QT(U) 延长伴 U 波。: Hypokalemia: QT(U) prolongation with U waves.
体表 ECG 定位是术前地图。: Surface ECG localization is the preoperative map.
体表心电图记录的是大量心肌细胞电活动在体表的电位差：除极波朝向电极产生正向波，背: The surface ECG records the potential difference at the body surface from the electrical activity of a large number of myocardial cells: a depolarization wave toward the electrode produces a positive wave, and away from the electrode produces a negative wave; repolarization direction is opposite.
体表看不到 P 波时，食管导联能把“隐藏的 P”拉到眼前。: When P waves are not visible on the surface ECG, an esophageal lead brings the “hidden P” into view.
使用房室结阻滞剂后心动过速加重或心室率更快。: Tachycardia worsens or ventricular rate increases after AV nodal blockers.
侧壁导联 ST 下斜型压低、T 倒置。: Downsloping ST depression and T wave inversion in lateral leads.
停用延长 QT 的药物，纠正低钾、低镁、低钙。: Stop QT-prolonging drugs; correct hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia, and hypocalcemia.
偶发无症状者无需治疗。: Occasional asymptomatic cases require no treatment.
偶发未下传房早多见于健康人，尤其夜间或迷走张力高时，本身不需要特殊治疗。频发、成: Occasional non-conducted PACs are common in healthy people, especially at night or with high vagal tone, and do not require specific treatment. When frequent, paired, or accompanied by marked symptoms, look for triggers: caffeine, alcohol, sleep deprivation, infection, anemia, hyperthyroidism, electrolyte disturbances, and drugs.
先天性长 QT 与家族筛查: Congenital long QT and family screening
先心病术后可出现传导阻滞/心律失常；需与术前对比。: ASD: right ventricular volume overload, RBBB; VSD: biventricular hypertrophy; TOF: right ventricular hypertrophy; Ebstein: right atrial enlargement, WPW.
先找 P 波，标记其频率与规律性。: First find the P waves and mark their rate and regularity.
先看定标脉冲高度与纸速标记，再看是否有导联错接。: First check calibration pulse height and paper speed marker, then check for lead misconnection.
先计算宽 QRS 的频率：<50 次/分为室性逸搏，50–110 次/分考虑 A: First calculate the wide-QRS rate: <50/min is ventricular escape, 50–110/min consider AIVR, >100/min be alert for VT.
冲动从心室肌到心室肌传导，速度慢且不同步，QRS 宽大畸形；除极与复极顺序异常，: Impulse conducts from ventricular myocardium to ventricular myocardium, slowly and asynchronously, QRS wide and bizarre; abnormal depolarization and repolarization sequence, ST-T opposite to the main QRS vector.
冲动在心室肌细胞间传导速度慢，导致 QRS 宽大畸形，心室除极与复极顺序异常，T: Impulse conduction between ventricular myocardial cells is slow, causing wide bizarre QRS, abnormal ventricular depolarization and repolarization sequence, and T wave direction opposite to the main QRS deflection.
冲动在心室肌间缓慢传导，QRS 宽大畸形；房室分离常见，但约 30% 可有室房逆: Impulse conducts slowly from ventricular myocardium to ventricular myocardium, QRS wide and bizarre; AV dissociation is common, but about 30% may have ventriculoatrial retrograde conduction.
冲动经房室结下传，QRS 多窄；房室结的生理性过滤可形成 2:1 或可变比例传导: The impulse conducts down through the AV node, so QRS is usually narrow; physiological filtering by the AV node can produce 2:1 or variable conduction, making the ventricular rate lower than the atrial rate.
出现宽 QRS、P 波消失或正弦波时按急诊处理。: Treat as an emergency when wide QRS, absent P waves, or sine waves appear.
分层定位：先看 PR，再看 QRS: Layer-by-layer localization: first look at PR, then QRS
分度看 PR 与脱落规律；定位看 QRS 宽度与阻滞类型。: Grade by PR and dropped-beat pattern; localize by QRS width and block type.
判断 QRS 主波方向与 T 波方向是否相反。: Determine whether the main QRS deflection and T wave are in opposite directions.
判断心梗不要只看一张图：把首份心电图当作起点，追踪 ST-T 与 Q 波的动态演: Do not judge MI from one tracing alone: use the first ECG as a starting point and track the dynamic evolution of ST-T and Q waves; culprit-vessel clues come from lead combinations, not the elevation amplitude in a single lead.
判读顺序永远是：定标 → 节律 → 频率 → 间期 → 形态。: Reading order is always: calibration → rhythm → rate → intervals → morphology.
前壁 STEMI 为 ST 抬高而非压低，并伴下壁镜像改变。: Anterior STEMI shows ST elevation rather than depression, with reciprocal changes in inferior leads.
前壁 STEMI 的典型导联分布。: Typical lead distribution of anterior STEMI.
前壁导联抬高、下壁镜像压低，定位与下壁 STEMI 相反。: Anterior lead elevation with reciprocal inferior depression; localization is opposite to inferior STEMI.
动作电位时程与形态决定 QT、T 波和药物反应；钾、钙、钠通道的改变会直接反映在: Action potential duration and morphology determine QT, T wave, and drug response; changes in potassium, calcium, and sodium channels are directly reflected in ST-T and QRS.
动作电位时程（与 QT 间期相关）受心率、血钾/血钙和药物影响：高钾使 T 波高: Action potential duration (related to QT interval) is affected by heart rate, potassium/calcium, and drugs: hyperkalemia causes tall peaked T waves and QRS widening; hypokalemia causes U waves and QT prolongation; drugs affecting repolarization alter T-wave morphology and QT.
动态复查心电图与肌钙蛋白，观察 ST-T 演变与再缺血。: Repeat ECG and troponin dynamically to observe ST-T evolution and recurrent ischemia.
劳损型 ST-T 与 QRS 主波方向相反。: Strain-pattern ST-T changes are opposite in direction to the main QRS deflection.
单导联、运动伪差常见。: Single-lead and motion artifact are common.
危急值包括 STEMI、无脉 VT/VF、三度 AVB 伴长间歇、TdP、严重高: Critical values include STEMI, pulseless VT/VF, third-degree AVB with long pauses, TdP, severe hyperkalemia sine wave, very fast atrial fibrillation with pre-excitation, long QT + syncope, etc.
双分支/三分支阻滞伴晕厥或宽 QRS 三度阻滞需评估起搏。: Bifascicular/trifascicular block with syncope or wide-QRS third-degree block requires assessment for pacing.
双分支阻滞伴晕厥者评估起搏器；无症状的双分支阻滞不常规起搏。: Evaluate for pacemaker in bifascicular block with syncope; asymptomatic bifascicular block does not routinely require pacing.
双室起搏钉后 QRS 变窄。: QRS narrows after biventricular pacing spike.
反复低氧与迷走张力增高导致夜间心动过缓/停搏；交感激活与胸腔压力变化促发房颤。: Recurrent hypoxia and increased vagal tone cause nocturnal bradycardia/pauses; sympathetic activation and changes in intrathoracic pressure promote AF.
发作前后可见 QT/QTc 延长，常有长-短周期启动现象。: QT/QTc prolongation may be seen before and after episodes, often with long-short cycle initiation.
只看一次脱漏就诊断，未确认 PR 逐搏延长。: Diagnosing based on a single dropped beat without confirming beat-by-beat PR lengthening.
只诊断下壁梗死而不加做 V4R，漏掉右室受累。: Diagnosing only inferior infarction without adding V4R misses right ventricular involvement.
可伴 AVRT 发作（窄 QRS 或宽 QRS 逆向型）。: May be accompanied by AVRT episodes (narrow QRS or wide QRS antidromic type).
右室梗死与后壁梗死常同源于右冠，附加导联一起评估。: Right ventricular and posterior infarction often originate from the right coronary artery; evaluate together with additional leads.
右室梗死：快速补液维持前负荷，避免硝酸酯、利尿剂与吗啡；必要时加用正性肌力药。: Right ventricular infarction: rapid fluid resuscitation to maintain preload; avoid nitrates, diuretics, and morphine; add inotropes if necessary.
右室：下壁梗死 + 低血压/右心衰表现，加做 V4R。: Right ventricle: inferior infarction + hypotension/right heart failure signs; add V4R.
右房增大→下壁 P 波高尖。: Right atrial enlargement → peaked P waves in inferior leads.
右房增大：下壁导联 P 高尖 ≥2.5 mm。: Right atrial enlargement: peaked P wave ≥2.5 mm in inferior leads.
右臂/左腿反接：II/III 互换，假性下壁改变。: Right arm/left leg reversal: II/III swapped, pseudo-inferior changes.
合并 RBBB 时 QRS ≥0.12 s，称为双分支阻滞，需评估房室传导风险。: With RBBB, QRS ≥0.12 s, called bifascicular block; assess risk of atrioventricular conduction.
合并房室阻滞、室速或室颤，提示大面积缺血与高风险。: Combined AV block, VT, or VF suggests large-area ischemia and high risk.
同一导联 P 波形态 ≥3 种、PP 间期不等、心率不快；QRS 多窄。: In the same lead, ≥3 P-wave morphologies, unequal PP intervals, and rate not fast; QRS is usually narrow.
同一导联可见两种形态/频率的 P 波，部分 P 后无 QRS；需与房扑/房颤、伪: In the same lead, P waves of two morphologies/rates may be seen, with no QRS after some P waves; differentiate from atrial flutter/atrial fibrillation and artifact.
同时纠正低镁（硫酸镁），否则低钾难以纠正。: Correct hypomagnesemia (magnesium sulfate) at the same time; otherwise hypokalemia is difficult to correct.
后壁位于心脏后方，标准 12 导联没有直接面向它的电极。后壁损伤向量背离 V1–: The posterior wall lies behind the heart, and the standard 12 leads have no electrode directly facing it. Posterior injury vectors point away from V1–V3, so these three leads show ST depression, increased R wave, and upright T wave; this triad is more specific than ST depression alone.
哮喘 + SVT，先迷走；需要腺苷时备好沙丁胺醇，别在没监护的地方推。: Asthma + SVT: vagal first; if adenosine is needed, have salbutamol ready and do not push it in an unmonitored setting.
回旋支：I、aVL、V5、V6；下壁导联 II>III；后壁受累常见。: Circumflex: I, aVL, V5, V6; inferior leads II>III; posterior involvement is common.
在 II、III、aVF 寻找 P 波，并对照 aVR；QRS 终末的细小切迹或: Look for P waves in II, III, aVF and compare with aVR; small notches or pseudo-s waves at the end of QRS may be retrograde P waves.
在 V2–V3 观察 T 波与 U 波，注意 U 波是否高于 T 波。: Observe T waves and U waves in V2–V3, noting whether the U wave is taller than the T wave.
基础窦性心律，约 64 次/分，记录中段 P 波消失 2.6 s，间歇与 PP: Baseline sinus rhythm, about 64 beats/min; in the middle of the recording, P waves disappear for 2.6 s; the pause is not an integer multiple of the PP interval, consistent with sinus arrest.
复极主要由钾通道完成。与心室肌不同，窦房结动作电位没有明显的 1 相和 2 相平: Repolarization is mainly accomplished by potassium channels. Unlike ventricular myocardium, the sinus node action potential lacks prominent phase 1 and phase 2 plateaus, so its response to sodium channel blockers also differs.
复极钾通道功能增强使动作电位时程缩短、复极离散增加，易形成折返。: Enhanced repolarizing potassium channel function shortens action potential duration and increases repolarization dispersion, predisposing to reentry.
多形性 VT/尖端扭转：纠正 QT 延长因素，静脉硫酸镁，必要时超速起搏/除颤；: Polymorphic VT/torsades de pointes: correct factors prolonging QT, IV magnesium sulfate, overdrive pacing/defibrillation if necessary; asynchronous defibrillation for unstable patients.
多形性宽 QRS 心动过速，QRS 振幅围绕基线周期性扭转，符合尖端扭转型室速；: Polymorphic wide QRS tachycardia with QRS amplitude periodically twisting around the baseline, consistent with torsades de pointes; correlate with QT and electrolytes.
大面积肺栓塞、右心功能不全或心脏骤停。: Massive pulmonary embolism, right heart dysfunction, or cardiac arrest.
夺获搏动易被误认为早搏；看前面有无 P 与 PR 关系。: Premature narrow QRS complexes (preceded by P waves with appropriate PR) in the setting of a wide QRS escape rhythm suggest capture; capture beats indicate AV conduction is not completely interrupted.
女性、左室肥厚、洋地黄、低钾可导致假阳性；运动试验阴性也不能完全排除冠心病。: Female sex, left ventricular hypertrophy, digitalis, and hypokalemia can cause false positives; a negative exercise test cannot completely exclude coronary heart disease.
定位前先排除左束支阻滞、预激、心室起搏、左室肥厚与心包炎等会改变 ST-T 的图: Before localization, exclude patterns that alter ST-T, such as left bundle branch block, preexcitation, ventricular pacing, left ventricular hypertrophy, and pericarditis; then judge with symptoms, troponin, and dynamic evolution.
室性并行心律是独立心室起搏点受保护性传入阻滞，按固定频率发放；联律间期多变，可见: Ventricular parasystole is an independent ventricular pacemaker protected by entrance block, firing at a fixed rate; coupling intervals vary, and fusion beats may be seen.
室性期前收缩是心室肌或浦肯野系统异位起搏点提前放电，冲动不经正常希氏束-浦肯野系: Premature ventricular contraction is an ectopic focus in the ventricular myocardium or Purkinje system discharging early; the impulse does not conduct synchronously through the normal His-Purkinje system, causing a wide, bizarre QRS and secondary ST-T changes.
室速起源于心室，QRS 宽大；室上速伴束支阻滞或差异性传导也可宽。: VT originates from the ventricles with a wide QRS; SVT with bundle branch block or aberrant conduction can also be wide.
家族筛查与避免 QT 延长药物。: Family screening and avoidance of QT-prolonging drugs.
宽 QRS 前有 P；与心率相关。: Wide QRS in atrial fibrillation is not necessarily a PVC; first look for a long-short cycle, which may be Ashman.
宽 QRS 心动过速先按室速处理；Brugada 四步法帮助区分室速与室上速伴差: Wide QRS tachycardia is first managed as ventricular tachycardia; the Brugada four-step method helps distinguish ventricular tachycardia from supraventricular tachycardia with aberrant conduction.
宽 QRS 心动过速：先当室速，除非有确凿证据排除。: Wide QRS tachycardia: assume VT first unless conclusively excluded.
宽 QRS 心动过速：先按室速处理，除非有确凿证据排除。: Wide QRS tachycardia: manage as VT first unless there is conclusive evidence to exclude it.
宽 QRS 节律，心室率约 84 次/分，QRS 0.14 s，未见 P 波，T: Wide QRS rhythm, ventricular rate about 84 bpm, QRS 0.14 s, no P waves, T wave opposite to the main QRS direction, consistent with accelerated idioventricular rhythm.
宽 QRS 逸搏背景下出现提前的窄 QRS（前面有 P、PR 合适），提示夺获；: A premature narrow QRS (preceded by P wave with appropriate PR) in the background of wide QRS escape beats suggests capture; capture beats can indicate that AV conduction is not completely interrupted.
对关键间期用多个导联、多个搏动复核。: Recheck key intervals using multiple leads and multiple beats.
寻找可逆病因：缺血、低钾/高钾、低体温、药物、触电。: Look for reversible causes: ischemia, hypokalemia/hyperkalemia, hypothermia, drugs, electric shock.
寻找突然脱漏的 P 波，比较脱漏前后的 PR。: Look for suddenly non-conducted P waves and compare PR before and after the drop.
寻找诱因：贫血、感染、快速心律失常、低血压、药物依从性差。: Identify triggers: anemia, infection, tachyarrhythmia, hypotension, poor medication adherence.
导联与病因也能提供方向：下壁心肌梗死常累及房室结动脉，出现一度或二度 I 型阻滞: Leads and etiology can also provide direction: inferior myocardial infarction often involves the AV node artery, causing first-degree or second-degree type I block, most of which can recover as ischemia improves; anterior myocardial infarction involves the interventricular septum and bundle branch system, more often causing second-degree type II or third-degree block and a worse prognosis.
导联位置错误可制造假性抬高或压低，复查时标记电极位置。: Incorrect lead position can create pseudo-elevation or pseudo-depression; mark electrode positions when rechecking.
小儿自主神经调节未成熟，血管迷走性晕厥常见；心脏性原因虽少但危险。: Pediatric autonomic regulation is immature, and vasovagal syncope is common; cardiac causes are rare but dangerous.
屏气试验只能辅助，不能替代对 P 波形态的逐搏确认。: The breath-holding test is only adjunctive and cannot replace beat-by-beat confirmation of P-wave morphology.
左前分支细长，由左前降支的间隔支供血，位于左室流出道前上方，容易受到前壁缺血、纤: The left anterior fascicle is long and thin, supplied by septal branches of the left anterior descending artery, located anterior and superior to the left ventricular outflow tract, and vulnerable to injury from anterior ischemia, fibrosis, and mechanical stretch.
左前分支阻滞是病理性左偏的常见原因。: Left anterior fascicular block is a common cause of pathologic left axis deviation.
左前分支阻滞（LAFB）：电轴左偏（约 −45° 至 −90°），I/aVL q: Left anterior fascicular block (LAFB): left axis deviation (about −45° to −90°), qR in I/aVL, rS in II/III/aVF, QRS usually <120 ms. Left posterior fascicular block (LPFB): right axis deviation, rS in I/aVL, qR in II/III/aVF; exclude right ventricular hypertrophy and lateral infarction.
左右臂反接时 I 导联 P/QRS/T 全部倒置，aVR 与 aVL 互换；右臂: With left/right arm reversal, P/QRS/T in lead I are all inverted, and aVR and aVL are swapped; right arm/left leg reversal can cause II and III to swap.
左室电压增高（S V1 + R V5/V6 ≥35 mm），可伴侧壁 ST 压低: Left ventricular voltage increase (S V1 + R V5/V6 ≥35 mm), may be accompanied by lateral ST depression and T-wave inversion (strain pattern).
左室肥厚、预激、下壁起搏均可模拟 LAFB 图形。: Left ventricular hypertrophy, pre-excitation, and inferior pacing can all mimic the LAFB pattern.
希氏束穿过纤维三角后分为左、右束支。右束支细长，易受右室压力负荷影响；左束支分为: The bundle of His passes through the fibrous triangle and then divides into the left and right bundle branches. The right bundle branch is long and thin and is susceptible to right ventricular pressure overload; the left bundle branch divides into anterior and posterior fascicles, forming the anatomical basis of left anterior/left posterior fascicular block.
常伴 II、III、aVF 镜像性 ST 压低；aVR ST 抬高提示左主干或前: Often accompanied by reciprocal ST depression in II, III, aVF; ST elevation in aVR suggests left main or proximal LAD disease.
常见为单导联 I 或类似导联，P 波可能不明显；房颤检测依赖 RR 不规则与 P: Commonly a single lead I or similar lead; P waves may be inconspicuous; AF detection relies on irregular RR intervals and absent P waves.
常见报警：导线阻抗异常、电池耗竭、房颤负荷增加、ICD 放电、心衰指标变化；需结: Common alarms: abnormal lead impedance, battery depletion, increased AF burden, ICD shocks, and changes in heart failure metrics; clinical follow-up is needed.
干扰性房室分离不是三度 AVB；三度 AVB 通常心房率 > 心室率，且有传导系: No fixed relationship between P and QRS, ventricular rate > atrial rate, and P waves seen gradually “marching through”; common in VT and junctional tachycardia.
年轻人久站心悸、躺下就好，别只开安定；量一下立卧位心率。: Young people with palpitations on prolonged standing that resolve lying down: don't just prescribe diazepam; measure supine and standing heart rate.
年轻人运动时宽 QRS 心动过速 + V1–V3 T 倒置，要想到 ARVC。: In a young person, wide QRS tachycardia during exercise + V1–V3 T-wave inversion should raise suspicion of ARVC.
年轻运动员晕厥 + 高电压 + 深 Q 波，必须想到 HCM，不能只当作“运动员: In a young athlete with syncope + high voltage + deep Q waves, HCM must be considered; do not just treat it as 'athlete's heart'.
并行心律需长条图测量；不要因“室早很多”直接射频消融，需明确机制。: Parasystole requires long rhythm strips for measurement; do not proceed directly to radiofrequency ablation because of “many PVCs”; clarify the mechanism.
广泛 ST 压低伴 aVR 抬高，提示左主干/多支病变。: Widespread ST depression with aVR elevation suggests left main/multivessel disease.
延长监测/ILR。: 45-year-old male, sudden hemiparesis; sinus rhythm, 24-hour Holter showed no AF, normal ultrasound.
异位灶周围有传入阻滞，窦性冲动不能重置它；它按自己的频率发放，竞争心室。: An entrance block surrounds the ectopic focus, so sinus impulses cannot reset it; it fires at its own rate and competes for the ventricles.
心内电图定位最早激动点。: Intracardiac electrograms locate the earliest activation site.
心室异位灶以固定联律间期反复提前放电，形成二联律。: A ventricular ectopic focus repeatedly fires early at a fixed coupling interval, forming bigeminy.
心室率 <40 次/分、长间歇 >3 s、晕厥或低血压。: Ventricular rate <40 beats/min, long pause >3 s, syncope, or hypotension.
心室率约 32 次/分的宽 QRS 节律，QRS 0.16 s，P 波缺失，T: Wide QRS rhythm with ventricular rate about 32 beats/min, QRS 0.16 s, absent P waves, T waves opposite to the main QRS vector, suggesting ventricular escape rhythm.
心室率过快或血流动力学不稳定（低血压、胸痛、心衰、意识改变）。: Ventricular rate too fast or hemodynamic instability (hypotension, chest pain, heart failure, altered consciousness).
心悸的评估先区分规则/不规则、突发突止/渐进、有无血流动力学不稳定；心电图/动态: Evaluation of palpitations first distinguishes regular/irregular, sudden onset and termination/gradual, and presence or absence of hemodynamic instability; ECG/ambulatory monitoring is central.
心房分离是罕见诊断；先排除导联伪差、房扑/房颤与多源性房速。: Atrial dissociation is a rare diagnosis; first exclude lead artifact, atrial flutter/atrial fibrillation, and multifocal atrial tachycardia.
心房壁同样受炎症累及，心房复极异常产生 PR 段偏移：II、aVF、V4–V6: The atrial wall is also involved by inflammation; abnormal atrial repolarization produces PR-segment deviation: depression in II, aVF, V4–V6 and elevation in aVR.
心房多个异位灶竞争，常与心房牵张、缺氧、低钾/低镁、茶碱有关。: Multiple atrial ectopic foci compete; often related to atrial stretch, hypoxia, hypokalemia/hypomagnesemia, and theophylline.
心房率高于心室率，常见 4:3、3:2 或 5:4 传导。: Atrial rate higher than ventricular rate, commonly 4:3, 3:2, or 5:4 conduction.
心电向量、波形与导联理论: Cardiac vectors, waveforms, and lead theory
心电图“电轴右偏 + I 倒置 + aVR 直立”，先看左右臂导联是不是反了。: ECG shows “right axis deviation + inverted lead I + upright aVR”: first check whether the left and right arm leads are reversed.
心电图报告怎么写: How to write an ECG report
心电图是“电的投影”，超声是“结构的尺子”；两者不能互相替代。: ECG is the “electrical projection,” echo is the “ruler of structure”; the two cannot replace each other.
心电图能告诉你去哪一间房，心内标测告诉你敲哪一扇门。: ECG tells you which chamber to go to; intracardiac mapping tells you which door to knock on.
心肌肌钙蛋白动态升高，符合急性心肌梗死定义。: Dynamic elevation of cardiac troponin is consistent with the definition of acute myocardial infarction.
忽略高钾、药物和缺血等可逆病因，只考虑永久起搏。: Ignoring reversible causes such as hyperkalemia, drugs, and ischemia and considering only permanent pacing.
怀疑 PE 时心电图是“辅助”，不是“排除工具”；别因 ECG 正常延误 CTP: When PE is suspected, ECG is supportive, not a rule-out tool; do not delay CTPA because the ECG is normal.
急性下壁 ST 段抬高型心肌梗死多由右冠状动脉或回旋支急性闭塞引起，心电图上 I: Acute inferior ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction is mostly caused by acute occlusion of the right coronary artery or circumflex artery; on ECG, ST-segment elevation appears in contiguous leads II, III, aVF, often with reciprocal depression in I, aVL, and may be complicated by right ventricular infarction and AV block. Early risk of inferior MI is closely related to right ventricular involvement, hypotension, and bradyarrhythmias.
急性下壁心梗合并房室阻滞多为房室结缺血，常可恢复；前壁心梗合并宽 QRS 的三度: Acute inferior MI with AV block is mostly due to AV node ischemia and is often reversible; anterior MI with wide-QRS third-degree block suggests extensive His-Purkinje system necrosis and a worse prognosis. Specific pacing and drug decisions must be made by clinicians based on symptoms, block site, and reversible factors.
急性缺血与再灌注使心室浦肯野纤维自律性增高，超过窦房结频率，形成加速性室性节律。: Acute ischemia and reperfusion increase automaticity of ventricular Purkinje fibers above the sinus node rate, producing an accelerated ventricular rhythm.
恢复窦性后逐渐正常。: Gradually normalizes after return to sinus rhythm.
感知不足的危险不在“钉多”，而在“钉落在易损期”；有症状时需立即处理。: The danger of undersensing is not “too many spikes” but “spikes falling in the vulnerable period”; if symptomatic, manage immediately.
成人 ACLS 的核心是高质量 CPR、及时除颤/复律、血管活性药物与可逆病因处: The core of adult ACLS is high-quality CPR, timely defibrillation/cardioversion, vasoactive drugs, and management of reversible causes; energy and drug doses must be distinguished by rhythm and presence or absence of pulse.
房室分离是“心房与心室独立”，不是单一诊断；机制决定处理。: AV dissociation means “atria and ventricles are independent,” not a single diagnosis; management depends on the mechanism.
房室结/希氏束病变导致房室分离；宽 QRS 逸搏提示阻滞位置较低，风险更高。: AV node/His bundle disease causes AV dissociation; wide-QRS escape beats suggest a lower block site and higher risk.
房室结、希氏束或双侧束支的传导完全中断，心房冲动不能到达心室。: Complete interruption of conduction in the AV node, His bundle, or bilateral bundle branches, so atrial impulses cannot reach the ventricles.
房性心动过速是起源于心房（窦房结以外）的异位快速节律，频率通常在 150–250: Atrial tachycardia is an ectopic rapid rhythm originating from the atria (outside the sinus node), with a rate usually 150–250 次/分; P′ wave morphology differs from sinus P, and QRS is mostly narrow.
房扑伴可变传导时易误诊为房颤；房颤无规则 F 波，RR 绝对不规则。: Atrial flutter with variable conduction is easily misdiagnosed as atrial fibrillation; atrial fibrillation has no regular F waves and RR is absolutely irregular.
房速 P 波形态异常，频率常 150–250 次/分。: Atrial tachycardia has abnormal P-wave morphology, with a rate often 150–250 beats/min.
房速伴阻滞、室早、ST 鱼钩。: Atrial tachycardia with block, PVCs, ST fishhook.
房速的关键不是“快”，而是“P′ 长得不像窦性 P”。: The key to atrial tachycardia is not “fast,” but that “P′ does not look like sinus P.”
房颤中宽 QRS 不一定是室早；先找长-短周期，可能是 Ashman。: Ashman: long-short cycle + RBBB-type wide QRS.
房颤终止后出现 >3 s 长间歇、晕厥；平时窦缓；动态心电图可捕捉交替。: After AF termination, >3 s long pause and syncope; baseline sinus bradycardia; Holter can capture the alternation.
房颤负荷指监测期内房颤时间占比；负荷与卒中风险、症状和节律治疗决策相关，但不能单: Atrial fibrillation burden refers to the proportion of time in AF during the monitoring period; burden is associated with stroke risk, symptoms, and rhythm treatment decisions, but cannot alone replace CHA₂DS₂-VASc.
手术室监护仪“室速” + 电刀正在工作，先看患者和脉搏；可能是干扰。: OR monitor shows “VT” while electrocautery is active: check the patient and pulse first; it may be interference.
手术瘢痕与补片形成折返环路；传导系统损伤导致房室阻滞。: Postoperative congenital heart disease may show conduction block/arrhythmias; compare with preoperative findings.
手机/设备可干扰 ECG。: Mobile phones/devices can interfere with ECG.
把 AIVR 一律当良性，漏掉持续单形性室速或进行性缺血。: Treating AIVR as uniformly benign and missing sustained monomorphic VT or progressive ischemia.
把右胸导联 T 波倒置误认为前壁缺血而忽略肺栓塞。: Mistaking T-wave inversion in right precordial leads for anterior ischemia and overlooking pulmonary embolism.
把房室阻滞与束支阻滞的图形区分开: Distinguish the patterns of AV block and bundle branch block.
把无脉性 VT 当有脉心动过速做同步复律，延误除颤。: Treating pulseless VT as a tachycardia with pulse and performing synchronized cardioversion, delaying defibrillation.
把未下传的房性早搏误认为二度房室阻滞：提前出现的 P 波（可能藏在 T 波中）后: Mistaking a non-conducted premature atrial contraction for second-degree AV block: a premature P wave (possibly hidden in the T wave) is not followed by a QRS, with a longer compensatory pause; it is not a progressive decline in AV node conduction.
把窦性心律不齐误诊为房颤：后者无 P 波，前者有清晰窦性 P。: Misdiagnosing sinus arrhythmia as AF: the latter has no P waves, while the former has clear sinus P waves.
把粗大伪差当成 VF 而错误除颤；反之，把细颤当成停搏而漏除颤。: Mistaking coarse artifact for VF and defibrillating incorrectly; conversely, mistaking fine VF for asystole and missing defibrillation.
把运动员心脏的电压增高误诊为病理性 LVH。: Misdiagnosing the increased voltage of an athlete's heart as pathological LVH.
把高尖 T 波只归因于高钾而忽略早期复极、缺血或正常变异。: Attributing tall peaked T waves only to hyperkalemia while ignoring early repolarization, ischemia, or normal variant.
投影接近零的导联最容易被误读为“等电位”，此时相邻导联通常能给出方向。: A lead with projection near zero is most easily misread as “isoelectric”; adjacent leads usually provide the direction.
报警疲劳与伪差是 ICU 常见问题；不能把监护仪报警当作诊断。: Alarm fatigue and artifacts are common ICU problems; monitor alarms should not be treated as diagnoses.
持续可致心衰；急性处理迷走/腺苷。: If persistent, can cause heart failure; acute treatment: vagal maneuvers/adenosine.
支持室速诊断。: Supports the diagnosis of ventricular tachycardia (VT).
新发 LBBB 伴缺血症状：按 ACS 流程评估，动态心电图与肌钙蛋白，必要时冠: New-onset LBBB with ischemic symptoms: evaluate per ACS protocol with serial ECG and troponin, and coronary angiography if necessary; do not give thrombolysis for LBBB alone.
新发心律失常，尤其房速伴房室阻滞、交界性心动过速、室速。: New-onset arrhythmias, especially atrial tachycardia with AV block, junctional tachycardia, and VT.
新发晕厥/跌倒要查长间歇。: New syncope/falls require evaluation for long pauses.
新生儿右室优势、心率快。: Neonates have right ventricular dominance and fast heart rate.
旁路绕过房室结，缺乏生理性过滤；房颤时冲动可经旁路快速下传，诱发室颤。: The accessory pathway bypasses the AV node and lacks physiologic filtering; during atrial fibrillation, impulses can conduct rapidly down the pathway and induce ventricular fibrillation.
无症状小儿 WPW 需风险分层；避免盲目使用房室结阻滞药（可能加速旁路）。: Short PR, delta wave, wide QRS; during SVT, narrow QRS (orthodromic) or wide QRS (antidromic).
无症状患者风险分层个体化，需电生理/遗传咨询。: Individualized risk stratification for asymptomatic patients; electrophysiology/genetic counseling is needed.
无脉 VT 按 VF 处理。: Pulseless VT is managed as VF.
早期复极有 J 点切迹、形态稳定，无镜像压低。: Early repolarization has a J-point notch, stable morphology, and no reciprocal depression.
显示心率约为真实两倍。: Displayed heart rate is about twice the true rate.
最具特异性的是“T 波低平/倒置 + 明显 U 波（V2–V3 最明显）+ ST: The most specific finding is “flattened/inverted T waves + prominent U waves (most obvious in V2–V3) + ST depression + prolonged QT(U)”; a U wave taller than the T wave or >0.1 mV supports hypokalemia.
最具特异性的是“先看定标脉冲与纸速标记”：定标不足或纸速错误会让所有间期与振幅判: The most specific is “first check the calibration pulse and paper speed marker”: insufficient calibration or incorrect paper speed distorts all interval and amplitude judgments.
有症状低钙静脉补钙，先保心肌与神经肌肉稳定。: For symptomatic hypocalcemia, give intravenous calcium; first stabilize cardiac and neuromuscular status.
有症状或 PR 明显延长：评估病因；迷走张力高者运动后 PR 可缩短。: Symptomatic or markedly prolonged PR: evaluate the cause; in individuals with high vagal tone, PR may shorten after exercise.
有症状或负荷高者：β 受体阻滞剂为首选；结构性心脏病患者避免Ⅰ类抗心律失常药。: Symptomatic or high-burden cases: β-blockers are first-line; avoid Class I antiarrhythmic drugs in patients with structural heart disease.
有症状或频发者：首选 β 受体阻滞剂；避免在结构性心脏病中随意使用Ⅰ类抗心律失常: Symptomatic or frequent cases: β-blockers are first-line; avoid arbitrary use of Class I antiarrhythmic drugs in structural heart disease.
未下传房早的关键是找到提前的异位 P 波：形态与窦性 P 不同、出现时间提前、其: The key to non-conducted PACs is finding the premature ectopic P wave: morphology differs from sinus P, it occurs early, no QRS follows, and the compensatory pause is often incomplete; the difference from second-degree AV block is that atrial activation itself is premature and abnormal in morphology.
未加做 V7–V9 而漏诊后壁梗死，尤其在合并下壁梗死时。: Failure to add V7–V9 leads to missed posterior infarction, especially with concomitant inferior infarction.
未来心电图将融合 AI 筛查、可穿戴连续监测、远程医疗与精准遗传学；核心仍是病理: Future ECG will integrate AI screening, continuous wearable monitoring, telemedicine, and precision genetics; the core remains pathophysiology and clinical decision-making.
未测量 QT，漏诊长 QT 背景。: QT not measured, missing underlying long QT.
术前 ECG 的价值取决于是否能改变围术期管理；异常需结合症状、病史与进一步检查: The value of preoperative ECG depends on whether it can change perioperative management; abnormalities require correlation with symptoms, history, and further testing.
术前心电图的目的是“让麻醉更安全”，不是“给病历加一张纸”。: Preoperative ECG aims to make anesthesia safer, not to add a piece of paper to the chart.
术后患者“房颤” + 寒战，先保暖；伪差消失后可能还是窦性。: Postoperative patient with “atrial fibrillation” + shivering: warm first; after artifact resolves, it may still be sinus rhythm.
极度右偏伴窄 QRS，需排除导联反接。: Marked right axis deviation with narrow QRS: rule out lead reversal.
检查侧壁导联有无 q 波；出现 q 波需怀疑 LBBB 诊断或合并梗死。: Check lateral leads for q waves; if q waves are present, question the LBBB diagnosis or consider concomitant infarction.
检查有无伴随的 PR 延长、QRS 增宽、ST-T 改变。: Check for associated PR prolongation, QRS widening, and ST-T changes.
正常 ECG 不排除心律失常。: A normal ECG does not exclude arrhythmia.
正常成人：P 波 <0.12 s、PR 0.12–0.20 s、QRS <0.1: Normal adult: P wave <0.12 s, PR 0.12–0.20 s, QRS <0.12 s, QTc <0.44 s (men)/<0.46 s (women); heart rate 60–100 bpm.
正弦波不要等血钾结果；先钙剂，再降钾，并联系透析。: Do not wait for potassium results with a sine wave; give calcium first, then lower potassium, and contact dialysis.
比较既往心电图，判断是否存在束支阻滞或预激。: Compare with prior ECG to determine whether bundle branch block or pre-excitation is present.
治疗原发病：甲旁减、肾病、胰腺炎、输血相关枸橼酸中毒。: Treat the underlying disease: hypoparathyroidism, kidney disease, pancreatitis, transfusion-related citrate toxicity.
波形与 ST-T；与旧图比较。: Waveforms and ST-T; compare with prior ECG.
注意频发、多源、成对房早或房早诱发房颤，这些更具临床意义。: Note frequent, multifocal, paired atrial premature beats or atrial premature beats triggering atrial fibrillation; these are more clinically significant.
洋地黄中毒所致者停药、纠正电解质，必要时使用地高辛特异抗体。: For digitalis toxicity, stop the drug, correct electrolytes, and use digoxin-specific antibodies if necessary.
测量 PVC 的联律间期是否固定，判断单源还是多源。: Measure whether the PVC coupling interval is fixed to determine unifocal versus multifocal.
测量从起点到终点，QT 需校正。: Measure from start to end; QT requires correction.
浦肯野纤维从心内膜向心室肌呈放射状分布，使左、右心室几乎同时除极。浦肯野传导受损: Purkinje fibers radiate from the endocardium to the ventricular myocardium, causing the left and right ventricles to depolarize almost simultaneously. Impaired Purkinje conduction produces intraventricular conduction delay, with a widened QRS but possibly atypical morphology.
游走性起搏点常见于迷走张力高、洋地黄、老年；多源性房速常 >100 且与肺病相关: In the same lead, P-wave morphology ≥3 types, unequal PP intervals, and not a fast rate; QRS is usually narrow.
理解正交导联与 12 导联的差异: Understand differences between orthogonal leads and 12-lead
理解起搏指征与“先处理可逆原因”的边界: Understand pacing indications and the boundaries of 'treat reversible causes first'.
用导联组合推断右冠、回旋支、前降支与左主干病变: Use lead combinations to infer right coronary, circumflex, left anterior descending, and left main disease
甲状腺功能减退、低体温、颅内压增高、下壁心肌缺血也可通过神经或代谢机制抑制窦房结: Hypothyroidism, hypothermia, increased intracranial pressure, and inferior myocardial ischemia can also suppress the sinus node through neural or metabolic mechanisms.
电压是“筛查信号”，不是“诊断结论”；把体型、导联和传导因素先排除。: Voltage is a 'screening signal', not a 'diagnostic conclusion'; first exclude body habitus, lead, and conduction factors.
电轴左偏短期内明显加重并伴心力衰竭，提示心肌病变进展。: Marked worsening of left axis deviation within a short period accompanied by heart failure suggests progression of myocardial disease.
电轴本身不是诊断；要结合 QRS 形态、电压、ST-T 与临床。急性下壁心梗出现: Axis itself is not a diagnosis; combine with QRS morphology, voltage, ST-T, and clinical findings. Leftward axis with acute inferior MI may suggest left anterior fascicular involvement; rightward axis + tall R in V1 suggests right ventricular load; new leftward axis + dyspnea should raise suspicion of pulmonary embolism/right heart strain.
病例：无症状房颤的抗凝决策: Case: anticoagulation decision in asymptomatic AF
病例：起搏器患者晕厥: Case: syncope in a pacemaker patient
病变常为传导系统退行性变（Lenègre-Lev 病）、缺血、心肌炎或心脏术后，: The lesion is often degenerative conduction system disease (Lenègre-Lev disease), ischemia, myocarditis, or post-cardiac surgery, and may progress to third-degree block.
症状性心动过缓可试用阿托品 1 mg 静脉推注，每 3–5 分钟重复，最大 3: For symptomatic bradycardia, atropine 1 mg IV push may be tried, repeat every 3–5 minutes, max 3 mg; but it is often ineffective for ventricular escape and may even suppress escape by increasing sinus rate.
症状性心动过缓：阿托品 1 mg 静脉推注，每 3–5 分钟可重复，最大 3 m: Symptomatic bradycardia: atropine 1 mg IV push, repeat every 3–5 minutes, max 3 mg; often effective in those with increased vagal tone.
症状性或进展性者准备起搏；经皮起搏桥接，必要时永久起搏。: Prepare for pacing in symptomatic or progressive cases; bridge with transcutaneous pacing and, if necessary, permanent pacing.
监护 II 导联看节律，V1 看室上速/室早形态。: Monitor lead II for rhythm, V1 for SVT/PVC morphology.
监护仪突然报警，先看患者，再看旁边是不是有人充电/打电话。: If the monitor suddenly alarms, check the patient first, then see whether someone nearby is charging a phone/calling.
直立位使静脉回流减少，触发迷走反射，导致低血压/心动过缓；阳性反应可复制临床晕厥: Upright posture reduces venous return, triggers the vagal reflex, and causes hypotension/bradycardia; a positive response can reproduce clinical syncope.
看 QRS：确认每个 P 后都有 QRS，QRS 时限正常、无异常 Q 波。: Look at QRS: confirm every P is followed by a QRS, QRS duration is normal, and no abnormal Q waves.
看 ST 抬高的分布是否“弥漫”：多个血管区域同时受累提示心包炎。: Check whether the distribution of ST elevation is “diffuse”: simultaneous involvement of multiple vascular territories suggests pericarditis.
看到 T 波和 QT，不要只想“复极异常”，要想到具体离子通道与药物；看到 QR: When seeing T waves and QT, do not just think 'repolarization abnormality'; think of specific ion channels and drugs. When seeing a widened QRS, also ask whether it is a sodium channel or conduction system problem.
看到“肺型 P 波”先找右心负荷证据，不要只凭 P 波高度诊断肺心病。: When seeing 'P pulmonale', first look for evidence of right heart strain; do not diagnose cor pulmonale based only on P wave height.
看到高电压先问“年龄、体型、血压、运动习惯”，再看有无劳损与左房增大。: When high voltage is seen, first ask about 'age, body habitus, blood pressure, exercise habits', then check for strain and left atrial enlargement.
短 PR、delta 波、宽 QRS；SVT 发作时窄 QRS（顺向）或宽 QR: Short PR, delta wave, wide QRS; during SVT, narrow QRS (orthodromic) or wide QRS (antidromic).
短 PR 可能来自房室结传导加速或旁路；LGL 不是单一明确疾病，诊断需谨慎。: A short PR may result from accelerated AV nodal conduction or an accessory pathway; LGL is not a single well-defined disease, and diagnosis requires caution.
磁铁是“临时开关”，不是“修复起搏器”；用完必须程控。: A magnet is a “temporary switch,” not a “pacemaker repair”; reprogramming is mandatory afterward.
稳定单形性 VT：胺碘酮等；不明原因时避免房室结阻滞剂。: Stable monomorphic VT: amiodarone, etc.; avoid AV nodal blockers when the cause is unclear.
稳定后复查 ECG/肌钙蛋白。: 35-year-old female, generalized urticaria, throat tightness, hypotension after eating; ECG sinus tachycardia, ST depression, T inversion.
窄 QRS 规则心动过速：先迷走刺激，腺苷；哮喘患者腺苷可能诱发支气管痉挛，需谨: Narrow-QRS regular tachycardia: first vagal maneuvers, adenosine; in asthma, adenosine may induce bronchospasm, so use caution and have bronchodilators ready.
窦性停搏与窦房传导阻滞的机制不同，但临床处理原则相近。: Sinus arrest and sinoatrial exit block have different mechanisms, but clinical management principles are similar.
窦性心动过缓有直立窦性 P 波，PR 正常；交界性心律无直立 P 或仅有逆行 P: Sinus bradycardia has upright sinus P waves and normal PR; junctional rhythm has no upright P waves or only retrograde P waves.
窦性心动过速，约 112 次/分，I 导联深 S、III 导联 Q 波与 T 波: Sinus tachycardia, about 112 beats/min, deep S wave in lead I, Q wave and T-wave inversion in lead III, V1 shows right heart strain changes, consistent with S1Q3T3 pattern.
窦性心律预激不明显，起搏或心动过速时出现 LBBB 样宽 QRS；旁路前传，逆传: Pre-excitation is not obvious in sinus rhythm; an LBBB-like wide QRS appears during pacing or tachycardia; antegrade conduction via the accessory pathway and retrograde conduction via the AV node.
窦性心律，II、V5、V6 导联勺状 ST 段压低，QT 缩短，T 波低平，符合: Sinus rhythm, scooped ST depression in leads II, V5, V6, shortened QT, flattened T waves, consistent with digitalis effect.
窦性心律，QT 间期缩短至约 0.28 s，ST 段缩短，T 波形态正常，符合高: Sinus rhythm, QT interval shortened to about 0.28 s, shortened ST segment, normal T-wave morphology, consistent with ECG changes of hypercalcemia.
窦性心律，RR 间期随呼吸呈周期性变化，P 波形态与 PR 间期恒定。: Sinus rhythm, RR intervals vary cyclically with respiration, and P-wave morphology and PR interval remain constant.
窦房结主导：P 波在 I、II、aVF 直立，每个 P 后跟随 QRS，频率 6: Sinoatrial node dominance: P waves are upright in I, II, and aVF; each P wave is followed by a QRS; rate 60–100 beats/min.
窦房结功能障碍与心房肌病变导致起搏与传导异常；慢快综合征中快速房性心律失常后窦房: Sinus node dysfunction and atrial myocardial disease cause pacing and conduction abnormalities; in tachy-brady syndrome, rapid atrial arrhythmias suppress the sinus node, causing long pauses.
窦房结自律性与起搏机制: Sinus node automaticity and pacing mechanism
窦房结频率最高，通过“超速抑制”压制下级起搏点。窦房结频率下降、房室传导中断或窦: The SA node has the highest rate and suppresses lower pacemakers through “overdrive suppression.” Lower pacemakers can manifest only when the SA node rate decreases, AV conduction is interrupted, or sinus arrest occurs.
窦速常见；异常要排除 PE/贫血/甲亢。: Sinus tachycardia is common; abnormalities require ruling out PE/anemia/hyperthyroidism.
窦速有正常 P 波，起止渐缓，频率随病因波动。: Sinus tachycardia has normal P waves, gradual onset and offset, and rate fluctuates with the cause.
立即监护、吸氧、建立静脉通路；血流动力学不稳定者按高级生命支持流程处理。: Immediate monitoring, oxygen, and IV access; manage hemodynamically unstable patients according to advanced life support protocols.
结合低钙症状与病因（甲旁减、肾病、胰腺炎）。: Combine with hypocalcemia symptoms and causes (hypoparathyroidism, kidney disease, pancreatitis).
结论要回答“是什么、可能为什么、下一步”。: The conclusion should answer “what it is, possible why, and next steps”.
肌钙蛋白与临床决策。: 50-year-old male, persistent chest pain; initial ECG normal, repeat at 1 hour showed V3–V4 ST depression, elevated troponin.
肌钙蛋白升高为 NSTEMI，正常为不稳定型心绞痛，需结合临床综合判断。: Elevated troponin indicates NSTEMI; normal troponin indicates unstable angina; interpret in conjunction with the overall clinical picture.
肥厚心肌复极顺序改变，出现侧壁导联 ST 压低与 T 波倒置（劳损型改变）。: Altered repolarization sequence in hypertrophied myocardium, causing lateral lead ST depression and T-wave inversion (strain-pattern changes).
肺栓塞心电图可正常，也可出现窦速、S1Q3T3、右束支阻滞、右胸 T 倒置、电轴: According to the site’s course “Hypotension and ECG,” which of the following is a learning objective?
胎儿心率基线 110–160 次/分；变异、加速、减速模式比单次心率更重要；需结: Fetal heart rate baseline 110–160 beats/min; variability, acceleration, and deceleration patterns are more important than a single heart rate; interpret with uterine contractions and fetal movement.
胎儿心电图不能按成人心律失常标准判读；异常胎心需产科紧急评估。: Fetal ECG cannot be interpreted using adult arrhythmia criteria; abnormal fetal heart rate requires urgent obstetric evaluation.
脓毒症 ECG：窦速、房颤、ST-T 改变。: Sepsis ECG: sinus tachycardia, atrial fibrillation, ST-T changes.

让患者放松、保暖、重新贴电极通常可改善；不要因“波形乱”直接诊断房颤。: Relaxing the patient, warming, and reapplying electrodes usually improve it; do not diagnose atrial fibrillation just because the waveform is messy.

起搏器患者心率突然“翻倍”或“掉到 30”，先看钉与程控；可能只是感知问题。: In a pacemaker patient, if the heart rate suddenly “doubles” or “drops to 30,” check spikes and programming first; it may just be a sensing issue.

起搏钉突然消失、心率慢。: Pacing spikes suddenly disappear, heart rate is slow.
超急性期：高尖 T、ST 开始抬高、无 Q。: Hyperacute phase: tall peaked T waves, beginning ST elevation, no Q wave.
