运动试验阳性通常指运动中或运动后出现 ≥0.1 mV 水平/下斜型 ST 压低、: A positive exercise test usually refers to ≥0.1 mV horizontal/downsloping ST depression, typical chest pain, blood pressure drop, or severe arrhythmia during or after exercise.
这会产生“电轴右偏”“侧壁缺血”等假象；重新连接后图形恢复正常。: This can create artifacts such as “right axis deviation” and “lateral ischemia”; after reconnection, the tracing returns to normal.
远程监测数据可能有延迟/伪差；紧急症状仍需现场评估。: Remote monitoring data may have delays/artifacts; urgent symptoms still require in-person assessment.
连续 ≥3 个 PVC 为室速，而非二联律。: Consecutive ≥3 PVCs indicate VT, not bigeminy.
连续、规则、锯齿状 F 波，频率约 250–350 次/分，F 波之间无真正等电: Continuous, regular, sawtooth F waves at about 250–350 次/分, with no true isoelectric line between F waves.
选择取决于临床问题与事件频率；先问“我要回答什么问题”，再选检查。: Choice depends on the clinical question and event frequency; first ask what question I need to answer, then choose the test.
逐搏测量 PR，确认恒定且没有 QRS 脱漏。: Measure PR beat by beat to confirm it is constant and there is no dropped QRS.
逐条应用 Brugada 四步法，记录每一步。: Apply the Brugada four-step method step by step and document each step.
逸搏发生在长间歇后，频率慢；PVC 是提前出现。: Escape beats occur after a long pause and have a slow rate; PVCs occur prematurely.
逸搏是长间歇后的保护性搏动，早搏是提前的异位搏动。: Escape beats are protective beats after a long pause; premature beats are early ectopic beats.
部分穿透的冲动使房室结部分除极，延长其不应期；下一次冲动传导变慢或阻滞。: A partially penetrating impulse partially depolarizes the AV node and prolongs its refractory period; the next impulse conducts more slowly or is blocked.
重新贴电极/换导联。: ICU patient monitor alarms VT, patient awake and normotensive; irregular waveform across multiple leads, sinus rhythm restored after moving electrodes.
重点关注房颤、室速、心动过缓、长间歇、QTc 与 ST 趋势；报警阈值应个体化。: Focus on AF, ventricular tachycardia, bradycardia, long pauses, QTc, and ST trends; alarm thresholds should be individualized.
鉴别：不是所有长间歇都是房室阻滞: Differential diagnosis: not all long pauses are AV block
钉 + P/QRS=夺获；只有钉=失夺获。: Spike + P/QRS = capture; spike alone = loss of capture.
钉后 P 波，QRS 窄。: P wave after spike, narrow QRS.
钉突然消失/心率慢=感知过度或电池。: Sudden spike disappearance/slow heart rate = oversensing or battery.
钠通道功能丧失（如 SCN5A 突变）导致右室流出道心外膜复极不均一，形成 ST: Loss of sodium channel function (e.g., SCN5A mutation) causes heterogeneous repolarization in the right ventricular outflow tract epicardium, producing ST elevation and reentry.
长 QT 可伴 T 波异常，但低钾有明确 U 波与电解质证据。: Long QT can be accompanied by T-wave abnormalities, but hypokalemia has clear U waves and electrolyte evidence.
长间歇可能与房颤终止后的窦房结抑制有关，不一定是新发三度阻滞；需结合监测。: Long pauses may be related to sinus node suppression after AF termination, not necessarily new-onset third-degree block; correlate with monitoring.
间歇后无逸搏，或逸搏频率过慢、QRS 宽。: No escape beat after the pause, or escape rate is too slow, QRS is wide.
间歇长度通常 >2.0 s（部分标准 >3.0 s）；窦性停搏的间歇与基础 PP: Pause length is usually >2.0 s (some criteria >3.0 s); the pause in sinus arrest has no integer multiple relationship with the basic PP interval.
阻滞也可位于心房、希氏束或束支；希氏束内或希氏束下阻滞常伴 QRS 增宽，进展风: Block may also be located in the atria, His bundle, or bundle branches; intra-His or infra-His block is often accompanied by QRS widening and carries a higher risk of progression.
阿托品无效或不适用时，经皮起搏可作为过渡；也可使用多巴胺或肾上腺素泵入维持血压与: When atropine is ineffective or not applicable, transcutaneous pacing can serve as a bridge; dopamine or epinephrine infusion can also be used to maintain blood pressure and heart rate. In patients with high-grade block, wide QRS, or hemodynamic instability, prepare for transvenous temporary pacing as soon as possible and look for reversible causes.
除极顺序改变导致复极顺序改变：QRS 主波向上的 I、aVL、V5、V6 出现: Altered depolarization sequence leads to altered repolarization sequence: ST depression and T inversion in I, aVL, V5, V6 where the main QRS vector is positive, and ST elevation and upright T in V1–V3 where the main vector is negative, i.e., 'discordant' ST-T changes.
随时间推移，VF 可变为细颤并退化为心搏停止，除颤成功率随时间下降。: Over time, VF may become fine VF and degenerate into asystole; defibrillation success rate decreases over time.
需排除房性心动过速、心房扑动 2:1 传导、AVNRT 等窄 QRS 心动过速。: Need to exclude narrow-QRS tachycardias such as atrial tachycardia, atrial flutter with 2:1 conduction, and AVNRT.
需排除房早伴极短 PR、室早伴窄 QRS（分支起源）等情况。: Need to exclude atrial premature beats with very short PR, ventricular premature beats with narrow QRS (fascicular origin), etc.
需排除测量误差、束支阻滞、起搏心律等影响 QT 的因素。: Need to exclude measurement error, bundle branch block, paced rhythm, and other factors affecting QT.
预激合并心动过速时，避免单纯房室结阻滞剂。: In preexcitation with tachycardia, avoid AV node-blocking agents alone.
预激时 delta 波方向反映旁路插入心室的位置；胸导联 R 波递增不良提示前壁: In preexcitation, delta wave direction reflects the ventricular insertion site of the bypass tract; poor R-wave progression in precordial leads suggests anterior wall disease or lead position issues.
食管导联靠近左房，P 波清晰。: Esophageal lead is close to the left atrium; P waves are clear.
高密度标测用于复杂心律失常。: High-density mapping is used for complex arrhythmias.
高电压≠LVH；低电压≠没有 LVH。: High voltage ≠ LVH; low voltage ≠ absence of LVH.
高质量 CPR 是任何药物与电治疗生效的基础。: High-quality CPR is the foundation for any drug and electrical therapy to be effective.
高钙可增强洋地黄毒性，需询问地高辛使用。: Hypercalcemia can enhance digitalis toxicity; ask about digoxin use.
高钙血症缩短心肌动作电位平台期，心电图上表现为 ST 段缩短、QT 间期缩短，严: Hypercalcemia shortens the plateau phase of the myocardial action potential; on ECG it manifests as shortened ST segment and shortened QT interval, and severe cases may present with bradycardia, AV block, and arrhythmias.
高钙：ST 缩短、QT 缩短；严重时心动过缓/传导阻滞。: Hypercalcemia: shortened ST and QT; severe cases cause bradycardia/conduction block.
高钾→T 高尖、QRS 宽。: Hyperkalemia → peaked T waves, wide QRS.
高钾危重：静脉钙剂稳定心肌 → 胰岛素+葡萄糖/β₂ 激动剂 → 排钾/透析。: Severe hyperkalemia: IV calcium to stabilize myocardium → insulin + glucose/β₂ agonists → potassium removal/dialysis.
高钾降低膜电位、减慢传导；新生儿心肌对高钾更敏感。: SIDS is a diagnosis of exclusion; not all sudden infant deaths should be attributed to long QT.
鱼钩样 ST、T 低平、QT 短。: Fish-hook ST, flattened T waves, short QT.
4 相钠钾泵恢复离子梯度；自律细胞在 4 相还有 If 等内向电流，产生自动除极: Phase 4 sodium-potassium pump restores ion gradients; automatic cells also have inward currents such as If in phase 4, producing automatic depolarization.
30 岁男性，发热 39°C 后晕厥；V1–V2 穹隆型 ST 抬高、T 倒置，: 30-year-old man, syncope after fever of 39°C; coved ST elevation and T inversion in V1–V2, family history of sudden death at a young age.
70 岁男性，体检发现房颤，无心悸；CHA₂DS₂-VASc 3 分，HAS-B: 70-year-old man, AF found on examination, no palpitations; CHA₂DS₂-VASc 3, HAS-BLED 1.
75 岁女性，起搏器植入后反复晕厥；心电图起搏钉后无 QRS，自身逸搏 25 次: 75-year-old woman with recurrent syncope after pacemaker implantation; ECG shows pacing spikes without QRS, intrinsic escape 25 bpm.
ATP 可见快速起搏钉。: ATP may show rapid pacing spikes.
AV 间期可程控优化。: The AV interval can be programmed and optimized.
Brugada 综合征是一种遗传性离子通道病，心电图表现为右胸导联（V1–V3）: Brugada syndrome is an inherited ion channelopathy; ECG shows coved-type ST-segment elevation and T-wave inversion in right precordial leads (V1–V3), with susceptibility to ventricular fibrillation and sudden cardiac death; cardiac structure is usually normal.
DDD：双腔起搏、双腔感知、双腔反应。: DDD: dual-chamber pacing, dual-chamber sensing, dual response.
F 波: When ventricular rate is around 150, first look for F waves or P′, do not assume sinus tachycardia.
HCM 心肌肥厚、纤维化与微血管缺血导致运动时心律失常；是年轻运动员猝死的重要原: In HCM, myocardial hypertrophy, fibrosis, and microvascular ischemia cause exercise-related arrhythmias; it is an important cause of sudden death in young athletes.
ICU 的监护仪是“哨兵”，不是“医生”；报警后第一眼要看患者。: The ICU monitor is a "sentinel," not a "doctor"; after an alarm, look at the patient first.
ICU 监测重点：心律失常、QT、ST。: ICU monitoring focus: arrhythmias, QT, ST.
I、aVL 镜像性 ST 压低，aVL 最敏感；III 导联抬高大于 II 导联: Reciprocal ST depression in I and aVL, with aVL most sensitive; ST elevation in III greater than in II supports right coronary artery disease.
I 负向、aVF 正向：电轴右偏；结合右室肥厚、左后分支阻滞等。: Lead I negative, aVF positive: right axis deviation; correlate with right ventricular hypertrophy, left posterior fascicular block, etc.
LQT1 的典型场景是“游泳时晕厥”；问病史比只看 QTc 更有价值。: The classic scenario for LQT1 is “syncope while swimming”; history taking is more valuable than QTc alone.
LQT3：睡眠/慢心率诱发。: LQT3: induced by sleep/slow heart rate.
LVH 侧壁、RVH 右胸。: LVH lateral leads, RVH right precordial leads.
Mahaim 的“预激”可能只在起搏/心动过速时出现；静息正常不代表没有旁路。: Mahaim "pre-excitation" may appear only during pacing/tachycardia; a normal resting ECG does not mean no pathway.
P-QRS 频率接近但无固定 PR。: P-QRS rates are close but no fixed PR.
POTS：直立 10 分钟心率增加 ≥30 次/分 + 症状，需排除贫血、甲亢、: POTS: heart rate increase ≥30 bpm within 10 minutes of standing + symptoms; exclude anemia, hyperthyroidism, dehydration, and drugs.
PR 间期延长、P 波振幅降低甚至消失，提示 6.5–7.5 mmol/L。: PR interval prolongation, reduced or even absent P wave amplitude, suggesting 6.5–7.5 mmol/L.
PVC 三件套：宽 QRS、无 P、T 波反向；再加完全代偿间歇。: The PVC triad: wide QRS, no P wave, opposite T wave; plus a fully compensatory pause.
P 波=心房除极，QRS=心室除极，T 波=心室复极；ST 段是复极早期，T 波: P wave = atrial depolarization, QRS = ventricular depolarization, T wave = ventricular repolarization; the ST segment is early repolarization and the T wave is late repolarization, and the two usually have the same direction.
P 波一会儿一个样但心率不快，先想游走性起搏点；心率快则想多源性房速。: If P waves keep changing but the rate is not fast, think wandering pacemaker first; if the rate is fast, think multifocal atrial tachycardia.
P 波反映左右心房除极，正常在 II 导联直立；QRS 反映心室除极，窄而快；T: The P wave reflects depolarization of the right and left atria and is normally upright in lead II; the QRS reflects ventricular depolarization and is narrow and fast; the T wave reflects ventricular repolarization and is broad and slow.
P 波形态多变，提示游走性心房起搏点或房性心律失常。: Variable P-wave morphology suggests wandering atrial pacemaker or atrial arrhythmia.
QRS 增宽：先想除极异常（钠通道、束支、心肌病变），不要只盯复极。: QRS widening: think first of depolarization abnormalities (sodium channels, bundle branches, myocardial disease), not just repolarization.
QRS 多窄；若 QRS 增宽，提示合并束支阻滞或病变更远端。: QRS is usually narrow; if QRS is widened, it suggests concurrent bundle branch block or a more distal lesion.
QRS 宽度与形态都要看。: Assess both QRS width and morphology.
QRS 形态介于窦性与室性之间、PR 间期可变；室速中可见融合波/夺获波，支持室: QRS morphology is between sinus and ventricular, and the PR interval is variable; fusion beats/capture beats can be seen in VT, supporting VT.
QRS 时限 ≥0.12 s；I、aVL、V5、V6 呈宽钝、切迹或顿挫的 R: QRS duration ≥0.12 s; I, aVL, V5, V6 show broad, blunt, notched, or slurred R waves.
QTc 正常不能完全排除 LQTS；动态变化、基因与家族史重要。: A normal QTc does not completely exclude LQTS; dynamic changes, genetics, and family history are important.
QT 延长/T 倒置需复查。: QT prolongation/T-wave inversion requires repeat ECG.
RBBB 有 rSR′，PR 正常，无 delta 波。: RBBB has rSR′, normal PR, and no delta wave.
RR 绝对不规则: When atrial fibrillation with wide QRS is mistaken for ventricular tachycardia: look for pre-excitation, bundle branch block, and prior ECGs.
S1Q3T3 特异性低；右心负荷改变（V1–V4 T 倒置、RBBB、右房增大）: S1Q3T3 has low specificity; right heart strain changes (V1–V4 T-wave inversion, RBBB, right atrial enlargement) suggest massive/submassive PE.
SIDS 部分与长 QT 相关。: Some SIDS cases are associated with long QT.
ST 压低也可见于 LVH 劳损、洋地黄、低钾、肺栓塞；需结合临床与动态。: ST depression can also be seen in LVH strain, digitalis, hypokalemia, and pulmonary embolism; correlate with clinical findings and serial changes.
ST 压低看三点：形态（水平或下斜）、幅度（≥1 mm）、分布（相邻或广泛）。: ST depression: look at three points: morphology (horizontal or downsloping), magnitude (≥1 mm), distribution (adjacent or widespread).
ST 压低需在相邻导联、连续搏动、与基线比较；上斜型 ST 压低特异性较低。: ST depression must be assessed in adjacent leads, on consecutive beats, and compared with baseline; upsloping ST depression has lower specificity.
ST 抬高的相邻导联定位梗死区域，镜像压低帮助确认。: ST elevation in adjacent leads localizes the infarct territory; reciprocal depression helps confirm.
T 高尖、QRS 宽、正弦波。: Peaked T waves, wide QRS, sine wave.
V1 形态不同于单纯右室起搏。: V1 morphology differs from pure right ventricular pacing.
V1 的 R 峰时间 >50 ms；V5、V6 的 R 峰时间正常，这是与右室肥: R peak time in V1 >50 ms; R peak time in V5 and V6 is normal, an important distinction from right ventricular hypertrophy.

V1–V3 ST 压低伴 R 波增高、T 波直立构成后壁镜像三联征；V7–V9: ST depression in V1–V3 with tall R waves and upright T waves forms the posterior reciprocal triad; ST elevation ≥1 mm in contiguous V7–V9 leads confirms posterior infarction. Isolated V1–V3 ST depression without tall R, upright T, or inferior elevation is more likely anterior subendocardial ischemia.
V1–V3 压低伴下壁抬高但未加做后壁导联，容易漏诊后壁梗死。: V1–V3 depression with inferior ST elevation but no posterior leads, making posterior infarction easy to miss.
V1–V6 位于水平面，反映心室除极向量在前后、左右方向的投影；正常 R 波从: V1–V6 are located in the horizontal plane and reflect the projection of ventricular depolarization vectors in the anteroposterior and left-right directions; normal R waves gradually increase from V1 to V5, and S waves gradually become shallower.
V1：P 波初始高大正向 + 终末深负向。: V1: initial tall positive P wave + terminal deep negative P wave.
VF/pVT 未及时除颤，或除颤后停顿过长。: Key values for ACLS Energy and Drug Quick Reference: 120–200 J unsynchronized (VF/pVT)
VF/无脉性 VT：立即 CPR，尽快非同步除颤，双相 120–200 J（按厂: VF/pulseless VT: immediate CPR, non-synchronized defibrillation as soon as possible, biphasic 120–200 J (per manufacturer), monophasic 360 J.
aVR P 波倒置、I/II P 直立是位置正确的重要线索。: Inverted P wave in aVR and upright P in I/II are important clues of correct electrode placement.
“心电图正常”不是出院理由；症状持续就复查、观察、评估。: A "normal ECG" is not a reason for discharge; if symptoms persist, repeat ECG, observe, and evaluate.

宽 QRS 心动过速指 QRS ≥0.12 s、频率 >100 次/分的心动过速: Wide QRS tachycardia refers to tachycardia with QRS ≥0.12 s and rate >100 bpm, mainly including VT, SVT with aberrancy/bundle branch block, and pre-excited tachycardia.
宽 QRS 极速心律；若患者无脉，按无脉性 VT 立即非同步除颤。: Very fast wide QRS rhythm; if pulseless, defibrillate asynchronously immediately as for pulseless VT.
宽 QRS 节律里突然出现一个窄 QRS，先找 P；可能是夺获，不是早搏。: A sudden narrow QRS in a wide QRS rhythm: look for P first; it may be capture, not a premature beat.
寻找 P 波与房室分离，注意 QRS 前后是否出现融合波或夺获波。: Look for P waves and AV dissociation; note whether fusion beats or capture beats occur before or after the QRS.
寻找夺获搏动、融合波、电轴极度偏移等支持室速的线索。: Look for clues supporting VT such as capture beats, fusion beats, and extreme axis deviation.
寻找洋地黄中毒、低钾、慢性肺病、结构性心脏病等诱因。: Commonly seen in structural heart disease, chronic lung disease, digitalis toxicity, hypokalemia, and myocarditis; may also occur in those without structural heart disease.
寻找窦性 P 波：若 P 频率高于 QRS 且无固定关系，为三度阻滞伴室性逸搏。: Look for sinus P waves: if the P rate is higher than the QRS rate and there is no fixed relationship, it is third-degree block with ventricular escape.
小儿宽 QRS 心动过速，不要随意用维拉帕米；可能是预激伴房颤。: In pediatric wide QRS tachycardia, do not use verapamil casually; it may be pre-excitation with atrial fibrillation.
小儿心肌炎可表现为窦速、低电压、ST-T 改变、心律失常、QRS 增宽；暴发性心: Pediatric myocarditis can present with sinus tachycardia, low voltage, ST-T changes, arrhythmias, and QRS widening; fulminant myocarditis can rapidly cause heart failure/shock.
尖端扭转是长 QT 的并发症，已发生心动过速。: Torsades de pointes is a complication of long QT, with tachycardia already occurring.
左右臂反接使 I 导联 P/QRS/T 全部倒置、aVR 与 aVL 互换；右臂: Left/right arm reversal inverts P/QRS/T in lead I and swaps aVR and aVL; right arm/left leg reversal can cause II/III swap and 'pseudo-inferior infarction.'
左室肥厚可伴电轴左偏。: Left ventricular hypertrophy may be accompanied by left axis deviation.
左室肥厚可有电轴左偏与侧壁高 R，但伴电压增高与劳损型 ST-T 改变。: Left ventricular hypertrophy may have left axis deviation and tall lateral R waves, but is accompanied by increased voltage and strain-type ST-T changes.
左心室肥厚是左室心肌质量增加，心电图表现为左室导联电压增高、电轴左偏及继发性 S: Left ventricular hypertrophy is an increase in left ventricular myocardial mass; ECG shows increased voltage in left ventricular leads, left axis deviation, and secondary ST-T changes; commonly seen in long-term hypertension, aortic stenosis, and hypertrophic cardiomyopathy.
左房增大→P 波增宽、V1 终末负向。: Left atrial enlargement → widened P waves, terminal negative deflection in V1.
左房增大：P 宽、双峰，V1 终末负向增大。: Left atrial enlargement: widened, notched P waves, with increased terminal negative deflection in V1.
常伴 RVH 与电轴右偏。: Often accompanied by RVH and right axis deviation.
常伴房颤、左室肥厚或二尖瓣病变。: Often accompanied by atrial fibrillation, left ventricular hypertrophy, or mitral valve disease.
常见于三度房室阻滞、严重高钾血症、洋地黄或抗心律失常药中毒、急性心肌梗死、心肌炎: Common in third-degree AV block, severe hyperkalemia, digitalis or antiarrhythmic drug toxicity, acute myocardial infarction, myocarditis, and terminal states.
常见于心肌缺血、心肌病、心力衰竭、洋地黄中毒、低钾血症；也可见于健康人。: Ventricular bigeminy is one PVC in every two beats, i.e., alternating sinus-PVC-sinus-PVC. It is a pattern of PVC coupling and suggests frequent ectopic focus activity.
常见于病态窦房结综合征、下壁心肌梗死、心肌炎、洋地黄或 β 受体阻滞剂过量、高钾: Common in sick sinus syndrome, inferior myocardial infarction, myocarditis, digitalis or beta-blocker overdose, hyperkalemia, and increased vagal tone; physiological presentations also occur during sleep and in athletes.
常见原因包括 β 受体阻滞剂、非二氢吡啶类钙拮抗剂、地高辛、胺碘酮、下壁心肌梗死: Common causes include beta-blockers, non-dihydropyridine calcium channel blockers, digoxin, amiodarone, inferior myocardial infarction, myocarditis, electrolyte disturbances, and high vagal tone in athletes.
常见原因：甲状旁腺功能减退、维生素 D 缺乏、慢性肾病、急性胰腺炎、大量输血（枸: Common causes: hypoparathyroidism, vitamin D deficiency, chronic kidney disease, acute pancreatitis, massive transfusion (citrate).
常见病因：高血压、主动脉瓣狭窄、肥厚型心肌病、运动员心脏。: Common causes: hypertension, aortic stenosis, hypertrophic cardiomyopathy, athlete's heart.
干扰性分离：心室率 > 心房率。: Interference dissociation: ventricular rate > atrial rate.
广泛压低伴 aVR ST 抬高 ≥1 mm：提示左主干或三支血管病变。: Widespread depression with aVR ST elevation ≥1 mm: suggests left main or three-vessel disease.
延长记录时间提高阵发性事件检出率；患者日志与症状时间戳是解读关键。: Longer recording time improves detection of paroxysmal events; patient logs and symptom timestamps are key to interpretation.
异常 Q 波可不代表梗死。: Abnormal Q waves may not indicate infarction.
心动过缓依赖型：提高心率（异丙肾上腺素/起搏）缩短 QT。: Bradycardia-dependent: increase heart rate (isoproterenol/pacing) to shorten QT.
心动过缓：阿托品 0.5–1 mg 静注，可重复；高度阻滞且血流动力学不稳定时临: Bradycardia: atropine 0.5–1 mg IV, may repeat; temporary pacing for high-grade block with hemodynamic instability; note higher pacing complications in inferior myocardial infarction.
心包积液使心电电压降低，大量积液可致电交替；炎症与疼痛引起交感兴奋，常伴窦性心动: Pericardial effusion reduces ECG voltage; large effusions may cause electrical alternans; inflammation and pain cause sympathetic activation, often with sinus tachycardia.
心室率 150 左右时，先找 F 波或 P′，不要默认窦速。: Refer recurrent cases or those unresponsive to drugs to cardiology for catheter ablation evaluation.
心室由交界区（窄 QRS，40–60 次/分）或室性（宽 QRS，20–40 次: The ventricles are paced by junctional (narrow QRS, 40–60 beats/min) or ventricular (wide QRS, 20–40 beats/min) escape beats; the rate is slow and may be unstable.
心律失常/缺血/梗阻性原因导致心输出量下降；心电图是快速鉴别工具之一。: Arrhythmic/ischemic/obstructive causes lead to decreased cardiac output; ECG is one of the rapid differential tools.
心悸时心电图正常很常见；需要事件记录器/可穿戴设备，不能一次正常就结束。: A normal ECG during palpitations is common; event recorders/wearable devices are needed, and one normal ECG should not end the evaluation.
心房分离：两种独立 P 波。: Atrial dissociation: two independent P waves.
心房率: Bigeminy = a 1:1 duet of normal beats and PVCs; first count the ratio, then assess morphology.
心电向量图（VCG）可用于束支阻滞、预激、心室肥厚的辅助分析，但对操作与设备要求: Vectorcardiography (VCG) can be used for adjunctive analysis of bundle branch block, preexcitation, and ventricular hypertrophy, but has high operator and equipment requirements.
心电图不是“画出来的波形”，而是心肌电活动在体表留下的投影。每一次心动周期都要经: The ECG is not a 'drawn waveform' but the projection left on the body surface by myocardial electrical activity. Each cardiac cycle undergoes four layers of transformation: ion channel opening/closing changes membrane potential, cardiomyocytes generate action potentials, electrical activity of many cells sums into a spatial vector, and finally the vector projects onto each lead axis to form P, QRS, and T waves.
心电图呈大小、形态、频率完全不规则的混沌波形，无可见 P-QRS-T。: ECG shows a chaotic waveform with completely irregular amplitude, morphology, and rate, with no visible P-QRS-T.
心电图异常往往不止一个；系统化阅读把“图形”转化为结构化报告，减少遗漏。: There is often more than one ECG abnormality; systematic reading converts 'patterns' into a structured report, reducing omissions.
心电图机以固定纸速记录电压随时间的变化；纸速改变会改变波形在横轴上的宽度。: The ECG machine records voltage over time at a fixed paper speed; changing paper speed changes the waveform width on the horizontal axis.
心电图研究需明确问题、数据来源、标注标准、终点与验证集；AI 研究还要报告设备、: ECG research must define the question, data source, annotation criteria, endpoints and validation set; AI studies must also report devices, leads and population.
心脏性晕厥可能由短暂心律失常导致，静息心电图可正常；需要动态监测/电生理评估。: Cardiac syncope may be caused by transient arrhythmias, and resting ECG can be normal; ambulatory monitoring/electrophysiologic evaluation is needed.
心脏记忆指心室激动顺序改变后，T 波在恢复正常传导后仍持续倒置一段时间；常见于起: Cardiac memory refers to persistent T-wave inversion for a period after ventricular activation sequence changes and normal conduction resumes; commonly seen after pacing, pre-excitation, and ventricular tachycardia.
心衰合并窦性心律、QRS ≥150 ms、EF ≤35% 的 LBBB 是 CR: LBBB with heart failure and sinus rhythm, QRS ≥150 ms, and EF ≤35% is a strong indication for CRT; QRS 120–149 ms requires individualization.
快速室率与房室不同步导致心输出量下降，可退化为室颤。: Rapid ventricular rate with AV dyssynchrony reduces cardiac output and may degenerate into ventricular fibrillation.
急性心肌梗死相关的房室阻滞：下壁梗死所致的一度/二度 I 型阻滞多数在数天内恢复: AV block associated with acute myocardial infarction: first-degree/type I second-degree block due to inferior infarction usually resolves within days and can initially be observed and supported; type II second-degree or third-degree block associated with anterior infarction, or block persisting beyond the expected time, requires assessment for temporary and permanent pacing.
急性期：ST 明显抬高、Q 波形成、T 开始倒置。: Acute phase: marked ST elevation, Q wave formation, T wave begins to invert.
总钙受白蛋白影响，需校正或测离子钙。: Total calcium is affected by albumin; correct or measure ionized calcium.
慢快综合征：快速房性心律失常 + 慢窦性。: Tachy-brady syndrome: rapid atrial arrhythmia + slow sinus rhythm.
房室分离、夺获搏动、融合波支持室速，但敏感性有限。: AV dissociation, capture beats, and fusion beats support VT, but sensitivity is limited.
房室结的延迟与过滤: Delay and filtering by the AV node
房室结：QRS 窄、文氏型、药物/迷走相关、常可逆。: AV node: narrow QRS, Wenckebach, drug/vagal-related, often reversible.
房早为突然提前的 P′，随后非代偿间歇，而非渐进变化。: PAC is a suddenly premature P′, followed by a noncompensatory pause, rather than a gradual change.
房早伴快速房颤、心房扑动或频繁成对出现，提示心房基质不稳定。: PACs with rapid atrial fibrillation, atrial flutter, or frequent paired occurrence suggest atrial substrate instability.
房速 P′ 可见且形态异常，Adenosine 可能仅暂时阻滞房室结。: In atrial tachycardia, P′ waves are visible and abnormal in morphology; Adenosine may only temporarily block the AV node.
房颤伴宽 QRS 时误认为室速：寻找预激、束支阻滞与既往心电图。: Pre-excited atrial fibrillation (wide QRS, very fast ventricular rate) carries risk of ventricular fibrillation.
房颤患者晕厥，不要只看房颤；问“终止时有没有长间歇”。: In AF patients with syncope, do not look only at AF; ask "was there a long pause at termination?"
房颤时 DDD 转 VVI/DDIR。: In AF, DDD switches to VVI/DDIR.
房颤时房室结过滤冲动；药物/传导系统病变使心室率过慢，导致低灌注。: In AF, the AV node filters impulses; drugs/conduction system disease can make the ventricular rate too slow, causing hypoperfusion.
房颤时最短 RR <250 ms 是高危。: Shortest RR <250 ms during AF is high risk.
房颤算法可假阳性。: AF algorithms can have false positives.
所有间期都必须结合心率、年龄、导联与测量方法；QT 必须校正，PR 与 QRS: All intervals must be interpreted with heart rate, age, lead, and measurement method; QT must be corrected, and PR and QRS should be assessed by overall morphology rather than a single number.
把 2:1 阻滞直接归为二度 I 型或 II 型：单凭 2:1 无法分型，需结合: Classifying 2:1 block directly as type I or type II second-degree: 2:1 alone cannot determine the type; combine QRS width, whether PR is fixed, response to activity or drugs, and electrophysiologic study if necessary.
把 LVH 劳损型 ST-T 改变误认为缺血；后者多有动态变化与症状。: Mistaking LVH strain-pattern ST-T changes for ischemia; the latter often has dynamic changes and symptoms.
把右室梗死导致的低血压当作左心衰，使用利尿剂或硝酸酯使病情恶化。: Mistaking hypotension due to right ventricular infarction for left heart failure; using diuretics or nitrates worsens the condition.
把右室肥厚伴劳损的高 R 与 ST 压低误认为后壁梗死。: Mistaking tall R waves and ST depression of right ventricular hypertrophy with strain for posterior infarction.
把左室肥厚劳损（V5/V6 ST 压低加 T 倒置）当作缺血。: Mistaking left ventricular hypertrophy strain (ST depression plus T-wave inversion in V5/V6) for ischemia.
把文氏现象一律当良性：宽 QRS、症状性或进展性者需起搏评估。: Treating all Wenckebach phenomenon as benign: wide QRS, symptomatic, or progressive cases require pacing evaluation.
把早期复极、急性心包炎、左室室壁瘤的 ST 抬高误认为急性 STEMI。: Mistaking ST elevation from early repolarization, acute pericarditis, or left ventricular aneurysm for acute STEMI.
把波形当成“电活动的时间轴”，而不是孤立图形；这能解释为什么同一病变在不同导联方: Treat the waveform as a “timeline of electrical activity,” not an isolated shape; this explains why the same lesion has different directions in different leads.
把测量值与临床背景结合，不用单一数字替代整体判断。: Combine measurements with clinical context; do not substitute a single number for overall judgment.
持续性 VT 或结构性心脏病患者转诊电生理评估（ICD/消融）。: Refer patients with sustained VT or structural heart disease for electrophysiology evaluation (ICD/ablation).
持续胸痛伴动态 ST 压低 ≥2 mm，或广泛压低加 aVR 抬高。: Persistent chest pain with dynamic ST depression ≥2 mm, or widespread depression plus aVR elevation.
持续胸痛超过 20 分钟，伴低血压、肺水肿、心源性休克（Killip III–I: Persistent chest pain for >20 minutes, with hypotension, pulmonary edema, cardiogenic shock (Killip class III–IV).
按顺序复述一次正常心房-心室激动: Recite once in order the normal atrial-ventricular activation
提前的窄 QRS + 前无 P + 后有逆行 P = 交界性早搏。: Premature narrow QRS + no preceding P + retrograde P after = junctional premature beat.
数据量与依从性是挑战。: Data volume and adherence are challenges.
新发右束支阻滞、S1Q3T3 伴胸痛/呼吸困难。: New-onset right bundle branch block, S1Q3T3 with chest pain/dyspnea.
新生儿右室优势：电轴右偏、V1 高 R、V6 深 S；随年龄右室退化，成人型 R: Neonatal right ventricular dominance: right axis deviation, tall R in V1, deep S in V6; right ventricle regresses with age, and adult-type R-wave progression gradually forms.
新生儿心电图以右室优势、电轴右偏、V1 高 R、心率快为特征；出生后数周至数月逐: Neonatal ECG is characterized by right ventricular dominance, right axis deviation, tall R in V1, and rapid heart rate; it gradually changes over weeks to months after birth.
旁路、房速、室早/室速标测。: Mapping of accessory pathways, atrial tachycardia, and PVCs/VT.
无症状预激：评估旁路风险，避免剧烈竞技运动需个体化；导管消融可根治。: Asymptomatic pre-excitation: assess accessory pathway risk; avoidance of strenuous competitive sports should be individualized; catheter ablation can be curative.
早期复极的“良性”是概率，不是保证；有晕厥/家族猝死时需电生理评估。: Early repolarization being "benign" is a probability, not a guarantee; with syncope/family history of sudden death, electrophysiologic evaluation is needed.
早期复极表现为 J 点抬高、ST 段凹面向上抬高、T 波高耸，常见于 V2–V5: Early repolarization shows J-point elevation, concave-upward ST segment elevation, and tall T waves, commonly in V2–V5; ST elevation is usually <0.2 mV without reciprocal depression.
早期复极：J 点抬高、凹面 ST、T 高耸、无镜像压低。: Early repolarization: J-point elevation, concave ST segment, tall T waves, no reciprocal depression.
最具特异性的是“QTc 延长 + T 波形态异常（双相、切迹、倒置）”；QTc: The most specific is 'QTc prolongation + abnormal T-wave morphology (biphasic, notched, inverted)'; when QTc >500 ms or increased >60 ms from baseline, the risk of torsades de pointes is significantly elevated.
最具特异性的是“提前的窄 QRS 前无窦性 P，且 QRS 后可见逆行 P（II: Most specific is “premature narrow QRS with no preceding sinus P, and retrograde P visible after QRS (inverted in II, III, aVF); if retrograde P is buried in QRS, it presents as premature narrow QRS with no preceding P.”
最具特异性的是“窦性 P 波 + 1:1 房室传导 + 心率 >100 次/分”: The most specific is 'sinus P waves + 1:1 AV conduction + heart rate >100 beats/min'; normal P-wave morphology and relatively gradual onset/offset help distinguish it from reentrant tachycardia.
有脉/无脉是 VT 处理的第一分叉：无脉=除颤+CPR，有脉不稳定=同步电复律。: Pulse/no pulse is the first branch in VT management: pulseless = defibrillation + CPR; unstable with pulse = synchronized cardioversion.
未下传的房早可表现为“长间歇”，易误诊为窦性停搏，需寻找 T 波上的 P′。: Nonconducted PACs can present as a 'long pause' and are easily misdiagnosed as sinus arrest; look for P′ on the T wave.
术后房扑/房速常见。: Postoperative atrial flutter/atrial tachycardia are common.
查地高辛浓度、钾、肾功能。: Check digoxin level, potassium, and renal function.
查诱因：缺血、感染、PE、电解质。: Check triggers: ischemia, infection, PE, electrolytes.
检查 ST 形态：凹面向上、J 点抬高，而非弓背向上。: Check ST morphology: concave upward with J-point elevation, not convex upward.
正常传导顺序保证心房收缩先于心室，PR 间期与 QRS 时限处于生理范围内。: Normal conduction sequence ensures atrial contraction precedes ventricular contraction, with PR interval and QRS duration within physiologic ranges.
正常值不是“背数字”，而是“知道什么时候该校正、什么时候不该硬套”。: Normal values are not about “memorizing numbers,” but about “knowing when to correct and when not to apply them rigidly.”
正常心电图不能排除 ACS；持续症状需动态复查 ECG 与肌钙蛋白。: A normal ECG cannot exclude ACS; persistent symptoms require serial ECG and troponin testing.
正常窦性心律指冲动由窦房结发出，按固定顺序经心房、房室结、希氏束-浦肯野系统下传: Normal sinus rhythm means the impulse originates from the sinoatrial node and travels down in a fixed sequence through the atria, AV node, and His-Purkinje system, producing consistent P waves and narrow QRS complexes.
测量 QRS 频率，比较房率与室率。: Measure the QRS rate and compare atrial and ventricular rates.
测量 QT 与 QU 间期，避免把 U 波误并入 T 波。: Measure QT and QU intervals; avoid mistakenly incorporating U waves into T waves.
测量代偿间歇是否完全。: Commonly seen in myocardial ischemia, cardiomyopathy, heart failure, electrolyte disturbances, and drug toxicity; may also occur in healthy people without structural heart disease.
浦肯野系统也是室性心律失常的重要参与结构；分支间折返可形成分支型室速。: The Purkinje system is also an important participant in ventricular arrhythmias; interfascicular reentry can produce fascicular VT.
消费级设备的光电容积脉搏波可能有假阳性；抗凝决策需用可穿戴/植入设备确认。: Consumer-device PPG may have false positives; anticoagulation decisions require confirmation with wearable/implantable devices.
游走性起搏点：P 形态多变、心率不快。: Wandering pacemaker: variable P morphology, rate not fast.
理解房颤心室率为何不规则: Understand why the ventricular rate is irregular in atrial fibrillation
用 I/aVF 快速确定电轴象限: Use I/aVF to quickly determine the axis quadrant
用于窄 QRS 心动过速与房室分离。: Used for narrow QRS tachycardia and AV dissociation.
用相邻导联的 ST 抬高与镜像改变定位：前壁 V1–V4、侧壁 I/aVL/V5: Use ST elevation in adjacent leads and reciprocal changes for localization: anterior V1–V4, lateral I/aVL/V5/V6, inferior II/III/aVF, posterior V7–V9, right ventricle V3R–V5R; V4R ST elevation is most sensitive for right ventricular infarction.
电压受体型、传导、阻抗影响。: Voltage is affected by body habitus, conduction, and impedance.
电极位置或导联错接会改变投影，先排除技术因素再谈电轴。: Electrode position or lead misconnection changes the projection; rule out technical factors before discussing axis.
电轴右偏的鉴别: Differential diagnosis of right axis deviation
电轴左偏 + II/III/aVF rS：考虑 LAFB。: Left axis deviation + rS in II/III/aVF: consider LAFB.
症状性心动过缓：阿托品 1 mg 静脉推注，每 3–5 分钟重复，最大 3 mg: Symptomatic bradycardia: atropine 1 mg IV push, repeat every 3–5 minutes, maximum 3 mg; if ineffective, transcutaneous pacing or epinephrine 2–10 μg/min.
症状明显或频发者可考虑 β 受体阻滞剂等控制房早；合并房速、房颤风险或结构性心脏: For symptomatic or frequent PACs, β-blockers etc. may be considered to control them; if atrial tachycardia, atrial fibrillation risk, or structural heart disease is present, further evaluation is needed. Specific drugs and doses must be determined by clinicians based on the patient's condition; this page is for teaching only.
监护仪“室速”但患者清醒，不要电击；先确认导联与脉搏。: If the monitor shows "VT" but the patient is awake, do not shock; first confirm leads and pulse.
监护仪不等于 12 导联，ST 报警需确认。: A monitor is not equivalent to a 12-lead ECG; ST alarms need confirmation.
相邻导联 ST 压低 ≥0.05–0.1 mV、T 波倒置、动态变化；aVR S: Contiguous-lead ST depression ≥0.05–0.1 mV, T-wave inversion, dynamic changes; aVR ST elevation suggests left main/multivessel disease.
看传导阻滞先做两步：PR 延长吗？QRS 增宽吗？把答案放进“房室结—希氏束—束: For conduction block, first take two steps: Is PR prolonged? Is QRS widened? Put the answers into the anatomic chain of “AV node—His bundle—bundle branches—fascicles,” and the meaning of the pattern becomes clear.
看到“两种 P 波”先别兴奋；先排除伪差和房扑，再考虑罕见的心房分离。: Don't get excited when seeing "two P waves"; first rule out artifact and atrial flutter, then consider rare atrial dissociation.
知道其临床应用边界: Know the boundaries of its clinical application
短 PR、δ 波，宽 QRS 由预激造成，而非束支阻滞。: Short PR, δ wave, and wide QRS caused by pre-excitation, not bundle branch block.
短 PR、正常 QRS、无 delta 波。: Short PR, normal QRS, no delta wave.
确认提前的 QRS 形态是否与窦性一致。: Confirm whether the morphology of the premature QRS is consistent with the sinus QRS.
离子通道突变导致复极异常；儿童期即可发生 TdP/室颤。: Ion channel mutations cause abnormal repolarization; TdP/VF can occur in childhood.
程序刺激用于诱发/终止心动过速。: Programmed stimulation is used to induce/terminate tachycardia.
稳定：先尝试改良 Valsalva 或颈动脉窦按摩（老年/颈动脉杂音者慎用）；无: Stable: first try modified Valsalva or carotid sinus massage (use cautiously in elderly/those with carotid bruit); if ineffective, Adenosine 6 mg rapid IV push, and 12 mg if necessary.
窄 QRS 心动过速，心室率约 150 次/分，下壁导联可见连续锯齿状 F 波，: Using AV nodal blockers in pre-excited atrial flutter may accelerate accessory pathway conduction and induce ventricular fibrillation.
窄 QRS 规则→AVNRT/AVRT/房速；窄 QRS 不规则→房颤/房扑多变: Narrow QRS regular → AVNRT/AVRT/atrial tachycardia; narrow QRS irregular → atrial fibrillation/atrial flutter with variable conduction; wide QRS → VT/pre-excitation/aberrancy.
窄 QRS 规则：迷走→腺苷。: Narrow regular QRS: vagal maneuvers → adenosine.
窦性 P-QRS-T 之后提前出现一个异位 P 波，其后没有 QRS，形成长间歇: After a sinus P-QRS-T, an ectopic P wave appears early with no following QRS, creating a long pause; the premature P wave often falls on the preceding T wave.
窦性冲动穿透房室结，短暂“夺获”心室，产生窄 QRS；室速的心室激动被暂时打断。: A sinus impulse penetrates the AV node and briefly 'captures' the ventricles, producing a narrow QRS; ventricular activation of VT is temporarily interrupted.
窦性心动过缓伴 PR 延长时，需判断是否合并一度房室阻滞。: In sinus bradycardia with prolonged PR, determine whether first-degree AV block is also present.
窦性心动过速是“体征”，治疗应指向病因。: Sinus tachycardia is a 'sign'; treatment should target the cause.
窦性心律，心房率约 82 次/分，PR 恒定 0.18 s，每 3 个 P 波中: Sinus rhythm, atrial rate about 82 beats/min, constant PR 0.18 s, 1 of every 3 P waves not conducted, QRS with RBBB pattern, consistent with second-degree type II AV block.
窦性心律，心率约 72 次/分，PR 0.16 s，QRS 0.08 s，电轴正: Sinus rhythm, heart rate about 72 bpm, PR 0.16 s, QRS 0.08 s, normal axis, no ST-T abnormalities.
窦性心律，心率约 72 次/分，QRS 0.14 s，I、V5、V6 宽钝 R: Sinus rhythm, heart rate about 72 beats/min, QRS 0.14 s, broad slurred R without q in I, V5, V6, deep S in V1, ST-T opposite to the main QRS direction.
窦性心律，心率约 88 次/分，II、III、aVF ST 段抬高 2–3 mm: Sinus rhythm, heart rate about 88 beats/min, ST elevation 2–3 mm in II, III, aVF, with reciprocal depression in I, aVL, and V1–V3.
窦性心律，心率约 96 次/分，I、II、aVF 与 V2–V6 弥漫凹面 ST: Sinus rhythm, heart rate about 96 beats/min, diffuse concave ST elevation 1–1.5 mm in I, II, aVF, and V2–V6, PR segment depression, with reciprocal ST depression and PR elevation in aVR.
窦性心律，约 72 次/分，记录中可见一次提前出现的 P′ 波后跟窄 QRS，代: Sinus rhythm, about 72 bpm; one premature P′ followed by a narrow QRS is seen in the recording, with an incomplete compensatory pause.
窦房结失败时，交界区与心室按 40–60、20–40 次/分顺序接管。: When the SA node fails, the junctional area and ventricles take over in sequence at 40–60 and 20–40 beats/min.
窦房结细胞没有稳定的静息电位，而是通过 If、ICa-L 等内向电流产生第四相自: SA node cells do not have a stable resting potential; instead, they generate phase 4 automatic depolarization through inward currents such as If and ICa-L; upon reaching threshold, an action potential is triggered.
窦缓、窦停、窦房阻滞、慢快综合征。: Sinus bradycardia, sinus arrest, sinoatrial block, tachy-brady syndrome.
纸速 25 mm/s 时，小格 0.04 s、大格 0.20 s；增益 10 m: At paper speed 25 mm/s, a small box is 0.04 s and a large box is 0.20 s; at gain 10 mm/mV, 1 mV = 10 mm. Measure from the start to the end of the waveform and choose a clear lead.
结合症状与用药：无症状的运动员、睡眠中常见生理性心动过缓。: Consider symptoms and medications: physiologic bradycardia is common in asymptomatic athletes and during sleep.
结合血压、瓣膜病、肥厚型心肌病家族史与超声。: Correlate with blood pressure, valvular disease, family history of hypertrophic cardiomyopathy, and echocardiography.
结论分级；危急值电话通知。: Grade conclusions; notify critical values by phone.
缺血性 ST 压低多为水平/下斜型，伴动态变化与症状。: Ischemic ST depression is mostly horizontal/downsloping, with dynamic changes and symptoms.
老年人常见窦缓、传导阻滞、房颤、早搏、ST-T 改变；也更容易受药物/电解质影响: Older adults commonly have sinus bradycardia, conduction block, atrial fibrillation, premature beats, ST-T changes; they are also more susceptible to drug/electrolyte effects.
肌肉损伤释放钾，酸中毒/低灌注加重高钾；高热直接损伤心肌与传导系统。: Muscle injury releases potassium; acidosis/hypoperfusion worsens hyperkalemia; hyperthermia directly injures the myocardium and conduction system.
肾排钾减少导致高钾；酸中毒与药物（ACEI/ARB、保钾利尿剂）加重。: Decreased renal potassium excretion causes hyperkalemia; acidosis and drugs (ACEI/ARB, potassium-sparing diuretics) worsen it.
胎儿监护的核心是“模式与背景”，不是单个心率数字。: The core of fetal monitoring is "pattern and context," not a single heart rate number.
胸前导联无 RS、RS >100 ms、房室分离：三条硬线索。: Absence of RS in precordial leads, RS >100 ms, and AV dissociation: three hard clues.
胸导联位置错误可制造假性递增不良或假性心梗。: Incorrect chest lead placement can create pseudo-poor R wave progression or pseudo-infarction.
胸导联错位可造成 R 波递增异常或“假性前壁心梗”；读图时先确认 aVR P 波: Misplacement of chest leads can cause abnormal R wave progression or “pseudo-anterior infarction”; when reading an ECG, first confirm inverted P waves in aVR and upright P waves in I/II.
自动测量算法在噪声、房颤、起搏心律中容易出错；关键异常应人工复核。: Automated measurement algorithms are prone to errors with noise, atrial fibrillation, and paced rhythms; key abnormalities should be manually reviewed.
自身心房活动可触发心室起搏。: Intrinsic atrial activity can trigger ventricular pacing.
若不能确定，按室速处理，避免误用维拉帕米等房室结阻滞剂。: If uncertain, manage as VT; avoid inappropriate use of AV nodal blockers such as verapamil.
若为 Brugada 表型，避免诱发药物与发热，转诊电生理评估。: If a Brugada phenotype is present, avoid triggering drugs and fever, and refer for electrophysiology evaluation.
药物治疗不能替代对病因的处理：缺血再灌注、停药或解毒、纠正电解质、治疗感染或炎症: Drug therapy cannot replace treatment of the underlying cause: ischemia-reperfusion, stopping the drug or antidote, correcting electrolytes, and treating infection or inflammation often determine whether the block resolves.
融合波不是“混合心律”的诊断；它提示两个起搏点同时激动心室。: Fusion beats are not a diagnosis of "mixed rhythm"; they indicate simultaneous activation of the ventricles by two pacemakers.
血钾 >6.5 mmol/L，尤其伴 QRS 增宽、P 波消失或正弦波。: Serum potassium >6.5 mmol/L, especially with QRS widening, loss of P waves, or sine wave.
血钾正常不能排除组织间钾升高；临床与心电图需综合判断。: Normal serum potassium does not exclude increased tissue potassium; clinical and ECG findings must be assessed together.
观察 QRS 宽度与形态，宽 QRS 提示更远端病变。: Assess QRS width and morphology; a wide QRS suggests a more distal lesion.
观察 QRS 宽度与形态，宽 QRS 提示更远端病变或合并束支阻滞。: Assess QRS width and morphology; a wide QRS suggests a more distal lesion or concurrent bundle branch block.
观察 V1–V3 的 ST-T：继发倒置属预期；若 ST 段呈穹隆型抬高，需排查: Assess ST-T in V1–V3: secondary inversion is expected; if there is coved ST-segment elevation, evaluate for Brugada syndrome.
观察节律是否在长间歇后出现，测量逸搏前间歇、RR 间期与心室率。: Observe whether the rhythm appears after a long pause; measure the pre-escape interval, RR interval, and ventricular rate.
计算 PVC 负荷（PVC 数 / 总心搏数），评估心肌病风险。: Commonly seen in myocardial ischemia, cardiomyopathy, heart failure, digitalis toxicity, and hypokalemia; may also occur in healthy people.
计算模型可探索折返、消融靶点与药物反应，但不能完全替代真实心脏。: Computational models can explore reentry, ablation targets, and drug responses, but cannot fully replace the real heart.
记录器不能治疗心律失常；发现异常后仍需评估病因与治疗。: Recorders cannot treat arrhythmias; after an abnormality is found, etiology and treatment still need evaluation.
设备提示“房颤”是线索，不是处方；确认心律与卒中风险后再谈抗凝。: A device alert of "AF" is a clue, not a prescription; confirm rhythm and stroke risk before discussing anticoagulation.
设备监测可报告房颤负荷百分比、发作次数与持续时间；短阵房颤也可能有临床意义。: Device monitoring can report AF burden percentage, number of episodes, and duration; short runs of AF may also be clinically significant.
评估频率与节律：用 300 除以相邻 R 波间的大格数，或数 10 秒内 QRS: Assess rate and rhythm: divide 300 by the number of large boxes between adjacent R waves, or count QRS complexes in 10 seconds and multiply by 6.
诊断靠临床概率与影像。: Diagnosis relies on clinical probability and imaging.
询问晕厥、夜间濒死呼吸、家族猝死史。: Ask about syncope, nocturnal agonal respiration, and family history of sudden death.
说明右胸导联的适应证: Explain the indications for right chest leads
起搏器患者出现晕厥、低血压或新发宽 QRS 心动过速，需立即评估设备与患者。: In pacemaker patients with syncope, hypotension, or new-onset wide QRS tachycardia, immediately evaluate the device and patient.
起搏器患者晕厥 + 钉后无 QRS，先按失夺获处理，不要只做 Holter。: In a pacemaker patient with syncope + no QRS after pacing spike, treat as loss of capture first; do not only perform Holter.
起搏点位于希氏束分叉以下，QRS 宽；当窦性与室性频率接近时，出现等频房室分离、: Pacemaker site is below the His bundle bifurcation, with wide QRS; when sinus and ventricular rates are similar, isorhythmic AV dissociation, fusion beats, or capture beats occur.
超急性期 T 波高尖、R 波递增不良；演变期出现病理性 Q 波与 T 波倒置。: Hyperacute phase: tall peaked T waves and poor R wave progression; evolving phase: pathologic Q waves and T wave inversion.
过敏性休克优先肾上腺素、补液、气道；心电图 ST-T 改变可来自低血压/缺氧/儿: In anaphylactic shock, prioritize epinephrine, fluids, and airway; ECG ST-T changes may be due to hypotension/hypoxia/catecholamines and require repeat ECG.
过敏性休克时先救命，不要因为 ST 压低先去导管室；稳定后评估缺血。: In anaphylactic shock, save the patient first; do not go to the cath lab first just because of ST depression; assess ischemia after stabilization.
运动员、LBBB、WPW 是常见混杂因素。: Athletes, LBBB, and WPW are common confounders.
运动员、年轻人可生理性高电压。: Athletes and young people may have physiologic high voltage.
运动增加心肌耗氧，诱发病变冠脉供血不足，产生可逆 ST 改变；敏感性与病变程度、: Exercise increases myocardial oxygen demand, provoking insufficient blood supply in diseased coronary arteries and causing reversible ST changes; sensitivity is related to lesion severity and exercise workload.
运动试验的结论要写“概率”，不是“有/没有冠心病”；临床背景决定下一步。: Exercise test conclusions should state "probability," not "presence/absence of coronary artery disease"; clinical context determines next steps.
进展为高度或三度阻滞，或脱漏比例增加（如 3:1、2:1）。: Progression to high-grade or third-degree block, or an increased dropped-beat ratio (e.g., 3:1, 2:1).
远程监测提高设备随访效率。: Remote monitoring improves device follow-up efficiency.
远程监测是“预警系统”，不是“急诊替代”；患者晕厥/电击仍需现场处理。: Remote monitoring is an "early warning system," not an emergency department substitute; syncope/shock still requires on-site management.
连续 ≥3 个室性搏动，宽 QRS、频率 >100 次/分；有脉/无脉决定处理路: Consecutive ≥3 ventricular beats, wide QRS, rate >100 beats/min; presence or absence of a pulse determines the management pathway.
连续监测能捕捉短暂缺血；但 Holter 导联有限，不能等同 12 导联或运动试: Continuous monitoring can capture transient ischemia; however, Holter leads are limited and cannot be equated with a 12-lead ECG or exercise testing.
适应证：反复不明原因晕厥、心悸、隐匿性癫痫/卒中；ILR 电池可维持数年。: Indications: recurrent unexplained syncope, palpitations, occult epilepsy/stroke; ILR battery can last several years.
选择 P/QRS 起点清晰的导联测量 PR 与 QRS；QT 选择 T 波终点清: Select leads with clear P/QRS onset to measure PR and QRS; for QT, select a lead with a clear T-wave endpoint.
选择 T 波终点清晰的导联（常用 II 或 V5），测量 QT 并校正心率。: Select a lead with a clear T-wave endpoint (commonly II or V5), measure QT, and correct for heart rate.
透析患者 sine wave，先推钙；不要只给降钾药而忽略心肌稳定。: In a dialysis patient with sine wave, give calcium first; do not only give potassium-lowering agents and neglect myocardial stabilization.
逐导联评估 ST-T 是否“不一致”；一旦出现一致型改变，按 Sgarbossa: Assess ST-T discordance lead by lead; if concordant changes appear, apply Sgarbossa criteria.
逸搏-夺获=高度 AVB 背景下的偶发下传。: Escape-capture = occasional conduction in the setting of high-grade AVB.
避免常规使用利多卡因或胺碘酮等抗心律失常药，可能抑制心室起搏点，导致停搏或诱发室: Avoid routine use of antiarrhythmic drugs such as lidocaine or amiodarone; they may suppress the ventricular pacemaker, causing asystole or inducing ventricular fibrillation.
重点找可改变管理的异常。: Focus on abnormalities that can change management.
钠通道阻滞剂在快速心率时更容易与通道结合，QRS 增宽更明显（使用依赖性）；这是: Sodium channel blockers bind more readily to channels at fast heart rates, with more marked QRS widening (use dependence); this is one mechanism of drug-induced arrhythmia.
长间歇后 PR 重置: PR reset after a long pause
间歇内可无 QRS，或出现交界性/室性逸搏。: There may be no QRS during the pause, or junctional/ventricular escape beats may occur.
阻滞后左室激动先由左后分支支配的下壁、后壁开始，再指向上方与左方，额面 QRS: After block, left ventricular activation begins in the inferior and posterior walls supplied by the left posterior fascicle, then directs superiorly and leftward; the frontal QRS vector points superior-left, producing marked left axis deviation.
阿托品无效或出现高度房室阻滞：经皮起搏，或肾上腺素 2–10 μg/min 泵入: If atropine is ineffective or high-grade AV block occurs: transcutaneous pacing, or epinephrine infusion 2–10 μg/min to maintain blood pressure and tissue perfusion.
阿托品无效时首选经皮起搏，或肾上腺素 2–10 μg/min 泵入维持灌注，并准: If atropine is ineffective, transcutaneous pacing is preferred, or epinephrine infusion 2–10 μg/min to maintain perfusion, and prepare for transvenous pacing.
陈旧期 ST 持续抬高：考虑室壁瘤，而不是再次急性梗死。: Persistent ST elevation in the old phase: consider ventricular aneurysm, not recurrent acute infarction.
除颤后立即检查脉搏/心律，延误胸外按压。: Check pulse/rhythm immediately after defibrillation; do not delay chest compressions.
随年龄逐渐转为成人型。: Gradually converts to adult type with age.
隐源性卒中的房颤可能“抓不到”；监测时间越长，检出越多。: AF in cryptogenic stroke may not be captured; longer monitoring increases detection.
隐源性卒中需延长心电监测寻找阵发房颤；短程 Holter 正常不能排除。: Cryptogenic stroke requires prolonged ECG monitoring to detect paroxysmal AF; a normal short-term Holter does not exclude it.
需与右室肥厚、前壁心内膜下缺血、洋地黄效应与导联错位鉴别。: Differentiate from right ventricular hypertrophy, anterior subendocardial ischemia, digitalis effect, and lead misplacement.
需与后壁 MI、WPW、RBBB 鉴别。: Differentiate from posterior MI, WPW, and RBBB.
预激伴房扑时使用房室结阻滞剂可能加速旁路传导，诱发室颤。: In pre-excitation with atrial flutter/fibrillation, impulses can conduct rapidly via the accessory pathway, with risk of ventricular fibrillation; avoid AV nodal blockers alone.
预激伴房颤是“宽 QRS 不规则”，不要按普通房颤控制心率；房室结阻滞药可能加速: Pre-excited AF is "irregular wide QRS"; do not rate-control as ordinary AF; AV nodal blockers may accelerate the accessory pathway.
预激伴房颤：冲动经旁路快速下传，可蜕变为室颤；避免房室结阻滞药，立即同步复律。: Pre-excitation with AF: impulses conduct rapidly down the accessory pathway and can degenerate into VF; avoid AV nodal blockers and perform immediate synchronized cardioversion.
预激伴房颤：宽 QRS、极快且不规则心室率，是急症。: Pre-excitation with atrial fibrillation: wide QRS, very fast and irregular ventricular rate; it is an emergency.
预激合并房扑/房颤时，冲动可经旁路快速下传，有室颤风险，禁用单纯房室结阻滞剂。: F waves are often negative sawtooth in II, III, and aVF and often positive in V1; QRS is usually narrow.
预激合并房颤（宽 QRS、极快心室率）有室颤风险。: QRS is usually narrow; it may be wide with bundle branch block, aberrant conduction, or pre-excitation.
颈动脉窦综合征由颈动脉窦压力感受器过敏导致心动过缓/血管扩张，常见于老年人，转头: Carotid sinus syndrome is caused by hypersensitivity of carotid sinus baroreceptors leading to bradycardia/vasodilation; common in older adults, triggered by head turning/tight collar.
频率约 150–250 次/分，可短阵或持续。: Rate approximately 150–250 beats/min; may be short-lived or sustained.
频率过慢时心输出量下降，尤其在不能代偿增加每搏量的患者中可出现头晕、乏力、晕厥。: When the rate is too slow, cardiac output decreases, especially in patients unable to compensate by increasing stroke volume, who may develop dizziness, fatigue, or syncope.
首次医疗接触至导丝通过: First medical contact to wire crossing
高尖 T 波与宽 QRS，无相邻导联 ST 抬高与镜像压低。: Peaked T waves and wide QRS, without ST elevation in contiguous leads or reciprocal depression.
高度房室阻滞、晕厥或严重心动过缓。: High-grade AV block, syncope, or severe bradycardia.
高负荷 PVC、非持续性室速或伴左室功能下降：心内科评估，必要时导管消融。: Measure whether the compensatory pause is complete.
高负荷（>10–15%）或疑心动过速性心肌病：心内科评估导管消融。: Calculate PVC burden (PVC count / total beats) to assess cardiomyopathy risk.
高钾最特异的是高尖对称 T 波与 P 波变平；低钾最特异的是 U 波与 QT(U: The most specific feature of hyperkalemia is tall, peaked, symmetric T waves and flattened P waves; the most specific feature of hypokalemia is U waves and QT(U) prolongation; hypocalcemia is ST prolongation causing QT prolongation with normal T waves; hypercalcemia is shortened QT/ST.
高钾正弦波是濒危心律：立即静脉钙剂稳定心肌，同时胰岛素+葡萄糖、β2、透析降钾。: Hyperkalemic sine wave is a life-threatening rhythm: give IV calcium immediately to stabilize the myocardium, while using insulin + glucose, β2, and dialysis to lower potassium.
高钾看 T 与 QRS；低钾看 U 与 QT；钙看 QT 长短。: Hyperkalemia: look at T and QRS; hypokalemia: look at U and QT; calcium: look at QT length.
高风险手术/心脏病/症状者更有价值。: More valuable in high-risk surgery/heart disease/symptomatic patients.
2:1 阻滞不能仅凭 PR 分型，需结合 QRS 与临床。: 2:1 block cannot be classified by PR alone; combine QRS and clinical context.
10 mm/mV、25 mm/s 是默认标准。: 10 mm/mV and 25 mm/s are the default standards.
10 mm/mV 时，1 mV 对应 10 mm；25 mm/s 时，1 mm=: At 10 mm/mV, 1 mV corresponds to 10 mm; at 25 mm/s, 1 mm=0.04 s, 5 mm=0.20 s.
16 岁女性，情绪激动后“抽搐”数次，脑电图正常；QTc 520 ms，家族有猝: 16-year-old female with several “convulsions” after emotional stress, normal EEG; QTc 520 ms, family history of sudden death.
18 导联：加做哪些、放在哪里: 18-lead ECG: which additional leads and where to place them
80 岁心衰患者，恶心、视物发黄；心电图房速伴 2:1 阻滞、室早，血钾 5.8: 80-year-old heart failure patient with nausea and yellow vision; ECG shows atrial tachycardia with 2:1 block and PVCs, potassium 5.8, poor renal function.
AAI 起搏心房、感知心房，用于窦房结功能障碍而房室传导正常者；起搏钉后紧跟 P: AAI paces the atrium and senses the atrium; it is used for sinus node dysfunction with normal AV conduction; a pacing spike is immediately followed by a P wave, and the QRS is usually narrow.
ACS 早期 ECG 可正常。: ECG may be normal early in ACS.
AVRT：稳定者可用 Adenosine（窄 QRS）或同步电复律；不稳定者同步: AVRT: for stable patients, use Adenosine (narrow QRS) or synchronized cardioversion; for unstable patients, synchronized cardioversion.
Adenosine 无效或复发：β 受体阻滞剂或非二氢吡啶类钙拮抗剂；血流动力学: If Adenosine is ineffective or recurrence occurs: β-blocker or non-dihydropyridine calcium channel blocker; for hemodynamic instability, synchronized cardioversion (start at 50–100 J for narrow QRS).
