CPVT 是运动/情绪诱发的双向性或多形性室速，静息心电图常正常；多见于儿童/青: CPVT is exercise/emotion-induced bidirectional or polymorphic ventricular tachycardia, with resting ECG often normal; more common in children/young adults.
CRT 同时起搏右室与左室（经冠状静脉窦），使心室同步收缩；心电图 QRS 可变: CRT paces the right and left ventricles simultaneously (via the coronary sinus) to synchronize ventricular contraction; ECG QRS may narrow, and the morphology after the pacing spike differs from single-chamber pacing.
CRT 常为双室起搏，用于心衰伴 LBBB。: CRT is usually biventricular pacing for heart failure with LBBB.
DDD 患者出现不明原因宽 QRS 心动过速要想到。: Consider it in DDD patients with unexplained wide-QRS tachycardia.
ICD 可起搏、抗心动过速起搏（ATP）与除颤；心电图可见起搏钉、ATP 快速刺: ICD can pace, provide antitachycardia pacing (ATP), and defibrillate; the ECG may show pacing spikes, rapid ATP stimulation, or a brief pause after defibrillation.
II 与 III 互换，aVR 与 aVF 互换；可出现假性下壁 Q 波与 ST: II and III swapped, aVR and aVF swapped; can produce pseudo-inferior Q waves and ST changes.
I、V5、V6 无 q 波（aVL 可有窄 q）；V5、V6 的 R 峰时间 >: No q waves in I, V5, V6 (aVL may have a narrow q); R peak time in V5, V6 >60 ms.
I、aVF 均负向：极度右偏，需排除导联错接与室速。: Both I and aVF negative: extreme right axis deviation; exclude lead misplacement and VT.
I 导联为左臂-右臂，II 为左腿-右臂，III 为左腿-左臂；aVR、aVL、: Lead I is left arm–right arm, II is left leg–right arm, III is left leg–left arm; aVR, aVL, and aVF are augmented unipolar leads.
I 正、aVF 负时，观察 II 导联：II 仍净正多为生理性左偏（−30° 至: When I is positive and aVF negative, look at lead II: II still net positive is mostly physiologic left axis deviation (−30° to 0°); II net negative suggests pathologic left axis deviation (<−30°), commonly seen in left anterior fascicular block, inferior MI, LVH, etc.
LAFB：电轴左偏，I/aVL qR，下壁 rS，QRS 窄。: LAFB: left axis deviation, qR in I/aVL, rS in inferior leads, narrow QRS.
LBBB/起搏/预激需用专门标准，不直接套用普通 STEMI 阈值。: LBBB/pacing/pre-excitation require dedicated criteria; do not directly apply ordinary STEMI thresholds.
LBBB 使左室侧壁延迟激动、机械不同步；CRT 可改善部分患者。: LBBB delays left ventricular lateral wall activation and causes mechanical dyssynchrony; CRT can improve some patients.
LVH 常伴劳损型 ST-T 改变。: LVH often has strain-pattern ST-T changes.
NBG 代码用 5 个位置描述起搏心腔、感知心腔、反应方式、频率适应与多部位起搏: The NBG code uses 5 positions to describe pacing chamber, sensing chamber, response mode, rate adaptation, and multisite pacing; e.g., VVI, DDD, CRT.
NSTEMI 的心电图可能“不夸张”，但风险不低；动态复查与肌钙蛋白是关键。: The ECG in NSTEMI may be "not dramatic," but risk is not low; serial ECGs and troponin are key.
PE 心电图可正常。: The ECG can be normal in PE.
PR 段代表房室结-希氏束传导；QT 间期代表心室电收缩总时间，包括除极与复极。: The PR segment represents AV node–His bundle conduction; the QT interval represents total ventricular electrical systole, including depolarization and repolarization.
PR 逐搏延长后出现 QRS 脱漏，脱漏后 PR 缩短，呈周期性“渐长—脱漏—重: Normal sinus PR 0.12–0.20 s; first-degree block >0.20 s.
PVC 的危险不只看数量，更看基础心脏病、R-on-T、多源与成串。: PVC risk depends not only on number but also on underlying heart disease, R-on-T, multifocality, and runs.
P′ 波形态与同导联窦性 P 不同，频率通常 150–250 次/分。: P′ morphology differs from sinus P in the same lead; rate is usually 150–250 bpm.
P 与 QRS 无固定关系: No fixed relationship between P and QRS
P 波为窦性（I、II、aVF 直立，aVR 倒置），每个 P 后跟随 QRS。: P waves are sinus (upright in I, II, aVF; inverted in aVR), and each P is followed by a QRS.
P 波在 I、II、aVF 导联直立，在 aVR 导联倒置；同一导联内 P 波形: P waves are upright in leads I, II, and aVF and inverted in lead aVR; P wave morphology is basically consistent within the same lead.
P 波在 aVR 应倒置；若 aVR P 波直立，要考虑导联接错或异位房性心律。: P wave should be inverted in aVR; if the aVR P wave is upright, consider lead reversal or ectopic atrial rhythm.
P 波消失，基线可见细颤 f 波，RR 间期绝对不规则，QRS 窄，符合心房颤动: P waves are absent, fine fibrillatory f waves are visible on the baseline, RR intervals are absolutely irregular, and QRS is narrow, consistent with atrial fibrillation.
P 波突然消失形成长间歇，间歇与基础 PP 间期不成整数倍；危险在于脑供血不足。: P waves suddenly disappear, forming a long pause that is not an integer multiple of the basic PP interval; the danger is cerebral hypoperfusion.
P 波终末力 = 终末负向深度×宽度。: P-wave terminal force = terminal negative depth × width.
P 波高尖也可见于低钾/先心病。: Peaked P waves can also be seen in hypokalemia/congenital heart disease.
QRS 增宽，可呈束支阻滞样；严重时与 T 波融合成正弦波。: Widened QRS, may resemble bundle branch block; in severe cases fuses with T wave into a sine wave.
QTc >480 ms 高疑；LQT1/2/3 诱因不同；晕厥、家族猝死、耳聋（: QTc >480 ms high suspicion; LQT1/2/3 have different triggers; syncope, family history of sudden death, and deafness (Jervell-Lange-Nielsen) are suggestive.
QTc >500 ms 是红灯；长-短周期 + R-on-T 是 TdP 的启动: QTc >500 ms is a red flag; long-short cycle + R-on-T is the triggering combination for TdP.
QTc 延长（男 >450 ms、女 >460 ms），T 波异常；是尖端扭转型: QTc prolongation (men >450 ms, women >460 ms), abnormal T waves; it is the substrate for torsades de pointes.
QT 在 II 或 V5 导联测量，T 波终点用切线法；房颤、束支阻滞、起搏心律: Measure QT in lead II or V5, using the tangent method for the end of the T wave; QT interpretation is limited in AF, bundle branch block, and paced rhythm.
RBBB 的记忆法：V1 的“兔耳”（rsR′）加 I、V6 的“宽尾巴”（宽: Complete right bundle branch block danger signal: new-onset RBBB with acute chest pain, dyspnea, hypotension, or tachycardia; be alert for pulmonary embolism and acute coronary syndrome.
RR 变化呈周期性、渐进性，常与呼吸相关。: RR variation is periodic and gradual, often related to respiration.
RVH 与后壁 MI 都可出现 V1 高 R，但 RVH 常伴电轴右偏、右房增大: RVH and posterior MI can both show a tall R in V1, but RVH often has right axis deviation, right atrial enlargement, and right precordial strain; posterior MI often has ST depression and upright T waves in V1–V3.
ST 段延长、QT 间期延长，T 波形态可正常；严重时手足抽搐、癫痫、心律失常。: ST segment prolongation, QT interval prolongation, and T wave morphology may be normal; in severe cases, tetany, seizures, and arrhythmias.
ST 段延长，QT 间期延长，T 波形态多正常。: ST segment prolongation, QT interval prolongation, and T wave morphology is usually normal.
ST 段：位于 2 相平台期，损伤电流与缺血是最常见解释。: ST segment: located in phase 2 plateau; injury current and ischemia are the most common explanations.
SVT 处理需避免加速旁路。: SVT management should avoid accelerating the accessory pathway.
Sokolow-Lyon：S V1 + R V5 或 V6 ≥35 mm（3.5: Sokolow-Lyon: S V1 + R V5 or V6 ≥35 mm (3.5 mV).
T 高尖/P 低平/QRS 宽。: Tall peaked T / flattened P / wide QRS.
V1 主要看右室与室间隔，V5/V6 主要看左室；胸导联 R 波递增不良、V1: Normal R wave increases gradually from V1→V5, with transition zone at V3–V4.
V1 高 R 的常见原因：右室肥厚、后壁心肌梗死、WPW A 型、RBBB、肥厚: Common causes of tall R in V1: RVH, posterior myocardial infarction, WPW type A, RBBB, hypertrophic cardiomyopathy, and normal variant.
V1 高 R（R/S>1）可见于右室肥厚、后壁心梗、WPW A 型、RBBB、肥: Tall R in V1 (R/S>1) can be seen in right ventricular hypertrophy, posterior MI, WPW type A, RBBB, hypertrophic cardiomyopathy, and normal variant.
V2–V3 的 ST 抬高要按年龄性别“打折”，但典型症状与动态变化优先于数字。: ST elevation in V2–V3 should be “discounted” by age and sex, but typical symptoms and dynamic changes take priority over numbers.
V4R 电极位置不正确或未标记，导致假阴性。: Incorrect V4R electrode position or failure to label it causes false negatives.
WPW：短 PR、delta 波、宽 QRS。: WPW: short PR, delta wave, wide QRS.
“奇怪的图”先怀疑导联，再怀疑心脏；重做一次心电图往往比加做更多检查更有效。: For a “strange ECG,” suspect leads first, then the heart; repeating the ECG is often more effective than adding more tests.
“没有症状”不是停抗凝的理由；房颤的卒中风险是长期的。: “No symptoms” is not a reason to stop anticoagulation; stroke risk in AF is long-term.
“癫痫”反复发作、脑电图正常，别忘了长 QT；一张心电图可能改变诊断。: Recurrent “seizures” with normal EEG: do not forget long QT; one ECG may change the diagnosis.
一个年轻人晕厥，查完患者还要查家族；LQTS 是家族病。: In a young person with syncope, evaluate the family after the patient; LQTS is a familial disease.
三度 AVB：心房率 > 心室率。: Third-degree AVB: atrial rate > ventricular rate.
三度房室阻滞伴晕厥者直接准备起搏，不要用单纯阿托品替代起搏。: For third-degree AV block with syncope, prepare for pacing directly; do not use atropine alone instead of pacing.
下壁 STEMI + 低血压 + 肺清：查 V4R。: Inferior STEMI + hypotension + clear lungs: check V4R.
下壁 STEMI 患者加做 V4R，ST 抬高 ≥1 mm 对右室梗死具有较高特: In inferior STEMI patients, add V4R; ST elevation ≥1 mm has high specificity for right ventricular infarction; clinically there is the triad of hypotension, elevated jugular venous pressure, and clear lungs. V4R elevation often precedes V1 and is more sensitive than V1.
下壁 STEMI 有 II/III/aVF 抬高加 aVL 压低，心包炎 aVL: Inferior STEMI has II/III/aVF elevation plus aVL depression; in pericarditis, aVL is also elevated.
下壁心梗出现病理性 Q 波与 ST 抬高，而非单纯 rS 与电轴左偏。: Inferior MI presents with pathologic Q waves and ST elevation, rather than isolated rS and left axis deviation.
下壁心梗时窦性心动过缓可能对阿托品反应良好，但也要警惕进展为高度房室阻滞。: In inferior MI, sinus bradycardia may respond well to atropine, but be alert for progression to high-grade AV block.
下壁：II、III、aVF；aVL 镜像压低最敏感。: Inferior: II, III, aVF; reciprocal depression in aVL is most sensitive.
不一致时以影像与临床为准。: If inconsistent, imaging and clinical findings prevail.
不能确定时按室速处理，避免使用维拉帕米等房室结阻滞剂。: When uncertain, manage as VT; avoid AV nodal blockers such as verapamil.
不要把所有老年心电图异常都归为“老化”；新发/症状性改变需评估。: Do not attribute all ECG abnormalities in the elderly to 'aging'; new-onset/symptomatic changes require evaluation.
不要把新生儿右室优势误诊为 RVH；需结合年龄与随访。: Do not misdiagnose neonatal right ventricular dominance as RVH; integrate age and follow-up.
不要据此诊断房颤。: Do not diagnose atrial fibrillation based on this.
不要用同一数据集训练与验证；AI 论文要外部验证。: Do not use the same dataset for training and validation; AI papers need external validation.
严重时出现室性心律失常、意识改变、脱水。: In severe cases, ventricular arrhythmias, altered consciousness, and dehydration occur.
事件记录器用于少见阵发性事件。: Event recorders are used for infrequent paroxysmal events.
二度 II 型：PR 固定→突然脱落。: Second-degree type II: fixed PR → sudden dropped beat.
二度 I 型：多为房室结，症状明显时进一步评估。: Second-degree type I: mostly AV node; further evaluation if symptoms are significant.
二级预防与随访：他汀、β 受体阻滞剂（无禁忌时）、ACEI/ARB、心脏康复，出: Secondary prevention and follow-up: statins, β-blockers (if no contraindications), ACEI/ARB, cardiac rehabilitation, and assessment of left ventricular function before discharge.
二联律时心室充盈时间与每搏量交替变化，可出现脉搏强弱交替，但不等同于交替脉。: In bigeminy, ventricular filling time and stroke volume alternate, which can cause alternating pulse strength, but this is not equivalent to pulsus alternans.
亚急性期：ST 回落、T 深倒置、Q 波持续。: Subacute phase: ST resolves, deep T-wave inversion, Q wave persists.
交感神经兴奋、儿茶酚胺升高或迷走张力下降使窦房结第四相除极加速。: Sympathetic activation, increased catecholamines, or decreased vagal tone accelerate phase 4 depolarization of the sinus node.
交感神经通过 β1 受体增加 If 与钙电流，使第四相斜率增大、心率加快；迷走神: Sympathetic nerves increase If and calcium current via β1 receptors, steepening phase 4 and increasing heart rate; vagal nerves reduce If and activate acetylcholine-sensitive potassium channels via M2 receptors, slowing heart rate.
交界区也不出手时，心室以 20–40 次/分被动起搏：宽 QRS、无 P、T 波: When the junctional area also fails to fire, the ventricles are paced passively at 20–40 beats/min: wide QRS, no P wave, inverted T wave; this is a sign of an endangered conduction system.
交界区异位灶自律性增高或触发活动，提前发放冲动。: Increased automaticity or triggered activity of a junctional ectopic focus fires early.
交界性早搏是提前的单个窄 QRS 搏动；逸搏心律是长间歇后的持续替代节律。: A junctional premature beat is a single early narrow QRS beat; an escape rhythm is a sustained replacement rhythm after a long pause.
交界性逸搏心律 QRS 窄、常无 P；三度阻滞有独立窦性 P，QRS 常宽。: Junctional escape rhythm has a narrow QRS and often no P waves; third-degree block has independent sinus P waves and often a wide QRS.
任何一层改变都会体现在最终曲线上：钠通道阻滞改变动作电位上升支，传导阻滞改变激动: Changes at any level appear on the final tracing: sodium channel block alters the action potential upstroke, conduction block alters activation sequence, myocardial hypertrophy alters vector magnitude and direction, and electrode position determines “from which angle you look.”
传导阻滞从房室结到浦肯野系统逐层定位：看 PR 判断房室结/希氏束，看 QRS: Localize conduction block layer by layer from AV node to Purkinje system: use PR to assess AV node/His bundle, QRS width and morphology to assess bundle branches and fascicles; bifascicular and trifascicular block determine risk.
伴尖端扭转型室速：静脉硫酸镁，纠正电解质，必要时起搏/除颤。: With torsades de pointes: intravenous magnesium sulfate, correct electrolytes, and if necessary pacing/defibrillation.
伴晕厥、休克或急性心肌缺血。: With syncope, shock, or acute myocardial ischemia.
伴晕厥、进行性传导阻滞或三度阻滞风险者准备起搏，避免用单纯阿托品替代。: For syncope, progressive conduction block, or risk of third-degree block, prepare for pacing; do not substitute atropine alone.
低电压/电交替→心包填塞；ST 抬高/心律失常→心肌挫伤；Osborn 波→低体: Low voltage/electrical alternans → cardiac tamponade; ST elevation/arrhythmias → myocardial contusion; Osborn wave → hypothermia; right heart strain → pulmonary embolism/pneumothorax.
低血压、心动过缓、室性心律失常或心脏骤停。: Hypotension, bradycardia, ventricular arrhythmia, or cardiac arrest.
低通/高通滤波、基线校正与自动增益可改变 ST 段与 QRS 形态；不同设备设置: Low-pass/high-pass filtering, baseline correction, and automatic gain can alter ST-segment and QRS morphology; different device settings may cause 'pseudo ST elevation/depression'.
低钙 QT 延长、ST 延长。: Hypocalcemia: prolonged QT and prolonged ST.
低钙：有症状静脉葡萄糖酸钙；高钙：补液、降钙素/双膦酸盐。: Hypocalcemia: IV calcium gluconate if symptomatic; hypercalcemia: fluids, calcitonin/bisphosphonates.
低钾有 U 波与 QT 延长；洋地黄 QT 缩短。: Hypokalemia has U waves and QT prolongation; digitalis shortens QT.
低风险年轻患者不常规。: Not routine in low-risk young patients.
偶发无症状：观察，纠正诱因即可。: Occasional and asymptomatic: observe and correct triggers.
先在 V1–V3 寻找 ST 压低，再看 R 波高度与 T 波方向，三项同时存在: First look for ST depression in V1–V3, then assess R-wave height and T-wave direction; when all three are present, posterior involvement is highly suspected.
先心病术后心律失常: Arrhythmias after congenital heart disease surgery
先找药物、电解质、缺血、感染、迷走等可逆因素。: First look for reversible factors: drugs, electrolytes, ischemia, infection, vagal, etc.
先确认 25 mm/s、10 mm/mV，再谈节律与间期；所有判读都建立在正确的: First confirm 25 mm/s, 10 mm/mV, then discuss rhythm and intervals; all interpretation is based on correct calibration.
先确认定标、纸速、导联位置。: First confirm calibration, paper speed, and lead placement.
先确认患者与导联，再处理“报警”。: First confirm the patient and leads, then address the “alarm.”
先确认患者，再处理心律。: Confirm the patient first, then treat the rhythm.
全身血管炎损伤冠脉，形成动脉瘤/血栓；心肌炎也可导致 ST-T 改变。: Systemic vasculitis damages the coronary arteries, forming aneurysm/thrombus; myocarditis can also cause ST-T changes.
创伤患者心电图异常需结合 FAST/超声、生命体征；不要因“心电图正常”排除严重: In trauma patients, ECG abnormalities require integration with FAST/ultrasound and vital signs; do not exclude severe injury because the ECG is 'normal'.
判断 P 与 QRS 的关系：P 在 QRS 前且 PR <0.12 s、P 在: Determine the P-QRS relationship: P before QRS with PR <0.12 s, P after QRS, or no P at all.
刺激迷走神经或 Adenosine 可暂时减慢房室传导，使 P′ 更容易暴露，但: Vagal stimulation or Adenosine can temporarily slow AV conduction and expose P′ more readily, but may not terminate atrial tachycardia.
前壁 STEMI 有相邻导联 ST 抬高与下壁镜像压低，LBBB 为不一致性抬高: Anterior STEMI has ST elevation in adjacent leads and reciprocal depression in inferior leads; LBBB has discordant elevation and no reciprocal changes.
加做 V7–V9 可见 ST 抬高: Additional V7–V9 leads show ST elevation
加做右胸/后壁导联可帮助定位。: Adding right precordial/posterior leads can help localize.
区分未下传房早与二度房室阻滞、窦性停搏: Distinguish non-conducted PACs from second-degree AV block and sinus arrest
卒中后房颤检出率随监测时间增加。: AF detection rate after stroke increases with monitoring duration.
卒中患者 ST 抬高需按 ACS 评估，不能都归为脑心综合征；同时寻找房颤。: In stroke patients, ST elevation should be evaluated as ACS and not all attributed to cerebral-cardiac syndrome; also look for AF.
危急值不是“心电图很吓人”，而是“如果不马上处理，患者可能出事”。: A critical value is not "a scary ECG" but "the patient may have an adverse event if not treated immediately."
双心房增大同时具备右房高 P 波与左房宽/双峰 P 波；P 波可既高又宽，V1: Biatrial enlargement has both tall right atrial P waves and wide/bifid left atrial P waves; P waves may be both tall and wide, with biphasic P waves in V1.
双房增大→P 波又高又宽。: Biatrial enlargement → P waves both tall and wide.
反复症状性交界性逸搏心律，尤其病态窦房结综合征：评估永久起搏器。: Recurrent symptomatic junctional escape rhythm, especially in sick sinus syndrome: evaluate for permanent pacemaker.
发热 + 晕厥 + V1 穹隆型 ST，先按 Brugada 处理，不要只当热性: Fever + syncope + coved ST in V1: manage first as Brugada, do not just treat as febrile seizure.
发热可揭示 Brugada 图形；避免诱发药物，积极退热，晕厥/家族猝死史需 I: Fever can reveal a Brugada pattern; avoid trigger drugs, actively reduce fever, and syncope/family history of sudden death requires ICD evaluation.
发热或用药后出现者，需警惕隐匿性 Brugada。: If it appears after fever or medication, be alert for concealed Brugada.
变异/减速模式比单次数字重要。: Variability/deceleration patterns matter more than a single number.
只看 V2–V3 的 1–2 mm 抬高而忽略年龄/性别阈值，导致过度诊断或漏诊: Looking only at 1–2 mm elevation in V2–V3 while ignoring age/sex thresholds leads to overdiagnosis or missed diagnosis.
只记药物剂量，忽略按压质量与可逆病因。: Remembering only drug doses while ignoring compression quality and reversible causes.
只降钾不保护心肌：严重高钾先静脉钙剂稳定心肌。: Lowering potassium without protecting myocardium: in severe hyperkalemia, give intravenous calcium first to stabilize the myocardium.
可与缺血/心梗相似，需结合电压、动态变化与临床。: Can mimic ischemia/MI; correlate with voltage, dynamic changes, and clinical context.
可发生多形性室速/室颤，常在夜间或休息时发作。: Can cause polymorphic VT/VF, often occurring at night or at rest.
可有 S1Q3T3、右心负荷与低氧，但下壁 ST 抬高不如 STEMI 典型。: May have S1Q3T3, right heart strain, and hypoxemia, but inferior ST elevation is less typical than in STEMI.
可疑后壁：V1–V3 ST 压低 + 高 R + 直立 T，加做 V7–V9。: Suspected posterior: V1–V3 ST depression + tall R + upright T; add V7–V9.
右室肥厚常伴 V1 高 R、电轴右偏和右胸导联劳损；左后分支阻滞呈 I、aVL: Right ventricular hypertrophy often has a tall R in V1, right axis deviation, and right chest lead strain; left posterior fascicular block shows rS in I and aVL, and qR in II, III, and aVF.
右室：V1、V4R；后壁：V1–V3 镜像压低、R 波增高。: Right ventricle: V1, V4R; posterior wall: reciprocal depression and tall R waves in V1–V3.
右心负荷可致电轴右偏。: Right heart strain can cause right axis deviation.
右胸导联出现继发性 ST-T 改变：ST 压低、T 波倒置，方向与 QRS 终末: Secondary ST-T changes in right precordial leads: ST depression and T-wave inversion, opposite to the terminal QRS vector.
合并主动脉瓣狭窄、心肌病等按指南处理；避免使用可能加重传导阻滞的药物。: Manage concomitant aortic stenosis, cardiomyopathy, etc. per guidelines; avoid drugs that may worsen conduction block.
后壁与右室同时受累时 V1 表现不典型，未加做附加导联导致低估范围。: When posterior wall and right ventricle are involved simultaneously, V1 findings are atypical; failure to add additional leads leads to underestimation of extent.
后壁心肌位于心脏后方，标准导联没有直接面向它的电极；后壁损伤电流背离 V1–V3: Posterior myocardium lies behind the heart, and standard leads have no electrode directly facing it; posterior injury current is directed away from V1–V3, producing reciprocal ST depression and tall R waves.
哮喘者腺苷可诱发支气管痉挛。: Adenosine can induce bronchospasm in asthma patients.
四个阶段：从高尖 T 到陈旧 Q 波: Four stages: from peaked T to old Q wave
四型房室阻滞示意：一度 PR 固定延长；二度 I 型 PR 渐长后脱落；二度 I: Schematic of the four AV block types: first-degree fixed PR prolongation; second-degree type I progressive PR lengthening then dropped beat; second-degree type II fixed PR with sudden dropped beat; third-degree complete P-QRS dissociation.
四层链路：离子通道 → 动作电位 → 空间向量 → 导联投影。: Four-level chain: ion channels → action potential → spatial vector → lead projection.
在 II、aVF、V4–V6 找 PR 压低，在 aVR 找 PR 抬高。: Look for PR depression in II, aVF, V4–V6, and PR elevation in aVR.
在 I、aVL 找 qR，在下壁导联找 rS，确认“上左向量”模式。: Look for qR in I and aVL, and rS in inferior leads, confirming the “superior-left vector” pattern.
在 V2–V4 看 T 波与 U 波；在 II 或 V5 量 QT。: Assess T and U waves in V2–V4; measure QT in II or V5.
在基层临床，标准 12 导联仍是首选；理解正交概念有助于读懂向量环与高级教材。: In primary care, the standard 12-lead remains first choice; understanding orthogonal concepts helps interpret vector loops and advanced texts.
在相邻两个及以上导联出现 ST 抬高，V2–V3 按年龄与性别采用不同阈值（男: ST elevation in two or more contiguous leads; for V2–V3, use different thresholds by age and sex (men ≥40 years ≥2 mm, men <40 years ≥2.5 mm, women ≥1.5 mm), other leads ≥1 mm; if reciprocal ST depression also appears in inferior leads, diagnostic specificity is further improved.
基础节律通常是窦性。提前出现的 P 波形态与窦性 P 不同，其后没有 QRS；由: Baseline rhythm is usually sinus. The premature P wave has a different morphology from sinus P and is not followed by QRS; because the P is premature, the next sinus P is often also disturbed, and the pause is usually incompletely compensatory. A long pause itself can readily cause an escape beat or delay of the next sinus P.
增益改变电压的纵向比例；增益过低会低估电压与 ST 改变，过高会造成假性高电压。: Gain changes the vertical scale of voltage; too low gain underestimates voltage and ST changes, while too high gain causes pseudo-high voltage.
多导联比单导联更能识别 P 波与 ST 改变；但佩戴依从性、数据量与报警管理是挑: Multiple leads identify P waves and ST changes better than a single lead; however, wear compliance, data volume, and alarm management are challenges.
多源性房速：同样多变但心率快。: Multifocal atrial tachycardia: also variable but rate is fast.
夺获搏动窄 QRS，前有 P。: Capture beat has narrow QRS, preceded by P.
女性缺血表现常不典型，可能与症状感知、共病和病变模式有关；不能因“不像心梗”漏诊: Ischemic presentation in women is often atypical and may relate to symptom perception, comorbidities, and lesion patterns; do not miss it because it “does not look like MI.”
婴儿心率 >220、窄 QRS 规则。: Infant heart rate >220, regular narrow QRS.
室性并行：联律间期多变 + 公约数。: Ventricular parasystole: variable coupling interval + common divisor.
室性心动过速是起源于希氏束分叉以下的心室快速节律，连续 3 个或以上室性搏动，频: Ventricular tachycardia is a rapid ventricular rhythm originating below the bifurcation of the bundle of His, with 3 or more consecutive ventricular beats and a rate usually >100 beats/min; lasting ≥30 seconds or accompanied by hemodynamic compromise defines sustained VT.
室性逸搏 20–40 次/分，是长间歇后的被动节律；AIVR 50–110 次/: Ventricular escape 20–40 bpm is a passive rhythm after a long pause; AIVR 50–110 bpm is an accelerated rhythm.
室颤无任何可辨 QRS，TdP 仍可辨宽 QRS 的扭转。: VF has no discernible QRS; TdP still shows twisting wide QRS complexes.
容量增加、膈肌上抬、交感激活与激素变化改变心脏位置与电活动。: Increased volume, elevated diaphragm, sympathetic activation, and hormonal changes alter cardiac position and electrical activity.
宽 QRS 不规则心动过速 + 预激病史，先按预激伴房颤处理，不要给维拉帕米。: Wide QRS irregular tachycardia + history of pre-excitation: treat first as pre-excited AF; do not give verapamil.
宽 QRS 心动过速中出现融合波，支持室速；但融合波消失不能排除室速。: Fusion beats during wide QRS tachycardia support VT; however, absence of fusion beats cannot exclude VT.
宽 QRS 心动过速中窄 QRS。: Narrow QRS within wide QRS tachycardia.
宽 QRS 心动过速需优先排除室速。: Wide QRS tachycardia requires exclusion of VT first.
宽 QRS 节律，QRS ≥0.12 s（图例 0.16 s），心室率 20–4: Wide QRS rhythm, QRS ≥0.12 s (example 0.16 s), ventricular rate 20–40 beats/min.
寻找 ST 压低、房早/室早等伴随改变。: Look for accompanying changes such as ST depression and premature atrial/ventricular contractions.
寻找缺血、电解质紊乱、药物（洋地黄、儿茶酚胺）等诱因。: Look for triggers such as ischemia, electrolyte disturbances, and drugs (digitalis, catecholamines).
导联脱落可产生平线，伪装成心搏停止；CPR、电刀、手机振动可产生高幅伪差。: A detached lead can produce a flat line, mimicking asystole; CPR, electrocautery, and phone vibration can produce high-amplitude artifact.
导联轴的方向决定同一心电向量在不同导联上的振幅与极性；这就是为什么 II 与 a: Lead axis direction determines the amplitude and polarity of the same ECG vector in different leads; this is why II and aVR often point in opposite directions.
导联错接是“假性异常”的常见原因；读图前确认 aVR P 波倒置、I/II P: Lead misplacement is a common cause of “pseudo-abnormalities”; before interpretation, confirm inverted P wave in aVR, upright P waves in I/II, and R-wave progression in precordial leads.
射频消融前需标测靶点。: Target mapping is required before radiofrequency ablation.
尖端扭转型室速：静脉硫酸镁 2 g，必要时重复；无脉/不稳定立即非同步除颤。: Torsades de pointes: IV magnesium sulfate 2 g, repeat if necessary; if pulseless/unstable, immediate asynchronous defibrillation.
左主干：aVR ST 抬高 ≥1 mm，伴多导联 ST 压低与广泛缺血表现。: Left main: aVR ST elevation ≥1 mm with multi-lead ST depression and widespread ischemia.
左室肥厚伴劳损表现为侧壁导联 ST 段压低、T 波倒置，常呈不对称、下斜型；对应: LVH with strain shows ST depression and T-wave inversion in lateral leads, often asymmetric and downsloping; corresponding right precordial leads may show ST elevation.
左束支阻滞：QRS ≥120 ms，V1 呈 QS 或 rS，V6 呈宽大 R: Left bundle branch block: QRS ≥120 ms, QS or rS in V1, broad R wave without q wave in V6, and similarly broad R in I/aVL. LBBB can mask infarction patterns and should be assessed with Sgarbossa or modified criteria; new LBBB with ischemic symptoms should be evaluated per STEMI pathway.
差异性传导与室速/室早的鉴别靠房室关系、形态、既往图与临床；不能只看宽度。: Differentiating aberrancy from VT/PVCs relies on AV relationship, morphology, prior ECGs, and clinical context; do not rely on width alone.
差异性传导指室上性冲动因束支不应期不同而呈宽 QRS，常为 RBBB 型；心率快: Aberrant conduction means a supraventricular impulse shows wide QRS due to differing bundle branch refractoriness, often RBBB type; more common at fast heart rates.
希氏束以下：QRS 宽、二度 II 型、三度宽逸搏、晕厥、风险高。: Below His bundle: wide QRS, second-degree type II, third-degree wide escape, syncope, high risk.
常见于 STEMI 溶栓或 PCI 再灌注、洋地黄中毒、心肌炎、高钾血症和缺氧，: Common in reperfusion after thrombolysis or PCI for STEMI, digitalis toxicity, myocarditis, hyperkalemia, and hypoxia; can also occur as short episodes without structural heart disease.
常见于特发性传导系统纤维化、急性心肌梗死、心肌炎、心脏术后、药物中毒、高钾血症和: Commonly seen in idiopathic conduction system fibrosis, acute myocardial infarction, myocarditis, post-cardiac surgery, drug toxicity, hyperkalemia, and congenital block.
常见于联合瓣膜病、先心病、心衰晚期。: Common in combined valvular disease, congenital heart disease, and advanced heart failure.
常见设计：诊断准确性、预后队列、随机试验、回顾性数据库；需避免数据泄漏与过拟合。: Common designs: diagnostic accuracy, prognostic cohort, randomized trials, retrospective databases; avoid data leakage and overfitting.
年轻卒中、Holter 正常，不等于没有房颤；考虑延长监测。: Young stroke with normal Holter does not rule out AF; consider prolonged monitoring.
广泛压低加 aVR 抬高，是左主干或三支病变的危险暗号。: Widespread depression plus aVR elevation is a danger signal for left main or three-vessel disease.
异位间期有公约数。: Ectopic intervals have a common denominator.
心内电图记录局部心肌的除极时间与电压，用于标测心律失常起源、旁路位置与消融靶点。: Intracardiac electrograms record local myocardial depolarization timing and voltage, used to map arrhythmia origin, accessory pathway location, and ablation targets.
心包炎为弥漫性 ST 抬高，无相邻导联局限。: Pericarditis shows diffuse ST elevation without limitation to adjacent leads.
心室复极钾/钠通道功能异常或药物阻滞，使动作电位时程延长，易发生早期后除极。: Abnormal ventricular repolarization potassium/sodium channel function or drug blockade prolongs action potential duration and predisposes to early afterdepolarizations.
心室率可快速（>100）、正常或缓慢（<60）；慢而规则需警惕三度阻滞。: Ventricular rate may be fast (>100), normal, or slow (<60); a slow, regular rate should raise suspicion of third-degree block.
心室率可规则（固定比例，如 2:1 约 150 次/分）或不规则（可变比例）。: Ventricular rate may be regular (fixed ratio, e.g., 2:1 at about 150 beats/min) or irregular (variable ratio).
心室率慢而规则的房颤，可能是房颤伴三度阻滞，不应只当“控制良好”。: Slow, regular atrial fibrillation may be AF with third-degree block and should not be considered merely “well controlled.”
心室率控制 + 抗凝风险评估。: Ventricular rate control + anticoagulation risk assessment.
心室电活动完全紊乱，无可见 P-QRS-T，符合心室颤动；患者应无脉，立即 CP: Completely disorganized ventricular electrical activity with no visible P-QRS-T, consistent with ventricular fibrillation; the patient should be pulseless; immediate CPR and unsynchronized defibrillation.
心室肥厚常伴继发性复极异常：ST 段与 T 波方向与 QRS 主波相反，称为“劳: Ventricular hypertrophy often has secondary repolarization abnormalities: ST segment and T wave directions are opposite to the main QRS deflection, called 'strain pattern' changes.
心室起搏点“抢跑”到 50–110 次/分：宽 QRS、无 P 或房室分离，常见: Ventricular pacemaker 'runs ahead' to 50–110 beats/min: wide QRS, absent P waves or AV dissociation, commonly seen in reperfusion, and mostly short-lived and self-limited.
心悸患者“发作时心电图”比“平时心电图”值钱；想办法抓到那一刻。: For palpitations, an ECG during an episode is more valuable than a baseline ECG; try to capture that moment.
心房增大改变心房除极向量的振幅、方向和持续时间；右房增大偏向下前，左房增大偏向后: Atrial enlargement changes the amplitude, direction, and duration of the atrial depolarization vector; right atrial enlargement is directed inferiorly and anteriorly, while left atrial enlargement is directed posteriorly and leftward.
心率 <40 次/分，或出现低血压、意识改变、晕厥、胸痛、心力衰竭。: Heart rate <40 beats/min, or hypotension, altered consciousness, syncope, chest pain, or heart failure.
心率突然变化先看自主神经与药物，再看窦房结本身；不要把所有窦性心动过缓都当作病态: For sudden heart rate changes, look first at autonomic tone and drugs, then at the SA node itself; do not treat all sinus bradycardia as sick sinus syndrome.
心电图学的未来不是“机器取代人”，而是“人用机器看得更远”；基础越牢，工具越有用: The future of electrocardiography is not “machines replacing people,” but “people using machines to see farther”; the stronger the foundation, the more useful the tools.
心电图形态决定是否除颤；但必须先确认无脉/无意识，不能只看监护仪。: ECG morphology determines whether to defibrillate; but first confirm pulselessness/unresponsiveness, not just the monitor.
心电图正常不能排除肺栓塞；确诊依赖 CTPA/通气灌注扫描。: A normal ECG cannot exclude pulmonary embolism; diagnosis relies on CTPA/ventilation-perfusion scan.
心电成像通过体表多导联重建心脏电活动，探索心律失常起源与心室激动顺序；目前多用于: ECG imaging reconstructs cardiac electrical activity from multi-lead body surface recordings, exploring arrhythmia origins and ventricular activation sequence; it is currently mostly used in research.
心肌与传导系统发育未成熟，间期随年龄增长；心率快时 QT 测量更困难。: The myocardium and conduction system are immature, and intervals increase with age; QT measurement is more difficult at fast heart rates.
心肌炎心电图可模拟心梗；儿童胸痛/心衰 + 病毒前驱史需警惕。: Myocarditis ECG can mimic MI; be alert in children with chest pain/heart failure + viral prodrome.
心肌肥厚、纤维化与微血管缺血导致心律失常；运动时儿茶酚胺增加风险。: Myocardial hypertrophy, fibrosis, and microvascular ischemia cause arrhythmias; catecholamines during exercise increase risk.
心脏记忆可模拟缺血性 T 波倒置；结合近期起搏/心律失常史与动态变化。: Cardiac memory can mimic ischemic T-wave inversion; correlate with recent pacing/arrhythmia history and dynamic changes.
忽略年轻患者 LVH 可能提示肥厚型心肌病或 Fabry 病。: Do not overlook that LVH in young patients may suggest hypertrophic cardiomyopathy or Fabry disease.
忽视可逆病因，反复除颤而不处理高钾、缺血或低体温。: Ignoring reversible causes and repeatedly defibrillating without treating hyperkalemia, ischemia, or hypothermia.
急性前壁心肌梗死合并新发 LAFB 提示较大范围缺血，应积极再灌注。: Acute anterior myocardial infarction with new-onset LAFB suggests a larger area of ischemia; active reperfusion should be pursued.
急性后壁 ST 段抬高型心肌梗死: Acute posterior ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction
急救: Chest compressions and ventilation to maintain vital organ perfusion.
患者无脉搏、无意识、无有效呼吸。: Patient is pulseless, unconscious, and not breathing effectively.
患者状态与波形不一致。: Patient status does not match the waveform.
患者移动、转运、抽搐可产生高幅不规则伪差，模拟室速/室颤；常见于急诊与院前。: Patient movement, transport, and seizures can produce high-amplitude irregular artifact mimicking VT/VF; common in emergency and prehospital settings.
感知过度指起搏器把肌肉电、电磁干扰、T 波或远场信号误认为自身电活动，导致起搏被: Oversensing means the pacemaker misinterprets muscle electrical activity, electromagnetic interference, T waves, or far-field signals as intrinsic electrical activity, causing inappropriate inhibition of pacing.
成人 PR 间期 >0.20 s，每个 P 波后均有 QRS。: Adult PR interval >0.20 s, with a QRS after every P wave.
房室分离、心室率慢（常 <55–70 次/分）、QRS 可窄；胎儿超声可发现心动: AV dissociation, slow ventricular rate (often <55–70 beats/min), QRS may be narrow; fetal ultrasound can detect bradycardia/hydrops.
房室结不应期受迷走张力影响；房颤时心室率的不规则来自隐匿性传导与不应期的动态变化: AV node refractoriness is affected by vagal tone; in AF, irregular ventricular rate comes from concealed conduction and dynamic changes in refractoriness.
房室结双径路或旁路形成折返环，一次冲动可再次激动心房/心室。: Dual AV nodal pathways or an accessory pathway form a reentry circuit; a single impulse can re-activate the atrium/ventricle.
房室结慢传导造成 PR 段，并过滤过快房性冲动。: Slow AV node conduction creates the PR segment and filters excessively fast atrial impulses.
房室结细胞动作电位上升支依赖 L 型钙电流，传导速度慢，形成 PR 段。这种延迟: The upstroke of the AV nodal cell action potential depends on L-type calcium current, conduction velocity is slow, forming the PR segment. This delay allows the atria to complete filling before ventricular contraction.
房室阻滞分度、定位与起搏决策: AV block grading, localization, and pacing decisions
房室阻滞按程度分为一度、二度 I 型、二度 II 型与三度。二度 I 型多为房室: AV block is graded as first-degree, second-degree type I, second-degree type II, and third-degree. Type I is mostly AV nodal disease, with narrow QRS and better prognosis; type II and third-degree with wide QRS are more likely below the His bundle and have higher risk of progression to complete block.
房早伴室内差异性传导时可出现宽 QRS，容易与室早混淆；未下传时则只剩 P 波。: PAC with aberrant ventricular conduction can produce a wide QRS, easily confused with PVC; when non-conducted, only the P wave remains. Consecutive non-conducted PACs can form paired or short-run atrial tachycardia-like patterns and need differentiation from atrial tachycardia with AV block.
房早伴差异性传导时 QRS 可宽大，易与室早混淆；寻找提前的 P′ 是关键。: In atrial premature beat with aberrant conduction, QRS may be wide and easily confused with PVC; finding the early P′ is key.
房早后出现长间歇或晕厥，需排查病态窦房结综合征。: Long pause or syncope after atrial premature beat requires evaluation for sick sinus syndrome.
房速 2:1 传导时心室率约 140–150 次/分，易误诊为窦性心动过速。: With 2:1 conduction in atrial tachycardia, the ventricular rate is about 140–150 beats/min, easily misdiagnosed as sinus tachycardia.
房颤与呼吸事件相关。: AF is associated with respiratory events.
房颤伴三度房室阻滞时心室率慢而规则，可出现晕厥。: In atrial fibrillation with third-degree AV block, the ventricular rate is slow and regular, and syncope may occur.
房颤心室率不规则。: Irregular ventricular rate in atrial fibrillation.
房颤抗凝由卒中风险决定，不由症状决定；CHA₂DS₂-VASc 3 分通常推荐抗: AF anticoagulation is determined by stroke risk, not symptoms; CHA₂DS₂-VASc 3 usually recommends anticoagulation.
房颤无 P 波，RR 绝对不规则。: Atrial fibrillation has no P waves, and RR intervals are absolutely irregular.
房颤无规则 F 波，基线细颤，RR 绝对不规则。: Atrial fibrillation has no regular F waves, a fine fibrillatory baseline, and absolutely irregular RR intervals.
房颤终止后长间歇是典型表现。: Long pauses after AF termination are a typical finding.
房颤负荷用于风险与疗效评估。: AF burden is used for risk and efficacy assessment.
手足抽搐、喉痉挛、癫痫或意识改变。: Carpopedal spasm, laryngeal spasm, seizures, or altered consciousness.
把 Brugada 波误认为右束支阻滞或正常变异。: Mistaking Brugada waves for right bundle branch block or a normal variant.
把 P/QRS/T 与离子通道、动作电位时相、传导顺序和向量投影逐一对应，遇到宽: Map P/QRS/T to ion channels, action potential phases, conduction sequence, and vector projection one by one, so when encountering wide QRS, ST changes, or axis deviation you can return to mechanism-based localization rather than just memorizing patterns.
把 ST 延长误认为缺血性 ST 改变；低钙的 T 波通常正常。: Mistaking ST prolongation for ischemic ST changes; T waves in hypocalcemia are usually normal.
把 V1 的 rsR′ 一律当作 RBBB：QRS <0.12 s 的正常变异、: Treating rsR′ in V1 as RBBB universally: normal variants with QRS <0.12 s, incomplete RBBB, and Brugada patterns can all show similar morphology.
把 VT 误认为 SVT 伴差异性传导，使用维拉帕米可能导致循环崩溃。: Mistaking VT for SVT with aberrancy; using verapamil may cause circulatory collapse.
把传导阻滞的部位与体表心电图改变对应起来: Correlate the site of conduction block with surface ECG changes
把心房扑动伴规则心室率误认为三度阻滞：房扑的 F 波可能被误读为 P 波，需观察: Mistaking atrial flutter with regular ventricular rate for third-degree block: flutter F waves may be misread as P waves; observe baseline sawtooth waves and atrial rate; atrial flutter with regular slow ventricular rate may suggest drug effect or AV block.
把电轴与分支阻滞/心室肥厚联系: Relate axis to fascicular block/ventricular hypertrophy
报告不要写“建议进一步检查”就结束；要说明“怀疑什么、多紧急、下一步做什么”。: Reports should not end with 'recommend further examination'; state 'what is suspected, how urgent, and what to do next'.
持续心电监护：下壁心梗易出现窦性心动过缓与房室阻滞。: Continuous ECG monitoring: inferior MI is prone to sinus bradycardia and atrioventricular block.
持续缓慢逸搏伴症状需起搏评估。: Persistent slow escape beats with symptoms require pacing evaluation.
按导联分区说出前壁、下壁、侧壁、后壁与右室梗死的对应导联: Name the corresponding leads for anterior, inferior, lateral, posterior, and right ventricular infarction by lead territory
按急性冠脉综合征处理：心电监护、抗血小板与抗凝评估，尽快再灌注。: Manage as acute coronary syndrome: cardiac monitoring, antiplatelet and anticoagulation assessment, and reperfusion as soon as possible.
提前出现的 QRS 波群，时限 ≥0.12 s，形态宽大畸形。: An early QRS complex with a duration ≥0.12 s and a wide, bizarre morphology.
提前出现的异常 P′ 波，后跟窄 QRS；代偿间歇通常不完全。: An abnormal P′ wave appearing early, followed by a narrow QRS; the compensatory pause is usually incomplete.
新发/动态改变要排除缺血。: New/dynamic changes require exclusion of ischemia.
新发 RBBB 伴急性胸痛、呼吸困难、低血压或心动过速，警惕肺栓塞与急性冠脉综合: New-onset RBBB with acute chest pain, dyspnea, hypotension, or tachycardia: be alert for pulmonary embolism and acute coronary syndrome.
新发室速、室颤或高度房室阻滞；前壁心梗易并发束支阻滞。: New-onset ventricular tachycardia, ventricular fibrillation, or high-grade atrioventricular block; anterior MI is prone to bundle branch block.
新发晕厥/跌倒、房颤、长间歇、三度 AVB、QT 延长需要重视；老化可解释部分改: New-onset syncope/falls, AF, long pauses, third-degree AVB, and QT prolongation require attention; aging can explain some changes but not all.
新生儿三度 AVB 是急症；心率 <55 或灌注差需立即起搏/转诊。: Neonatal third-degree AVB is an emergency; heart rate <55 or poor perfusion requires immediate pacing/referral.
新生儿传导系统未成熟、自律性高；先心病、心肌炎、电解质异常可诱发。: Neonatal conduction system is immature with high automaticity; congenital heart disease, myocarditis, and electrolyte abnormalities can trigger it.
新生儿心电图异常需结合血氧、灌注、血糖、电解质与先心病筛查；不能单凭图形诊断。: Neonatal ECG abnormalities require integration with oxygen saturation, perfusion, glucose, electrolytes, and congenital heart disease screening; do not diagnose based on tracing alone.
新生儿电轴 +60° 至 +180° 可见；V1 R/S>1 常见；QRS 时限: Newborn axis +60° to +180° may be seen; V1 R/S >1 is common; QRS duration is shorter than in adults.
无症状、短暂且可逆者：纠正病因，持续心电监护。: For asymptomatic, transient, and reversible cases: correct the cause and continue ECG monitoring.
无症状且诱因可逆者：纠正病因，停用减慢房室结传导的药物，持续监护。: Asymptomatic with reversible triggers: correct the cause, stop drugs that slow AV nodal conduction, continuous monitoring.
无脉/不稳定：立即非同步除颤，按心脏骤停流程处理；不要使用同步电复律。: Pulseless/unstable: immediate unsynchronized defibrillation and manage per cardiac arrest protocol; do not use synchronized cardioversion.
无脉、低血压、意识丧失、胸痛、心衰——立即 CPR/电复律。: Pulseless, hypotension, loss of consciousness, chest pain, heart failure—immediate CPR/electrical cardioversion.
无钉不等于无起搏。: No spike does not mean no pacing.
晕厥/家族猝死需 ICD 评估。: Syncope/family history of sudden death requires ICD evaluation.
晕厥、胸痛、心悸，尤其年轻运动员或肥厚型心肌病家族史。: Syncope, chest pain, palpitations, especially in young athletes or with a family history of hypertrophic cardiomyopathy.
晕厥反复、Holter 正常时，ILR 比反复住院更能抓到“那一刻”。: With recurrent syncope and normal Holter, an ILR captures 'that moment' better than repeated hospitalization.
晚钠电流；QT 显著延长。: Late sodium current; marked QT prolongation.
智能手表单导联心电图易受运动、接触、电极干燥影响，产生伪差；房颤算法也可能假阳性: Smartwatch single-lead ECG is susceptible to motion, contact, and electrode dryness, producing artifact; atrial fibrillation algorithms may also produce false positives.
最具特异性的是“短 PR + delta 波（QRS 起始部粗钝）+ QRS 增: The most specific is 'short PR + delta wave (slurred QRS onset) + widened QRS + secondary ST-T changes'; intermittent pre-excitation suggests a longer accessory pathway refractory period and relatively lower risk.
最具特异性的是“突发突止的规则窄 QRS 心动过速，P 波常埋藏于 QRS 或其: Most specific is 'paroxysmal, regular narrow QRS tachycardia, with P waves often buried in or after the QRS (retrograde P)'; AVNRT commonly shows a pseudo-r′ (V1) or pseudo-s (II, III, aVF), while the retrograde P in AVRT is often located farther after the QRS.
最后看 ST-T、QT 与电轴，形成完整结论：节律、频率、间期、形态。: Finally assess ST-T, QT, and axis to form a complete conclusion: rhythm, rate, intervals, morphology.
有猝死家族史时需遗传/专科评估。: With a family history of sudden death, genetic/specialist evaluation is needed.
有脉不稳定快速心律：同步电复律；房颤 120–200 J，房扑/SVT 50–1: Unstable tachyarrhythmia with a pulse: synchronized cardioversion; AF 120–200 J, atrial flutter/SVT 50–100 J, monomorphic VT 100 J.
未下传房早为单个提前 P′ 后无 QRS，不是规律性周期脱漏。: A non-conducted premature atrial contraction is a single premature P′ not followed by QRS, not regular cyclic dropped beats.
术后房颤常见于心脏/胸科/大手术，多发生在术后 2–4 天；需评估缺血、感染、肺: Postoperative AF is common after cardiac/thoracic/major surgery, mostly on postoperative days 2–4; assess ischemia, infection, pulmonary embolism, electrolytes, and volume.
查起搏器记录确认模式。: Check pacemaker records to confirm the mode.
检查导线阻抗、阈值、电池。: Check lead impedance, threshold, and battery.
检查灵敏度、导线、电磁环境。: Check sensitivity, leads, and electromagnetic environment.
正常变异应稳定、无动态演变、无病理性 Q。: Normal variants should be stable, without dynamic evolution or pathologic Q waves.
正常新生儿心率 120–160、PR 0.08–0.16 s、QRS <0.08: Normal neonatal heart rate 120–160, PR 0.08–0.16 s, QRS <0.08 s; V1 R/S >1 is common.
正常窦性 PR 0.12–0.20 s；一度阻滞 >0.20 s。: First-Degree AV Block must be differentiated from Second-Degree AV Block Type I: Type I has progressive PR prolongation and dropped QRS; in first-degree, every P is conducted.
每个 P 波都下传，但 PR 恒定 >0.20 s；多数无症状，重点找病因并监测: Every P wave is conducted, but PR is constant >0.20 s; most patients are asymptomatic, so focus on finding the cause and monitoring for progression.
洋地黄中毒的“背景音乐”常是交界性早搏/交界性心动过速。: The “background music” of digitalis toxicity is often junctional premature beats/junctional tachycardia.
洋地黄效应本身无需停药，但需评估是否中毒。: Digitalis effect itself does not require discontinuation, but assess whether toxicity is present.
洋地黄效应（鱼钩样压低）与低钾血症（ST 压低加 U 波）误判为 ACS。: Digitalis effect (fishhook-like depression) and hypokalemia (ST depression plus U waves) misdiagnosed as ACS.
洋地黄效应：ST 段鱼钩样下垂、T 波低平/倒置、QT 缩短；中毒：恶心、视觉异: Digitalis effect: fishhook-like ST segment depression, flattened/inverted T waves, shortened QT; toxicity: nausea, visual abnormalities, arrhythmias (atrial tachycardia with block, premature ventricular contractions).
测量 PR 与 QRS，寻找 delta 波。: Measure PR and QRS; look for a delta wave.
测量多个搏动取平均，避免单个搏动的误差。: Measure multiple beats and average to avoid errors from a single beat.
浦肯野纤维从心内膜面向外膜面快速传导，使左右心室几乎同步除极。正常心室除极约 0: Purkinje fibers conduct rapidly from endocardium to epicardium, causing nearly simultaneous depolarization of the left and right ventricles. Normal ventricular depolarization is about 0.08–0.10 s, appearing as a narrow QRS on the surface ECG.
特殊高危图形：Wellens 综合征（V2–V3 深倒 T）与 De Winte: Special high-risk patterns: Wellens syndrome (deep inverted T waves in V2–V3) and De Winter pattern (upsloping depression plus tall peaked T waves) suggest proximal left anterior descending artery occlusion.
用 50 mm/s 的图纸按 25 mm/s 读数，会把间期算短一半。: Reading a 50 mm/s tracing at 25 mm/s will calculate the interval as half as long.
用 II 区分正常与左偏: Use lead II to distinguish normal from left axis deviation
用阿托品后 PR 缩短就认为治愈，忽略病因和进展风险。: Assuming cure because PR shortens after atropine, while ignoring the cause and risk of progression.
电偶、向量与心电向量环: Electric dipole, vectors, and the ECG vector loop
电极脱落/接触不良导致基线漂移、平线、突发高幅噪声；可模拟心搏停止或室颤。: Electrode detachment/poor contact causes baseline drift, flat line, and sudden high-amplitude noise; it can mimic asystole or VF.
电生理检查通过心内电极记录局部电活动并进行程序刺激，评估窦房结、房室结、旁路与心: Electrophysiology study uses intracardiac electrodes to record local electrical activity and perform programmed stimulation, evaluating the sinus node, AV node, accessory pathways, and arrhythmia mechanisms.
电解质异常的心电图改变不是线性的，必须结合化验。: ECG changes of electrolyte abnormalities are not linear; correlate with laboratory tests.
电轴右偏 + V1 高 R + 右胸劳损：考虑 RVH/肺心病。: Right axis deviation + tall R in V1 + right precordial strain: consider RVH/cor pulmonale.
电轴本身不是治疗对象；处理其背后的传导、肥厚或缺血原因。: The axis itself is not the treatment target; manage the underlying conduction, hypertrophy, or ischemia cause.
疑后壁受累：V1–V3 ST 压低、R 波增高、T 波直立，V7–V9 可证实。: Suspected posterior wall involvement: ST depression in V1–V3, increased R wave, upright T wave; V7–V9 can confirm.
症状性心动过缓可试用阿托品 1 mg 静脉推注，每 3–5 分钟重复，最大 3: For symptomatic bradycardia, try atropine 1 mg IV push, repeat every 3–5 minutes, maximum 3 mg; however, it is often ineffective in third-degree block and cannot replace pacing.
症状明显者可试用 β 受体阻滞剂；频发且症状严重者转诊心内科。: For marked symptoms, a β-blocker may be tried; if frequent and severe, refer to cardiology.
监护仪可能把高尖 T 波或起搏钉误认为 R 波，显示心率约为真实心率的两倍；也可: The monitor may mistake tall peaked T waves or pacemaker spikes for R waves, displaying a heart rate about twice the true rate; it may also miss low-amplitude QRS complexes.
监护仪报警不等于患者心律失常；先看人，再看图。: Monitor alarm does not equal arrhythmia; look at the patient first, then the tracing.
监护导联优先保证连续、稳定和报警可靠性，而不是完整 12 导联诊断；常见 II: Monitoring leads prioritize continuous, stable signals and reliable alarms rather than complete 12-lead diagnosis; common choices are lead II, lead V1, or modified 3-lead.
相邻两个导联出现水平型或下斜型 ST 压低 ≥1 mm（0.1 mV），比上斜型: Horizontal or downsloping ST depression ≥1 mm (0.1 mV) in two contiguous leads is more specific than upsloping depression; widespread ST depression (≥6 leads) with aVR elevation ≥1 mm strongly suggests left main or three-vessel disease.
看到“房颤负荷 2%”不要只说“很少”；要结合卒中风险与症状决定是否抗凝。: When you see 'AF burden 2%,' do not just say 'very low'; combine stroke risk and symptoms to decide on anticoagulation.
看到宽 QRS 就诊断室速而忽略预激、高钾、药物。: Interpretation steps for Wide QRS Tachycardia Differentiation: first confirm whether the patient has a pulse and is stable, then analyze the tracing.
确认节律是否绝对规则、QRS 是否窄。: Confirm whether the rhythm is absolutely regular and whether the QRS is narrow.
离子通道/结构蛋白突变导致电活动或心肌结构异常；外显率与年龄相关。: Mutations in ion channels/structural proteins cause abnormal electrical activity or myocardial structure; penetrance is age-related.
程控感知阈值与导线位置。: Program sensing threshold and check lead position.
程控是金标准。: Device interrogation is the gold standard.
稳定患者：按肺栓塞危险分层抗凝（低分子肝素/直接口服抗凝药）。: Stable patients: anticoagulation according to pulmonary embolism risk stratification (low-molecular-weight heparin/direct oral anticoagulants).
窄 QRS + 规则 + 心率 150：先想房扑 2:1，再想 AVNRT。: Narrow QRS + regular + rate 150: first think atrial flutter 2:1, then AVNRT.
窦性 P 波，PR 恒定（通常正常或轻度延长），周期性出现 P 后无 QRS。: Second-degree AV block, Mobitz type II
窦性心律不齐为渐进性 RR 变化，P 波不会突然消失。: Sinus arrhythmia shows gradual RR variation; the P wave does not suddenly disappear.
窦性心律，左室导联电压增高，V5/V6 及 I 导联 ST 压低伴 T 波倒置，: Sinus rhythm, increased voltage in left ventricular leads, ST depression with T-wave inversion in V5/V6 and lead I, consistent with left ventricular hypertrophy with strain pattern.
窦性心律，心房率约 88 次/分，PR 由 0.18 s 逐搏延长至 0.34: Sinus rhythm, atrial rate about 88 bpm, PR prolongs beat by beat from 0.18 s to 0.34 s, and QRS is dropped after the 4th P wave, consistent with second-degree type I AV block.
窦性心律，心率约 42 次/分，PR 0.18 s，QRS 窄，未见 P 波脱漏: Sinus rhythm, heart rate about 42 beats/min, PR 0.18 s, narrow QRS, no dropped P waves.
窦性心律，心率约 50 次/分，P 波低平，PR 延长，QRS 增宽，T 波高尖: Sinus rhythm, heart rate about 50 beats/min, flat P waves, prolonged PR, widened QRS, tall peaked symmetrical T waves, consistent with ECG changes of hyperkalemia.
窦性心律，心率约 76 次/分，电轴左偏约 −60°，I、aVL 呈 qR，II: Sinus rhythm, heart rate about 76 beats/min, left axis deviation about −60°, qR in I and aVL, rS in II, III, and aVF, QRS 0.09 s.
窦房结停摆时交界区接班：窄 QRS、40–60 次/分，P 波缺失或逆行，关键在: When the sinus node stops, the junctional area takes over: narrow QRS, 40–60 beats/min, absent or retrograde P waves; the key is to find “why it is slow.”
窦房结的自主节律约 60–100 次/分，受交感与迷走神经双重调制；心率变化首先: The intrinsic rhythm of the SA node is about 60–100 beats/min and is dually modulated by sympathetic and vagal nerves; changes in heart rate primarily reflect autonomic tone, not “the heart is broken.”
窦速/房颤常见；右心负荷图形。: Sinus tachycardia/AF common; right heart strain pattern.
窦速与发热不相称、低电压、ST 抬高/压低、房室阻滞、室速；肌钙蛋白/BNP 升: Sinus tachycardia disproportionate to fever, low voltage, ST elevation/depression, AV block, VT; elevated troponin/BNP.
窦速是表现，不是病因；肺栓塞可表现为窦速。: Sinus tachycardia is a manifestation, not a cause; pulmonary embolism can present as sinus tachycardia.
立即启动 STEMI 再灌注：首选急诊 PCI，无法及时 PCI 时考虑溶栓。: Diagnostic criteria for STEMI Lead Localization and Culprit Vessel: anterior wall: V1–V4; extensive anterior wall can involve I, aVL, V5, V6.
等频性：频率接近、PR 渐变。: Isorhythmic: similar rates, gradual PR change.
糖皮质激素仅用于 NSAID 与秋水仙碱禁忌或无效者，因复发率较高，不作为常规。: Glucocorticoids are only for those with contraindications to or ineffective NSAIDs and colchicine; because of higher recurrence rates, they are not routine.
纠正缺血、低钾、低镁、甲亢与药物诱因；急性心梗后 PVC 按指南管理。: Correct ischemia, hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia, hyperthyroidism, and drug triggers; manage PVCs after acute MI per guidelines.
纠正缺血、低钾、低镁与洋地黄中毒。: Correct ischemia, hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia, and digitalis toxicity.
细胞膜超极化与兴奋性改变可诱发房早、室早、室速、尖端扭转型室速，尤其合并低镁时。: Membrane hyperpolarization and altered excitability can induce premature atrial contractions, premature ventricular contractions, ventricular tachycardia, and torsades de pointes, especially with concomitant hypomagnesemia.
细颤、除颤无效、长时间缺氧——预后差，需高质量 CPR。: Fine VF, refractory defibrillation, prolonged hypoxia—poor prognosis; requires high-quality CPR.
结合劳损、左房增大与超声。: Correlate with strain, left atrial enlargement, and echocardiography.
结合程控与起搏器记录。: Correlate with programming and pacemaker records.
结合药物、电解质、缺血和症状，寻找可逆原因。: Consider drugs, electrolytes, ischemia, and symptoms to identify reversible causes.
结合血气、超声与临床。: Correlate with blood gas, echocardiography, and clinical context.
结合超声与病史寻找病因：高血压、主动脉瓣狭窄、扩张型心肌病、前壁缺血。: Use echocardiography and history to identify the cause: hypertension, aortic stenosis, dilated cardiomyopathy, anterior ischemia.
结论要分级：正常/正常变异/异常但非急症/危急值；危急值需电话闭环。: Conclusions should be graded: normal/normal variant/abnormal but non-emergent/critical value; critical values require closed-loop telephone notification.
缺血性卒中后房颤检出率随监测时间增加；ST 改变可能来自卒中本身或合并冠心病。: After ischemic stroke, AF detection rate increases with monitoring duration; ST changes may be due to stroke itself or comorbid coronary heart disease.
罕见；常伴严重心房病变。: Rare; often associated with severe atrial disease.
老年人新出现明显窦性心律不齐，需排查病态窦房结综合征与药物影响。: New marked sinus arrhythmia in older adults requires evaluation for sick sinus syndrome and drug effects.
肢体导联看额面，胸导联看水平面。: Limb leads view the frontal plane; chest leads view the horizontal plane.
肺心病/肺动脉高压是常见背景。: Cor pulmonale/pulmonary hypertension is a common background.
肺栓塞导致右室压力负荷、右心扩张与传导延迟；小栓塞心电图可正常。: Pulmonary embolism causes right ventricular pressure overload, right heart dilation, and conduction delay; ECG can be normal in small emboli.
胸导联异常先确认位置与导联错接，再谈病理；V1 高 R 不等于右室肥厚。: For chest lead abnormalities, first confirm lead position and misconnection before considering pathology; a tall R in V1 does not equal right ventricular hypertrophy.
胸痛患者心电图正常但持续不适，别让他回家；一小时后可能就变了。: Chest pain patient with normal ECG but ongoing discomfort: do not send home; it may change in an hour.
自主神经发育与代谢率影响心率；新生儿交感张力高、迷走张力低，心率快。: Autonomic development and metabolic rate affect heart rate; newborns have high sympathetic tone and low vagal tone, so heart rate is fast.

P 波形态还受房内传导阻滞、洋地黄、低钾和导联位置影响；不能把 P 波改变简单等: P wave morphology is also affected by intra-atrial block, digitalis, hypokalemia, and lead position; do not equate P wave changes simply with atrial size.
P 波振幅反映右房向量，P 波时间与终末负向反映左房向量；V1 是观察左房终末向: P wave amplitude reflects the right atrial vector; P wave duration and terminal negative deflection reflect the left atrial vector; V1 is the key lead for observing the left atrial terminal vector.
P 波消失、基线细颤、RR 绝对不规则；最常见的心律失常之一。: Absent P waves, fine baseline fibrillation, absolutely irregular RR; one of the most common arrhythmias.
P 波缺失，或窦性 P 波按自身频率出现但与 QRS 无关（房室分离）。: P waves are absent, or sinus P waves appear at their own rate but are unrelated to QRS (AV dissociation).
QRS 前无窦性 P 波；若见 P 波，多为逆行 P（II、III、aVF 倒置: No sinus P wave before QRS; if P waves are seen, they are usually retrograde P waves (inverted in II, III, aVF and upright in aVR), which may be before, within, or after the QRS.
QT 受心率影响，必须用 Bazett/Fridericia 等公式校正为 QT: QT is affected by heart rate and must be corrected to QTc using formulas such as Bazett/Fridericia; the faster the heart rate, the shorter QT should be.
QT 显著延长、尖端扭转型室速。: Marked QT prolongation, torsades de pointes.
QT 间期延长是心室复极时间延长，按心率校正后 QTc 超过正常范围；可导致早期: QT interval prolongation is prolonged ventricular repolarization; after heart rate correction, QTc exceeds the normal range; it can cause early afterdepolarizations and torsades de pointes, and is an important risk marker for sudden death.
RBBB 合并 LAFB 时 QRS 增宽，两者需同时报告为双分支阻滞。: When RBBB is combined with LAFB, QRS is widened; both should be reported together as bifascicular block.
RBBB 合并左前分支阻滞（双分支阻滞）、PR 延长或晕厥，提示进展为三度房室阻: RBBB with left anterior fascicular block (bifascicular block), PR prolongation, or syncope suggests risk of progression to third-degree AV block.
RBBB：V1 rsR′，V6/I 宽 S，QRS ≥120 ms。: RBBB: V1 rsR′, wide S in V6/I, QRS ≥120 ms.
RR 0.35 s ≈ 170 次/分: P′ may be hidden in the T wave; relying only on the ventricular rate may lead to missed diagnosis.
RVH：V1 R/S>1、电轴右偏、右胸 ST 压低；后壁 MI：V1–V3 S: RVH: V1 R/S>1, right axis deviation, right precordial ST depression; posterior MI: V1–V3 ST depression, tall R waves, upright T waves, V7–V9 ST elevation.
S1Q3T3 对肺栓塞特异性有限，也可见于健康人、慢性肺病；窦性心动过速最敏感但: S1Q3T3 has limited specificity for pulmonary embolism and can also be seen in healthy individuals and chronic lung disease; sinus tachycardia is the most sensitive but nonspecific. When new S1Q3T3 + sinus tachycardia + T-wave inversion in right precordial leads + signs of right heart strain are present, the clinical context more strongly supports pulmonary embolism.
ST 抬高伴 aVR 抬高与广泛 ST 压低，提示左主干或三支血管病变。: ST elevation with aVR elevation and widespread ST depression suggests left main or three-vessel disease.
SVT >220 次/分、窄 QRS。: Neonatal ECG is a “transitional map”; RV dominance is not disease; only persistent abnormalities need investigation.
T 波高尖 + P 波变平: Tall peaked T waves + flattened P waves
T 波：反映 3 相复极方向，通常与 QRS 主向量大致一致。: T wave: reflects the direction of phase 3 repolarization, usually roughly consistent with the main QRS vector.
V1 的 R′ 峰时间 >50 ms、R′ 宽于初始 r，且 I 与 V6 的: The R′ peak time in V1 >50 ms, R′ is wider than the initial r, and the S wave duration in I and V6 >40 ms or wider than the R wave in the same lead; this combination of three criteria distinguishes true RBBB from normal variants and ventricular rhythms.
V1 高 R 伴胸痛时，后壁 MI 是急症；不要因为“没有 ST 抬高”而漏诊。: With tall R in V1 and chest pain, posterior MI is an emergency; do not miss it because of absent ST elevation.
V1–V2 穹隆型 ST 抬高 ≥2 mm + T 倒置（1 型）；发热、钠通道: Coved-type ST elevation ≥2 mm in V1–V2 + T inversion (type 1); fever and sodium channel blockers can unmask it; syncope/family history of sudden death supports diagnosis.
V1–V3 ST 压低、R 波增高、T 波直立提示后壁心梗；加做 V7–V9 可: ST depression in V1–V3, tall R waves, and upright T waves suggest posterior myocardial infarction; additional V7–V9 leads show ST elevation, often coexisting with inferior infarction.
V1–V3 呈 rS 或 QS，S 波深而宽，R 波递增不良；电轴可正常或左偏。: V1–V3 show rS or QS, with a deep and wide S wave and poor R-wave progression; the axis may be normal or leftward.
V1–V3 的 ST 压低也可来自前壁心内膜下缺血、右室肥厚劳损或洋地黄效应，必: ST depression in V1–V3 may also come from anterior subendocardial ischemia, right ventricular hypertrophy strain, or digitalis effect; must combine with inferior leads, R-wave height, and T-wave direction. With isolated V1–V3 depression and no posterior triad, do not directly conclude posterior infarction.
V5/V6、I、aVL 出现 ST 压低与 T 波倒置，ST 段下斜；V1/V2: ST depression and T-wave inversion appear in V5/V6, I, and aVL, with downsloping ST segments; reciprocal ST elevation may appear in V1/V2.
VF/无脉 VT→CPR + 除颤。: ECG in stroke patients has two tasks: find AF, do not miss MI.
WPW 三联：短 PR、delta 波、宽 QRS。: WPW triad: short PR, delta wave, wide QRS.
WPW 风险取决于旁路前传不应期与是否伴房颤；短不应期旁路在房颤时可导致极快心室: WPW risk depends on the accessory pathway antegrade refractory period and whether atrial fibrillation is present; a short refractory period pathway during atrial fibrillation can cause very rapid ventricular rates and ventricular fibrillation.
Wellens、De Winter 等闭塞等效图形，需紧急冠脉造影。: Occlusion-equivalent patterns such as Wellens and De Winter require emergency coronary angiography.
aVR 抬高是高风险信号。: aVR elevation is a high-risk signal.
一个 AI ECG 模型在单中心很准，不代表能用于另一个医院；外部验证是关键。: An AI ECG model being accurate at a single center does not mean it can be used at another hospital; external validation is key.
一个搏动后紧跟回波。: A beat followed closely by an echo.
一度房室传导阻滞是房室传导延迟，使 PR 间期恒定超过 0.20 s，但每个心房: First-degree AV block is AV conduction delay that makes the PR interval constantly exceed 0.20 s, but every atrial impulse still conducts to the ventricles, with no dropped QRS. It reflects prolonged AV conduction time rather than conduction interruption and can be seen with increased vagal tone, drugs, ischemia, myocarditis, or degenerative conduction system disease.
一度房室阻滞：PR 间期大于 0.20 s，但每个 P 波都能下传产生 QRS。: First-degree AV block: PR interval >0.20 s, but every P wave conducts to produce a QRS. It is usually asymptomatic and more often a clue to conduction system degeneration, drugs (β-blockers, non-dihydropyridine calcium antagonists, digoxin, amiodarone), or electrolyte abnormalities.
一度阻滞 = PR 延长但“一个都不少”。: First-degree block = PR prolonged but no dropped beats.
一度阻滞 PR 延长但无脱漏；文氏现象有周期性 QRS 脱漏。: First-degree block has a prolonged PR but no dropped beats; Wenckebach phenomenon has periodic QRS dropped beats.
三度阻滞伴晕厥者直接准备起搏。: For third-degree block with syncope, prepare for pacing directly.
三度阻滞时 P 与 QRS 分离，心室率慢但 P 频率正常。: In third-degree block, P and QRS are dissociated; the ventricular rate is slow, but the P rate is normal.
下壁 II/III/aVF，侧壁 I/aVL/V5/V6，前壁 V1–V4。: Inferior wall II/III/aVF, lateral wall I/aVL/V5/V6, anterior wall V1–V4.
下壁 STEMI 看三件事：III 与 II 比较判断血管、aVL 找镜像、V4: Three things to check in inferior STEMI: compare III with II to determine the vessel, look for reciprocal changes in aVL, and look for right ventricular involvement in V4R.
下壁导联直接抬高；后壁梗死常与之并存，需加做 V7–V9 确认扩展。: Inferior leads show direct elevation; posterior infarction often coexists and requires additional V7–V9 to confirm extension.
下壁心梗：多为房室结缺血，常可恢复。: Inferior MI: mostly AV node ischemia, often reversible.
下壁由 II、III、aVF 反映；侧壁由 I、aVL、V5、V6 反映；aVR: Inferior wall is reflected by II, III, aVF; lateral wall by I, aVL, V5, V6; aVR is often used to identify global ischemia and lead reversal.
不同起源的心室激动顺序产生不同 QRS 形态；体表心电图是三维激动顺序的投影。: Different origins of ventricular activation produce different QRS morphologies; the surface ECG is a projection of the three-dimensional activation sequence.
不稳定：同步电复律，房扑通常 50–100 J 起始，必要时递增；有意识者镇静。: Unstable: synchronized cardioversion; for atrial flutter, usually start at 50–100 J and increase if needed; sedate if conscious.
不稳定：同步电复律，房颤通常 120–200 J 起始；有意识者镇静。: Unstable: synchronized cardioversion; for atrial fibrillation, usually start at 120–200 J; sedate conscious patients.
不要仅凭监护仪 ST 报警诊断 STEMI；标准 12 导联与临床是关键。: Do not diagnose STEMI based solely on monitor ST alarms; standard 12-lead ECG and clinical assessment are key.
不要因“波形乱”诊断房颤；寻找可辨认的 QRS 与 P 波。: Do not diagnose atrial fibrillation because the waveform is messy; look for identifiable QRS and P waves.
不要把所有房室分离都诊断三度 AVB；室速中的分离是干扰性，不是起搏器适应证。: Do not diagnose all AV dissociation as third-degree AVB; dissociation in VT is interference, not an indication for a pacemaker.
不要把鱼钩样 ST 直接诊断中毒；也不要在中毒时盲目补钙（传统争议，需谨慎）。: Fishhook ST changes are not equivalent to poisoning; poisoning diagnosis combines drug levels, symptoms, renal function, and arrhythmias.
不要根据手表提示直接抗凝；确认心律、症状与卒中风险。: Do not anticoagulate directly based on a watch alert; confirm rhythm, symptoms, and stroke risk.
不要根据监护仪数字给抗心律失常药；先手动数 RR 或听诊。: Do not give antiarrhythmic drugs based on monitor numbers; first manually count RR intervals or auscultate.
与旧图比较判断新旧；新发 LBBB 伴胸痛按急性冠脉综合征处理并动态复查。: Compare with old ECGs to determine whether it is new; new LBBB with chest pain should be managed as acute coronary syndrome with serial ECG follow-up.
久站/闷热/疼痛诱发。: Triggered by prolonged standing, heat/stuffiness, or pain.
二度 II 型/三度：宽 QRS、晕厥、心衰时起搏指征更强。: Second-degree type II/third-degree: pacing indications are stronger with wide QRS, syncope, or heart failure.
二度 II 型房室传导阻滞: One-sentence description of Second-Degree AV Block Type II: PR is constant, but QRS complexes are periodically dropped; the lesion is usually below the His bundle, tends to progress to third-degree block, and pacing evaluation should be more aggressive.
二度 II 型房室阻滞：P 波按时出现、形态正常，PR 固定后突然脱漏。: Second-degree type II AV block: P waves appear on time with normal morphology, PR is fixed, then sudden dropout.
交感激活、低灌注、炎症介质与电解质紊乱共同影响心肌电活动；脓毒症心肌病可致 ST: Postoperative AF is not “benign”; stroke/heart failure risk must be assessed, especially if persistent/recurrent.
交界性逸搏心律是窦房结发放冲动过慢或冲动不能传出时，房室交界区作为后备起搏点被动: Junctional escape rhythm occurs when the SA node fires too slowly or impulses cannot exit; the AV junction acts as a backup pacemaker and passively fires, creating a regular rhythm at about 40–60 beats/min. Impulses travel down the His-Purkinje system, so QRS is usually narrow; the atria may have no P waves, or retrograde conduction may produce P waves that are inverted in II, III, aVF and upright in aVR.
交界性逸搏心律是长间歇后的替代节律，而非停搏本身。: Junctional escape rhythm is a replacement rhythm after a long pause, not the arrest itself.
代码不能说明起搏器当前工作模式；程控后实际模式可能改变，需查起搏器记录。: The code cannot indicate the pacemaker's current operating mode; the actual mode may change after programming, so check the pacemaker records.
伪差与运动同步、多导联不规则；停止运动后恢复；患者意识/脉搏与波形不一致。: Artifact is synchronized with movement and irregular across multiple leads; resolves after movement stops; patient consciousness/pulse is inconsistent with the waveform.
伪差多导联同步但形态不规则、与肌肉活动相关；真实心律的 QRS 通常仍可辨认。: Artifact is synchronous across multiple leads but irregular in morphology and related to muscle activity; the QRS of the true rhythm is usually still recognizable.
伴二度 II 型或三度房室阻滞、宽 QRS 逸搏、长间歇 >3 s。: With second-degree type II or third-degree AV block, wide QRS escape beats, or pauses >3 s.
低体温、电解质紊乱、药物中毒等特殊病因需同步处理。: Special causes such as hypothermia, electrolyte imbalance, and drug toxicity require concurrent management.
低血压、颈静脉怒张而肺部清晰：右室梗死，硝酸酯与利尿剂禁忌。: Hypotension, jugular venous distension with clear lungs: right ventricular infarction; nitrates and diuretics are contraindicated.
低钙血症延长心肌动作电位平台期，心电图上表现为 ST 段延长、QT 间期延长，T: Hypocalcemia prolongs the plateau phase of the myocardial action potential; on ECG it manifests as ST segment prolongation and QT interval prolongation, T wave morphology is usually normal, and severe cases may have arrhythmias.
低钾 T 波低平、U 波明显，QT 延长。: Hypokalemia: flat T waves, prominent U waves, QT prolongation.
体检发现的房颤，别因为“没感觉”就不抗凝；算风险，谈获益。: For AF found on examination, do not skip anticoagulation just because the patient feels no symptoms; calculate risk and discuss benefits.
侧壁心梗因侧壁向量丢失，向量向右偏移；导联错接（左右臂反接）也可产生“假性右偏”: Lateral MI, due to loss of lateral vectors, shifts the vector to the right; lead reversal (left/right arm reversal) can also produce 'pseudo-right axis deviation'.
侧壁：I、aVL、V5、V6；高侧壁以 I、aVL 为主。: Lateral: I, aVL, V5, V6; high lateral mainly I, aVL.
倾斜试验通过被动/药物激发直立应激，评估血管迷走性晕厥；阳性表现为症状伴血压/心: The tilt-table test assesses vasovagal syncope by provoking upright stress passively/pharmacologically; a positive response is symptoms with a drop in blood pressure/heart rate.
儿童感冒后胸痛/乏力/心率快，别只当“恢复期”；查心电图和心肌标志物。: Chest pain/fatigue/fast heart rate after a cold in children: don't just treat as “recovery phase”; check ECG and cardiac markers.
先天性 AVB 与母体抗体相关。: Congenital AVB is associated with maternal antibodies.
先天性 LQTS：β 受体阻滞剂、避免竞技性运动，评估 ICD。: Congenital LQTS: β-blockers, avoid competitive sports, assess ICD.
先天性长 QT 综合征（LQTS）与获得性因素（低钾、低镁、低钙、心动过缓、药物: Congenital long QT syndrome (LQTS) and acquired factors (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia, hypocalcemia, bradycardia, drugs) can both cause it.
先心病术后常见房扑/房速、房室阻滞、室速；Mustard/Senning 术后房: After congenital heart disease surgery, atrial flutter/atrial tachycardia, AV block, and VT are common; atrial flutter risk is high after Mustard/Senning, and VT risk is high after tetralogy of Fallot repair.
先看患者与多导联。: Assess the patient and multiple leads first.
先看患者再看监护。: Look at the patient first, then the monitor.
先看患者意识、脉搏、血压与其他导联；真实室颤应无脉且多导联一致。: First check the patient's consciousness, pulse, blood pressure, and other leads; true ventricular fibrillation should be pulseless and consistent across multiple leads.
先确认 I、II、aVF 导联位置与连接正确。: First confirm that leads I, II, and aVF are positioned and connected correctly.
先确认下壁 STEMI，再评估血压、颈静脉与肺部体征。: First confirm inferior STEMI, then assess blood pressure, jugular veins, and lung findings.
先问“这个搏动是提前还是迟到”，再问“它是谁发出的”；这一顺序能避免把逸搏误当早: First ask 'Is this beat early or late?', then ask 'Who is originating it?'; this order avoids mistaking an escape beat for a premature beat.
冲动经希氏束-浦肯野系统下传心室，故 QRS 多窄；逆传心房时可产生逆行 P 波: The impulse conducts to the ventricles via the His-Purkinje system, so the QRS is usually narrow; retrograde conduction to the atria can produce a retrograde P wave, often after the QRS.
出现高度房室阻滞或晕厥者评估起搏治疗。: For high-grade AV block or syncope, assess for pacing therapy.
创伤 ECG：填塞、挫伤、低体温。: Sympathetic activation, hypoperfusion, inflammatory mediators, and electrolyte disturbances jointly affect myocardial electrical activity; sepsis cardiomyopathy can cause ST-T changes.
前壁 STEMI 合并 LBBB 时，把 LBBB 的不一致性 ST 抬高当作缺: Mistaking the discordant ST elevation of LBBB for worsening ischemia in anterior STEMI with LBBB.
前无 P 波: Retrograde P waves are often hidden in the terminal portion of the QRS and are easily overlooked as "PACs without P waves".
前有 P、PR 合适。: Preceded by P wave; PR interval appropriate.
前降支完全闭塞后，前壁与室间隔发生透壁性缺血；心肌细胞膜离子泵失能，损伤电流使: After complete occlusion of the left anterior descending artery, transmural ischemia occurs in the anterior wall and interventricular septum; failure of myocardial cell membrane ion pumps causes injury current that shifts the ST segment toward the ischemic area.
加速性室性自主心律是心室异位起搏点以高于其固有频率、但低于室速频率发放冲动，形成: Accelerated idioventricular rhythm is when a ventricular ectopic pacemaker fires at a rate higher than its intrinsic rate but lower than the ventricular tachycardia rate, forming a rhythm at about 50–110 beats/min with QRS ≥0.12 s. It often competes with sinus rhythm, showing isorhythmic AV dissociation, ventricular fusion beats, or capture beats; it is mostly seen after reperfusion in acute myocardial infarction, and can also be caused by digitalis poisoning, myocarditis, and electrolyte disturbances.
劳损与缺血都可 ST 压低；运动试验、肌钙蛋白、动态变化与冠脉评估用于鉴别。: Strain and ischemia can both cause ST depression; exercise testing, troponin, dynamic changes, and coronary evaluation are used to differentiate.
卒中→查房颤。: Pre-dialysis hyperkalemia: tall peaked T/QRS wide.
单个导联异常、其他导联正常；轻压/重新贴电极后恢复；患者生命体征与波形不一致。: Abnormality in a single lead with other leads normal; recovers after light pressure/reapplying the electrode; patient vital signs are inconsistent with the waveform.
单导联“室颤”先看其他导联与患者；不要立即电击。: For single-lead "ventricular fibrillation," first check other leads and the patient; do not shock immediately.
单导联、P 波不清、运动时噪声；阳性提示需医疗级 ECG 确认，尤其抗凝决策前。: Single lead, unclear P waves, noise during movement; a positive prompt requires confirmation with a medical-grade ECG, especially before anticoagulation decisions.
双分支阻滞无症状者随访；伴晕厥或 HV 间期延长者考虑起搏器。: Asymptomatic bifascicular block: follow-up; with syncope or prolonged HV interval, consider pacemaker.
双室起搏时 QRS 常较单腔右室起搏窄；V1 可能仍呈负向，但电轴与形态改变；需: During biventricular pacing, QRS is often narrower than with single-chamber right ventricular pacing; V1 may still be negative, but axis and morphology change; pacemaker records are needed to confirm biventricular capture.
反复发作：转诊心内科评估导管消融（AVNRT/AVRT 消融成功率高）。: Look for retrograde P waves, pseudo-s waves, or pseudo-r′ waves at the end of the QRS in leads II and V1.
只看 QRS 宽度：部分 VT 可相对窄，部分 SVT 伴束支阻滞可宽。: QRS width alone: some VT may be relatively narrow, and some SVT with bundle branch block may be wide.
只看 ST 压低而忽略 aVR 抬高与广泛分布，低估左主干病变。: Looking only at ST depression while ignoring aVR elevation and widespread distribution underestimates left main disease.
只看 T 波，忽略 P 波变平与 QRS 增宽。: Looking only at T waves and ignoring flattened P waves and QRS widening.
只能从后续变化推断。: Can only be inferred from subsequent changes.
可伴心动过缓、交界性/室性逸搏、室速/室颤或停搏。: May be accompanied by bradycardia, junctional/ventricular escape beats, ventricular tachycardia/ventricular fibrillation, or asystole.
可伴手足抽搐、Chvostek/Trousseau 征、癫痫。: May be accompanied by tetany, Chvostek/Trousseau signs, and seizures.
右冠状动脉近端闭塞同时累及右室支与下壁供血，导致右室游离壁缺血、收缩力下降与右心: Proximal right coronary artery occlusion involving both the right ventricular branch and inferior wall supply causes right ventricular free wall ischemia, reduced contractility, and decreased right ventricular output.
右室心尖起搏使心室从右室向左侧除极，QRS 宽、呈 LBBB 形态；起搏钉是人工: Right ventricular apical pacing causes ventricular depolarization from the right ventricle toward the left side; the QRS is wide and LBBB-shaped; pacing spikes are a marker of artificial electrical stimulation.
