早期复极、幼稚型 T 波、体位性 ST 改变、运动员心脏都是常见正常变异；关键是: Early repolarization, juvenile T waves, positional ST changes, and athlete's heart are common normal variants; the key is to differentiate them from ischemia/pericarditis.
晕厥、室颤复苏史、夜间濒死呼吸。: Syncope, history of ventricular fibrillation resuscitation, nocturnal agonal breathing.
最具特异性的是“I 与 aVF 导联 QRS 主波方向组合”：I 正、aVF 正: The most specific is the “combination of QRS main wave directions in leads I and aVF”: I positive and aVF positive is normal; I positive, aVF negative, and II negative is left axis deviation; I negative is right axis deviation.
最具特异性的是“勺状 ST 段压低（scooped ST）+ QT 缩短 + T: Most specific is the combination of “scooped ST depression + shortened QT + flattened/inverted T waves”; however, this effect cannot distinguish therapeutic levels from toxicity; toxicity requires correlation with serum drug levels and arrhythmias.
最具特异性的是“原有窦性 P 波突然消失的长间歇，且间歇与基础 PP 间期不成整: The most specific finding is “a long pause with sudden disappearance of the original sinus P wave, and the pause is not an integer multiple of the basic PP interval”; carefully exclude a nonconducted P′ hidden in the T wave.
最具特异性的是“多形性宽 QRS + 振幅围绕基线扭转 + 发作前 QT/QTc: The most specific findings are “polymorphic wide QRS + amplitude twisting around the baseline + prolonged QT/QTc before onset (often >500 ms)”; differentiate from polymorphic VT (without long QT).
最具特异性的是“提前出现的 P′ 波且形态与窦性 P 不同”；若 P′ 隐藏在: Most specific is a premature P′ wave with morphology different from sinus P; if P′ is hidden in the T wave, compare its morphology with the preceding T wave, and if necessary use multiple leads or a longer recording to find it.
最具特异性的是“无 P 波 + RR 绝对不规则 + 基线 f 波”；若 RR: The most specific is “no P waves + absolutely irregular RR + baseline f waves”; if RR is regular, consider AF with complete AV block and escape rhythm, or paced rhythm.
最具特异性的是“相邻导联新发 ST 抬高 + 对应导联镜像压低”；定位需结合导联: The most specific finding is 'new ST elevation in adjacent leads + reciprocal depression in corresponding leads'; localization requires lead grouping, but culprit vessel and anatomic variants require coronary angiography confirmation.
有症状或家族史时不能只归为正常变异。: When symptoms or family history are present, do not simply attribute it to a normal variant.
有症状或长间歇：阿托品可试用，但病态窦房结综合征常反应不佳；准备经皮起搏。: Symptomatic or long pauses: atropine may be tried, but sick sinus syndrome often responds poorly; prepare for transcutaneous pacing.
有脉患者使用非同步电击，或未镇静即同步复律。: Using unsynchronized shocks in patients with a pulse, or synchronized cardioversion without sedation.
有脉：静脉硫酸镁 2 g（可重复），纠正低钾/低镁，停用延长 QT 药物。: With pulse: IV magnesium sulfate 2 g (may repeat), correct hypokalemia/hypomagnesemia, and stop QT-prolonging drugs.
未上移 V1/V2 导联而漏诊。: Missed diagnosis if V1/V2 leads are not moved higher.
未下传的 P 波常埋藏在 T 波或 QRS 终末，表现为 T 波形态改变、T 波: Non-conducted P waves are often buried in the T wave or terminal QRS, manifesting as T-wave morphology change, a notch on the T wave, or a seemingly 'extra' small deflection between two QRS complexes. Comparing with other T waves in the same lead is key to finding it.
术前心电图用于发现未识别的心律失常、传导阻滞、缺血或电解质异常；并非所有患者常规: Preoperative ECG is used to detect unrecognized arrhythmias, conduction block, ischemia, or electrolyte abnormalities; it is not routinely required for all patients.
术后房颤不是“良性”的；卒中/心衰风险需评估，尤其持续/复发者。: ECG shows AF/AFL with rapid ventricular rate; may be asymptomatic or cause palpitations/hypotension; anticoagulation risk assessment needed.
查缺血、药物、电解质；永久起搏评估。: Evaluate ischemia, drugs, electrolytes; assess for permanent pacing.
标准定标下的正常窦性心律，用于练习 PR、QRS、QT 与心率测量。: Normal sinus rhythm at standard calibration for practicing PR, QRS, QT, and heart rate measurement.
检查下壁导联 II、III、aVF 是否抬高；后壁梗死常与下壁梗死合并。: Check whether inferior leads II, III, and aVF show elevation; posterior infarction often coexists with inferior infarction.
正常年轻人 V1 高 R 可为变异；没有其他异常时不要过度诊断。: A tall R in V1 can be a variant in normal young people; do not overdiagnose without other abnormalities.
每个 P 波后均有 QRS 波群，每个 QRS 前均有 P 波。: Every P wave is followed by a QRS complex, and every QRS is preceded by a P wave.
比较不同导联的 delta 极性，粗略判断旁路位置（需电生理确认）。: Compare delta wave polarity in different leads to roughly localize the bypass tract (requires electrophysiology confirmation).
比较提前搏动前后的 PP 间期，判断代偿间歇。: Compare PP intervals before and after the premature beat to determine the compensatory pause.
洋地黄也可缩短 QT，但有勺状 ST 与用药史。: Digitalis can also shorten QT, but has scooped ST segments and a medication history.
测量 PR 与 QRS，寻找缺血、传导异常或预激线索。: Measure PR and QRS, and look for clues of ischemia, conduction abnormalities, or pre-excitation.
测量 QRS 宽度；超过 0.12 s 需考虑合并 RBBB 或其他原因。: Measure QRS width; >0.12 s requires considering concomitant RBBB or other causes.
浦肯野系统病变、束支阻滞或心室肌起源的激动会改变除极顺序，使 QRS 增宽并出现: Lesions of the Purkinje system, bundle branch block, or impulses originating from ventricular myocardium alter the depolarization sequence, widening QRS and changing morphology.
深度学习从大量 ECG-标签配对中学习特征；分布偏移、导联差异与伪差会影响性能。: Deep learning learns features from large ECG-label pairs; distribution shift, lead differences, and artifacts can affect performance.
环境电磁场被导联线拾取，叠加到心电信号；高阻抗电极更易受影响。: Environmental electromagnetic fields are picked up by lead wires and superimposed on the ECG signal; high-impedance electrodes are more susceptible.
现代监护仪可连续分析 ST 段趋势，但受基线漂移、导联位置与滤波影响；ST 报警: Modern monitors can continuously analyze ST segment trends, but are affected by baseline wander, lead position, and filtering; ST alarms must be confirmed by a 12-lead ECG or clinical assessment.
电压取决于心肌质量、胸壁阻抗、导联距离与除极同步性；不是单纯的“肌肉厚度”。: Voltage depends on myocardial mass, chest wall impedance, lead distance, and depolarization synchrony; it is not simply 'muscle thickness'.
电生理检查有创，需严格适应证；不能替代无创心电图与临床评估。: Electrophysiologic testing is invasive and requires strict indications; it cannot replace noninvasive ECG and clinical assessment.
电生理评估旁路不应期。: Electrophysiology assesses accessory pathway refractory period.
电磁场被导线拾取，尤其在高阻抗/长导线时；现代设备屏蔽较好但仍可能干扰。: Electromagnetic fields are picked up by wires, especially with high impedance/long wires; modern devices have better shielding but may still be interfered with.
电轴与 delta 波方向都可用向量解释。: Both the electrical axis and the direction of the delta wave can be explained by vectors.
电轴偏移 + 宽 QRS：先判断室性起源、预激或束支阻滞。: Axis deviation + wide QRS: first determine ventricular origin, pre-excitation, or bundle branch block.
电轴多正常；若电轴右偏，需考虑合并右室肥厚、肺栓塞或左后分支阻滞。: Axis is mostly normal; if right axis deviation is present, consider concomitant right ventricular hypertrophy, pulmonary embolism, or left posterior fascicular block.
电轴显著左偏（−45°～−90°），I、aVL 呈 qR，II、III、aVF: Marked left axis deviation (−45° to −90°), qR in I and aVL, rS in II, III, and aVF, without QRS widening.
疑中毒：停用地高辛，纠正低钾/低镁，监测心律；严重心律失常可用地高辛特异抗体。: Suspected toxicity: stop digoxin, correct hypokalemia/hypomagnesemia, monitor rhythm; digoxin-specific antibodies may be used for severe arrhythmias.
疑右室梗死：V4R ST 抬高 ≥1 mm（较 V1 敏感），伴低血压与颈静脉压: Suspected right ventricular infarction: V4R ST elevation ≥1 mm (more sensitive than V1), with hypotension and elevated jugular venous pressure.
病例：COPD 急性加重伴心律失常: Case: acute COPD exacerbation with arrhythmia
病例：房颤伴缓慢心室率: Case: atrial fibrillation with slow ventricular rate
病态窦房结综合征包括窦性心动过缓、窦性停搏、窦房阻滞与慢快综合征；症状与心电图不: Sick sinus syndrome includes sinus bradycardia, sinus arrest, sinoatrial block, and tachy-brady syndrome; long-term monitoring is needed when symptoms and ECG are discordant.
症状性三度、二度 II 型/高度阻滞：评估永久起搏。: Symptomatic third-degree, second-degree type II/high-grade block: evaluate for permanent pacing.
症状性心动过缓：监护 + 阿托品（房室结病变更有效）。: Symptomatic bradycardia: monitoring + atropine (more effective for AV node disease).
症状性心动过缓：阿托品 1 mg 静脉推注，每 3–5 分钟重复，最大 3 mg: Symptomatic bradycardia: atropine 1 mg IV push, repeat every 3–5 minutes up to a maximum of 3 mg; often effective for intranodal AV block.
症状性高度阻滞先支持、找可逆原因，再评估起搏。: Symptomatic high-grade block: support first, find reversible causes, then evaluate pacing.
监护仪上的恶性心律失常报警，第一步永远是看患者是否有脉，而不是先拿除颤器。: For a malignant arrhythmia alarm on the monitor, the first step is always to check whether the patient has a pulse, not to grab the defibrillator first.
监护仪适合发现心率/节律变化和 ST 趋势，但形态学诊断仍需 12 导联；报警疲: Monitors are suitable for detecting heart rate/rhythm changes and ST trends, but morphologic diagnosis still requires a 12-lead ECG; alarm fatigue and lead detachment are common problems.
直接 PCI 为首选，目标首次医疗接触至导丝通过 ≤120 分钟；不能及时 PC: Primary PCI is preferred, with a target first medical contact-to-wire crossing time ≤120 minutes; assess thrombolysis when timely PCI is not available.
直立后心率 ↑≥30 次/分。: Heart rate increases ≥30 beats/min after standing.
相邻导联 + 新发 + 镜像改变 = STEMI 定位的基本逻辑。: Adjacent leads + new onset + reciprocal changes = basic logic of STEMI localization.
相邻导联 ST 抬高→再灌注。: ST elevation in adjacent leads → reperfusion.
相邻导联水平型或下斜型 ST 压低 ≥1 mm；肌钙蛋白决定 NSTEMI 还是: Horizontal or downsloping ST depression ≥1 mm in contiguous leads; troponin determines NSTEMI versus unstable angina, and risk stratification determines timing of angiography.
看到 RBBB 必须回答两个问题：是新发的吗？有没有右心负荷或双分支阻滞？: When RBBB is seen, two questions must be answered: Is it new? Is there right heart strain or bifascicular block?
看到图形先问：是复极异常（ST-T）、除极异常（QRS），还是传导/激动顺序异常: When seeing a tracing, first ask: is it a repolarization abnormality (ST-T), depolarization abnormality (QRS), or conduction/activation sequence abnormality?
看到新生儿 V1 高 R 先问“多大”；这可能是正常的右室优势，不是 RVH。: Right ventricular dominance in neonates is physiologic.
看电轴（右偏→RVH；左偏→后壁 MI/WPW）、看 ST-T（后壁 MI V1: Check axis (right deviation→RVH; left deviation→posterior MI/WPW), check ST-T (posterior MI V1–V3 depression), check delta wave and PR.
看钉与波形关系、起搏频率、自身搏动是否被感知、是否有噪声/电磁干扰；结合程控与阻: Check the relationship between spikes and waveforms, pacing rate, whether intrinsic beats are sensed, and whether noise/electromagnetic interference is present; combine with programming and impedance.
睡眠呼吸暂停可导致夜间窦性心动过缓/停搏、房颤、室早与低氧相关 ST 改变；心电: Sleep apnea can cause nocturnal sinus bradycardia/pauses, AF, PVCs, and hypoxia-related ST changes; ECG abnormalities often occur with respiratory events.
短 PR、δ 波，宽 QRS 由预激造成，而非左束支阻滞。: Short PR and δ wave; the wide QRS is caused by pre-excitation, not left bundle branch block.
短 QT 综合征表现为 QTc <340 ms，伴高尖 T 波、室颤/猝死风险；: Short QT syndrome presents with QTc <340 ms, tall peaked T waves, and risk of ventricular fibrillation/sudden death; it is a rare ion channelopathy.
短程 Holter 正常不排除。: A normal short-term Holter does not exclude.
研究需明确终点与验证。: Research requires clear endpoints and validation.
硫酸镁 + 补钾；停 QT 延长药。: Magnesium sulfate + potassium replacement; stop QT-prolonging drugs.
确认 P 波是否消失，V1 导联最易看到 f 波。: Confirm whether P waves are absent; f waves are most easily seen in lead V1.
确认相邻导联、J 点抬高与年龄/性别阈值。: Confirm adjacent leads, J-point elevation, and age/sex thresholds.
磁铁通过霍尔传感器触发预设模式，绕过感知与跟踪；是急诊临时处理工具，不是治疗本身: A magnet triggers a preset mode via the Hall sensor, bypassing sensing and tracking; it is a temporary emergency management tool, not the treatment itself.
窄 QRS + 慢 + 无直立 P = 交界性逸搏；看到它先找长间歇背后的病因。: Narrow QRS + slow + no upright P = junctional escape; when seen, first look for the cause behind the long pause.
窦性 P 波约 78 次/分，QRS 逸搏约 38 次/分，P 与 QRS 完全: Sinus P waves about 78/min, QRS escape about 38/min, complete P–QRS dissociation, QRS 0.14 s, consistent with third-degree AV block.
窦性 P 波规则出现，但心室率 <60 次/分；先问“有没有症状”，再问“为什么: Sinus P waves appear regularly, but ventricular rate <60 beats/min; first ask 'Are there symptoms?', then ask 'Why is it slow?'
窦性停搏为 P 波消失的长间歇，不是渐进的 RR 变异。: Sinus arrest is a long pause with disappearance of P waves, not a gradual RR variation.
窦性心律，II、III、aVF ST 抬高，aVL 镜像压低，V1 轻度抬高；结: Sinus rhythm, ST elevation in II, III, aVF, reciprocal depression in aVL, mild elevation in V1; with hypotension and clear lungs, additional V4R shows ST elevation, supporting right ventricular infarction.
窦性心律，ST 段延长，QT 间期约 0.52 s，T 波形态相对正常，符合低钙: Sinus rhythm, prolonged ST segment, QT interval about 0.52 s, relatively normal T wave morphology, consistent with ECG changes of hypocalcemia.
窦性心律，V1–V3 ST 压低 2 mm，R 波增高、T 波直立；下壁导联轻度: Sinus rhythm, 2 mm ST depression in V1–V3, tall R waves, upright T waves; mild elevation in inferior leads suggests posterior infarction, requiring additional V7–V9 for confirmation.
窦性搏动: Mistaking the "alternating pulse strength" of bigeminy for pulsus alternans (the latter is seen in severe left heart failure).
窦性搏动与室性期前收缩交替出现，比例约为 1:1。: Sinus beats and premature ventricular contractions alternate, at a ratio of about 1:1.
窦速、电轴左偏常见。: In trauma patients with hypotension + low voltage + electrical alternans, look at the pericardium first; do not just stare at the monitor.
窦速最常见；S1Q3T3 不特异。: Sinus tachycardia is most common; S1Q3T3 is nonspecific.
窦速有正常 P 波与等电位线，频率随病因变化。: Sinus tachycardia has normal P waves and an isoelectric line; rate varies with the cause.
第一位起搏腔（A/V/D），第二位感知腔，第三位反应（I/T/D），第四位频率适: The first position is pacing chamber (A/V/D), the second is sensing chamber, the third is response (I/T/D), the fourth is rate adaptation (R), and the fifth is multisite pacing.
第一步：所有胸前导联均无 RS 型 → 诊断室速（特异性高）。: Step 1: absence of RS pattern in all precordial leads → diagnose ventricular tachycardia (high specificity).
等频性房室分离指心房与心室频率几乎相同但无固定关系，P 波逐渐“穿行”QRS；常: Isorhythmic AV dissociation means atrial and ventricular rates are nearly the same but without a fixed relationship; P waves gradually 'march through' the QRS; common in junctional rhythm/pacing.
紧急症状不能等传输。: Emergency symptoms cannot wait for transmission.
纠正高钾、药物中毒、缺血等可逆病因；存活者评估永久起搏器。: Correct reversible causes such as hyperkalemia, drug toxicity, and ischemia; evaluate survivors for a permanent pacemaker.
结合临床评估结构性心脏病、缺血、电解质与药物。: No related sinus P wave before the QRS; sinus P waves can be seen at their own rhythm but are not conducted (AV dissociation).
结合利尿剂、呕吐、腹泻、胰岛素与低镁病史。: Consider history of diuretics, vomiting, diarrhea, insulin, and hypomagnesemia.
结合病史：再灌注、洋地黄、心肌炎、电解质紊乱。: Consider history: reperfusion, digitalis, myocarditis, electrolyte imbalance.
结合药物、电解质、缺血与症状，判断是生理性保护还是需要起搏的传导系统病变。: Consider drugs, electrolytes, ischemia, and symptoms to determine whether this is physiologic protection or a conduction system disorder requiring pacing.
结合血压、意识、血钾、药物和缺血，判断是否为濒危节律。: Consider blood pressure, consciousness, potassium, drugs, and ischemia to determine whether this is a life-threatening rhythm.
绝对不应期内任何刺激都不能产生新的动作电位；有效不应期内刺激不能产生可传导的动作: During the absolute refractory period, no stimulus can produce a new action potential; during the effective refractory period, a stimulus cannot produce a conductible action potential; during the relative refractory period, a stronger stimulus is required and conduction is slower.
缺血时为什么 ST 段会偏移: Why the ST segment shifts in ischemia
罪犯血管判断必须结合造影、超声与临床，不凭心电图单独决定治疗。: Culprit vessel determination must combine angiography, ultrasound, and clinical findings; do not decide treatment based on ECG alone.
老年 ECG 异常常见但非都良性。: Sinus tachycardia and left axis deviation are common.
老年人跌倒不都是骨科问题；一张心电图可能发现长间歇。: ECG abnormalities are common in the elderly but not all are benign.
老年人转头晕厥，问衣领、刮胡子、转头；但按摩试验要先看颈动脉。: Older adults with syncope on head turning: ask about collar, shaving, head turning; but check carotid before massage test.
肺栓塞可引起新发 RBBB，但需结合临床与影像。: Pulmonary embolism can cause new-onset RBBB, but must be correlated with clinical and imaging findings.
肺过度充气增加胸壁阻抗、心脏位置下移，导致低电压与导联轴改变；肺动脉高压引起右室: Pulmonary hyperinflation increases chest wall impedance and displaces the heart downward, causing low voltage and changes in lead axis; pulmonary hypertension causes right ventricular hypertrophy.
胰岛素+葡萄糖、透析降钾。: Insulin + glucose, dialysis to lower potassium.
脱漏前没有 PR 进行性延长，脱漏后 PR 与脱漏前相同。: There is no progressive PR prolongation before dropout, and the PR after dropout is the same as before dropout.
若为三度房室阻滞伴晕厥，应直接准备起搏，不要用单纯阿托品替代。: If third-degree AV block with syncope is present, prepare for pacing directly; do not substitute atropine alone.
若出现成对 PVC 或短阵室速，应按更高级别心律失常处理。: Sinus beats alternate with premature ventricular contractions in a ratio of about 1:1.
若增益改为 5 mm/mV，电压看起来减半；若纸速改为 50 mm/s，波形拉宽: If gain is changed to 5 mm/mV, voltage appears halved; if paper speed is changed to 50 mm/s, the waveform widens, but true intervals remain unchanged.
药物阻滞 IKr 延长复极，增加早期后除极；电解质异常与心动过缓进一步放大风险。: Drugs blocking IKr prolong repolarization and increase early afterdepolarizations; electrolyte abnormalities and bradycardia further amplify risk.
血压不一定下降。: Blood pressure does not necessarily drop.
观察 QRS 宽度，判断逸搏来自交界区还是心室。: Observe QRS width to determine whether the escape rhythm comes from the junctional area or the ventricles.
观察 ST 段是否为勺状而非水平型/下斜型缺血性压低。: Observe whether the ST segment is scooped rather than horizontal/downsloping ischemic depression.
观察有无镜像压低：aVR/V1 以外出现明显镜像压低，应警惕 STEMI。: Observe for reciprocal depression: marked reciprocal depression outside aVR/V1 should raise concern for STEMI.
解释为什么 T 波通常与 QRS 同向: Explain why the T wave is usually in the same direction as the QRS.
解释第四相自动除极与阈值: Explain phase 4 spontaneous depolarization and threshold
证明房室传导并非完全阻断。: Proves that AV conduction is not completely blocked.
评估房颤负荷、早搏负荷、ST 趋势。: Assess AF burden, premature beat burden, and ST trends.
评估晕厥、进展风险与起搏指征。: Assess syncope, progression risk, and pacing indications.
识别 P 波埋藏在 T 波或 QRS 终末的隐匿表现: Recognize hidden P waves buried in the T wave or terminal QRS
识别可疑后壁心梗的间接征象并正确加做 18 导联: Recognize indirect signs of suspected posterior MI and correctly add 18-lead ECG
询问晕厥、家族猝死史与用药（抗心律失常药、喹诺酮、大环内酯、抗精神病药）。: Ask about syncope, family history of sudden death, and medications (antiarrhythmics, quinolones, macrolides, antipsychotics).
起搏后 T 波倒置不一定是缺血；问“最近有没有起搏/室速”，可能是心脏记忆。: T-wave inversion after pacing is not necessarily ischemia; ask “Have you had recent pacing/VT?”—it may be cardiac memory.
起搏器通过感知心房率判断房性心律失常，自动切换模式以保护心室率；心电图可显示起搏: The pacemaker senses the atrial rate to identify atrial tachyarrhythmias and automatically switches modes to protect the ventricular rate; ECG can show pacing mode changes.
起搏钉—P 波固定关系；P 波后 QRS 窄且 PR 正常；自身 P 波出现时起: Fixed relationship between pacing spike and P wave; after the P wave, the QRS is narrow and PR is normal; pacing is inhibited when an intrinsic P wave appears.
起搏钉后无 P/QRS；自身逸搏可能很慢；患者可晕厥、低血压；起搏器程控显示高阈: No P/QRS after pacing spike; intrinsic escape beat may be very slow; patient may have syncope and hypotension; pacemaker programming shows high threshold or abnormal lead impedance.
起搏钉极短高频，监护仪算法可能误识别；起搏器感知线路可拾取外界电磁信号。: Pacing spikes are very short and high-frequency, so monitor algorithms may misidentify them; the pacemaker sensing circuit may pick up external electromagnetic signals.
起搏钉由起搏器电容放电产生，持续时间极短；现代双极起搏钉更小，易被滤波。: Pacing spikes are produced by pacemaker capacitor discharge and have very short duration; modern bipolar pacing spikes are smaller and easily filtered.
起搏钉突然消失、心率低于下限；可伴头晕/晕厥；起搏器记录显示高频噪声或过度感知事: Pacing spikes suddenly disappear and heart rate falls below the lower rate limit; may be accompanied by dizziness/syncope; pacemaker records show high-frequency noise or oversensing events.
运动试验诱发双向性室速（QRS 轴逐搏交替）或多形性室速；静息 QTc 正常；晕: Exercise testing induces bidirectional ventricular tachycardia (QRS axis alternates beat-to-beat) or polymorphic ventricular tachycardia; resting QTc is normal; family history of syncope/sudden death.
连续记录多搏，逐搏测量 PR，寻找“渐长—脱漏—重置”的周期。: This description corresponds to Second-Degree AV Block Type I: PR lengthens beat by beat, then a QRS is dropped; after the drop, PR shortens, showing a cyclic “lengthening—drop—reset,” the most specific clue of Wenckebach phenomenon; the last PR before the drop is usually the longest.
逆行 P 波被心房导线感知，起搏器按 AV 间期起搏心室，形成“起搏器—房室结”: Retrograde P waves are sensed by the atrial lead, and the pacemaker paces the ventricle according to the AV interval, forming a “pacemaker–AV node” reentry.
透析前高钾：T 高尖/QRS 宽。: Falls in older adults are not always orthopedic problems; an ECG may reveal long pauses.
通道与电极不匹配使不同导联信号被错标；多导联同时出现“不合理”图形是线索。: Channel-electrode mismatch causes signals from different leads to be mislabeled; simultaneous 'implausible' patterns in multiple leads are a clue.
逸搏是“迟到”的搏动，通常发生在长间歇之后；早搏是“提前”的搏动，由异位兴奋灶或: Escape beats are 'late' beats, usually occurring after a long pause; premature beats are 'early' beats, triggered by an ectopic focus or reentry.
逸搏频率：房室交界区约 40–60 次/分，心室约 20–40 次/分；逸搏出现: Escape rates: AV junction about 40–60 beats/min, ventricles about 20–40 beats/min; escape beats indicate upstream failure but are themselves a protective mechanism.
避免抗凝与抗血小板（除非另有强指征），以防出血性心包积液。: Avoid anticoagulants and antiplatelet agents (unless another strong indication exists) to prevent hemorrhagic pericardial effusion.
钉后无 QRS=失夺获。: Spike without QRS = loss of capture.
钙延长或缩短动作电位平台期，分别导致 QT 延长或缩短。: Calcium lengthens or shortens the action potential plateau, causing QT prolongation or shortening, respectively.
钠通道阻滞减慢 0 相，QRS 增宽；抗胆碱/α 阻滞导致心动过速、低血压；碳酸: Sodium channel blockade slows phase 0 and widens QRS; anticholinergic/α blockade causes tachycardia and hypotension; sodium bicarbonate provides sodium loading and alkalinization.
长-短周期后的宽 QRS 先想 Ashman 差异性传导。: For a wide QRS after a long-short cycle, think first of Ashman aberrancy.
长 QT 导致的晕厥/抽搐可被误诊为癫痫；查心电图与家族史，避免 QT 延长药物: Long QT-induced syncope/seizures can be misdiagnosed as epilepsy; check ECG and family history, avoid QT-prolonging drugs.
长 QT 是 TdP 的基础，但长 QT 本身不是心动过速。: Long QT is the substrate for TdP, but long QT itself is not tachycardia.
长 QT 的处理先停药、补钾镁，再考虑提高心率。: For long QT management, first stop the drug and supplement potassium and magnesium, then consider increasing heart rate.
长周期延长束支不应期，短周期冲动落在不应期，形成功能性束支阻滞。: A long cycle prolongs the bundle branch refractory period; an impulse from a short cycle falls in the refractory period, producing a functional bundle branch block.
阿司匹林负荷、抗凝、他汀；根据血压与症状使用硝酸酯/β 阻滞剂。: Aspirin loading, anticoagulation, statin; use nitrates/β-blockers according to blood pressure and symptoms.
阿托品无效时经皮起搏或肾上腺素 2–10 μg/min 泵入，维持血压与灌注。: If atropine is ineffective, use transcutaneous pacing or epinephrine infusion at 2–10 μg/min to maintain blood pressure and perfusion.
陈旧期：ST 正常、Q/QS 遗留、T 可正常或倒置。: Old stage: normal ST, residual Q/QS, T may be normal or inverted.
隐匿性传导指冲动进入房室结但未穿透至心室，却改变了房室结的不应期，影响后续传导。: Concealed conduction means an impulse enters the AV node but does not penetrate to the ventricles, yet it changes the AV node refractory period and affects subsequent conduction.
需与伪差、电极脱落、心室扑动鉴别；临床判断优先。: Differentiate from artifact, electrode detachment, and ventricular flutter; clinical judgment takes priority.
需与房内传导阻滞、洋地黄效应鉴别。: Differentiate from intra-atrial conduction block and digitalis effect.
需排除左室肥厚劳损、洋地黄效应、低钾血症、预激与心动过速相关改变。: Exclude left ventricular hypertrophy with strain, digitalis effect, hypokalemia, pre-excitation, and tachycardia-related changes.
需排除药物、甲减、电解质与缺血。: Need to exclude drugs, hypothyroidism, electrolytes, and ischemia.
需结合血钙、白蛋白校正钙与临床症状。: Correlate with serum calcium, albumin-corrected calcium, and clinical symptoms.
需要多导联/高密度记录与数学模型；空间分辨率与稳定性仍有限，不能替代心内标测。: Requires multi-lead/high-density recordings and mathematical models; spatial resolution and stability remain limited and cannot replace intracardiac mapping.
青少年情绪性“抽搐”，查心电图；LQTS 被误诊癫痫并不罕见。: Emotionally triggered convulsions in adolescents: check ECG; LQTS misdiagnosed as epilepsy is not rare.
静息心率持续 <50 或 >110 次/分，需寻找原因而非直接归为正常。: Persistent resting heart rate <50 or >110 beats/min requires seeking the cause rather than directly classifying it as normal.
静息心电图正常不能排除 CPVT；需要运动试验或基因检测。: A normal resting ECG cannot exclude CPVT; exercise testing or genetic testing is needed.
静脉补液扩容，促进钙排泄；袢利尿剂仅在扩容后谨慎使用。: Intravenous fluid resuscitation to expand volume and promote calcium excretion; loop diuretics should be used cautiously only after volume expansion.
静脉钙剂外渗可致组织坏死，需确保通路通畅。: Extravasation of intravenous calcium can cause tissue necrosis; ensure a patent line.
预激合并房颤：立即同步电复律；药物可选普罗帕酮/胺碘酮（专科），避免单纯房室结阻: Pre-excitation with atrial fibrillation: immediate synchronized cardioversion; drug options include propafenone/amiodarone (specialist), avoid AV node-blocking agents alone (Adenosine, β-blockers, diltiazem, verapamil).
颈动脉窦综合征：诱因 + 按摩阳性。: Carotid sinus syndrome: trigger + positive massage.
频发或症状明显：查电解质、甲状腺功能、贫血与药物史。: Frequent or symptomatic: check electrolytes, thyroid function, anemia, and medication history.
额面电轴 −45°～−90°：I、aVL 主波向上，II、III、aVF 主波向: Frontal plane axis −45° to −90°: dominant positive in I and aVL, dominant negative in II, III, and aVF.
食管导联用于即时机制鉴别（窄 QRS 心动过速、房室分离），Holter 用于长: Esophageal leads are used for immediate mechanism differentiation (narrow QRS tachycardia, AV dissociation), while Holter is used to capture paroxysmal events over a long period; the two are complementary.
食管电极位于左房后方，记录心房电活动更近；体表 P 波不明显时尤其有用。: An esophageal electrode is located behind the left atrium and records atrial electrical activity from closer; it is especially useful when surface P waves are not obvious.
首先寻找窦性心动过速与右心负荷线索。: First look for sinus tachycardia and clues of right heart strain.
骨骼肌不自主收缩产生高频电信号；低体温与术后寒战常见。: Involuntary skeletal muscle contraction produces high-frequency electrical signals; hypothermia and postoperative shivering are common.
高危（休克/低血压）：全身溶栓或导管/手术取栓，必要时 ECMO。: High risk (shock/hypotension): systemic thrombolysis or catheter/surgical embolectomy, with ECMO if necessary.
高尖 T 波、宽 QRS、P 波低平，无 PR 压低与弥漫 ST 抬高。: Tall peaked T waves, wide QRS, flattened P waves, without PR depression or diffuse ST elevation.
高电压、深窄 Q、T 倒置。: High voltage, deep narrow Q waves, T inversion.
高钾 T 高尖/QRS 宽；低钾 U 波/ST 低；高钙 QT 短；低钙 QT: Hyperkalemia: tall peaked T waves/wide QRS; hypokalemia: U waves/low ST; hypercalcemia: short QT; hypocalcemia: long QT; hypomagnesemia: long QT + TdP.
高钾 T 高尖→P 平→QRS 宽→正弦波；低钾 U 波+QT 长；低钙 ST/: Hyperkalemia: tall peaked T waves → flattened P waves → widened QRS → sine wave; hypokalemia: U waves + prolonged QT; hypocalcemia: prolonged ST/QT; hypercalcemia: shortened QT.
高钾可致宽 QRS 缓慢节律，但 T 波高尖、P 波低平，血钾可鉴别。: Hyperkalemia can cause a slow wide-QRS rhythm, but tall peaked T waves and flattened P waves are present, and serum potassium can differentiate.
高钾心电图与低钾/早期复极可混淆；血钾与临床是关键，不能只凭 T 波。: K⁺ >6.5 or ECG changes require emergency treatment; calcium does not lower K⁺, only stabilizes myocardium; then insulin + glucose, β2 agonists, dialysis, etc. to lower K⁺.
高钾降低静息电位、加快复极，早期 T 波高尖，严重时 QRS 增宽、P 波消失、: Hyperkalemia lowers resting potential and accelerates repolarization: early tall peaked T waves; severe cases show QRS widening, loss of P waves, and sine wave. Hypokalemia prolongs repolarization, causing ST depression, flat T waves, and U waves.
鱼钩样 ST 改变不等同中毒；中毒诊断结合血药浓度、症状、肾功能与心律失常。: Fish-hook ST changes are not equivalent to toxicity; toxicity diagnosis combines serum drug levels, symptoms, renal function, and arrhythmias.
2/3 型：马鞍型 ST 抬高，需药物激发试验或移位导联确认。: Type 2/3: saddleback ST elevation; confirm with drug challenge or shifted leads.
2:1 阻滞是分型盲区，宽 QRS 加症状更支持 II 型。: 2:1 block is a classification blind spot; wide QRS plus symptoms favors type II.
3 个月婴儿，吃奶差、呼吸急促；心率 260 次/分，窄 QRS 规则，肝大。: 3-month-old infant, poor feeding, tachypnea; heart rate 260 bpm, regular narrow QRS, hepatomegaly.
18 岁篮球运动员，运动中晕厥；心电图 LVH 电压、侧壁 T 倒置、深窄 Q: 18-year-old basketball player, syncope during exercise; ECG shows LVH voltage, lateral T-wave inversion, deep narrow Q waves, and family history of sudden death.
28 岁跑者，高温运动后意识障碍、体温 41°C；心电图宽 QRS、T 高尖，血: 28-year-old runner, impaired consciousness after exertion in heat, temperature 41°C; ECG wide QRS, peaked T waves, potassium 6.5.
55 岁男性，少尿、乏力；心电图 T 高尖、P 波低平、QRS 110 ms，血: 55-year-old male, oliguria and fatigue; ECG peaked T waves, flat P waves, QRS 110 ms, serum potassium 6.9, creatinine 480.
58 岁男性，胸痛 1 小时，血压 82/50，肺野清；II/III/aVF S: 58-year-old man, chest pain for 1 hour, BP 82/50, clear lung fields; ST elevation in II/III/aVF and V4R.
70 岁男性，COPD 急性加重，喘憋；心电图窦速、肺型 P 波、电轴右偏、V1: 70-year-old man, acute COPD exacerbation, dyspnea; ECG shows sinus tachycardia, P pulmonale, right axis deviation, tall R in V1, and new-onset atrial fibrillation.
72 岁女性，腹泻后晕厥；QTc 560 ms，宽 QRS 多形性心动过速，QR: 72-year-old woman, syncope after diarrhea; QTc 560 ms, wide-QRS polymorphic tachycardia with QRS twisting around the baseline.
82 岁女性，乏力、头晕；房颤，心室率 38 次/分，服用地高辛与 β 阻滞剂。: 82-year-old woman, fatigue and dizziness; atrial fibrillation, ventricular rate 38 bpm, taking digoxin and β-blockers.
AAI 的关键不是“钉”，而是“每个钉后都有 P，每个 P 后都有 QRS”。: The key to AAI is not the “spike,” but that “every spike is followed by a P, and every P is followed by a QRS.”
AAI：心房起搏，钉后 P 波。: AAI: atrial pacing, P wave after the spike.
ACLS 中的心电图决策: Brain-heart syndrome can cause ST-T/QT changes.
AIVR 常是再灌注的“信号灯”，血流动力学稳定时多数不需要抗心律失常药。: AIVR is often a 'signal light' of reperfusion; when hemodynamically stable, most cases do not need antiarrhythmic drugs.
AI 可筛查房颤/低 EF/高钾等。: AI can screen for AF/low EF/hyperkalemia, etc.
AVNRT/AVRT 折返；腺苷短暂阻断房室结，终止折返；哮喘者腺苷可致支气管痉: AVNRT/AVRT reentry; adenosine briefly blocks the AV node and terminates reentry; in asthma, adenosine can cause bronchospasm.
A 钉—P—V 钉—宽 QRS 的顺序。: Sequence of A spike—P—V spike—wide QRS.
Brugada 1 型：穹隆型 ST + T 倒置。: Brugada type 1: coved-type ST + T inversion.
Brugada 标准在预激性心动过速中可靠性下降。: Brugada criteria are less reliable in pre-excited tachycardia.
CRT 双室起搏，QRS 可变窄。: CRT biventricular pacing; QRS may become narrower.
CRT 的“钉”可能不止一个；看到两个起搏钉与窄 QRS，要想到双室起搏。: CRT may have more than one “spike”; when two pacing spikes and a narrow QRS are seen, consider biventricular pacing.
Frank 导联与正交心电向量: Frank leads and orthogonal ECG vectors
Holter 可分析 ST 段趋势，发现无症状心肌缺血与变异型心绞痛；但受基线、: Holter can analyze ST-segment trends and detect asymptomatic myocardial ischemia and variant angina; however, it is affected by baseline, posture, and lead position.
Holter 连续记录 24–72 小时心电图，用于捕捉阵发性心律失常、评估负荷: Holter continuously records ECG for 24–72 hours to capture paroxysmal arrhythmias and assess burden and ST trends; it cannot replace 12-lead diagnosis.
ICD 电击不是“治疗结束”，而是“开始评估”：查诱因、查设备、查可逆原因。: An ICD shock is not the “end of treatment” but the “start of evaluation”: check triggers, check the device, check reversible causes.
II、III、aVF 中至少两个相邻导联 ST 抬高 ≥1 mm，伴 aVL（最: ST elevation ≥1 mm in at least two contiguous leads among II, III, aVF, with reciprocal depression in aVL (most sensitive); greater elevation in lead III than lead II suggests right coronary artery occlusion. Add V4R when right ventricular infarction is suspected; ST elevation ≥1 mm is diagnostic.
II、III、aVF 镜像 ST↓ 1 mm: Reciprocal ST depression of 1 mm in II, III, aVF
II、III、aVF：P 波高尖 ≥2.5 mm。: II, III, aVF: peaked P waves ≥2.5 mm.
IKs 在交感兴奋时负责缩短动作电位；LQT1 在运动时复极储备不足，易发生早期: IKs is responsible for shortening the action potential during sympathetic excitation; in LQT1, repolarization reserve is insufficient during exercise, making early afterdepolarizations more likely.
I、aVL 呈 qR 型（小 q、高 R）；II、III、aVF 呈 rS 型（: Leads I and aVL show qR pattern (small q, tall R); leads II, III, and aVF show rS pattern (small r, deep S).
I 导联 QRS 净正向、aVF 净正向：正常电轴；I 正、aVF 负：可能左偏: V1 mainly reflects the right ventricle and interventricular septum, while V5/V6 mainly reflect the left ventricle; poor R-wave progression in precordial leads, tall R in V1, and deep S in V6 all have localizing value.
I 正/aVF 正=正常；I 正/aVF 负=可能左偏；II 负=病理性左偏。: I positive/aVF positive = normal; I positive/aVF negative = possible left axis deviation; II negative = pathologic left axis deviation.
I 正、aVF 正=正常；I 正、aVF 负=可能左偏；I 负、aVF 正=右偏: I positive, aVF positive = normal; I positive, aVF negative = possible left deviation; I negative, aVF positive = right deviation.
LBBB 看“三无一宽”：I、V5、V6 无 q，R 波宽钝，V1 深 S。: For LBBB, look for “three no's and one wide”: no q in I, V5, V6; broad, blunt R wave; deep S in V1.
LGL 是历史概念，不能仅凭短 PR 诊断；很多短 PR 者无心动过速。: LGL is a historical concept and cannot be diagnosed by short PR alone; many people with short PR have no tachycardia.
LQT2 的 T 波形态不典型，容易被忽略；需测量 QTc 并问诱发因素。: LQT2 T-wave morphology is atypical and easily overlooked; measure QTc and ask about triggers.
LVH 的 ST-T 改变不是“良性”的代名词；有胸痛、动态变化时仍需按 ACS: ST-T changes of LVH are not synonymous with "benign"; with chest pain or dynamic changes, still manage per ACS pathway.
MAT 的治疗以纠正诱因、控制心率为主；不宜盲目复律。: MAT treatment mainly involves correcting triggers and controlling rate; avoid indiscriminate cardioversion.
Mahaim 旁路多位于右房-右束支区域，激动右室较晚，形成 LBBB 形态；与: Mahaim pathways are mostly located in the right atrium-right bundle branch region, activating the right ventricle later and forming an LBBB morphology; unlike typical WPW.
PR <0.12 s、QRS 正常、无 delta 波；阵发性窄 QRS 心动过: PR <0.12 s, normal QRS, no delta wave; paroxysmal narrow-QRS tachycardia; must exclude WPW, AVNRT, and normal variant.
PR >0.20 s 本身不是起搏指征，症状与进展风险才是。: PR >0.20 s alone is not a pacing indication; symptoms and risk of progression are.
PR 恒定，QRS 却周期性脱漏；病变多在希氏束以下，易进展为三度，起搏评估要更: PR is constant while QRS periodically drops; the lesion is mostly below the His bundle, easily progresses to third-degree, and pacemaker evaluation should be more proactive.
PR 显著延长 >0.30 s 或进行性延长，可能进展为二度或三度阻滞。: PR markedly prolonged >0.30 s or progressively prolonged, may progress to second- or third-degree block.
PR 正常、QRS 宽、束支形态：束支/分支阻滞。: Normal PR, wide QRS, bundle-branch morphology: bundle-branch/fascicular block.
PR 段压低（II、aVF、V4–V6），aVR PR 段抬高；可见 Spodi: PR-segment depression (II, aVF, V4–V6), PR-segment elevation in aVR; Spodick sign may be seen.
PR 缩短、delta 波、QRS 增宽；旁路可引发 AVRT，合并房颤时有室颤: Shortened PR, delta wave, widened QRS; an accessory pathway can cause AVRT, and with atrial fibrillation there is a risk of ventricular fibrillation.
PVC 宽大畸形、前无 P、T 波方向与 QRS 主波相反，代偿间歇完全。: PVCs are wide and bizarre, without a preceding P wave, T wave opposite to the main QRS deflection, and with a fully compensatory pause.
PVC 负荷高、左室功能下降或新发心力衰竭。: High PVC burden, reduced left ventricular function, or new-onset heart failure.
P 波与 QRS 频率接近、PR 逐渐变化、P 可落在 QRS 前后；无固定 P: P-wave and QRS rates are close, PR gradually changes, and P waves may fall before or after the QRS; there is no fixed PR.
P 波为窦性；QRS 多窄，若增宽提示合并束支阻滞或阻滞位于希氏束下。: P waves are sinus; QRS is usually narrow; if widened, suggests concomitant bundle branch block or block below the His bundle.
P 波缺失，或窦性 P 与 QRS 分离；可见室性融合波或夺获波。: Absent P waves or sinus P waves dissociated from QRS; ventricular fusion beats or capture beats may be seen.
QRS 增宽、aVR R 波增高。: If sine wave is seen, do not wait for potassium result; give IV calcium first, then lower potassium.
QTc <340 ms（部分标准 <360 ms）、T 波高尖、无 ST 段；晕: QTc <340 ms (some criteria <360 ms), tall peaked T waves, no ST segment; history of syncope/family sudden death/ventricular fibrillation supports diagnosis.
QTc >500 ms 或 Δ>60 ms 高风险。: ECG of digoxin toxicity is often "atrial tachycardia + AV block"; when this combination is seen, ask about digoxin.
QTc 延长、T 波低平或有切迹；情绪/声音诱发晕厥；产后风险增加。: Prolonged QTc, flattened or notched T waves; emotion/sound-triggered syncope; increased postpartum risk.
QT 延长导致复极不均一，早期后除极（EAD）触发多形性室速；常见诱因包括低钾、: QT prolongation causes repolarization heterogeneity, and early afterdepolarizations (EADs) trigger polymorphic VT; common triggers include hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia, hypocalcemia, bradycardia, and drugs (amiodarone, quinolones, macrolides, antipsychotics, etc.).
R-on-T 现象、多源 PVC、成对 PVC 或非持续性室速。: R-on-T phenomenon, multifocal PVCs, paired PVCs, or nonsustained ventricular tachycardia.
RVH 看电轴右偏与右胸劳损。: RVH: assess right axis deviation and right precordial strain.
S1Q3T3 不是肺栓塞的“确诊章”，只是右心负荷的线索。: S1Q3T3 is not a 'diagnostic confirmation' for pulmonary embolism, only a clue to right heart load.
ST-T 方向与 QRS 主波相反：V1–V3 ST 抬高、T 直立，侧壁导联: ST-T direction opposite to QRS main vector: ST elevation and upright T in V1–V3; ST depression and T inversion in lateral leads.
STEMI 导联定位与罪犯血管: STEMI Lead Localization and Culprit Vessel
ST 段与 T 波方向通常与 QRS 主波相反（继发性 ST-T 改变）。: The ST segment and T wave are usually opposite to the main QRS deflection (secondary ST-T changes).
ST 段压低、T 波低平或倒置，U 波振幅增高（V2–V3 最明显）。: ST segment depression, flattened or inverted T waves, increased U wave amplitude (most prominent in V2–V3).
TdP = 多形性 VT + 长 QT + 扭转；看到扭转先找 QT。: TdP = polymorphic VT + long QT + twisting; when you see twisting, look for QT first.
T 波与 QRS 主波方向相反，ST 段呈继发性改变。: The T wave is opposite in direction to the main QRS wave, with secondary ST segment changes.
T 波低平、ST 压低、U 波突出、QT(U) 延长；严重时可出现室性心律失常。: Flattened T waves, ST depression, prominent U waves, and prolonged QT(U); severe cases may develop ventricular arrhythmias.
V1 高 R + 胸痛 + V1–V3 ST 压低，先按后壁 STEMI 处理，: Tall R in V1 + chest pain + ST depression in V1–V3: manage as posterior STEMI first, not diagnose RVH first.
V1 高 R、R/S>1；电轴右偏。: Tall R in V1, R/S>1; right axis deviation.
V1 高 R 先看电轴与 ST-T。: For a tall R wave in V1, first check axis and ST-T.
V1 高 R 是“向量问题”，不是“右室肥厚”的同义词；先问哪个方向的向量变大了: Tall R in V1 is a "vector problem," not synonymous with "right ventricular hypertrophy"; first ask which direction the vector has increased.
V1–V3 穹隆型 ST 抬高伴晕厥或家族猝死史，需按 Brugada 综合征进: Coved-type ST elevation in V1–V3 with syncope or family history of sudden death requires electrophysiologic evaluation for Brugada syndrome.
VVI 单腔心室；AAI 单腔心房；DDD 双腔。: VVI single-chamber ventricular; AAI single-chamber atrial; DDD dual-chamber.
X 轴大致左右，Y 轴上下，Z 轴前后；三个轴互相垂直，便于重建三维向量环。: The X axis is roughly left-right, the Y axis up-down, and the Z axis front-back; the three axes are perpendicular, facilitating reconstruction of the 3D vector loop.
aVR P 波倒置是正常导联位置的重要线索。: Inverted P wave in aVR is an important clue to normal lead placement.
aVR P 直立/I 倒置。: P upright in aVR/inverted in I.
delta 波方向定位旁路。: Delta wave direction localizes the accessory pathway.
“劳损”是形态描述，不是“无需处理”；有症状和动态变化时仍要查缺血。: "Strain" is a morphologic description, not "no treatment needed"; with symptoms and dynamic changes, still evaluate for ischemia.
一个导联平线、患者还在说话，先查电极；不要开始 CPR。: One lead is flat while the patient is still talking: check electrodes first; do not start CPR.
一度、无症状二度 I 型：多数可观察，先处理病因。: First-degree and asymptomatic second-degree type I: mostly observation, treat the cause first.
一度与无症状二度 I 型通常不需要紧急起搏，但不能漏掉进展。: First-degree and asymptomatic second-degree type I usually do not need urgent pacing, but progression must not be missed.
一度：PR>0.20 s 且每个 P 均下传；二度 I 型：PR 渐长后脱落，多: First-degree: PR>0.20 s and every P conducts; second-degree type I: PR gradually lengthens then drops, mostly at AV node; second-degree type II: PR fixed, sudden drop, mostly below His bundle; third-degree: P and QRS completely dissociated, ventricular rate determined by escape pacemaker.
三度 AVB 伴慢逸搏：阿托品可能无效，准备经皮起搏；寻找下壁缺血/药物/电解质: Third-degree AVB with slow escape: atropine may be ineffective; prepare transcutaneous pacing; look for reversible causes such as inferior ischemia/drugs/electrolytes.
三度 AVB 的宽 QRS 逸搏不稳定；不要只等阿托品，准备起搏。: Wide-QRS escape in third-degree AVB is unstable; do not just wait for atropine—prepare pacing.
三度房室传导阻滞是心房冲动完全不能下传心室，心房与心室由各自起搏点独立控制，形成: Second-degree AV block, Mobitz type II
三度阻滞 = 心房与心室“各唱各的调”；房率快于室率、PR 不固定。: Third-degree block = atria and ventricles “each singing their own tune”; atrial rate is faster than ventricular rate, and PR is not fixed.
三度阻滞伴晕厥或依赖起搏者准备起搏，不要用单纯阿托品替代；反复症状性 AIVR: For third-degree block with syncope or pacing dependence, prepare for pacing; do not substitute atropine alone; recurrent symptomatic AIVR requires electrophysiologic evaluation.
三度：P 与 QRS 分离，房率>室率。: Third-degree: P and QRS dissociated, atrial rate > ventricular rate.
下壁 STEMI 先看血压，再想右室梗死。: In inferior STEMI, check blood pressure first, then consider right ventricular infarction.
下壁与后壁、右室常由同一罪犯血管供血，定位时要同时评估三个区域；右室梗死合并后壁: The inferior, posterior, and right ventricular regions are often supplied by the same culprit vessel; evaluate all three regions when localizing. When RV infarction coexists with posterior infarction, V1 may appear atypical because the two vectors cancel.
下壁心梗加低血压加肺部清晰等于右室梗死，要补液而不是用硝酸酯。: Inferior MI plus hypotension plus clear lungs equals right ventricular infarction; give fluids, not nitrates.
下壁心梗阻滞多可逆；前壁心梗宽 QRS 三度阻滞预后差。: Inferior MI block is often reversible; anterior MI with wide QRS third-degree block has poor prognosis.
下壁梗死伴低血压、肺清晰时先想到右室梗死，避免硝酸酯。: With inferior infarction, hypotension, and clear lungs, think first of RV infarction and avoid nitrates.
不完全 RBBB：QRS 100–119 ms，图形类似但未达宽度。: Incomplete RBBB: QRS 100–119 ms, similar pattern but not reaching width criterion.
不应期长度与动作电位时程相关，QT 延长时不应期也延长，容易发生早期后除极与尖端: Refractory period length correlates with action potential duration; when QT is prolonged, refractoriness also prolongs, predisposing to early afterdepolarizations and torsades de pointes.
不应期随动作电位时程改变，QT 延长增加早期后除极风险。: Refractoriness changes with action potential duration; QT prolongation increases the risk of early afterdepolarizations.
不要用 Holter 回答“这个心动过速的机制”；也不要用电生理检查回答“一天有: Do not use Holter to answer “what is the mechanism of this tachycardia”; do not use electrophysiology study to answer “how much AF burden is there per day.”
与不完全性 RBBB 鉴别：后者 QRS 0.11–0.119 s，图形相同但时: Differentiate from incomplete RBBB: the latter has QRS 0.11–0.119 s, same pattern but duration does not meet complete criteria.
严重主动脉瓣狭窄或心衰表现。: Manifestations of severe aortic stenosis or heart failure.
严重时 QT 延长可诱发尖端扭转型室速。: Severe QT prolongation can induce torsades de pointes.
二度 II 型 PR 恒定、突然脱漏；文氏现象 PR 渐长后脱漏。: Second-degree Type II: PR constant with sudden dropped beats; Wenckebach phenomenon: PR gradually lengthens then dropped beat.
二度 I 型（文氏型）：PR 间期逐渐延长，直到一个 P 波后 QRS 脱落，随: Second-degree type I (Wenckebach): PR interval gradually prolongs until a P wave is not followed by QRS, then PR shortens and the cycle repeats. Before the dropped beat, RR intervals gradually shorten, forming "grouped beating". Mostly located at AV node, QRS usually narrow, lower risk of progression to complete block.
交界区是心脏的“第二梯队”，它出场说明窦房结这一级已经失守。: The junctional area is the heart's 'second string'; its appearance indicates that the sinus node level has failed.
交界性心律常无直立 P 波或 P 波在 QRS 后。: Junctional rhythm often has no upright P wave, or the P wave is after the QRS.
交界性早搏伴室内差异性传导时 QRS 可宽，需与室早鉴别。: In junctional premature beats with aberrant ventricular conduction, the QRS may be wide and must be differentiated from PVCs.
交界性早搏无直立 P′，QRS 窄，逆行 P 可在 QRS 后。: Junctional premature beats have no upright P′, narrow QRS, and retrograde P may follow the QRS.
交界性期前收缩是房室交界区（房室结-希氏束区域）异位起搏点提前放电，冲动同时向心: A junctional premature contraction is an ectopic pacemaker in the AV junctional area (AV node–His bundle region) discharging early; the impulse conducts simultaneously to the atria and ventricles, forming a premature narrow QRS complex.
传导顺序：窦房结 → 心房 → 房室结 → 希氏束 → 束支 → 浦肯野 → 心: Conduction sequence: sinoatrial node → atria → atrioventricular node → bundle of His → bundle branches → Purkinje → ventricular muscle.
伴洋地黄中毒、严重电解质紊乱或急性心肌缺血。: With digitalis toxicity, severe electrolyte disturbance, or acute myocardial ischemia.
低电压 + 电轴右偏 + 右房增大。: Low voltage + right axis deviation + right atrial enlargement.
低电压/电交替→心包填塞；S1Q3T3→肺栓塞。: Low voltage/electrical alternans → cardiac tamponade; S1Q3T3 → pulmonary embolism.
低血压患者心电图可揭示心动过缓、快速心律失常、缺血、肺栓塞、心包填塞、电解质异常: In hypotensive patients, ECG can reveal reversible causes such as bradycardia, tachyarrhythmia, ischemia, pulmonary embolism, cardiac tamponade, and electrolyte abnormalities.
低钾、低镁、低钙与药物常协同致心律失常。: Hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia, hypocalcemia and drugs often act synergistically to cause arrhythmias.
体表心电图是“地图”，心内电图是“街道”；电生理检查把机制从推测变成测量。: Surface ECG is a “map,” intracardiac electrogram is a “street”; electrophysiology study turns mechanism from inference into measurement.
体表心电图给“区域”，心内电图给“点”；消融把点变成治疗。: Surface ECG gives the “region,” intracardiac electrogram gives the “point”; ablation turns the point into treatment.
使用不合适的导联或把 U 波计入 T 波，导致 QT 测量误差。: Using inappropriate leads or including U waves in the T wave causes QT measurement error.
倾斜试验阴性不能排除血管迷走性晕厥；阳性也不总是与自然发作一致。: A negative tilt-table test cannot exclude vasovagal syncope; a positive result does not always correlate with spontaneous episodes.
停保钾药，查酸中毒。: Stop potassium-sparing drugs, check for acidosis.
偶发无症状者无需治疗，避免咖啡因、酒精、睡眠不足等诱因。: Occasional asymptomatic cases do not require treatment; avoid triggers such as caffeine, alcohol, and sleep deprivation.
儿童运动晕厥、静息 ECG 正常，别漏 CPVT；运动试验是钥匙。: Exercise syncope in children with normal resting ECG: do not miss CPVT; exercise testing is key.
先处理患者，再补记录。: Treat the patient first, then complete documentation.
先天畸形改变心室容量/压力负荷与传导系统，心电图反映这些血流动力学后果。: Congenital malformations alter ventricular volume/pressure load and the conduction system; ECG reflects these hemodynamic consequences.
先心病术后晕厥/心悸需动态监测；不能只看静息 ECG。: Syncope/palpitations after congenital heart disease surgery require ambulatory monitoring; do not rely on resting ECG alone.
先找到提前的 QRS，再向前寻找其前的 P′ 波。: First find the premature QRS, then look backward for the preceding P′ wave.
先看 I 与 aVF 的净极性: First check the net polarity of I and aVF
先确认基线（TP 段或 PR 段），避免把 J 点压低与 ST 型压低混淆。: First confirm the baseline (TP segment or PR segment) to avoid confusing J-point depression with ST-segment depression.
判断间歇是否为 PP 的整数倍：整数倍支持窦房传导阻滞，不成整数倍支持窦性停搏。: Determine whether the pause is an integer multiple of PP: an integer multiple supports sinoatrial exit block, non-integer multiple supports sinus arrest.
前壁 STEMI 有 ST 抬高与动态变化，不是单纯电压增高。: Anterior STEMI has ST elevation and dynamic changes, not just increased voltage.
前壁心内膜下缺血也可 V1–V3 压低，但通常缺乏高 R、直立 T 与下壁抬高。: Anterior subendocardial ischemia can also cause depression in V1–V3, but usually lacks tall R waves, upright T waves, and inferior elevation.
前壁心梗：易累及束支系统，需警惕进展。: Anterior MI: often involves the bundle branch system; watch for progression.
加做 V7–V9，寻找相邻导联 ST 抬高；同时加做 V4R 评估右室。: Add leads V7–V9 to look for ST elevation in contiguous leads; also add V4R to assess the right ventricle.
劳损：侧壁 ST 下斜、T 倒置，右胸镜像抬高。: Strain: downsloping ST and T-wave inversion in lateral leads, with reciprocal elevation in right chest leads.
单纯下壁梗死可无右室受累；低血压、肺清晰与 V4R 抬高提示右室扩展。: Isolated inferior infarction may spare the right ventricle; hypotension, clear lungs, and V4R elevation suggest right ventricular extension.
危重患者的电解质、药物、缺氧与血流动力学变化可快速诱发心律失常；连续监测能缩短发: In critically ill patients, electrolytes, drugs, hypoxia, and hemodynamic changes can rapidly induce arrhythmias; continuous monitoring shortens time to detection.
双分支：RBBB + LAFB 最常见，QRS 宽且电轴左偏。: Bifascicular: RBBB + LAFB most common, wide QRS and left axis deviation.
双房增大不是独立诊断，而是提示寻找联合瓣膜病、先心病或长期房性压力负荷。: Biatrial enlargement is not an independent diagnosis; it prompts a search for combined valvular disease, congenital heart disease, or long-term atrial pressure overload.
双房增大：P 波又高又宽，V1 双相。: Biatrial enlargement: P wave is both tall and wide, biphasic in V1.
反复症状性窦性停搏/病态窦房结综合征：永久起搏器评估。: Recurrent symptomatic sinus arrest/sick sinus syndrome: evaluate for permanent pacemaker.
发热 + 晕厥 + V1 穹隆型 ST，先按 Brugada 处理并避免诱发药物: Fever + syncope + coved ST in V1: manage as Brugada first and avoid trigger drugs.
发热、使用钠通道阻滞剂后出现 1 型 Brugada 波。: Type 1 Brugada pattern after fever or sodium channel blocker use.
只在一个导联测量 QT，忽略导联间差异。: Measuring QT in only one lead, ignoring interlead differences.
只注意 PVC 而忽略其背后的缺血、低钾或洋地黄中毒。: Focusing only on PVCs and overlooking underlying ischemia, hypokalemia, or digitalis toxicity.
只看 PR 数值而不逐搏确认，漏掉间歇性二度阻滞。: Looking only at the PR value without beat-by-beat confirmation may miss intermittent second-degree block.
只补钾不补镁，低钾反复难纠。: Treating potassium alone without magnesium makes hypokalemia recurrent and hard to correct.
可伴窦性心动过缓、房室阻滞与室性早搏；肌钙蛋白动态升高。: May be accompanied by sinus bradycardia, AV block, and premature ventricular complexes; troponin rises dynamically.
可穿戴单导联易伪差。: Wearable single leads are prone to artifacts.
可穿戴设备提高无症状房颤检出率，但阳性结果需用医疗级设备确认，尤其是抗凝决策前。: Wearable devices increase detection of asymptomatic atrial fibrillation, but positive results need confirmation with medical-grade devices, especially before anticoagulation decisions.
右室扩张使室间隔左移，进一步降低左室充盈与心输出量，形成低血压；肺部通常清晰，因: Right ventricular dilation shifts the interventricular septum leftward, further reducing left ventricular filling and cardiac output and causing hypotension; the lungs are usually clear because left-sided filling pressures are not elevated.
右室梗死几乎总与下壁梗死同时出现。下壁 STEMI 伴低血压、颈静脉怒张而肺部清: Right ventricular infarction almost always occurs with inferior infarction. With inferior STEMI plus hypotension, jugular venous distention, and clear lungs, add V4R; V4R ST elevation ≥1 mm supports RV involvement, in which nitrates and diuretics may cause severe hypotension.
右心负荷→RBBB、右胸 T 倒置。: Right heart strain → RBBB, right precordial T-wave inversion.
右房看振幅，左房看时间与终末向量。: Right atrium: look at amplitude; left atrium: look at duration and terminal vector.
右束支沿室间隔右侧下行，位置表浅，容易受到右心牵张、缺血、纤维化与心脏手术的损伤: The right bundle branch runs down the right side of the interventricular septum and is superficial, making it vulnerable to right heart stretch, ischemia, fibrosis, and cardiac surgery injury; once blocked, the right ventricular free wall loses its fast conduction pathway.
右束支细长易阻滞；左束支分前、后分支。: The right bundle branch is long and thin and prone to block; the left bundle branch divides into anterior and posterior fascicles.
合并右室梗死时避免硝酸酯与利尿剂，维持前负荷，必要时补液与正性肌力药。: In concomitant right ventricular infarction, avoid nitrates and diuretics, maintain preload, and give fluids and inotropes if necessary.
同一向量在不同导联上的投影大小不同：投影 = |V| × cos(夹角)，朝向为: The same vector projects differently onto different leads: projection = |V| × cos(angle); toward the lead is positive, away is negative.
同一导联 P 波 ≥3 种形态、心率 >100、QRS 窄；需与房颤鉴别（有 P: In the same lead, ≥3 P-wave morphologies, heart rate >100, narrow QRS; must be differentiated from atrial fibrillation (P waves present).
同样有窦性 P 波，但频率 >100 次/分。: According to this site’s “Normal Sinus Rhythm” course, which of the following belongs to its mechanism?
后壁与右室同时受累时，两者向量可能部分抵消，使 V1 的 ST 改变不典型，需加: When the posterior wall and right ventricle are involved simultaneously, their vectors may partially cancel out, making ST changes in V1 atypical; add leads V7–V9 and V4R.
后壁：V7–V9 直接抬高，V1–V3 出现镜像压低。: Posterior wall: direct ST elevation in V7–V9, with reciprocal depression in V1–V3.
呼吸引起的低频漂移通常周期与呼吸一致；电极松动、皮肤准备不足或出汗也会造成漂移。: Baseline wander: look at respiration/electrodes; EMG: look at high-frequency fine waves.
固定顺序：定标与导联→心率→节律→电轴→PR/QRS/QT→P 波→QRS 形态: Fixed sequence: calibration and leads → heart rate → rhythm → axis → PR/QRS/QT → P waves → QRS morphology → ST-T → U waves → comparison with prior ECGs/clinical context.
在 II、III、aVF 与 V1 寻找 F 波，注意 F 波频率与形态。: Look for F waves in II, III, aVF, and V1; note F-wave rate and morphology.
地高辛中毒的心电图不是“鱼钩样 ST”那么简单；房速伴阻滞是危险信号。: The ECG in digoxin toxicity is not simply a “fishhook ST” pattern; atrial tachycardia with block is a danger sign.
地高辛中毒：房速伴阻滞、室早。: Digoxin toxicity: atrial tachycardia with block, PVCs.
地高辛抑制 Na⁺/K⁺-ATP 酶，增加细胞内钙，改变复极过程，形成勺状 ST: Digoxin inhibits Na⁺/K⁺-ATPase, increases intracellular calcium, alters repolarization, and produces scooped ST-T changes.
填塞行心包穿刺引流；反复复发者考虑激素、免疫抑制或心包切除。: For tamponade, perform pericardiocentesis and drainage; for recurrent cases, consider steroids, immunosuppression, or pericardiectomy.
复极早期心外膜与心内膜电位差增大，形成 J 波；高危者存在复极异质性，易诱发室颤: In early repolarization, the epicardial-endocardial potential difference increases, forming a J wave; high-risk individuals have repolarization heterogeneity and are prone to ventricular fibrillation.
多形性 VT 使用同步电复律可能无法识别 QRS，需非同步除颤。: In polymorphic VT, synchronized cardioversion may fail to identify the QRS; use unsynchronized defibrillation.
多形性宽 QRS、尖端扭转、长 QT。: Polymorphic wide QRS, torsades de pointes, long QT.
多形性宽 QRS 心动过速，QRS 振幅围绕基线“扭转”，几乎总伴 QT 延长。: Polymorphic wide QRS tachycardia with QRS amplitude twisting around the baseline, almost always with QT prolongation.
夜间心率周期性下降、长间歇、房颤发作与呼吸暂停事件时间对应；白天心电图可正常。: Periodic nocturnal heart rate drops, long pauses, and AF episodes correspond in time with apnea events; daytime ECG can be normal.
夜间长间歇不一定需要起搏器；先评估睡眠呼吸暂停与可逆因素。: Nocturnal long pauses do not necessarily require a pacemaker; first evaluate sleep apnea and reversible factors.
大量输血、急性胰腺炎、甲状旁腺术后低钙危象。: Massive transfusion, acute pancreatitis, and hypocalcemic crisis after parathyroid surgery.
夺获波是室速中窦性冲动成功下传、产生窄 QRS 的搏动；证明房室结与希氏-浦肯野: A capture beat is a beat in VT in which a sinus impulse successfully conducts down and produces a narrow QRS; it proves that the AV node and His-Purkinje system can still conduct.
妊娠与心电图: Electrical alternans + low voltage: prompt ultrasound.
定标错误或纸速不明时，不应直接据此判断间期是否异常。: When calibration is incorrect or paper speed is unknown, do not directly use it to judge whether intervals are abnormal.
宽 QRS + 慢 + 无 P：先按危重处理，同时查血钾与用药史。: Wide QRS + slow + no P: treat as critical first while checking serum potassium and medication history.
宽 QRS、起搏钉规律出现。: Wide QRS, pacing spikes appear regularly.
宽 QRS 心动过速伴极度电轴偏移，支持室速。: Wide QRS tachycardia with extreme axis deviation supports VT.
宽 QRS 房速与室速的鉴别不能只看宽度，需结合房室关系、形态与病史。: Differentiating wide-QRS atrial tachycardia from ventricular tachycardia cannot rely on width alone; AV relationship, morphology, and history must be considered.
寻找并纠正诱因：甲亢、电解质、咖啡因、酒精。: Identify and correct triggers: hyperthyroidism, electrolytes, caffeine, alcohol.
寻找镜像改变，排除心包炎、早复极、LVH 等。: Look for reciprocal changes and exclude pericarditis, early repolarization, LVH, etc.
小儿晕厥/抽搐需查 ECG；癫痫诊断前应排除长 QT。: Pediatric syncope/seizure requires ECG; exclude long QT before diagnosing epilepsy.
小儿晕厥伴抽搐需与癫痫鉴别；长 QT 可表现为抽搐。: Pediatric syncope with seizures must be differentiated from epilepsy; long QT can present with seizures.
尖端扭转型为多形性 VT，波形围绕基线扭转；不稳定时同样除颤。: Torsades de pointes is polymorphic VT with the waveform twisting around the baseline; if unstable, defibrillate similarly.
尽快再灌注（PCI/溶栓评估）。: Reperfusion as soon as possible (assess PCI/thrombolysis).
左偏：I 正、aVF 负、II 负。: Left axis deviation: I positive, aVF negative, II negative.
左前分支传导阻滞是左束支前分支传导中断，左心室激动先从后下分支区域开始，再向上、: Left anterior fascicular block is interruption of the anterior fascicle of the left bundle branch. Left ventricular activation begins in the posteroinferior fascicular region and then spreads slowly upward and leftward, causing marked leftward frontal plane axis deviation, rS in inferior leads, and qR in lateral leads; QRS duration is usually normal. It is one of the most common intraventricular conduction blocks.
左前降支急性闭塞：V1–V4 相邻导联 ST 段抬高，下壁导联出现镜像性压低，必: Acute left anterior descending artery occlusion: ST-segment elevation in adjacent leads V1–V4, reciprocal depression in inferior leads, immediate reperfusion required.
差异性传导：室上性冲动 + 束支不应期。: Aberrant conduction: supraventricular impulse + bundle branch refractory period.
希氏束与束支: Bundle of His and bundle branches
帕金森患者心电图“房扑”，先看是不是震颤伪差；放松后可能消失。: In a Parkinson's patient with "atrial flutter" on ECG, first check for tremor artifact; it may disappear after relaxation.
常见于洋地黄中毒、心肌缺血、心肌炎、低钾，也可见于健康人。: Commonly seen in digitalis toxicity, myocardial ischemia, myocarditis, hypokalemia, and also in healthy people.
年轻运动员：高电压 + 窦缓 + 早期复极，无劳损。: Young athletes: high voltage + sinus bradycardia + early repolarization, without strain.
并行心律不是“早搏变多”；联律间期多变是关键，需长条图分析。: Parasystole is not 'more premature beats'; variable coupling interval is key and requires long rhythm strip analysis.
幼稚型 T 波指 V1–V3 T 波倒置，在儿童和年轻女性中可见；体位改变可引起: Juvenile T wave refers to T-wave inversion in V1–V3, seen in children and young women; positional changes can cause mild ST-T changes.
广泛高频噪声，与寒战同步。: Widespread high-frequency noise, synchronous with shivering.
当冲动落在房室结绝对不应期时不能下传，QRS 脱漏；随后房室结获得较长恢复时间，: When the impulse falls in the AV node absolute refractory period, it cannot conduct and the QRS is dropped; the AV node then has a longer recovery time, and PR resets to the shortest.
心动过缓依赖型：提高心率（异丙肾上腺素或临时起搏）以缩短 QT。: Bradycardia-dependent: increase heart rate (isoproterenol or temporary pacing) to shorten QT.
心包炎等于弥漫凹面 ST 抬高加 PR 压低，加除 aVR/V1 外无镜像。: Pericarditis equals diffuse concave ST elevation plus PR depression, with no reciprocal changes except in aVR/V1.
心室扑动呈规则正弦波、频率约 200–300 次/分，处理与 VF 相同。: Ventricular flutter shows a regular sine wave at about 200–300 beats/min; manage the same as VF.
心室率 <30 次/分、QRS 进行性增宽或节律不稳定，可随时进展为室颤或停搏。: Ventricular rate <30 beats/min, progressively widening QRS, or unstable rhythm may progress to ventricular fibrillation or asystole at any time.
心室率 <40 次/分、长间歇 >3 s，或伴晕厥、黑矇、低血压、意识改变。: Ventricular rate <40 beats/min, long pause >3 s, or accompanied by syncope, amaurosis, hypotension, or altered consciousness.
心室除极的综合向量方向决定各肢体导联 QRS 的极性；左前分支阻滞、左室肥厚等使: The direction of the overall ventricular depolarization vector determines QRS polarity in each limb lead; left anterior fascicular block, left ventricular hypertrophy, etc. shift the vector leftward.
心房内传导屏障使两个心房区域独立除极；可见于心房梗死、洋地黄中毒、严重心肌病。: An intra-atrial conduction barrier causes two atrial regions to depolarize independently; seen in atrial infarction, digitalis toxicity, and severe cardiomyopathy.
心房内多个起搏点轮流发放，或起搏点沿心房游走；与多源性房速的区别是心率。: Multiple pacemakers in the atria fire alternately, or the pacemaker wanders along the atria; the difference from multifocal atrial tachycardia is the heart rate.
心房率通常 60–100 次/分；心室逸搏率 20–40 次/分（室性）或 40: Atrial rate usually 60–100 beats/min; ventricular escape rate 20–40 beats/min (ventricular) or 40–60 beats/min (junctional).
心房率高于心室率，常见 3:2、4:3 或 2:1 传导。: Atrial rate higher than ventricular rate; common conduction ratios 3:2, 4:3, or 2:1.
心房肌或肺静脉口附近的异位灶自律性增高，或触发/折返机制提前放电。: Increased automaticity of ectopic foci in atrial muscle or near pulmonary vein ostia, or premature firing via triggered/reentry mechanisms.
心房颤动是心房内多发微折返导致心房失去有效收缩，心电图表现为 P 波消失、代之以: Atrial fibrillation is caused by multiple microreentries within the atria, leading to loss of effective atrial contraction; ECG shows absent P waves, replaced by f waves of varying size and shape, and an absolutely irregular ventricular rate.
心梗从超急性高尖 T、ST 抬高到 Q 波形成、T 波倒置，最后遗留 Q 波；导: MI evolves from hyperacute peaked T waves and ST elevation to Q-wave formation and T-wave inversion, finally leaving a Q wave; lead combinations (III > II, V4R, aVR, etc.) help identify the culprit vessel.
心率双倍计数常因高 T/起搏钉。: Heart rate double counting is often due to tall T waves/pacing spikes.
心率增快本身增加心肌耗氧，若持续存在可诱发缺血或心动过速性心肌病。: Increased heart rate itself increases myocardial oxygen consumption; if persistent, it can induce ischemia or tachycardia-induced cardiomyopathy.
心率报警阈值应根据患者基础心率设置；过低阈值导致报警疲劳，过高阈值可能漏掉心动过: Heart rate alarm thresholds should be set according to the patient's baseline heart rate; too low a threshold causes alarm fatigue, too high a threshold may miss bradycardia.
心电轴、胸导联 R 波递增、预激 delta 波方向，本质都是向量投影问题；理解: Electrical axis, chest lead R wave progression, and pre-excitation delta wave direction are essentially all vector projection problems; understanding projection is more reliable than memorizing patterns.
心肌缺血与 ST 段压低指冠状动脉供血不足导致心内膜下心肌缺血，心电图上出现水平: Myocardial ischemia and ST depression refer to subendocardial myocardial ischemia caused by insufficient coronary artery blood supply; ECG shows horizontal or downsloping ST depression and T-wave inversion, with or without elevated cardiac troponin. Elevated troponin indicates NSTEMI; normal troponin indicates unstable angina; both are collectively called non-ST-elevation acute coronary syndrome.
心脏传导系统与正常激动顺序: Cardiac conduction system and normal activation sequence
快速心室节律使房室结处于不应期，窦性 P 无法下传；不是房室结病变。: Rapid ventricular rhythm keeps the AV node refractory, so sinus P waves cannot conduct; this is not AV node disease.
快速房性心律失常导致窦房结超速抑制与心房重构；终止后窦房结恢复延迟，形成长间歇。: Rapid atrial arrhythmias cause sinus node overdrive suppression and atrial remodeling; after termination, delayed sinus node recovery forms long pauses.
忽略 aVL 的镜像压低，漏掉早期下壁心梗。: Overlooking reciprocal depression in aVL and missing early inferior MI.
忽略发热、药物等诱因与家族史。: Ignoring triggers such as fever and drugs, and family history.
忽略后壁心梗：V1–V3 ST 压低伴高 R 波时应加做 V7–V9。: Overlooking posterior MI: add leads V7–V9 when V1–V3 show ST depression with tall R waves.
忽略间位性 PVC：PVC 插入两个窦性搏动之间，无代偿间歇。: Overlooking interpolated PVCs: the PVC falls between two sinus beats without a compensatory pause.
急性 ACS、严重主动脉瓣狭窄是禁忌。: Acute ACS and severe aortic stenosis are contraindications.
急性下壁心肌梗死合并窦性心动过缓，提示迷走张力增高或房室结缺血。: Acute inferior myocardial infarction with sinus bradycardia suggests increased vagal tone or AV node ischemia.
急性后壁心肌梗死通常由右冠状动脉或回旋支闭塞引起，后壁损伤向量背离 V1–V3，: Acute posterior myocardial infarction is usually caused by right coronary artery or circumflex artery occlusion. The posterior injury vector points away from V1–V3, so on the standard 12-lead ECG it manifests as ST depression, tall R waves, and upright T waves in V1–V3 rather than direct ST elevation. After adding leads V7–V9, ST elevation can be seen in the posterior leads. Posterior infarction rarely occurs in isolation and often coexists with inferior or lateral infarction, and is easily misdiagnosed as anterior ischemia.
急性心肌缺血、心衰、电解质紊乱诱发的 VT。: VT induced by acute myocardial ischemia, heart failure, or electrolyte disturbance.
急性透壁缺血使损伤区静息膜电位降低，收缩期损伤电流导致 ST 段抬高；心内膜下缺: Acute transmural ischemia lowers the resting membrane potential in the injured area; systolic injury current causes ST-segment elevation; subendocardial ischemia manifests as ST-segment depression.
慢心室率/灌注差需起搏。: Slow ventricular rate/poor perfusion requires pacing.
成人安静时心室率 60–100 次/分；PR 间期 0.12–0.20 s，QR: In adults at rest, ventricular rate 60–100 beats/min; PR interval 0.12–0.20 s, QRS duration <0.12 s.
房室分离是“现象”，不是“诊断”；先问谁控制谁、谁更快。: AV dissociation is a "phenomenon", not a "diagnosis"; first ask who controls whom and which is faster.
房室结负责“延迟”和“过滤”心房冲动，希氏-浦肯野系统负责快速、同步地激动心室；: The AV node is responsible for “delay” and “filtering” atrial impulses, while the His-Purkinje system is responsible for rapid, synchronized ventricular activation; together they determine PR and QRS.
房扑 2:1 传导时心室率约 150 次/分，F 波可能被误认为窦性 P 波。: With atrial flutter 2:1 conduction, ventricular rate is about 150 beats/min; F waves may be mistaken for sinus P waves.
房速 P′ 之间有等电位线，房率通常低于房扑。: Atrial tachycardia has an isoelectric line between P′ waves; atrial rate is usually lower than flutter.
房颤患者 P 波消失，左房增大只能靠超声或既往窦性心电图判断。: In AF, P waves are absent; left atrial enlargement can only be determined by echocardiography or prior sinus ECG.
所有下壁 STEMI 常规加做 V4R，不要等低血压出现才加做。: Add V4R routinely in all inferior STEMI; do not wait for hypotension to appear.
手表说“房颤”，先做 12 导联；确认之前不要开始抗凝。: Watch says "AF": do a 12-lead first; do not start anticoagulation before confirmation.
把 2 型心肌梗死（供需失衡）按 1 型 ACS 处理，忽略原发病。: Treating type 2 myocardial infarction (supply-demand imbalance) as type 1 ACS and ignoring the underlying disease.
把 2:1 阻滞都当文氏型：2:1 无法仅凭 PR 分型，宽 QRS 更支持 I: Treating all 2:1 block as Wenckebach: 2:1 cannot be typed based on PR alone; a wide QRS more strongly supports type II.
把 LBBB 在 V1–V3 的 ST 抬高当作前壁 STEMI：不一致性抬高是: Mistaking ST elevation in V1–V3 with LBBB for anterior STEMI: discordant elevation is expected in LBBB.
把 P 波分成“右房前半段、左房后半段”来读，比背“二尖瓣型/肺型”更接近机制。: Reading the P wave as "first half right atrium, second half left atrium" is closer to the mechanism than memorizing "P mitrale/P pulmonale".
把 U 波并入 T 波，误判 QT。: Including the U wave in the T wave leads to misjudgment of QT.
把 V1–V3 的继发 T 波倒置误读为前壁缺血。: Misreading secondary T-wave inversion in V1–V3 as anterior ischemia.
Mistaking junctional escape rhythm for sinus bradycardia: in the latter, the P wave is upright in lead II and PR ≥0.12 s.
把动作电位的 0/2/3 相与 QRS/ST/T 对应起来: Correlate phases 0/2/3 of the action potential with QRS/ST/T
把室性逸搏误认为室早或室速：逸搏发生在长间歇后、频率慢；室速频率 >100 次/: Mistaking ventricular escape for PVC or VT: escape occurs after a long pause and is slow; VT rate is >100 bpm.
把每一个波都当成“向量在某导联轴上的投影”，而不是孤立的起伏。: Treat each wave as “the projection of a vector onto a lead axis,” not as an isolated deflection.
抗缺血：硝酸酯（无禁忌时）、β 受体阻滞剂，吸氧仅用于低氧血症，充分镇痛。: Anti-ischemic therapy: nitrates (when no contraindications), beta-blockers; oxygen only for hypoxemia; adequate analgesia.
折返环路快速而规则，QRS 多窄；P 波常与 QRS 重叠或位于 QRS 终末。: The reentrant circuit is fast and regular, QRS is usually narrow; P waves often overlap the QRS or lie at the end of the QRS.
持续心电监护，准备除颤；处理并发症（心衰、休克、传导阻滞）。: Continuous ECG monitoring, prepare for defibrillation; manage complications (heart failure, shock, conduction block).
持续性窦缓 <40、窦性停搏 >3 s、窦房阻滞、心动过缓与房颤/房速交替；晕厥: Persistent sinus bradycardia <40, sinus pause >3 s, sinoatrial block, alternating bradycardia and AF/AT; syncope/amaurosis is key to treatment.
按顺序浏览 12 导联，先找 ST 抬高最明显的相邻导联，再寻找镜像性压低。: Review the 12 leads in order: first find the contiguous leads with the most obvious ST elevation, then look for reciprocal depression.
提前的异位 P 波：形态与窦性不同，可正向、负向或双相。: Premature ectopic P wave: morphology differs from sinus P; may be positive, negative, or biphasic.
整个心室除极过程中，瞬时向量首尾相接形成 QRS 向量环；复极形成 T 向量环。: During the entire ventricular depolarization process, instantaneous vectors join head-to-tail to form the QRS vector loop; repolarization forms the T vector loop. Surface leads are projections of the vector loop at different angles.
斑块破裂或侵蚀继发不完全闭塞血栓，或固定狭窄在运动、贫血、感染时需氧增加，造成可: Plaque rupture or erosion with secondary incomplete occlusive thrombus, or fixed stenosis with increased oxygen demand during exercise, anemia, or infection, causes reversible ischemia.
新出现的 PR 延长、QRS 增宽、病理性 Q 波或 ST-T 改变，提示传导或: New PR prolongation, QRS widening, pathological Q waves, or ST-T changes suggest conduction or myocardial problems.
新发 LBBB 伴持续胸痛、肌钙蛋白升高或血流动力学不稳定。: New-onset LBBB with persistent chest pain, troponin elevation, or hemodynamic instability.
新发房颤/ST 压低提示风险。: Postoperative AF: first look for "why now": infection, hypoxia, volume, electrolytes—not just give β-blockers.
新生儿标本溶血可造成假性高钾；需复查并同时看心电图。: Hemolysis of neonatal specimens can cause pseudohyperkalemia; repeat testing and review ECG simultaneously.
新生儿血钾正常上限约 6.0–6.5 mmol/L（因标本而异）；心电图改变 +: Neonatal normal upper limit of serum potassium is about 6.0–6.5 mmol/L (varies by specimen); ECG changes + hyperkalemia require urgent management.
旁路与房室结可形成折返性心动过速（AVRT）；合并房颤时，冲动可经旁路快速下传，: Accessory pathway and AV node can form reentrant tachycardia (AVRT); with atrial fibrillation, impulses can conduct rapidly down the accessory pathway and induce ventricular fibrillation.
旁路绕过房室结，形成折返环；婴儿旁路可随发育退化。: The accessory pathway bypasses the AV node and forms a reentry circuit; in infants, accessory pathways may regress with development.
无效：经皮起搏/升压药过渡，尽快经静脉起搏。: Ineffective: transcutaneous pacing/vasopressors as a bridge; transvenous pacing as soon as possible.
无症状 WPW 不等于低危；高风险职业、运动或家族史需进一步评估。: Asymptomatic WPW does not mean low risk; high-risk occupation, sports, or family history require further evaluation.
无症状的窦缓不一定需要起搏；起搏适应证取决于症状与可逆因素。: Asymptomatic sinus bradycardia does not necessarily require pacing; pacing indication depends on symptoms and reversible factors.
早期复极、幼稚型 T 波、体位性 ST 改变、运动员心脏都可表现为“异常”图形；: Early repolarization, juvenile T waves, positional ST changes, and athlete's heart can all present as "abnormal" patterns; symptoms, age, and dynamic changes must be integrated.
早期复极常见 J 点抬高、凹面向上 ST 抬高、T 波高耸，多见于年轻男性与运动: Early repolarization commonly shows J-point elevation, concave upward ST elevation, and tall T waves, mostly in young men and athletes; usually asymptomatic and no special treatment needed.
晕厥/跌倒查长间歇/传导阻滞。: Premature beats/nonspecific ST-T changes may be seen.
晕厥、黑矇、心室率 <40 次/分或长间歇 >3 s。: Syncope, amaurosis, ventricular rate <40 beats/min or long pause >3 s.
晕厥患者心电图红线：长 QT、短 PR/预激、Brugada、ARVC、三度 A: ECG red flags in syncope patients: long QT, short PR/pre-excitation, Brugada, ARVC, third-degree AVB, bifascicular block, VT, pacemaker malfunction.
晚钠电流延长动作电位平台，心动过缓时更明显；钠通道阻滞剂可能有效。: Late sodium current prolongs the action potential plateau, more pronounced during bradycardia; sodium channel blockers may be effective.
最具特异性的是“QT 间期缩短、ST 段缩短”；T 波通常无明显改变。QT 缩短: The most specific findings are 'shortened QT interval and shortened ST segment'; T waves usually show no obvious changes. The degree of QT shortening is roughly correlated with elevated serum calcium, but not in an exact linear relationship.
最具特异性的是“下壁导联（II、III、aVF）连续锯齿状 F 波，房率约 30: The most specific finding is 'continuous sawtooth F waves in inferior leads (II, III, aVF), atrial rate about 300 bpm, no isoelectric line'; V1 often shows upright F waves. With 2:1 conduction, ventricular rate about 150 bpm is an important clue.
最具特异性的是“窦性 P 波形态一致 + PR 恒定 + RR 渐短渐长的周期性: The most specific is “consistent sinus P-wave morphology + constant PR + periodic RR shortening and lengthening”; there is no premature P′ or compensatory pause.
最具特异性的是“高尖、对称、基底窄的 T 波，尤其在 V2–V4”；QRS 增宽: The most specific finding is “tall, peaked, symmetric, narrow-based T waves, especially in V2–V4”; QRS widening, flattened P waves, and sine waves indicate severe hyperkalemia. ECG and serum potassium do not correspond linearly; hyperkalemia cannot be excluded by ECG alone.
最后与旧图、症状、电解质/药物对照。: Finally compare with old ECGs, symptoms, electrolytes/drugs.
有心电图改变或血钾 >6.5：立即静脉钙剂（葡萄糖酸钙 1 g 或氯化钙 10%: With ECG changes or blood potassium >6.5: immediately give intravenous calcium (calcium gluconate 1 g or 10% calcium chloride 10 mL) to stabilize the myocardium; onset is rapid but duration is short.
有症状或高危旁路：导管消融；合并房颤按房颤抗凝评估。: Symptomatic or high-risk accessory pathway: catheter ablation; with atrial fibrillation, assess anticoagulation as for AF.
有脉/无脉决定同步或非同步。: Presence/absence of pulse determines synchronized or unsynchronized.
术前 ECG 异常不等于取消手术；需评估严重程度、可逆因素与麻醉风险。: Abnormal preoperative ECG does not mean canceling surgery; assess severity, reversible factors, and anesthetic risk.
术后房颤先找“为什么现在发生”：感染、缺氧、容量、电解质，而不是只给 β 阻滞剂: Postoperative AF is often self-limited but triggers need investigation.
术后新发房室阻滞需起搏评估；房扑/房速需抗凝与节律控制；室速需评估是否需要 IC: New postoperative AV block requires pacing evaluation; atrial flutter/atrial tachycardia require anticoagulation and rhythm control; ventricular tachycardia requires assessment for ICD.
标准 12 导联由 6 个肢体导联（I、II、III、aVR、aVL、aVF）与: The standard 12-lead ECG consists of 6 limb leads (I, II, III, aVR, aVL, aVF) and 6 precordial leads (V1–V6), recording the same cardiac vector from different angles.
标准定标为 10 mm/mV、纸速 25 mm/s；改变增益或纸速会改变波形高度: Standard calibration is 10 mm/mV and paper speed 25 mm/s; changing gain or paper speed changes waveform height/width but should not change the true time of intervals.
标记未下传的 P 波，确认其后没有 QRS。: Mark non-conducted P waves and confirm no QRS follows.
检查 I、III、V1 导联的 S1Q3T3 与右束支阻滞。: Check S1Q3T3 and right bundle branch block in leads I, III, and V1.
检查下壁导联有无病理性 Q 波及 ST-T 改变，排除下壁心肌梗死。: Check inferior leads for pathological Q waves and ST-T changes to exclude inferior myocardial infarction.
检查钾、镁、钙与甲状腺功能。: Check potassium, magnesium, calcium, and thyroid function.
正交导联用于向量环重建，不替代常规 12 导联。: Orthogonal leads are used for vector loop reconstruction and do not replace the routine 12-lead ECG.
正常 ECG 不能排除 ACS，需动态复查。: A normal ECG cannot exclude ACS; repeat dynamically.
正常 QT 与心率匹配，不缩短。: Normal QT matches the heart rate and is not shortened.

窦房结位于上腔静脉与右心房交界处的界沟附近，是正常心脏的最高起搏点。冲动沿心房肌: The SA node is located near the sulcus terminalis at the junction of the superior vena cava and right atrium and is the primary pacemaker of the normal heart. Impulses propagate along atrial muscle and internodal tracts to the AV node, activating the right and left atria simultaneously and forming the surface P wave.

立即高质量 CPR，尽快非同步除颤，双相 120–200 J（按厂商），单相 3: Immediate high-quality CPR, asynchronous defibrillation as soon as possible, biphasic 120–200 J (per manufacturer), monophasic 360 J.
第二步：任一胸导联 RS 间期 >100 ms → 支持室速。: Step 2: RS interval >100 ms in any precordial lead → supports VT.
等频性分离不是三度 AVB；需看频率、P 波穿行与临床。: Isorhythmic dissociation is not third-degree AVB; assess rates, P-wave marching, and clinical context.
纠正高钾、药物中毒和缺血等可逆病因；存活者评估永久起搏器。: Correct reversible causes such as hyperkalemia, drug toxicity, and ischemia; evaluate survivors for permanent pacemaker.
红线：运动中晕厥、胸痛、心悸、长 QT、WPW、HCM、ARVC、Brugada: Red flags: exertional syncope, chest pain, palpitations, long QT, WPW, HCM, ARVC, Brugada, third-degree AVB.

结合症状日志与起搏器记录。: Combine symptom diary and pacemaker records.
结合药物史（洋地黄）、电解质和心肌缺血评估病因。: Evaluate etiology with medication history (digitalis), electrolytes, and myocardial ischemia.

维持前负荷：谨慎补液，避免硝酸酯、利尿剂与吗啡。: Maintain preload: cautious fluid administration; avoid nitrates, diuretics, and morphine.

罪犯血管：用导联组合做概率判断: Culprit vessel: use lead combinations for probabilistic assessment

肥厚→继发复极异常，ST-T 与 QRS 相反。: Hypertrophy → secondary repolarization abnormality; ST-T opposite to QRS.

胎儿自主神经发育与胎盘功能影响胎心模式；缺氧可导致变异减少、晚期减速。: Fetal autonomic nervous system development and placental function affect fetal heart rate patterns; hypoxia can cause reduced variability and late decelerations.
胸痛患者首份心电图应在 10 分钟内完成；ST 抬高/压低、T 波动态、后壁/右: The first ECG in chest pain patients should be completed within 10 minutes; ST elevation/depression, T-wave dynamics, and posterior/right ventricular leads determine the reperfusion strategy.
脑心综合征可 ST-T/QT 改变。: Post-dialysis hypokalemia/hypocalcemia can also cause arrhythmias.
自主神经调节异常导致直立时心率代偿过度；血容量不足与去适应参与。: Autonomic dysregulation causes excessive heart rate compensation on standing; hypovolemia and deconditioning contribute.
自动测量不能替代人工复核。: Automated measurements cannot replace manual review.
自身搏动后仍有起搏钉。: Pacing spikes persist after intrinsic beats.

节律基本规则，可伴轻度窦性心律不齐。: Rhythm is basically regular, may have mild sinus arrhythmia.
血钾 <2.5 mmol/L，或伴室速、尖端扭转型室速、室颤。: Serum potassium <2.5 mmol/L, or with ventricular tachycardia, torsades de pointes, or ventricular fibrillation.

观察 QRS 振幅是否围绕基线扭转，而非固定形态。: Observe whether the QRS amplitude twists around the baseline rather than having a fixed morphology.

设备靠近时出现噪声。: Noise appears when devices are nearby.

识别 R 波递增不良与 V1 高 R: Identify poor R-wave progression and tall R in V1
说出频发未下传房早的常见诱因与处理原则: State common triggers and management principles for frequent non-conducted PACs

起搏/室早也可融合。: Pacing/ventricular premature beats can also fuse.

起搏器故障先看钉与夺获。: For pacemaker malfunction, look first at spikes and capture.

运动伪差可模拟室颤。: Motion artifact can mimic ventricular fibrillation.

连续记录 10 秒以上，观察 RR 是否呈呼吸周期起伏。: Record continuously for more than 10 seconds and observe whether RR shows respiratory cyclic fluctuation.
适应证：反复晕厥、怀疑血管迷走性、心脏性晕厥已排除；需在受控环境下进行。: Indications: recurrent syncope, suspected vasovagal syncope, cardiac syncope excluded; must be performed in a controlled environment.
逆行 P 位于 QRS 之前时 PR 间期 <0.12 s；位于 QRS 之后时: When the retrograde P is before the QRS, the PR interval is <0.12 s; when after the QRS, the RP interval is short and the P wave often falls in the ST segment or at the beginning of the T wave.
逆行 P 可埋于 QRS 终末: Retrograde P waves may be buried at the end of the QRS.
逆行 P 或窄 QRS。: Retrograde P wave or narrow QRS.

透析与心电图: Syncope/falls: evaluate for long pauses/conduction block.

避免把正常变异误判为异常: Avoid misjudging normal variants as abnormal

钉后无波形=失夺获。: No waveform after spike = failure to capture.
钉消失 + 心率低于下限=可能感知过度。: Spike disappearance + heart rate below lower rate limit = possible oversensing.
