长 QT 可表现为抽搐。: Long QT can present as seizures.
长间歇 + P 波消失 = 窦性停搏；长间歇 + P 波仍规律 = 房室阻滞。: Long pause + absent P waves = sinus arrest; long pause + P waves still regular = AV block.
阿托品无效或进展为高度阻滞：经皮起搏，或肾上腺素 2–10 μg/min 泵入。: Atropine ineffective or progression to high-grade block: transcutaneous pacing, or epinephrine infusion 2–10 μg/min.
降钙素、双膦酸盐抑制骨吸收；严重者血液透析。: Calcitonin and bisphosphonates inhibit bone resorption; hemodialysis in severe cases.
隐匿性传导是解释“为什么这次没传/传得慢”的机制，不是独立心律诊断。: Concealed conduction is a mechanism explaining 'why this impulse did not conduct/conducted slowly', not an independent rhythm diagnosis.
震颤伪差可模拟房扑/房颤。: Tremor artifact can mimic atrial flutter/atrial fibrillation.
预激 + 房颤 = 宽 QRS 不规则极速心动过速；禁用单纯房室结阻滞剂。: Pre-excitation + atrial fibrillation = irregular, very fast wide-QRS tachycardia; avoid AV node blockers alone.
预激可引起电轴偏移，但 PR 短、有 δ 波。: Pre-excitation can cause axis deviation, but PR is short and a δ wave is present.
首先确认血钾；心电图改变与血钾不完全平行。: First confirm serum potassium; ECG changes and serum potassium are not completely parallel.
高危症状需观察/负荷/冠脉评估。: High-risk symptoms require observation/stress testing/coronary evaluation.
高危线索：房颤时最短 RR <250 ms、多旁路、晕厥、家族猝死；无症状预激需: High-risk clues: shortest RR <250 ms during atrial fibrillation, multiple pathways, syncope, family history of sudden death; asymptomatic pre-excitation requires assessment of occupational/sport risk.
高度房室阻滞、长间歇、晕厥，或室速、室颤。: High-grade AV block, long pauses, syncope, or VT/VF.
高电压 + 深窄 Q 波 + T 倒置。: High voltage + deep narrow Q waves + T-wave inversion.
高质量 CPR：100–120 次/分，深度 5–6 cm，完全回弹，中断 <1: High-quality CPR: 100–120 beats/min, depth 5–6 cm, full recoil, interruptions <10 s.
高钙 QT 缩短、ST 缩短。: Hypercalcemia: shortened QT and shortened ST.
高钾血症心电图：P 波低平、QRS 增宽、T 波高尖。: Hyperkalemia ECG: flattened P waves, widened QRS, peaked T waves.
高钾降低膜电位、减慢传导；钙剂拮抗膜效应但不降钾，需同时清除钾。: Hyperkalemia lowers membrane potential and slows conduction; calcium antagonizes membrane effects but does not lower potassium; potassium removal is also needed.
高风险手术/心脏病/症状者评估。: With long QT + U waves, do not just replace potassium; check magnesium—hypomagnesemia is an accomplice in TdP.
高风险手术、已知心脏病、症状、老年/多种共病者更有价值；低风险手术年轻无症状者常: More valuable in high-risk surgery, known heart disease, symptoms, older age/multiple comorbidities; routine ECG has low yield in young asymptomatic patients undergoing low-risk surgery.
0 相由电压门控钠通道快速内流形成，决定 QRS 的上升速度；1 相是短暂钾外流: Phase 0 is formed by rapid influx through voltage-gated sodium channels and determines the upstroke velocity of QRS; phase 1 is transient potassium efflux, forming the early repolarization notch.
0 相钠内流、2 相钙内流、3 相钾外流。: Phase 0 sodium influx, phase 2 calcium influx, phase 3 potassium efflux.
2:1 阻滞不能仅凭 PR 分型。: 2:1 block cannot be classified by PR alone.
62 岁女性，乏力、恶心、上腹不适，无典型胸痛；心电图 V2–V5 ST 压低、: 62-year-old female, fatigue, nausea, epigastric discomfort, no typical chest pain; ECG V2–V5 ST depression, T inversion, troponin elevated.
68 岁男性，活动后气短；心电图窦性、QRS 160 ms、LBBB，超声 EF: 68-year-old male, exertional dyspnea; ECG sinus rhythm, QRS 160 ms, LBBB, echo EF 30%.
ACLS 中心电图分“可除颤”（VF/无脉 VT）与“不可除颤”（心搏停止/PE: In ACLS, ECG rhythms are divided into “shockable” (VF/pulseless VT) and “non-shockable” (asystole/PEA); management pathways are completely different.
ATP 是快速起搏，不是放电。: ATP is rapid pacing, not a shock.
COPD 与右心负荷心电图: COPD and Right Heart Strain ECG
COPD 急性加重常伴窦速/房颤/右心负荷；先纠正低氧、感染、电解质，再考虑心率: Acute COPD exacerbation often accompanies sinus tachycardia/AF/right heart strain; first correct hypoxia, infection, and electrolytes, then consider rate control.
COPD 患者心率快、P 波多变，别只诊断房颤；可能是 MAT。: COPD patient with fast rate and variable P waves: do not just diagnose AF; it may be MAT.
COPD 房颤不要只给 β 阻滞剂；先治低氧与感染，选药考虑支气管痉挛。: In COPD with AF, do not give only β-blockers; treat hypoxia and infection first, and consider bronchospasm when choosing drugs.
DDD 顺序起搏可见两个钉。: Two spikes can be seen with DDD sequential pacing.
Frank 导联用 X、Y、Z 三个正交轴重建心电向量；它不同于标准 12 导联: Frank leads reconstruct the ECG vector using three orthogonal axes, X, Y, and Z; they differ from the standard 12-lead ECG but remain valuable in vector analysis and research.
Holter 正常不能排除所有心律失常；阵发性事件可能需要事件记录器或植入式循环: Normal Holter cannot exclude all arrhythmias; paroxysmal events may require an event recorder or implantable loop recorder.
Holter 的 ST 改变假阳性率高；不要仅凭趋势诊断冠心病。: ST changes on Holter have a high false-positive rate; do not diagnose coronary artery disease based on trends alone.
II、III、aVF ST↑ 2–3 mm: ST↑ 2–3 mm in II, III, aVF
I、II 主波向上 → 电轴正常: Dominant upward QRS in I and II → normal axis
I 导联轴为 0°，aVF 为 +90°。QRS 净正向表示主向量朝该导联，净负: Lead I axis is 0°, aVF is +90°. A net positive QRS means the main vector points toward that lead, net negative means away. Combining the two divides the frontal plane into four quadrants.
I 负/aVF 正=右偏；两者均负=极度右偏。: I negative/aVF positive = right axis deviation; both negative = extreme right axis deviation.
J 点抬高、ST 凹面、J 波。: J-point elevation, concave ST segment, J wave.
LAFB 的记忆法：I、aVL“qR 高”，II、III、aVF“rS 深”，电: LAFB mnemonic: tall qR in I and aVL, deep rS in II, III, and aVF; axis points leftward and superiorly.
LBBB 伴晕厥、PR 延长或双分支阻滞进展，提示完全性房室阻滞风险。: LBBB with syncope, PR prolongation, or progression of bifascicular block suggests risk of complete AV block.
LBBB 合并胸痛时，先算 Sgarbossa，再决定是否紧急再灌注。: In LBBB with chest pain, calculate Sgarbossa first, then decide whether emergency reperfusion is needed.
LBBB：V1 QS/rS，V6 宽 R 无 q，QRS ≥120 ms。: LBBB: V1 QS/rS, V6 broad R without q, QRS ≥120 ms.
LGL：短 PR + 正常 QRS + 室上速。: LGL: short PR + normal QRS + supraventricular tachycardia.
POTS 指直立 10 分钟内心率增加 ≥30 次/分（或 ≥40 次/分青少年: Assess the carotid artery before massage.
PR 延长 + QRS 宽：可能希氏束以下病变，需更警惕。: Prolonged PR + wide QRS: possible infranodal disease, requiring greater vigilance.
PR 延长定位在房室结/希氏束，QRS 增宽定位在束支/浦肯野；把“间期”与“解: PR prolongation localizes to the AV node/His bundle; QRS widening localizes to the bundle branches/Purkinje; map “interval” to “anatomy.”
PR 延长看房室结，QRS 增宽看束支/分支。: PR prolongation points to the AV node; QRS widening points to bundle branch/fascicular block.
PVC 负荷 >10–15%，或伴左室功能下降，需评估心动过速性心肌病。: PVC burden >10–15%, or with reduced left ventricular function, requires evaluation for tachycardia-induced cardiomyopathy.
P 波为窦性形态，每个 P 后跟随 QRS。: P waves have a sinus morphology, and each P is followed by a QRS.
P 波慢慢“穿过”QRS，PR 一会儿长一会儿短，频率又接近，想等频性分离。: P waves slowly 'march through' the QRS; PR is sometimes long and sometimes short, and rates are close—think isorhythmic dissociation.
QRS ≥0.12 s 加 I、V5、V6 宽钝或切迹 R 波、同导联无 q 波: QRS ≥0.12 s plus broad/slurred or notched R waves in I, V5, V6, no q wave in the same leads, and R peak time >60 ms in V5/V6; when combined with myocardial infarction, “ST elevation ≥1 mm in leads with positive QRS” in the Sgarbossa criteria or an ST/S ratio ≤−0.25 in the modified criteria is most specific.
QRS 可窄（交界性逸搏）或宽（室性逸搏）；图例 QRS 0.14 s。: QRS may be narrow (junctional escape) or wide (ventricular escape); example QRS 0.14 s.
QRS 可窄，但宽 QRS（束支阻滞）更常见，提示希氏束下病变。: QRS may be narrow, but wide QRS (bundle branch block) is more common, suggesting infra-Hisian disease.
QRS 时限 <0.12 s，通常 0.08–0.10 s；aVL 的 R 峰时: QRS duration <0.12 s, usually 0.08–0.10 s; aVL R peak time ≥45 ms.
QT(U) 间期延长；U 波可与 T 波融合形成宽大复极波。: Prolonged QT(U) interval; U waves may fuse with T waves to form a broad repolarization wave.
QTc >500 ms 或较基线增加 >60 ms。: QTc >500 ms or an increase >60 ms from baseline.
QTc 延长：男性 >450 ms，女性 >460 ms（不同指南略有差异），>: QTc prolongation: men >450 ms, women >460 ms (slight differences across guidelines), >500 ms is high risk.
QT 明显延长但未校正心率，可能漏诊或过度诊断。: Marked QT prolongation uncorrected for heart rate may lead to underdiagnosis or overdiagnosis.
RBBB 有 rSR′，ST-T 通常继发改变，无穹隆型 ST 抬高。: RBBB has rSR′, ST-T usually shows secondary changes, and no coved ST elevation.
SSS=窦房结功能障碍的谱系。: SSS = spectrum of sinus node dysfunction.
SSS 的关键不是“心率多少”，而是“心率慢的时候患者有没有症状”。: The key to SSS is not "what the heart rate is," but "whether the patient has symptoms when the heart rate is slow."
STEMI：相邻导联 ST 抬高 + 临床；NSTEMI/不稳定心绞痛：ST 压: STEMI: ST elevation in adjacent leads + clinical context; NSTEMI/unstable angina: ST depression/T-wave inversion; however, a normal ECG cannot exclude ACS.
ST 抬高仍需排除 ACS。: ST elevation still requires exclusion of ACS.
ST 段改变的方向取决于损伤电流相对于探查电极的方向，因此需要结合相邻导联与冠脉: The direction of ST-segment change depends on the direction of injury current relative to the exploring electrode, so it should be assessed with adjacent leads and the coronary supply territory, not from a single lead.
SVT 多窄 QRS，伴差异性传导时可宽，需用 Brugada 标准鉴别。: SVT is usually narrow QRS; it can be wide with aberrancy and requires Brugada criteria for differentiation.
TdP 的“扭转”不是普通室速；先补镁，不要只补钾。: The twisting of TdP is not ordinary VT; give magnesium first, not just potassium.
TdP：纠正低钾/低镁，静脉硫酸镁，停 QT 延长药；不稳定立即非同步除颤。: TdP: correct hypokalemia/hypomagnesemia, IV magnesium sulfate, stop QT-prolonging drugs; if unstable, immediate asynchronous defibrillation.
T 波高尖对称 → P 波变平 → QRS 增宽 → 正弦波；血钾越高，心电图越: Peaked symmetric T waves → flattened P waves → widened QRS → sine wave; the higher the serum potassium, the more “rounded” the ECG.
V1 出现“兔耳”样 rsR′，I 与 V6 出现宽钝 S 波，QRS ≥0.1: A “rabbit ear” rsR′ in V1, broad slurred S waves in I and V6, and QRS ≥0.12 s indicate complete right bundle branch block.
V1 是左房终末负向的关键导联。: V1 is the key lead for the terminal negative left atrial component.
V1 高 R、V5/V6 深 S。: Tall R in V1, deep S in V5/V6.
V1/V2 过高可造成 R 波递增不良；左右胸导联互换可造成“右室肥厚”或“后壁: V1/V2 placed too high can cause poor R-wave progression; swapping left and right chest leads can create a false impression of "right ventricular hypertrophy" or "posterior myocardial infarction".
V1–V2 位于右胸，反映右室与室间隔；V3–V4 位于前胸，反映前壁；V5–V: V1–V2 are on the right chest and reflect the right ventricle and ventricular septum; V3–V4 are on the anterior chest and reflect the anterior wall; V5–V6 are at the left anterior axillary line/midaxillary line and reflect the lateral wall.
V1–V3 压低 + 高 R + 直立 T：先想后壁，再看下壁，最后加做 V7–: V1–V3 depression + tall R + upright T: think posterior first, then inferior, finally add V7–V9.
V1–V3 水平型或下斜型 ST 压低 ≥1 mm，伴 R 波增高与 T 波直立: Horizontal or downsloping ST depression ≥1 mm in V1–V3, with increased R waves and upright T waves.
V1：P 波直立或双相，提示右房增大。: V1: upright or biphasic P wave suggests right atrial enlargement.
V3R–V5R 置于右胸对应位置，V4R 最常用。右室梗死时 V4R ST 抬高: V3R–V5R are placed at the corresponding right chest positions, with V4R most commonly used. In right ventricular infarction, ST elevation ≥0.1 mV in V4R (especially with inferior STEMI) has high specificity.
V5/V6 深 S 可见于右室肥厚、肺心病、左前分支阻滞或胸导联位置偏移；不能只: Deep S waves in V5/V6 can occur with right ventricular hypertrophy, cor pulmonale, left anterior fascicular block, or chest lead misplacement; do not diagnose from a single lead.
V5/V6 深 S；右胸导联 ST-T 劳损。: Deep S in V5/V6; ST-T strain in right precordial leads.
V7–V9：左腋后线、左肩胛中线、左脊柱旁线第 5 肋间。: V7–V9: fifth intercostal space at the left posterior axillary line, left midscapular line, and left paraspinal line.
WPW 的危险不在“delta 波好看”，而在“房颤时旁路能跑多快”。: The danger of WPW is not that "the delta wave looks nice," but "how fast the accessory pathway can conduct during AF."
WPW 风险看旁路前传不应期。: WPW risk depends on the antegrade refractory period of the accessory pathway.
“被闹钟吓晕”不是夸张病史，可能是 LQT2 的典型触发。: LQT2: induced by sound/emotion, T-wave notching.
三分支：RBBB + 交替分支阻滞、PR 延长或间歇三度，风险最高。: Trifascicular: RBBB + alternating fascicular block, PR prolongation, or intermittent third-degree block; highest risk.
三度 AVB：P-QRS 分离、慢心室率。: Third-degree AVB: P-QRS dissociation, slow ventricular rate.
下壁 STEMI + 低血压 + 肺清 → 右室梗死；避免硝酸酯，优先补液并尽快: Inferior STEMI + hypotension + clear lungs → RV infarction; avoid nitrates, prioritize fluids and prompt reperfusion.
下壁 STEMI + 低血压 + 肺清：加做 V4R。: Inferior STEMI + hypotension + clear lungs: add V4R.
下壁心梗伴低血压、颈静脉怒张而肺部清晰时想到右室梗死；加做 V4R，ST 抬高: Inferior MI with hypotension, jugular venous distension, and clear lungs: think RV infarction; add V4R, ST elevation ≥1 mm supports diagnosis, nitrates are a trap.
不出现病理性 Q 波；ST 抬高可持续数天至数周，演变缓慢。: No pathologic Q waves; ST elevation may persist for days to weeks with slow evolution.
不要一开始就盯着 ST 段；先确定节律与导联，否则可能把伪差/错接当成心梗。: A fixed sequence prevents seeing only the most obvious abnormality and missing key information such as conduction block, short PR, and QT prolongation.
与 QRS 主波方向相反。: Opposite to the main QRS deflection.
与旧图比较很重要。: Comparison with prior tracings is important.
两个激动源同时除极心室，波形是两种形态的“加权平均”；融合波越明显，两个源越同步: Two activation sources depolarize the ventricles simultaneously; the waveform is a 'weighted average' of the two morphologies; the more obvious the fusion beat, the more synchronous the two sources.
严重心动过缓/三度 AVB、室速、广泛 ST 改变、低电压/电交替、S1Q3T3: Severe bradycardia/third-degree AVB, ventricular tachycardia, extensive ST changes, low voltage/electrical alternans, S1Q3T3, and hyperkalemic sine wave all require immediate management.
中毒心律失常：房速伴阻滞、室早。: Toxic arrhythmias: atrial tachycardia with block, premature ventricular contractions.
临床定位仍以标准导联的相邻改变为主。: Clinical localization still relies mainly on adjacent changes in standard leads.
二度 II 型房室传导阻滞是在固定 PR 间期下突然发生 QRS 脱漏，脱漏前没: Second-degree type II AV block is sudden QRS dropout with a fixed PR interval, without progressive PR prolongation before the dropped beat. The block is usually at the His bundle or bilateral bundle branch level, often with QRS widening, and carries a higher risk of progression to complete AV block. Its essential difference from type I is that the block is below the AV node, rather than progressive fatigue within the AV node.
二度 II 型：PR 间期固定，P 波突然不能下传，脱落前没有 PR 逐渐延长。: Second-degree type II: fixed PR interval, sudden failure of P wave conduction, no progressive PR prolongation before the dropped beat. The lesion is usually below the His bundle; QRS is often widened, and the risk of progression to third-degree block is high; this is a pattern warranting careful evaluation for pacing.
二级预防：他汀、β 受体阻滞剂（无禁忌）、ACEI/ARB 与心脏康复。: Secondary prevention: statins, beta-blockers (if no contraindication), ACEI/ARB, and cardiac rehabilitation.
代偿间歇完全：早搏前后两个窦性 P 波之间的距离约等于两倍基础 PP 间期。: Fully compensatory pause: the distance between the two sinus P waves before and after the premature beat is approximately equal to twice the basic PP interval.
伪差可模拟房颤、ST 改变甚至室颤。: Artifact can mimic atrial fibrillation, ST changes, or even ventricular fibrillation.
伴 QRS 增宽、束支阻滞、晕厥或黑矇。: With QRS widening, bundle branch block, syncope, or amaurosis.
伴急性下壁心肌梗死、洋地黄中毒、严重高钾血症等可逆但高危的病因。: Associated with reversible but high-risk causes such as acute inferior MI, digitalis toxicity, severe hyperkalemia.
伴晕厥、抽搐、低血压、意识障碍，提示阿-斯综合征。: With syncope, seizures, hypotension, altered consciousness, suggests Adams-Stokes syndrome.
伴晕厥、胸痛、呼吸困难、低血压时，即使节律“窦性”也需急诊评估。: RR intervals are basically regular; mild respiratory variation is allowed, but the difference between maximum and minimum RR in the same recording is usually <0.12 s.
低氧、交感兴奋导致窦性心动过速；右心负荷可导致 S1Q3T3。: Hypoxia and sympathetic activation cause sinus tachycardia; right heart strain can cause S1Q3T3.
低血压 + 下壁 ST 抬高，不要习惯性给硝酸甘油；先看右胸导联与肺野。: Hypotension + inferior ST elevation: do not habitually give nitroglycerin; first check right-sided chest leads and lung fields.
低血压+心电图异常时，先稳定患者，不要为了“确诊”延误处理；床旁超声很有价值。: Severe bradycardia/third-degree AVB, ventricular tachycardia, widespread ST changes, low voltage/electrical alternans, S1Q3T3, and hyperkalemic sine wave all require immediate management.
低血压持续时加用正性肌力药，必要时机械循环支持。: If hypotension persists, add inotropes; mechanical circulatory support if necessary.
低钾合并低镁、洋地黄中毒或 QT 延长。: Hypokalemia with hypomagnesemia, digitalis toxicity, or QT prolongation.
低钾有 U 波、T 波低平、ST 压低。: Hypokalemia has U waves, flattened T waves, and ST depression.
低钾血症使心肌细胞复极延迟、兴奋性增高，心电图上表现为 ST 段压低、T 波低平: Hypokalemia delays myocardial repolarization and increases excitability; on ECG it manifests as ST-segment depression, flattened or inverted T waves, prominent U waves, and QT/U interval prolongation, and can induce atrial/ventricular arrhythmias.
低镁常伴低钾，补钾不补镁难纠正。: Hypomagnesemia often accompanies hypokalemia; potassium is difficult to correct without magnesium.
侧壁导联 ST 压低伴高 R 与电压增高，属劳损型改变。: Lateral lead ST depression with tall R waves and increased voltage is a strain-type change.
倾斜试验用于血管迷走性晕厥。: Tilt-table testing is used for vasovagal syncope.
停搏为平线，不可除颤，处理为 CPR+肾上腺素。: Asystole is a flat line, non-shockable; manage with CPR + epinephrine.
停用噻嗪类、维生素 D、含钙制剂；治疗原发病（甲旁亢、肿瘤）。: Stop thiazides, vitamin D, and calcium-containing agents; treat the underlying disease (hyperparathyroidism, tumor).
停用或调整减慢心率药物，纠正电解质紊乱。: Look for escape beats and P waves during the pause to assess whether lower pacemakers are "taking over."
先写清楚临床问题，再选检查；否则再贵的设备也可能答错题。: First clarify the clinical question, then choose the test; otherwise even the most expensive device may answer the wrong question.
先天性 LQTS：β 受体阻滞剂、避免竞争性运动，评估 ICD；获得性者处理病因: Congenital LQTS: beta-blockers, avoid competitive sports, evaluate ICD; acquired: treat underlying cause.
先天性长 QT 综合征（LQTS）也可在情绪/运动/睡眠中发作。: Congenital long QT syndrome (LQTS) can also trigger during emotion/exercise/sleep.
先心病术后多年出现房扑，别只当“新发房颤”；瘢痕折返很常见。: Atrial flutter years after congenital heart surgery: do not just call it 'new-onset AF'; scar-related reentry is common.
先心病术后易房扑/房室阻滞/室速。: After congenital heart surgery, atrial flutter/AV block/VT are common.

形态不同: Look at the T wave before the pause: a hidden P′ is the clue to a "non-conducted atrial premature beat."

透析前后对比 ECG/电解质。: Compare ECG/electrolytes before and after dialysis.

遗传性心律失常（LQTS、Brugada、CPVT、ARVC、HCM）可通过基因: Inherited arrhythmias (LQTS, Brugada, CPVT, ARVC, HCM) can be detected early through genetic testing and family screening.
部分 SIDS 与长 QT 相关。: Some SIDS is related to long QT.

钙剂稳定心肌，不降钾。: Calcium stabilizes the myocardium; it does not lower potassium.

阵发性室上性心动过速是一组起源于房室结或房室旁路的折返性心动过速，典型表现为突发: Paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia is a group of reentrant tachycardias originating from the AV node or an accessory AV pathway; it typically presents as a regular narrow-QRS tachycardia with abrupt onset and termination, and the most common type is atrioventricular nodal reentrant tachycardia (AVNRT).

除颤后立即恢复按压 2 分钟，不要停顿查看心律；每 2 分钟评估。: Immediately resume compressions for 2 min after defibrillation; do not pause to check rhythm; reassess every 2 min.
隐匿传导=进入房室结但未过。: Concealed conduction = enters the AV node but does not conduct through.
需与心包炎、早期复极、左束支阻滞等鉴别。: Differentiate from pericarditis, early repolarization, left bundle branch block, etc.
需排除急性缺血、电解质紊乱、右室肥厚、肺栓塞等继发原因。: Secondary causes such as acute ischemia, electrolyte disturbances, right ventricular hypertrophy, and pulmonary embolism must be excluded.
需排除窦性心动过速、心房扑动 2:1、AVNRT 与 AVRT。: Need to exclude sinus tachycardia, atrial flutter with 2:1 conduction, AVNRT, and AVRT.
需校正白蛋白或测离子钙；总钙正常但白蛋白低时仍可能低钙。: Correct for albumin or measure ionized calcium; low calcium is still possible when total calcium is normal but albumin is low.
需结合既往束支阻滞、预激、药物与电解质情况；宽 QRS 不能单独确诊。: Must consider prior bundle branch block, pre-excitation, drugs, and electrolytes; wide QRS alone cannot confirm diagnosis.
需结合超声心动图；运动员心脏可有电压增高但无病理劳损改变。: Echocardiography is needed; athlete's heart may show increased voltage without pathologic strain changes.
静息 ST-T 异常、LBBB、起搏、WPW 会使运动心电图判读困难；需改用影像: Resting ST-T abnormalities, LBBB, pacing, and WPW make exercise ECG interpretation difficult; switch to imaging stress testing.
静息可无预激；心动过速呈 LBBB 样。: No pre-excitation may be present at rest; tachycardia shows an LBBB-like pattern.
静息心率持续 >150 次/分，或与发热/疼痛程度不相称。: Resting heart rate persistently >150 beats/min, or disproportionate to the degree of fever/pain.
预激合并房颤的极速宽 QRS 心律。: Extremely rapid wide-QRS rhythm of pre-excitation with AF.

频发交界性早搏伴洋地黄中毒表现（恶心、视觉异常、缓慢性心律失常）。: Frequent junctional premature beats with manifestations of digitalis toxicity (nausea, visual disturbances, bradyarrhythmias).
频率 >100–110 次/分、QRS 进一步增宽或节律不齐，可能为室速。: Rate >100–110 beats/min, further QRS widening, or irregular rhythm may indicate ventricular tachycardia.
频率接近上限；磁铁可终止。: Rate near upper limit; magnet can terminate.

高度阻滞或宽 QRS：降低阈值，尽早评估起搏。: High-grade block or wide QRS: lower the threshold and evaluate pacing early.
高钙看 QT：短 QT + 短 ST，T 波往往正常。: Hypercalcemia on QT: short QT + short ST, with T waves often normal.

高钾伴 QRS 增宽、P 波消失或正弦波。: Hyperkalemia with QRS widening, loss of P waves, or sine wave.

高钾：T 波高尖 → P 波变平/PR 延长 → QRS 增宽 → 正弦波 →: Hyperkalemia: tall peaked T waves → flattened P waves/PR prolongation → widened QRS → sine wave → asystole.
0 相对应 QRS 上升支，2 相平台对应 ST 段，3 相复极对应 T 波；Q: Estimate axis with the frontal six-axis system; explain projection polarity and amplitude

Wide QRS, fixed PR, and no improvement with exercise or drug testing favor a sub-Hisian lesion; narrow QRS and prolonged PR are more likely AV nodal. Electrophysiology study is needed when necessary.
2:1 阻滞需与二度 I 型鉴别，必要时行电生理检查。: 2:1 block must be differentiated from second-degree type I block; perform electrophysiologic study if necessary.

AI 心电图可从波形识别房颤、低 EF、肥厚、高钾等，但依赖训练数据与设备，不能: AI ECG can identify atrial fibrillation, low EF, hypertrophy, hyperkalemia, etc. from waveforms, but depends on training data and devices and cannot replace clinical judgment.
ARVC 以右室心肌纤维脂肪替代为特征，表现为右胸导联 T 倒置、epsilon: ARVC is characterized by fibrofatty replacement of right ventricular myocardium, presenting with T-wave inversion in right precordial leads, epsilon waves, right ventricular enlargement, and left bundle branch block-type ventricular tachycardia.
AV 间期由程控设置。: AV interval is set by programming.
Ashman 现象：长-短周期后出现宽 QRS（常 RBBB 型），是功能性差异: Ashman phenomenon: a wide QRS (often RBBB type) after a long-short cycle; it is functional aberrant conduction, not a PVC.
COPD 可导致低电压、电轴右偏、RVH、右房增大、R 波递增不良和“假性前壁梗: COPD can cause low voltage, right axis deviation, RVH, right atrial enlargement, poor R-wave progression, and 'pseudo-anterior infarction'; the mechanism is pulmonary hyperinflation and right heart strain.
COPD 急性加重→窦速/房颤/右心负荷。: COPD exacerbation → sinus tachycardia/atrial fibrillation/right heart strain.
COPD 患者新发房颤，先看血气和感染；治肺比单纯降心率更重要。: In COPD with new-onset AF, check ABG and infection first; treating the lungs is more important than just rate control.
CRT 关注双室起搏与 QRS 变窄。: CRT focuses on biventricular pacing and QRS narrowing.
DDD 可起搏/感知心房与心室，并按房室顺序起搏，保持房室同步；心电图可见心房钉: DDD can pace/sense the atrium and ventricle and pace in AV sequential order to maintain AV synchrony; ECG shows atrial spike—P and ventricular spike—QRS.
HCM 常有高电压、深窄 Q 波、ST-T 改变和左房增大；晕厥、家族猝死史、运: HCM often has high voltage, deep narrow Q waves, ST-T changes, and left atrial enlargement; syncope, family history of sudden death, and exercise-related symptoms are warning signs.
HCM 心电图可模拟心梗；不能仅凭 Q 波诊断陈旧性心梗。: HCM ECG can mimic myocardial infarction; old myocardial infarction cannot be diagnosed based on Q waves alone.
HCM 是青少年运动猝死的重要原因；心电图可高电压、深 Q、T 倒置，也可正常。: HCM is an important cause of sudden cardiac death during sports in adolescents; ECG may show high voltage, deep Q waves, T-wave inversion, or be normal.
Holter ST 趋势是筛查，不是确诊。: Holter ST trend is a screening tool, not a diagnosis.
Holter 上“ST 压低”先看是不是体位/基线；动态与症状关联才是关键。: On Holter, first check whether 'ST depression' is due to position/baseline; correlation with symptoms is key.
Holter 用于阵发性心律失常与负荷评估。: Holter is used for paroxysmal arrhythmias and burden assessment.
Holter 的价值不只在“抓到什么”，还在“症状发生时有没有对应的心律改变”。: The value of Holter is not only what it captures, but also whether there is a corresponding rhythm change when symptoms occur.
III 导联的 S 波深于 II 导联（SIII > SII），支持左前分支阻滞: The S wave in lead III is deeper than in lead II (SIII > SII), supporting left anterior fascicular block.
I 正/aVF 正：正常电轴（约 −30° 至 +90°）；I 正/aVF 负：: Axis deviation: rapid assessment with I, aVF, II
LBBB + 低 EF + 心衰症状 → 评估 CRT；新发 LBBB 需排除缺: LBBB + low EF + heart failure symptoms → evaluate for CRT; new-onset LBBB requires exclusion of ischemia.
LBBB 不只是“QRS 宽”；在合适的心衰患者中，它可能是 CRT 的指征。: LBBB is not just “wide QRS”; in appropriate heart failure patients, it may be an indication for CRT.
LBBB 合并心梗：使用 Sgarbossa 等专门标准。: Second-degree type II, third-degree with wide QRS: high progression risk; assess pacing indications.
LBBB 合并急性心力衰竭、低血压、肺水肿，提示心肌病失代偿。: LBBB with acute heart failure, hypotension, and pulmonary edema suggests decompensated cardiomyopathy.
LVH 伴劳损型 ST-T 改变提示心血管风险增加，需强化危险因素控制。: LVH with strain-pattern ST-T changes indicates increased cardiovascular risk and requires intensified risk factor control.
LVH 看电压，确诊靠超声；心电图是筛查工具。: LVH is assessed by voltage; confirmation relies on ultrasound; ECG is a screening tool.
MONA-B 的现代边界：氧疗仅用于 SpO₂ <90%；硝酸酯禁用于右室梗死、: Modern boundaries of MONA-B: oxygen only for SpO₂ <90%; nitrates contraindicated in right ventricular infarction, hypotension, and recent PDE5 inhibitor use; morphine only for refractory pain; β-blockers orally within 24 hours if no heart failure, shock, or bradycardia.
P=心房除极，QRS=心室除极，T=心室复极。: P = atrial depolarization, QRS = ventricular depolarization, T = ventricular repolarization.
PMT 多见于 DDD 起搏器：室性早搏或房性早搏被心房导线感知后触发心室起搏，: PMT is most common with DDD pacemakers: a premature ventricular contraction or premature atrial contraction is sensed by the atrial lead and triggers ventricular pacing, forming a reentrant tachycardia.
POTS 是临床综合征，不是单纯“心跳快”；需排除其他原因并综合管理。: POTS is a clinical syndrome, not simply 'fast heartbeat'; other causes must be excluded and comprehensive management is needed.
PR 从 P 起点量到 QRS 起点；QRS 从最早起点量到最晚终点；QT 从: Measure PR from the start of P to the start of QRS; QRS from the earliest onset to the latest offset; QT from the start of QRS to the end of T wave.
PR interval <0.12 s, delta wave at the onset of QRS, QRS duration ≥0.12 s.
PR 间期恒定 >0.20 s，且每个 P 波后均有 QRS，是一度房室阻滞最直: A constant PR interval >0.20 s with a QRS after every P wave is the most direct diagnostic clue for first-degree AV block; if QRS is also widened, consider concomitant bundle branch block or a more distal lesion.
PR 间期恒定而 QRS 突然、周期性脱漏，且脱漏前无 PR 延长，是二度 II: A non-conducted PAC is a premature P′ not followed by QRS, without progressive PR prolongation or periodic resetting.
P 波在 I、II、aVF 直立，aVR 倒置，宽度 <0.12 s；PR 间期: P wave upright in I, II, aVF and inverted in aVR, width <0.12 s; PR interval from P onset to QRS onset, normal 0.12–0.20 s.
P 波形态异常、频率更快，常见房室传导比例变化。: Abnormal P-wave morphology and faster rate, with common changes in AV conduction ratio.
P 波改变需结合超声与临床。: P-wave changes should be interpreted with echocardiography and clinical findings.
P 穿行 QRS。: P waves march through the QRS.
QRS 前无窦性 P 波；若出现 P 波，多为逆行 P（II、III、aVF 倒: No sinus P wave before QRS; if a P wave appears, it is mostly retrograde P (inverted in II, III, aVF) and may be before QRS (very short PR), within QRS, or after QRS.
QRS 宽度接近 0.12 s 时，需多导联确认最宽处。: When QRS width is close to 0.12 s, confirm the widest point in multiple leads.
QRS 形态介于窦性与室性之间。: QRS morphology intermediate between sinus and ventricular.
QTc >460–480 ms、T 波切迹/双峰、晕厥/家族猝死；运动/声音/睡: QTc >460–480 ms, T-wave notching/bifid T waves, syncope/family history of sudden death; triggers by exercise/sound/sleep vary by subtype.
QTc 显著延长，T 波晚尖。: Markedly prolonged QTc, late-peaked T waves.
QT 从 QRS 起点到 T 波终点，T 波终点用切线法；心率快时 QT 缩短，: Correctly read calibration and paper speed
Q 波出现不代表一定透壁坏死，Q 波消失也不代表没有梗死；再灌注后 Q 波可变小: Anterior infarction is mostly caused by the LAD. aVR ST elevation with widespread ST depression and V1 elevation suggests left main or proximal LAD; V2–V4 elevation without aVR elevation is more consistent with mid-to-distal LAD. Posterior and right ventricular infarction often share the same origin as inferior infarction; add V7–V9 and V4R.
RBBB：V1 rsR′、V6 宽 S；LBBB：V1 QS/rS、V6 宽 R: RBBB: V1 rsR′, V6 wide S; LBBB: V1 QS/rS, V6 wide R without q.
RR 间期随呼吸渐长渐短，但每个 P 波都是窦性、PR 固定。: Atrial flutter shows sawtooth F waves; with 2:1 conduction, the ventricular rate is approximately 150 beats/min.
S1Q3T3 可见于肺栓塞，也可见于 COPD。: S1Q3T3 can be seen in pulmonary embolism and also in COPD.
STEMI 的导联定位基于心室壁与导联的空间关系；相邻导联 ST 抬高提示对应区: STEMI lead localization is based on the spatial relationship between ventricular walls and leads; ST elevation in adjacent leads suggests transmural ischemia in the corresponding region, allowing preliminary inference of the culprit vessel and involved myocardium.
SVT 伴差异性传导可宽，需比较既往心电图。: SVT with aberrant conduction can be wide; compare with prior ECGs.
SVT 可窄或宽 QRS。: SVT may have narrow or wide QRS.
SVT 心率常 >220 次/分、窄 QRS、规则；房颤/房扑可见房性活动；室早: SVT rate is often >220 beats/min, narrow QRS, regular; atrial activity may be seen in atrial fibrillation/flutter; PVCs require evaluation for structural heart disease.
TCA 过量导致钠通道阻滞：QRS 增宽、电轴右偏、aVR R 波增高、QT 延: TCA overdose causes sodium channel blockade: QRS widening, right axis deviation, increased aVR R wave, QT prolongation; QRS >100 ms is high risk.
TdP 导致短暂脑缺血，可出现抽搐；脑电图不一定异常。: TdP causing transient cerebral ischemia can present with convulsions; EEG may not be abnormal.
TdP：QT 长 + 多形性宽 QRS。: TdP: long QT + polymorphic wide QRS.
T 波可呈双相、切迹、倒置或电交替。: T waves may be biphasic, notched, inverted, or show electrical alternans.
V1–V3 ST 压低 + 直立 T：考虑后壁梗死，加做 V7–V9。: ST depression in V1–V3 + upright T: consider posterior infarction; obtain V7–V9.
V3R–V5R：与 V3–V5 对称的右胸位置，V4R 最常用。: Suspected posterior wall: indirect clues in V1–V3
V5/V6 高 R 与 V1/V2 深 S，ST 抬高多不成比例且无动态演变。: Tall R in V5/V6 and deep S in V1/V2; ST elevation is often disproportionate and lacks dynamic evolution.
V7–V9 相邻导联 ST 抬高 ≥1 mm 可直接证实后壁梗死。: ST elevation ≥1 mm in adjacent V7–V9 leads can directly confirm posterior infarction.
VF = 无脉 + 混沌波形；治疗只有两个字：按压、除颤。: VF = pulseless + chaotic waveform; treatment is just two words: compressions, defibrillation.
VVI 起搏心室、感知心室，自身心率低于下限时发放起搏；起搏钉后紧跟宽 QRS，: VVI paces the ventricle and senses the ventricle; it delivers pacing when the intrinsic rate is below the lower rate limit; a pacing spike is immediately followed by a wide QRS, usually LBBB-like.
X 轴左右、Y 轴上下、Z 轴前后；通过正交导联可计算空间向量环，理解标准导联的: X axis left-right, Y axis up-down, Z axis front-back; orthogonal leads allow calculation of the spatial vector loop and understanding of standard lead projections.
“不像心梗”不是排除 ACS 的理由；女性和老年人常表现不典型。: “Not like MI” is not a reason to exclude ACS; women and older adults often present atypically.
一个搏动后总跟着一个“回音”，量 PR/RP；可能是回波，不是频发早搏。: Each beat is followed by an "echo"; measure PR/RP; may be an echo beat, not frequent premature beats.
一个窦性/起搏搏动后紧跟一个逆行 P 或窄 QRS；回波搏动常成对出现；需与早搏: A sinus/paced beat is followed closely by a retrograde P wave or narrow QRS; echo beats often occur in pairs; must be differentiated from premature beats.
下壁 STEMI 一律加做 V4R，V4R 抬高 ≥1 mm 支持右室梗死。: Always add V4R in inferior STEMI; V4R elevation ≥1 mm supports right ventricular infarction.
下壁导联 II、III、aVF 至少两个相邻导联 ST 抬高。: ST elevation in at least two adjacent leads among II, III, and aVF.
下壁心梗合并 V1–V3 ST 压低时误判为前壁缺血，实际是后壁镜像改变。: Inferior MI with V1–V3 ST depression is often misjudged as anterior ischemia; it is actually reciprocal change of the posterior wall.
下壁心梗的低血压不是“心衰”一律利尿；右室梗死需要容量。: Hypotension in inferior MI is not “heart failure” requiring routine diuresis; right ventricular infarction needs volume.
下壁心肌梗死所致者常对阿托品有反应，但仍需备好经皮起搏。: When caused by inferior myocardial infarction, it often responds to atropine, but transcutaneous pacing should still be prepared.
下壁心肌梗死的 Q 波可使下壁呈 QS 型，掩盖 rS 图形，需结合 ST-T: Q waves of inferior myocardial infarction can produce a QS pattern in the inferior leads, masking the rS pattern; correlate with ST-T dynamics and history.
下壁梗死合并 V1–V3 压低时，优先考虑后壁扩展而不是前壁缺血。: With inferior infarction and V1–V3 depression, prioritize posterior extension rather than anterior ischemia.
不应期随心率、药物和电解质变化；房颤时快速房性冲动常落在房室结不应期，形成“过滤: Refractory periods vary with heart rate, drugs, and electrolytes; during atrial fibrillation, rapid atrial impulses often fall within the AV node refractory period, creating a “filtering” effect.
不稳定：同步电复律（窄 QRS 不规则/房速可 50–100 J 起始，按设备与: Unstable: synchronized cardioversion (for narrow QRS irregular/atrial tachycardia, may start at 50–100 J, adjust according to device and clinical response); sedate conscious patients first.
不要把所有 ST-T 改变都归为劳损。: Do not attribute all ST-T changes to strain.
与右室起搏心律、预激、高钾血症导致的宽 QRS 鉴别。: Differentiate from wide QRS caused by right ventricular paced rhythm, preexcitation, and hyperkalemia.
与室速鉴别靠 P/形态/病史。: Differentiate from VT by P waves/morphology/history.
与窦性心律频率接近时可交替出现，形成竞争。: When the rate is close to sinus rhythm, the two may alternate, creating competition.
两者不一致时结合临床与影像。: When the two are inconsistent, combine clinical and imaging findings.
严重乏力、肌无力、肠麻痹或呼吸肌无力。: Severe fatigue, muscle weakness, ileus, or respiratory muscle weakness.
严重时心房肌兴奋性丧失（P 波消失）、心室传导极度减慢，形成正弦波并可能停搏。: In severe cases, atrial muscle excitability is lost (P waves disappear) and ventricular conduction is extremely slowed, forming a sine wave and possibly asystole.
严重高钙可抑制窦房结与房室传导，导致心动过缓、传导阻滞；也可增强洋地黄毒性。: Severe hypercalcemia can inhibit the sinoatrial node and atrioventricular conduction, causing bradycardia and conduction block; it can also enhance digitalis toxicity.
严重高钾血症、洋地黄或抗心律失常药中毒、急性心肌梗死背景。: In the setting of severe hyperkalemia, digitalis or antiarrhythmic drug toxicity, and acute myocardial infarction.
二度 II 型、三度宽 QRS：进展风险高，评估起搏指征。: Understand the combinations and risks of bifascicular and trifascicular block
亚急性期（数天至数周）：ST 段逐渐回落，T 波深倒置，Q 波持续存在；部分患者: Describe in chronological order the ECG features of the hyperacute, acute, subacute, and old stages
亚急性期：ST 回落、T 深倒置、Q 持续；陈旧期遗留 Q 波。: The presence of a Q wave does not necessarily mean transmural necrosis, and Q-wave disappearance does not mean there is no infarction; Q waves may become smaller after reperfusion. Persistent ST elevation in the old stage should raise consideration of ventricular aneurysm. New LBBB, paced rhythm, or preexcitation can mask infarction patterns and should be assessed by the corresponding criteria.
交流电干扰呈 50/60 Hz 均匀细密波，电磁干扰可来自电刀、手机、充电器、附: AC interference presents as uniform fine 50/60 Hz waves; electromagnetic interference may come from electrosurgical units, phones, chargers, and nearby equipment.
传导系统纤维化、心房重构、冠脉病变与多病共存导致心电图异常；药物相互作用常见。: Conduction system fibrosis, atrial remodeling, coronary disease, and multimorbidity cause ECG abnormalities; drug interactions are common.
伴低血压、胸痛、意识改变或心力衰竭。: With hypotension, chest pain, altered consciousness, or heart failure.
伴胸痛、晕厥、低血压、呼吸困难、意识改变。: With chest pain, syncope, hypotension, dyspnea, or altered consciousness.
伴血流动力学不稳定、晕厥或进展为交界性心动过速。: With hemodynamic instability, syncope, or progression to junctional tachycardia.
低血压、胸痛、心衰、意识改变等不稳定表现。: Unstable manifestations such as hypotension, chest pain, heart failure, and altered consciousness.
低血压先找可逆心律失常/缺血/梗阻。: For hypotension, first look for reversible arrhythmia/ischemia/obstruction.
低血压患者的心电图是“血流动力学线索”，不是单纯诊断题；先救命再解释。: The ECG in a hypotensive patient provides 'hemodynamic clues', not just a diagnostic question; save life first, then explain.
低钾、低镁、高钙、肾功能不全增加中毒风险。: Hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia, hypercalcemia, and renal insufficiency increase the risk of toxicity.
低钾伴尖端扭转、室速或洋地黄中毒。: Hypokalemia with torsades de pointes, VT, or digitalis toxicity.
低钾：T 波低平、ST 压低、U 波明显、QT(U) 延长。: Hypokalemia: flattened T waves, ST depression, prominent U waves, prolonged QT(U).
先分脉搏，再分同步；无脉 VF/pVT 一律非同步。: First determine pulse, then synchrony; pulseless VF/pVT is always nonsynchronized.
先判断患者有无脉搏与血流动力学稳定性，再分析心电图。: First determine whether the patient has a pulse and hemodynamic stability, then analyze the ECG.
先测量心房率与心室率，判断是否存在房室传导比例。: First measure the atrial rate and ventricular rate, and determine whether there is an AV conduction ratio.
先看 II、III、aVF 的 ST 段，再比较 III 与 II 的抬高幅度以: First look at the ST segments in II, III, aVF, then compare the elevation amplitude in III versus II to infer the culprit vessel.
先看定标：纸速 25 mm/s、增益 10 mm/mV 时，一小格 0.04 s: First check calibration: at paper speed 25 mm/s and gain 10 mm/mV, one small box is 0.04 s, one large box is 0.20 s.
先看患者与脉搏，再判读。: Check the patient and pulse first, then interpret.
先看患者，再判读监护仪。: Look at the patient first, then interpret the monitor.
具体药物与剂量需由临床医生结合患者情况决定，本页仅作教学。: Specific drugs and doses must be determined by clinicians based on patient condition; this page is for teaching only.
再灌注：直接 PCI 为首选，目标 ≤120 分钟；不能及时 PCI 且无禁忌时: Reperfusion: primary PCI is preferred, with a target ≤120 minutes; if timely PCI is unavailable and there are no contraindications, give thrombolysis within 30 minutes.
判断小儿心动过速/过缓必须按年龄；成人 60–100 的标准不适用于新生儿。: Assessing pediatric tachycardia/bradycardia must be age-based; the adult standard of 60–100 does not apply to neonates.
判断逸搏是否需要起搏治疗: Determine whether an escape beat requires pacing therapy
刺激迷走神经或 Adenosine 可暂时增加房室阻滞，使 F 波更清晰。: Vagal stimulation or Adenosine can temporarily increase AV block and make F waves clearer.
前壁 STEMI 有缺血症状、动态 ST 改变与心肌标志物升高。: Anterior STEMI has ischemic symptoms, dynamic ST changes, and elevated cardiac biomarkers.
前壁 STEMI 看 V1–V4；侧壁看 I、aVL、V5、V6；下壁看 II、: Anterior STEMI: V1–V4; lateral: I, aVL, V5, V6; inferior: II, III, aVF; right ventricle: V3R–V4R; posterior: V7–V9.
前壁梗死多由前降支引起。aVR ST 抬高伴广泛导联 ST 压低、V1 抬高，提: Subacute stage (days to weeks): ST segment gradually falls, T wave deeply inverted, Q wave persists; in some patients the Q wave may become shallower or even disappear. This stage needs differentiation from ischemic T-wave changes such as Wellens.
前驱症状：恶心、出汗、苍白、视野模糊；晕厥时心动过缓/低血压；心电图多正常。: Prodromal symptoms: nausea, sweating, pallor, blurred vision; bradycardia/hypotension during syncope; ECG is usually normal.
单个 PVC 是二联律的组成单位；二联律强调 1:1 交替模式。: A single PVC is the building block of bigeminy; bigeminy emphasizes the 1:1 alternating pattern.
双极起搏钉可能很小。: Bipolar pacing spikes may be very small.
发作可自行终止，也可退化为室颤导致猝死。: Episodes may terminate spontaneously or degenerate into ventricular fibrillation causing sudden death.
发热 + V1 穹隆型 ST + T 倒置。: Fever + coved-type ST in V1 + T-wave inversion.
发热 >5 天、结膜充血、皮疹、口唇皲裂、淋巴结肿大；心电图异常提示冠脉受累。: Fever >5 days, conjunctival congestion, rash, cracked lips, lymphadenopathy; abnormal ECG suggests coronary involvement.
发热、哭闹、脱水、贫血都可心率快；先看状态与体温，不要直接诊断心律失常。: Fever, crying, dehydration, and anemia can all cause tachycardia; first assess status and temperature, do not directly diagnose arrhythmia.
只看 ST 抬高而忽略 PR 段，漏掉心包炎的关键线索。: Looking only at ST elevation and ignoring the PR segment misses the key clue to pericarditis.
只看心室率慢就诊断，未确认 P 与 QRS 完全分离。: Diagnosing based only on a slow ventricular rate without confirming complete P-QRS dissociation.
只诊断逸搏心律而不找窦房结抑制的原因，漏诊药物过量、高钾或急性缺血。: Diagnosing escape rhythm without seeking the cause of sinus node suppression misses drug overdose, hyperkalemia, or acute ischemia.
可伴房性/室性期前收缩、室上速、室速或尖端扭转型室速。: May be accompanied by atrial/ventricular premature contractions, supraventricular tachycardia, ventricular tachycardia, or torsades de pointes.
可伴窦性心动过速与低电压；肌钙蛋白可轻度升高，提示心肌心包炎。: May be accompanied by sinus tachycardia and low voltage; troponin may be mildly elevated, suggesting myopericarditis.
可疑后壁：V1–V3 的间接线索: Localization principles: face the infarct and confirm with reciprocal changes
右冠近端闭塞累及右室支时发生右室梗死，表现为低血压、颈静脉怒张而肺部清晰；硝酸酯: Right ventricular infarction occurs when proximal right coronary occlusion involves the right ventricular branch, presenting with hypotension, distended jugular veins, and clear lungs; nitrates can induce severe hypotension.
右室梗死三联：低血压、肺清、颈静脉压高。: Right ventricular infarction triad: hypotension, clear lungs, elevated jugular venous pressure.
右室梗死合并后壁梗死时，V1 的 ST 改变可能不典型，需同时加做 V7–V9。: When right ventricular infarction is combined with posterior infarction, ST changes in V1 may be atypical; V7–V9 should also be added.
右室梗死常伴低血压、颈静脉压升高、肺野清晰；治疗上需谨慎使用硝酸酯，优先补液。: RV infarction often presents with hypotension, elevated jugular venous pressure, and clear lung fields; use nitrates cautiously and prioritize fluid resuscitation.
右室肥厚使右室除极向量占优势，V1 出现高 R、电轴右偏，右胸导联可有 ST-T: Right ventricular hypertrophy makes the RV depolarization vector dominant, producing a tall R wave in V1, right axis deviation, and possible ST-T strain in right precordial leads; it is commonly seen in cor pulmonale, pulmonary hypertension, and congenital heart disease.
右室肥厚：电轴右偏 + V1 高 R。: Right ventricular hypertrophy: right axis deviation + tall R in V1.
右心负荷→RBBB、右胸 T 倒置、电轴右偏。: Right heart strain → RBBB, right precordial T-wave inversion, right axis deviation.
右房增大使 P 波振幅增高，II、III、aVF 出现高尖“肺型 P 波”；常见: Right atrial enlargement increases P wave amplitude, producing tall peaked 'P pulmonale' in II, III, aVF; commonly seen in cor pulmonale, pulmonary hypertension, and tricuspid valve disease.
右束支细长、左束支分前后分支，是束支/分支阻滞定位的解剖基础。: The right bundle branch is long and thin, while the left bundle branch divides into anterior and posterior fascicles; this is the anatomic basis for localizing bundle branch/fascicular block.
右束支阻滞使右室最后除极，V1 出现 rsR′；左束支阻滞使左室最后除极，V6: Right bundle branch block causes the right ventricle to depolarize last, producing rsR′ in V1; left bundle branch block causes the left ventricle to depolarize last, producing a broad, slurred R wave in V6 and QS/rS in V1.
同一导联中 PVC 形态一致为单源，多种形态为多源；连续 ≥3 个为室速。: In the same lead, uniform PVC morphology indicates unifocal, multiple morphologies indicate multifocal; ≥3 consecutive PVCs indicate ventricular tachycardia.
同时降钾与查病因。: Lower potassium and investigate the cause simultaneously.
后壁梗死不是孤立的，常与下壁或侧壁梗死一起出现。: Posterior infarction is not isolated and often occurs with inferior or lateral infarction.
哮喘：腺苷风险，备沙丁胺醇。: Asthma: adenosine risk; have salbutamol ready.
围术期心电图用于发现可改变管理的异常：新发缺血、严重传导阻滞、未控制心律失常、长: Perioperative ECG is used to detect abnormalities that can change management: new ischemia, severe conduction block, uncontrolled arrhythmia, long QT, pacemaker malfunction.
固定十步法，避免只看 ST。: A fixed sequence prevents “seeing only the most obvious abnormality” and missing key information such as conduction block, short PR, and QT prolongation.
基因检测不是“算命”；需遗传咨询与多学科解读。: Genetic testing is not “fortune-telling”; it requires genetic counseling and multidisciplinary interpretation.
基因结果需结合表型、家族史与变异解读；意义未明变异不能单独诊断。: Genetic results need to be combined with phenotype, family history, and variant interpretation; variants of uncertain significance cannot be used for diagnosis alone.
基线漂移多由呼吸、电极接触不良或运动引起；肌电干扰为高频细碎波，常见于寒战、焦虑: Baseline wander is mostly caused by respiration, poor electrode contact, or motion; EMG interference is high-frequency fine waves, often seen with shivering, anxiety, Parkinson's, or muscle tension.
处理诱因：甲亢、饮酒、感染、肺栓塞、电解质紊乱、睡眠呼吸暂停。: Treat precipitating factors: hyperthyroidism, alcohol, infection, pulmonary embolism, electrolyte disturbance, sleep apnea.
复极顺序对除极顺序有“记忆”，即使除极恢复，复极仍保持旧顺序；机制涉及离子通道重: The repolarization sequence has 'memory' of the depolarization sequence; even when depolarization recovers, repolarization maintains the old sequence; the mechanism involves ion channel remodeling.
多支病变、左主干病变可表现为广泛 ST 压低伴 aVR 抬高。: Multivessel or left main disease can present as widespread ST depression with aVR elevation.
多数良性；晕厥/家族猝死需评估。: Mostly benign; syncope/family history of sudden death require evaluation.
多种抗心律失常药、抗生素、抗精神病药、止吐药可延长 QT；QTc >500 ms: Multiple antiarrhythmics, antibiotics, antipsychotics, and antiemetics can prolong QT; QTc >500 ms or an increase >60 ms from baseline is high risk.
多见于健康儿童、青少年和运动员，也可见于颅内压增高、洋地黄过量或病态窦房结综合征: Most common in healthy children, adolescents, and athletes; also seen with increased intracranial pressure, digitalis overdose, or sick sinus syndrome.
大量心包积液（>20 mm）或填塞征象：低血压、颈静脉怒张、心音遥远、电交替。: Large pericardial effusion (>20 mm) or tamponade signs: hypotension, distended jugular veins, muffled heart sounds, electrical alternans.
大面积肺栓塞可导致低血压、休克甚至心脏骤停。: Massive pulmonary embolism can cause hypotension, shock, and even cardiac arrest.
夺获前有合适 PR 的 P 波。: Capture is preceded by a P wave with appropriate PR.
夺获波=室速中窄 QRS。: Capture beat = narrow QRS in VT.
女性 ACS 可无典型胸痛；心电图动态改变 + 肌钙蛋白 → NSTEMI/不稳: Women with ACS may lack typical chest pain; dynamic ECG changes + troponin → evaluate for NSTEMI/unstable angina.
妊娠期 D-二聚体升高、心电图正常不能排除 PE；临床概率与影像决策。: Elevated D-dimer and normal ECG during pregnancy cannot exclude PE; use clinical probability and imaging decisions.
婴儿 SVT 可致心衰。: SVT in infants can cause heart failure.
婴儿猝死与心电图筛查: Sudden infant death and ECG screening
完全性右束支传导阻滞指右束支传导中断，室上性冲动先经左束支激动左心室，再跨室间隔: Third-degree AV block: Third-degree (complete) atrioventricular block
定位总则：面对梗死、镜像确认: With wide QRS, ST-segment shift, or abnormal axis, first return to 'which layer is the problem': depolarization, repolarization, conduction sequence, or lead projection. To observe hands-on, open the Vector Lab and Activation Sequence pages for comparison.
家族猝死史需评估。: Family history of sudden death requires evaluation.
宽 QRS 不一定是室早；房颤中出现长-短周期后的 RBBB 形态，先考虑 As: Wide QRS is not necessarily a PVC; RBBB morphology after a long-short cycle in AF should first suggest Ashman, not be treated directly as VT.
宽 QRS 不规则 + 极快心室率。: Irregular wide QRS + very rapid ventricular rate.
宽 QRS 心动过速中突然一个窄 QRS，先找 P；可能是夺获波，支持室速。: A sudden narrow QRS during wide-complex tachycardia: look for P first; a capture beat supports VT.
宽 QRS 心动过速中，把室速误认为 PSVT 伴差异性传导，可能导致致命处理错: In wide QRS tachycardia, mistaking VT for PSVT with aberrant conduction may lead to fatal treatment errors.
宽 QRS 心动过速鉴别中，Brugada 四步法报告敏感性约 98.7%、特异: In the differentiation of wide QRS tachycardia, the Brugada four-step method has reported sensitivity of about 98.7% and specificity of about 96.5%; among these, “absence of RS pattern in all precordial leads” has specificity 100% and sensitivity about 21%; AV dissociation, RS interval >100 ms, and specific morphology combinations can improve accuracy.
宽 QRS 逸搏提示低位阻滞。: Wide QRS escape beats indicate lower-level block.
宽 QRS（≥0.12 s）的缓慢节律，频率 20–40 次/分，P 波缺失且: A slow rhythm with wide QRS (≥0.12 s), rate 20–40 beats/min, absent P waves, and T waves opposite to the main QRS deflection; if regular sinus P waves are seen without conduction, it supports third-degree AV block with ventricular escape.
寒战产生持续高频肌电噪声，常见于术后、发热/降温、输血反应；可掩盖 P 波与 S: Shivering produces continuous high-frequency EMG noise, commonly seen after surgery, with fever/cooling, or transfusion reactions; it can obscure P waves and ST segments.
寻找心动过缓、PR 延长等传导异常。: Look for conduction abnormalities such as bradycardia and prolonged PR interval.
导线脱位/阈值升高/电池耗竭导致起搏刺激不能夺获；晕厥是危险信号。: Lead dislodgement/increased threshold/battery depletion cause pacing stimuli to fail to capture; syncope is a warning sign.
导联位置错误、电极反接也会造成假性电轴偏移。: Lead misplacement and electrode reversal can also cause pseudo-axis deviation.
导联脱落可表现为平线或高幅噪声；患者活动、CPR、电刀、肌肉震颤都会产生伪差。: Lead detachment may appear as a flat line or high-amplitude noise; patient movement, CPR, electrocautery, and muscle tremor can all produce artifact.
射频消融前需根据体表心电图定位旁路、房速起源或室早/室速起源；消融后心电图可验证: Before RF ablation, surface ECG is needed to localize accessory pathways, atrial tachycardia origin, or PVC/VT origin; post-ablation ECG can verify the target.
小儿长 QT 易被漏诊；晕厥、家族猝死、耳聋需警惕。: Pediatric long QT is easily missed; syncope, family history of sudden death, and deafness warrant vigilance.
小婴儿心率 260 + 肝大，先做心电图；SVT 可能已经引起心衰。: Infant HR 260 + hepatomegaly: do ECG first; SVT may already have caused heart failure.
尖端扭转为多形性 VT，QRS 振幅围绕基线扭转，常伴长 QT。: Torsades de Pointes is polymorphic VT, with QRS amplitude twisting around the baseline, often with long QT.
尽快完成 18 导联（含 V4R、V7–V9）并启动再灌注流程。: Complete 18-lead ECG (including V4R, V7–V9) as soon as possible and initiate reperfusion pathway.
岛叶/自主神经中枢受损导致交感激活、复极异常；房颤可能是卒中原因而非结果。: Insular/autonomic center injury leads to sympathetic activation and repolarization abnormalities; atrial fibrillation may be a cause of stroke rather than a consequence.
川崎病心电图正常不能排除冠脉瘤；需超声与随访。: Normal ECG in Kawasaki disease cannot exclude coronary aneurysm; echocardiography and follow-up are needed.
左室肥厚使左室除极向量增大，胸导联 R 波增高、S 波加深；常用 Sokolow: Left ventricular hypertrophy increases the left ventricular depolarization vector, with taller R waves and deeper S waves in chest leads; voltage criteria such as Sokolow-Lyon and Cornell are commonly used.
左束支主干阻滞后，左心室失去快速同步激动；冲动经右束支先到右心室，再跨室间隔自右: After blockade of the left bundle branch main trunk, the left ventricle loses rapid synchronous activation; the impulse reaches the right ventricle first via the right bundle branch, then crosses the interventricular septum from right to left.
常伴右房增大、肺型 P 波。: Often accompanied by right atrial enlargement and P pulmonale.
常伴电轴右偏、RVH、右胸导联劳损。: Often accompanied by right axis deviation, RVH, and right precordial lead strain.
常见于 DDD，需与室速鉴别。: Common in DDD; differentiate from VT.
平台期决定 QT；复极方向决定 T 波极性。: The plateau phase determines QT; the direction of repolarization determines T wave polarity.
平时窦缓；可晕厥。: Usually sinus bradycardia; may cause syncope.
年轻卒中查房颤。: In young stroke, look for AF.
年轻运动员晕倒，最危险的不是“没休息好”，而是 HCM/离子通道病。: When a young athlete faints, the most dangerous cause is not “not resting enough” but HCM/ion channel disease.
异位冲动常逆传并重置窦房结，使代偿间歇多不完全；频发房早可诱发房颤。: Ectopic impulses often conduct retrogradely and reset the sinus node, making the compensatory pause usually incomplete; frequent atrial premature beats can trigger atrial fibrillation.
弥漫凹面 ST 抬高加 PR 段压低，除 aVR/V1 外没有镜像改变；治疗靠: Diffuse concave ST elevation plus PR-segment depression, no reciprocal changes except aVR/V1; treatment relies on NSAID plus colchicine, and anticoagulation should be avoided.
强化他汀、ACEI/ARB 与危险因素控制；NSTEMI 不进行溶栓治疗。: Intensive statin, ACEI/ARB, and risk factor control; NSTEMI should not receive thrombolysis.
心内标测仍是金标准。: Intracardiac mapping remains the gold standard.
心动过缓用阿托品，高度阻滞且不稳定时临时起搏。: Use atropine for bradycardia; use temporary pacing for high-grade block with instability.
心包炎为弥漫凹面抬高伴 PR 压低，不符合单一血管分布。: V3R–V5R: right chest positions symmetric to V3–V5; V4R is most commonly used.
心室率 <30 次/分、长间歇、宽 QRS 逸搏或逸搏不稳定。: Ventricular rate <30 beats/min, long pauses, wide-QRS escape beats, or unstable escape rhythm.
心室节律基本规则，但逸搏频率可漂移。: The ventricular rhythm is basically regular, but the escape rate may drift.
心室颤动是心室肌多处微折返导致完全无组织的电活动，心室失去有效收缩，患者无脉搏、: Ventricular fibrillation is completely disorganized electrical activity caused by multiple microreentrant circuits in the ventricular myocardium; the ventricles lose effective contraction, and the patient has no pulse and is unconscious. It is one of the shockable rhythms in cardiac arrest.
心房血流淤滞增加血栓栓塞风险，卒中风险与年龄、心衰、高血压、糖尿病、卒中史等相关: Atrial blood flow stasis increases thromboembolic risk; stroke risk is associated with age, heart failure, hypertension, diabetes, stroke history, etc.
心率增加 10–20 次/分、心输出量增加；下壁/侧壁非特异 ST-T 改变可见: Heart rate increases by 10–20 beats/min and cardiac output increases; nonspecific inferior/lateral ST-T changes may be seen; QT is usually not prolonged.
心电图信号高维、标签噪声与人群差异大；方法学质量决定结论可信度。: ECG signals are high-dimensional, with label noise and large population differences; methodological quality determines the credibility of conclusions.
心电图对肥厚的敏感性和特异性有限；超声/心脏 MRI 是结构诊断标准，心电图更多: ECG has limited sensitivity and specificity for hypertrophy; echocardiography/cardiac MRI is the standard for structural diagnosis, and ECG is used more for screening and follow-up.
心电图敏感度有限，需超声确认。: ECG has limited sensitivity; echocardiography is needed for confirmation.
心电图正常不能排除 PE；S1Q3T3 也不是 PE 的同义词。: A normal ECG cannot exclude PE; S1Q3T3 is not synonymous with PE.
心电轴是心室除极平均向量在额面的方向，常用 I 与 aVF 导联快速判断；正常约: The electrical axis is the direction of the mean ventricular depolarization vector in the frontal plane; leads I and aVF are commonly used for rapid assessment; normal is about −30° to +90°.
心肌动作电位与离子通道: Myocardial action potential and ion channels
心脏 MRI/超声右室异常。: Right ventricular abnormalities on cardiac MRI/ultrasound.
心脏的电活动沿“窦房结→心房肌/结间束→房室结→希氏束→左右束支→浦肯野纤维”传: Cardiac electrical activity propagates along “SA node → atrial myocardium/internodal pathways → AV node → bundle of His → left and right bundle branches → Purkinje fibers”; the spatial location of the conduction system determines the sequence and intervals of the surface ECG.
心脏结构通常正常；可有晕厥、室颤复苏史或家族猝死史。: Cardiac structure is usually normal; there may be syncope, history of resuscitation from ventricular fibrillation, or family history of sudden death.
忽略频率重叠：100–110 次/分的宽 QRS 节律需结合房室分离、融合波和临: Ignoring rate overlap: a wide-QRS rhythm at 100–110 bpm requires assessment with AV dissociation, fusion beats, and clinical context.
忽略高钾或药物中毒：宽 QRS 缓慢节律可能是可逆的代谢或中毒原因。: Ignoring hyperkalemia or drug toxicity: a slow wide-QRS rhythm may have a reversible metabolic or toxic cause.
急性下壁 ST 段抬高型心肌梗死: Acute Inferior ST-Segment Elevation Myocardial Infarction
急性下壁心肌梗死、心肌炎或洋地黄中毒背景。: Background of acute inferior myocardial infarction, myocarditis, or digitalis toxicity.
急性前壁心肌梗死、心肌炎或心脏术后新发二度 II 型。: New-onset second-degree type II block in acute anterior myocardial infarction, myocarditis, or after cardiac surgery.
急性右室心肌梗死多与下壁心肌梗死同时发生，常由右冠状动脉近端闭塞引起。右室心肌薄: Acute right ventricular myocardial infarction often occurs with inferior myocardial infarction, usually caused by proximal right coronary artery occlusion. The right ventricular myocardium is thin and low-pressure; during ischemia it easily dilates and causes hypotension. On ECG, in addition to inferior ST elevation, V4R ST elevation is the most valuable clue. Because standard 12-lead ECG lacks right chest leads, relying on routine leads alone can easily miss the diagnosis.
急性右心负荷可新发 RBBB，常伴窦性心动过速、S1Q3T3 与低氧血症。: Acute right heart strain can cause new-onset RBBB, often accompanied by sinus tachycardia, S1Q3T3, and hypoxemia.
急性心肌梗死、心肌炎、长 QT 或电解质紊乱背景下的新发 PVC。: New-onset PVCs in the setting of acute myocardial infarction, myocarditis, long QT, or electrolyte disturbance.
急性缺血/心梗、洋地黄中毒、严重低钾背景下的二联律。: Bigeminy in the setting of acute ischemia/MI, digitalis toxicity, or severe hypokalemia.
急性缺血、心肌瘢痕、电解质紊乱、触电、溺水、药物毒性等诱发心室多发微折返。: Acute ischemia, myocardial scar, electrolyte disturbances, electric shock, drowning, drug toxicity, etc. induce multiple ventricular microreentries.
感知不足指起搏器未识别自身 P/QRS，导致在自身搏动后仍发放起搏钉，可能落在不: Undersensing means the pacemaker fails to recognize intrinsic P/QRS, causing pacing spikes to be delivered after intrinsic beats; these may fall in the refractory period or trigger competition.
慢快综合征：房颤终止后长间歇。: Tachy-brady syndrome: long pause after AF termination.
成人静息心率 >100 次/分；通常成人不超过 220−年龄。: Adult resting heart rate >100 beats/min; usually adults do not exceed 220−age.
房室结、希氏束与束支: AV node, bundle of His, and bundle branches
房室结不能以 300 次/分全部下传，常见 2:1、3:1、4:1 或可变比例传: The AV node cannot conduct all impulses at 300 beats/min; 2:1, 3:1, 4:1, or variable conduction is common, and ventricular rate depends on the conduction ratio.
房室结病变的线索：QRS 窄、一度或二度 I 型、PR 明显延长、迷走张力增高或: Clues to AV nodal disease: narrow QRS, first-degree or second-degree type I, marked PR prolongation, increased vagal tone or drug-related, improvement after exercise or atropine. The AV node has some compensatory capacity, and the risk of progression to complete block is relatively low.
房室阻滞的定位与处理边界: AV block: localization and management boundaries
房扑/房速定位辅助。: Adjunct for localizing atrial flutter/atrial tachycardia.
房扑为连续锯齿状 F 波，房率约 250–350 次/分。: Atrial flutter shows continuous sawtooth F waves, with an atrial rate of about 250–350 次/分.
房扑伴缓慢规则心室率需排除药物/阻滞。: Atrial flutter with a slow regular ventricular rate requires exclusion of drugs/block.
房扑的抗凝评估与房颤同等重要。: Anticoagulation assessment in atrial flutter is as important as in atrial fibrillation.
房早伴差异传导：提前 P 后有宽 QRS，注意与室早鉴别。: Long pause: often incompletely compensatory; the next sinus P wave re-establishes.
房早前有 P′，QRS 多窄，代偿间歇多不完全。: Atrial premature beats have a preceding P′, QRS is usually narrow, and the compensatory pause is usually incomplete.
房早前有提前的 P′，PR 通常 ≥0.12 s。: Premature atrial complexes are preceded by a premature P′, and PR is usually ≥0.12 s.
房早的“身份证”是提前的 P′；室早的“身份证”是宽大畸形 QRS 且无 P。: The 'ID' of a PAC is a premature P′; the 'ID' of a PVC is a wide, bizarre QRS with no P.
房早诱发房颤者按房颤评估抗凝与节律控制；合并结构性心脏病者转诊心内科。: For atrial premature beats triggering atrial fibrillation, assess anticoagulation and rhythm control as for atrial fibrillation; refer to cardiology if structural heart disease is present.
房颤 + 短 RR 可致室颤。: AF + short RR can cause VF.
房颤三要素：无 P、RR 绝对不规则、f 波。: Three key elements of AF: no P waves, absolutely irregular RR intervals, f waves.
房颤导致心房血流淤滞与血栓，卒中风险随危险因素增加；无症状不等于低风险。: Atrial fibrillation causes atrial blood stasis and thrombus; stroke risk increases with risk factors; asymptomatic does not mean low risk.
房颤常与呼吸事件相关。: AF is often associated with respiratory events.
房颤患者头晕 + 心率 38，先看药；地高辛/β阻滞剂可能过量。: AF with dizziness + HR 38: check drugs first; digoxin/beta-blockers may be excessive.
房颤缓慢心室率查药物/传导/电解质。: AF with slow ventricular rate: check drugs/conduction/electrolytes.
所有决策以指南、症状与进展风险为准。: All decisions should be guided by guidelines, symptoms, and risk of progression.
手机、充电器、电子设备靠近导联线可产生电磁干扰，表现为细密噪声或突发伪差。: Mobile phones, chargers, and electronic devices near lead wires can produce electromagnetic interference, presenting as fine noise or sudden artifacts.
把 Frank 导联当作“理解投影的模型”，不要把它当作临床常规；考试与床旁仍以: Treat Frank leads as a "model for understanding projections," not as a clinical routine; exams and bedside practice still rely on the 12-lead.
把 S1Q3T3 当作肺栓塞的特异性标志；其敏感性/特异性均有限。: Treating S1Q3T3 as a specific marker of pulmonary embolism; its sensitivity/specificity are both limited.
把 TdP 当成普通单形性 VT 使用同步电复律，可能无法同步。: Treating TdP as ordinary monomorphic VT with synchronized cardioversion may fail to synchronize.
把右室起搏心律误判为 LBBB：起搏钉、QRS 前无 P 波可资鉴别。: Misdiagnosing right ventricular paced rhythm as LBBB: pacing spikes and no P wave before QRS help differentiate.
把呼吸性变异误判为房性早搏：后者有提前的异常 P′ 波和非代偿间歇。: Misjudging respiratory variation as atrial premature beat: the latter has a premature abnormal P′ wave and a noncompensatory pause.
把心包炎/早复极/LVH 的 ST 抬高误认为 STEMI。: Mistaking ST elevation of pericarditis/early repolarization/LVH for STEMI.
把未下传的房性早搏误认为窦性停搏：仔细看前一个 T 波是否变形。: Mistaking a nonconducted premature atrial contraction for sinus arrest: carefully check whether the preceding T wave is deformed.
把正常变异（年轻、体型瘦）误认为病理性左偏。: Mistaking normal variant (young, slender body habitus) for pathologic left axis deviation.
把洋地黄效应的勺状 ST 压低误认为缺血。: Mistaking the scooped ST depression of digitalis effect as ischemia.
把运动员或睡眠中的迷走性 PR 延长过度治疗。: Over-treating vagal PR prolongation in athletes or during sleep.
抗凝按房颤同样标准评估 CHA₂DS₂-VASc；房扑可转为房颤。: Anticoagulation should be assessed by the same standards as atrial fibrillation using CHA₂DS₂-VASc; atrial flutter can convert to atrial fibrillation.
折返性心动过速多突发突止、P 波常不可见，心率更固定。: Reentrant tachycardia often starts and stops abruptly, P waves are usually not visible, and the heart rate is more fixed.
报警时先看患者。: When an alarm sounds, look at the patient first.
按时间顺序说出超急性期、急性期、亚急性期与陈旧期的心电图特征: Non-conducted PAC = early ectopic P wave + no QRS + long pause.
数压低导联与幅度，记录是否动态变化；同时观察 aVR 有无抬高。: Count depressed leads and magnitude, record whether dynamic; also assess aVR for elevation.
数字孪生可以帮你理解折返，但不能代替电生理检查与临床判断。: Digital twins can help you understand reentry, but cannot replace electrophysiology studies and clinical judgment.
文氏现象 = PR 渐长 → 脱漏 → 重置，像“越走越慢，最后停一拍”。: Wenckebach phenomenon = PR gradually lengthens → dropped beat → reset, like “walking slower and slower, then pausing for one beat.”
新发 LAFB 伴胸痛或肌钙蛋白升高，提示前降支近端病变。: New-onset LAFB with chest pain or elevated troponin suggests proximal LAD disease.
新发动态改变要排除缺血。: New dynamic changes require exclusion of ischemia.
新生儿 QRS 较窄、PR 较短；QTc 随年龄略有变化；不能直接套成人阈值。: Neonatal QRS is narrower and PR shorter; QTc changes slightly with age; adult thresholds cannot be directly applied.
新生儿 SVT 可能难以识别，需与哭闹/发热鉴别；迷走刺激/腺苷为急性处理。: Neonatal SVT may be difficult to recognize and must be differentiated from crying/fever; vagal stimulation/adenosine is acute management.
旁路前传、房室结逆传。: Antegrade via accessory pathway, retrograde via AV node.
无症状的短暂交界性逸搏可见于睡眠、迷走张力高或药物作用；持续缓慢的室性逸搏、宽: Asymptomatic brief junctional escape beats can occur during sleep, high vagal tone, or drug effects; persistent slow ventricular escape with wide QRS and low rate often suggests severe conduction system disease.
无脉 VT/VF：立即 CPR + 非同步除颤；PEA/心搏停止：CPR + 肾: Pulseless VT/VF: immediate CPR + unsynchronized defibrillation; PEA/asystole: CPR + epinephrine, search for reversible causes (5H5T).
无脉性 VT：按 VF 处理，非同步除颤 + CPR。: Pulseless VT: manage as VF, unsynchronized defibrillation + CPR.
晕厥/家族猝死/运动症状需专科评估。: Syncope/family history of sudden death/exercise symptoms require specialist evaluation.
晕厥、家族性猝死、既往尖端扭转型室速。: Syncope, familial sudden death, prior torsades de pointes.
晕厥伴胸痛、心悸、运动中发生、家族猝死史，需先排除心脏性原因。: Syncope with chest pain, palpitations, occurrence during exercise, or family history of sudden death requires first excluding cardiac causes.
晕厥先查心电图红线。: For syncope, first check ECG red flags.
晕厥患者的心电图不是“走流程”，而是在找可能下一秒致命的线索。: The ECG in a syncope patient is not a formality; it is looking for clues that may be fatal the next second.
更多导联提供空间信息，改善房颤/缺血检测；远程传输缩短发现时间。: More leads provide spatial information and improve AF/ischemia detection; remote transmission shortens detection time.
最具特异性的是“P′ 波形态与窦性 P 不同 + 心房率 150–250 次/分: The most specific is “P′ wave morphology differs from sinus P + atrial rate 150–250 bpm + narrow QRS”; the polarity of P′ in II, III, and aVF may suggest the origin site, but localization requires electrophysiologic study.
最具特异性的是“ST 段延长导致 QT 延长，而 T 波形态相对正常”；与低钾不: The most specific finding is 'ST-segment prolongation causing QT prolongation, while T-wave morphology is relatively normal'; unlike hypokalemia, hypocalcemia usually has no obvious U waves.
最具特异性的是“提前的宽 QRS（≥0.12 s）+ 无相关 P 波 + ST-: Most specific: early wide QRS (≥0.12 s) + no related P wave + ST-T direction opposite to the main QRS deflection + fully compensatory pause; the key to differentiating from atrial premature beat with aberrant conduction is finding an early P′ and the compensatory pause.
最具特异性的是“窦性 P 波 + 每个 P 后均有 QRS + 心率 <60 次: The most specific is “sinus P wave + QRS after every P + heart rate <60 beats/min”; differentiation from second-/third-degree block is absence of dropped P waves or AV dissociation.
最具特异性的是“窦性 P 波电轴（I、II、aVF 直立，aVR 倒置）+ 每个: The most specific is “sinus P-wave axis (upright in I, II, aVF; inverted in aVR) + QRS with fixed PR after each P”; P-wave morphology remains consistent in the same lead.
有 P 波，与房颤不同。: P waves present, unlike atrial fibrillation.

《心电图研究方法入门》学习目标：研究需明确终点与验证。: Learning objectives of Introduction to ECG Research Methods: research needs clear endpoints and validation.

《心肌缺血与 ST 段压低》与《左心室肥厚》的鉴别点：侧壁导联 ST 压低伴高: Distinguishing point between “Myocardial Ischemia and ST-Segment Depression” and “Left Ventricular Hypertrophy”: lateral lead ST depression with high R and increased voltage, consistent with strain-type changes.
《心肌缺血与 ST 段压低》的一句话描述：相邻导联水平型或下斜型 ST 压低 ≥: One-sentence description of “Myocardial Ischemia and ST-Segment Depression”: horizontal or downsloping ST depression ≥1 mm in contiguous leads; troponin determines NSTEMI versus unstable angina, and risk stratification determines timing of angiography.
《心肌缺血与 ST 段压低》诊断标准：相邻两个导联水平型或下斜型 ST 压低 ≥: Diagnostic criteria for “Myocardial Ischemia and ST-Segment Depression”: horizontal or downsloping ST depression ≥1 mm (0.1 mV) in two contiguous leads; upsloping depression has lower specificity.

Impulses propagate along atrial muscle and internodal tracts to the AV node, simultaneously activating the right and left atria to form the surface P wave.
《急性下壁 ST 段抬高型心肌梗死》与《高钾血症》的鉴别点：高尖 T 波与宽 Q: Distinguishing point between “Acute Inferior ST-Segment Elevation Myocardial Infarction” and “Hyperkalemia”: peaked T waves and wide QRS, with no contiguous-lead ST elevation and no reciprocal depression.

It is an emergency requiring immediate vessel opening, and diagnosis and reperfusion decisions cannot wait for myocardial injury biomarkers.
《急性心包炎》与《急性下壁 ST 段抬高型心肌梗死》的鉴别点：下壁 STEMI: Distinguishing point between “Acute Pericarditis” and “Acute Inferior ST-Segment Elevation Myocardial Infarction”: inferior STEMI has II/III/aVF elevation plus aVL depression, while in pericarditis aVL is also elevated.
《急性心包炎》发生机制：心包炎症累及心外膜下心肌，产生弥漫性心外膜损伤电流，ST: Mechanism of “Acute Pericarditis”: pericardial inflammation involving the subepicardial myocardium produces a diffuse epicardial injury current; the ST vector points toward the epicardium, causing ST elevation in multiple leads.
《急性心包炎》属于“缺血、梗死与 ST-T”板块。: Acute Pericarditis belongs to the Ischemia, Infarction and ST-T section.

《房性心动过速》关键数值：150–250次/分（心房率）: Atrial Tachycardia key value: 150–250 beats/min (atrial rate)

《房性期前收缩》与《交界性期前收缩》的鉴别点：交界性早搏无直立 P′，QRS 窄: Differentiating “Premature Atrial Contraction” from “Premature Junctional Contraction”: junctional premature beats have no upright P′, narrow QRS, and a retrograde P wave may follow the QRS.
《房性期前收缩》诊断标准：提前出现的 P′ 波，形态与同导联窦性 P 波不同。: “Premature Atrial Contraction” diagnostic criteria: a premature P′ wave with morphology different from the sinus P wave in the same lead.

《数字孪生与电生理模拟》的一句话描述：数字孪生用患者影像/电生理数据构建心脏电活: One-sentence description of Digital Twins and Electrophysiological Simulation: digital twins use patient imaging/electrophysiological data to construct cardiac electrical activity models and simulate arrhythmias and treatment responses; currently mostly used in research.

《新生儿心电图》学习目标：新生儿右室优势正常。: Neonatal ECG learning objectives: neonatal right ventricular dominance is normal.
《正常窦性心律》处理原则：正常窦性心律本身无需治疗。: 'Normal Sinus Rhythm' management principle: normal sinus rhythm itself requires no treatment.
《正常窦性心律》属于“窦性心律与基础”板块。: 'Normal sinus rhythm' belongs to the 'Sinus rhythm and basics' section.

《游走性心房起搏点》的最具特异性的线索：同一导联 P 波形态 ≥3 种、PP 间: Most specific clue for “Wandering Atrial Pacemaker”: ≥3 P-wave morphologies in the same lead, irregular PP intervals, and heart rate is not fast; QRS is usually narrow.
《窦性停搏 / 窦性静止》与《交界性逸搏心律》的鉴别点：交界性逸搏心律是长间歇后: Differentiation between 'Sinus arrest / sinus standstill' and 'junctional escape rhythm': junctional escape rhythm is the replacement rhythm after a long pause, not the arrest itself.
《窦性停搏 / 窦性静止》危险信号：长间歇 >3 s，或伴晕厥、抽搐、低血压。: 'Sinus Arrest / Sinus Standstill' danger signs: long pause >3 s, or accompanied by syncope, convulsions, or hypotension.
《窦性停搏 / 窦性静止》属于“窦性心律与基础”板块。: 'Sinus arrest / sinus standstill' belongs to the 'Sinus rhythm and basics' section.
《窦性停搏 / 窦性静止》的定义：窦性停搏是窦房结暂时不能发出冲动，心电图上出现: 'Sinus Arrest / Sinus Standstill' definition: sinus arrest is the SA node temporarily failing to fire impulses, with a long pause showing absent P waves on ECG; if due to sinoatrial exit block, the pause is often an integer multiple of the basic PP interval.
《窦性心动过缓》易错点：不要只凭“心率 <60”诊断病态窦房结综合征；运动员与睡: 'Sinus Bradycardia' pitfall: do not diagnose sick sinus syndrome based only on 'heart rate <60'; 40–50 beats/min in athletes and during sleep can be normal.
《窦性心动过速》与《心房扑动》的鉴别点：房扑可见锯齿状 F 波，2:1 传导时心: Distinguishing 'Sinus Tachycardia' from 'Atrial Flutter': flutter shows sawtooth F waves; with 2:1 conduction the ventricular rate is close to 150 beats/min.
《窦性心动过速》判读步骤：先找 P 波：II 导联直立、aVR 倒置支持窦性起源: 'Sinus Tachycardia' interpretation step: first find P waves; upright in lead II and inverted in aVR supports sinus origin.
《窦性心动过速》的最具特异性的线索：最具特异性的是“窦性 P 波 + 1:1 房: 'Sinus Tachycardia' most specific clue: most specific is 'sinus P waves + 1:1 AV conduction + heart rate >100 beats/min'; normal P-wave morphology and relatively gradual onset/termination help distinguish it from reentrant tachycardia.
《窦性心律不齐》的一句话描述：RR 间期随呼吸渐长渐短，但每个 P 波都是窦性、: One-sentence description of 'Sinus Arrhythmia': RR intervals gradually lengthen and shorten with breathing, but every P wave is sinus and PR is fixed.
《窦性心律不齐》诊断标准：P 波为窦性形态，每个 P 后均有 QRS，PR 间期: 'Sinus Arrhythmia' diagnostic criteria: P waves have sinus morphology, every P is followed by a QRS, and PR interval is basically constant.
《窦房结自律性与起搏机制》关键点：窦房结第四相自动除极由 If 与钙电流驱动。: Key point of 'Sinoatrial Node Automaticity and Pacemaker Mechanisms': Phase 4 spontaneous depolarization of the SA node is driven by If and calcium current.
《窦房结自律性与起搏机制》的最具特异性的线索：窦房结的自主节律约 60–100: Most specific clue for 'Sinoatrial Node Automaticity and Pacemaker Mechanisms': The SA node's intrinsic rhythm is about 60–100 beats/min and is dually modulated by sympathetic and vagal nerves; changes in heart rate primarily reflect autonomic tone rather than 'the heart is broken.'
《肺栓塞心电图》教学要点：肺动脉高压与右室负荷导致右心扩张、传导延迟与复极异常；: Pulmonary Embolism ECG teaching points: pulmonary hypertension and right ventricular load cause right heart dilation, conduction delay, and repolarization abnormalities; ECG can be completely normal in small embolism.
《肺栓塞心电图》的一句话描述：肺栓塞心电图可正常，也可出现窦速、S1Q3T3、右: One-sentence description of Pulmonary Embolism ECG: the ECG can be normal or show sinus tachycardia, S1Q3T3, RBBB, right precordial T-wave inversion, and right axis deviation; ECG cannot be relied on to exclude PE.
《肺栓塞（S1Q3T3）》与《窦性心动过速》的鉴别点：窦速是表现，不是病因；肺栓: Differentiation between Pulmonary Embolism (S1Q3T3) and Sinus Tachycardia: sinus tachycardia is a manifestation, not a cause; pulmonary embolism can present with sinus tachycardia.
《肺栓塞（S1Q3T3）》发生机制：肺动脉急性阻塞导致右心室压力骤增、右室扩张与: Mechanism of Pulmonary Embolism (S1Q3T3): acute pulmonary artery obstruction causes a sudden increase in right ventricular pressure, right ventricular dilation and ischemia, right axis deviation, right bundle branch block, and T wave inversion in right precordial leads.
《自律性与逸搏机制》教学要点：窦房结频率最高，通过“超速抑制”压制下级起搏点。窦: Teaching points of 'Automaticity and Escape Mechanisms': The SA node has the highest rate and suppresses lower pacemakers through 'overdrive suppression.' Only when the SA node rate decreases, AV conduction is interrupted, or sinus arrest occurs can lower pacemakers become manifest.
《致心律失常性右室心肌病》关键点：ARVC：右胸 T 倒置 + epsilon: Key points of "Arrhythmogenic Right Ventricular Cardiomyopathy": ARVC: right precordial T inversion + epsilon + LBBB-type VT.
《致心律失常性右室心肌病》的最具特异性的线索：V1–V3 T 倒置、epsilo: Most specific clues of "Arrhythmogenic Right Ventricular Cardiomyopathy": V1–V3 T inversion, epsilon wave, terminal QRS delay, right ventricular structural/functional abnormalities; family history and exercise-induced VT.
《融合波》教学要点：两个激动源同时除极心室，波形是两种形态的“加权平均”；融合波: “Fusion Beat” teaching point: two activation sources simultaneously depolarize the ventricles, and the waveform is a “weighted average” of the two morphologies; the more obvious the fusion beat, the more synchronous the two sources.
《融合波》的一句话描述：融合波是室上性冲动与室性异位/起搏冲动同时激动心室，QR: One-sentence description of “Fusion Beat”: A fusion beat occurs when a supraventricular impulse and a ventricular ectopic/pacing impulse simultaneously activate the ventricles, with QRS morphology between the two; it supports VT or pacing.
《起搏器 NBG 代码》教学要点：代码是理解起搏心电图的第一步：知道起搏腔和感知: Teaching point for Pacemaker NBG Code: the code is the first step to understanding paced ECGs: knowing the pacing chamber and sensing chamber allows prediction of the relationship among pacing spikes, P waves, and QRS complexes.
《起搏器 NBG 代码》的一句话描述：NBG 代码用 5 个位置描述起搏心腔、感: One-sentence description of Pacemaker NBG Code: the NBG code uses 5 positions to describe pacing chamber, sensing chamber, response mode, rate adaptation, and multisite pacing; e.g., VVI, DDD, CRT.
《起搏器介导性心动过速》关键点：PMT：起搏钉 + 宽 QRS 心动过速。: Key point for Pacemaker-Mediated Tachycardia: PMT: pacing spike + wide QRS tachycardia.
《起搏器介导性心动过速》的最具特异性的线索：宽 QRS 心动过速（起搏心律），频: Most specific clue for Pacemaker-Mediated Tachycardia: wide QRS tachycardia (paced rhythm) with rate near upper limit; pacemaker records show an atrial sensing–ventricular pacing cycle; magnet can terminate.
《起搏器感知不足》学习目标：自身搏动后仍有钉=感知不足。: Learning objective for Pacemaker Undersensing: spike still present after intrinsic beat = undersensing.
《起搏器感知过度》教学要点：感知灵敏度过高、单极导线、电磁干扰、肌肉震颤或 T: Teaching point for Pacemaker Oversensing: oversensing due to excessively high sensitivity, unipolar leads, electromagnetic interference, muscle tremor, or T-wave oversensing causes pacing inhibition.
《起搏器感知过度》的一句话描述：感知过度指起搏器把肌肉电、电磁干扰、T 波或远场: One-sentence description of Pacemaker Oversensing: oversensing means the pacemaker mistakenly interprets muscle electrical signals, electromagnetic interference, T waves, or far-field signals as intrinsic electrical activity, causing inappropriate inhibition of pacing.
《起搏钉伪差与过感知》教学要点：起搏钉极短高频，监护仪算法可能误识别；起搏器感知: “Pacemaker Spike Artifact and Oversensing” teaching points: pacer spikes are very short and high-frequency, so monitor algorithms may misidentify them; pacemaker sensing circuits can pick up external electromagnetic signals.
《起搏钉伪差与过感知》的一句话描述：起搏钉可能被监护仪误计为 QRS，或起搏器把: One-sentence description of “Pacemaker Spike Artifact and Oversensing”: pacer spikes may be mistakenly counted by the monitor as QRS, or the pacemaker may oversense monitor/electromagnetic signals; both cause “pseudo-arrhythmias.”
《运动伪差》关键点：运动伪差可模拟室颤。: “Motion Artifact” key point: motion artifact can mimic ventricular fibrillation.
《运动伪差》的最具特异性的线索：伪差与运动同步、多导联不规则；停止运动后恢复；患: Most specific clue for “Motion Artifact”: artifact is synchronous with movement and irregular across leads; it resolves after stopping movement; patient consciousness/pulse does not match the waveform.
《运动试验阳性标准》教学要点：缺血导致心内膜下损伤电流，体表表现为 ST 压低；: 'Exercise Test Positive Criteria' teaching point: Ischemia causes subendocardial injury current, manifesting on the body surface as ST depression; exercise workload, heart rate, and blood pressure response provide additional information.
《运动试验阳性标准》的一句话描述：运动试验阳性通常指运动中或运动后出现 ≥0.1: 'Exercise Test Positive Criteria' one-sentence description: A positive exercise test usually refers to ≥0.1 mV horizontal/downsloping ST depression during or after exercise, typical chest pain, blood pressure drop, or severe arrhythmia.
《运动负荷心电图适应证》学习目标：运动试验用于冠心病与运动性心律失常。: 'Exercise Stress ECG Indications' learning objective: Exercise testing is used for coronary heart disease and exercise-induced arrhythmias.
《逸搏-夺获心律》学习目标：逸搏-夺获=高度 AVB 背景下的偶发下传。: “Escape-Capture Rhythm” learning objectives: escape-capture = occasional conduction in the setting of high-grade AVB.
《钾钙心电图速查》关键数值：>6.5mmol/L（高钾危重）: Potassium and Calcium ECG Quick Reference key value: >6.5mmol/L (critical hyperkalemia).
《钾钙心电图速查》的定义：钾与钙是影响心电图形态最常见的电解质。钾主要影响复极与: Definition of Potassium and Calcium ECG Quick Reference: potassium and calcium are the most common electrolytes affecting ECG morphology. Potassium mainly affects repolarization and conduction; calcium mainly affects the action potential plateau and QT; both can cause severe arrhythmias.
《长 QT 综合征 3 型》学习目标：LQT3：睡眠/慢心率诱发。: Learning objectives of "Long QT Syndrome Type 3": LQT3: triggered by sleep/slow heart rate.
《阵发性室上性心动过速》易错点：把窦性心动过速误认为 PSVT：窦速有 P 波且: Paroxysmal Supraventricular Tachycardia pitfall: mistaking sinus tachycardia for PSVT; sinus tachycardia has P waves and starts/stops gradually.
《阵发性室上性心动过速》需与《窦性心动过速》鉴别：窦速有正常 P 波，起止渐缓，: Paroxysmal Supraventricular Tachycardia must be differentiated from Sinus Tachycardia: sinus tachycardia has normal P waves, gradual onset/termination, and rate varies with the cause.
《预激综合征（WPW）》与《完全性左束支传导阻滞》的鉴别点：LBBB QRS 宽: Distinguishing point between 'Wolff-Parkinson-White (WPW) Syndrome' and 'Complete Left Bundle Branch Block': LBBB has a wide QRS but normal PR and no delta wave.
《预激综合征（WPW）》的定义：预激综合征是存在房室旁路（Kent 束），心房冲: Definition of 'Wolff-Parkinson-White (WPW) Syndrome': pre-excitation syndrome involves an accessory atrioventricular pathway (Kent bundle), through which atrial impulses prematurely activate part of the ventricles, producing a short PR interval, delta wave, and wide QRS; when accompanied by tachycardic episodes, it is called WPW syndrome.
《预激综合征（WPW）》记忆点：WPW 三联：短 PR、delta 波、宽 QR: Memory point for 'Wolff-Parkinson-White (WPW) Syndrome': WPW triad: short PR, delta wave, wide QRS.
《额面心电轴判读》教学要点：I 导联 QRS 净正向、aVF 净正向：正常电轴；: Teaching points of 'Frontal Plane Electrical Axis Interpretation': Net positive QRS in lead I and net positive in aVF: normal axis; positive I and negative aVF: possible left axis deviation, need to check whether II is negative; negative I and positive aVF: right axis deviation; both negative: extreme right axis deviation.
《高钙血症》易错点：把 QT 缩短误认为正常变异，忽略高钙。: Hypercalcemia pitfall: mistaking shortened QT for a normal variant and overlooking hypercalcemia.
《高钙血症》需与《低钙血症》鉴别：低钙 QT 延长、ST 延长。: Hypercalcemia must be differentiated from Hypocalcemia: hypocalcemia has QT prolongation and ST prolongation.
《高钾血症》易错点：把高尖 T 波只归因于高钾而忽略早期复极、缺血或正常变异。: Hyperkalemia pitfall: attributing tall peaked T waves only to hyperkalemia and ignoring early repolarization, ischemia, or normal variant.
《高钾血症心电图急症》关键点：高钾：T 高尖、P 消失、QRS 宽、正弦波。: Hyperkalemia ECG Emergency key points: hyperkalemia: tall peaked T waves, absent P waves, wide QRS, sine wave.

按本站课程，以下描述最符合哪个主题？CRT 同时起搏右室与左室（经冠状静脉窦），: According to this site's course, which topic does the following description best match? 按本站课程，以下描述最符合哪个主题？ICD 可起搏、抗心动过速起搏（ATP）与除: According to the site's course, which topic does the following description best match? ICDs can pace, provide antitachycardia pacing (ATP), and defibrillate; ECG may show pacing spikes, rapid ATP stimulation, or a brief pause after defibrillation.
按本站课程，以下描述最符合哪个主题？II、III、aVF P 波振幅 ≥0.25: According to this site's course, which topic best matches the following description? P wave amplitude ≥0.25 mV (2.5 mm) in II, III, aVF, with narrow and peaked P waves; V1 P wave may be upright or biphasic.
按本站课程，以下描述最符合哪个主题？NSTEMI 常表现为 ST 段水平/下斜型: According to this site's course, which topic does the following description best match? NSTEMI often presents as horizontal/downsloping ST depression, T-wave inversion, or dynamic changes; diagnosis requires troponin and clinical context.
按本站课程，以下描述最符合哪个主题？QTc 延长、T 波宽大/双峰；运动或情绪激: According to this site's course, which topic best matches the following description? Prolonged QTc, broad/bifid T waves; syncope/ventricular fibrillation triggered by exercise or emotional stress; family history is common.
按本站课程，以下描述最符合哪个主题？交界区也不出手时，心室以 20–40 次/分: According to this site's course, which topic best matches the following description? When the junctional area also fails to fire, the ventricles are paced passively at 20–40 beats/min: wide QRS, no P wave, inverted T wave; this is a sign of an endangered conduction system.
按本站课程，以下描述最符合哪个主题？动作电位时程与形态决定 QT、T 波和药物反: According to this site's course, which topic does the following description best fit? Action potential duration and morphology determine QT, T waves, and drug responses; changes in potassium, calcium, and sodium channels are directly reflected in ST-T and QRS.
按本站课程，以下描述最符合哪个主题？单个导联异常、其他导联正常；轻压/重新贴电极: According to this site's course, which topic best matches the following description? 该描述对应《AI 心电图：能力与边界》：AI 输出是概率/提示，不是诊断；在筛查: This description corresponds to 'AI ECG: Capabilities and Boundaries': AI output is a probability/hint, not a diagnosis; it has potential in screening, primary care, and remote monitoring, but requires prospective validation and regulatory oversight.
