该描述对应《CPR 与电击伪差》：CPR 时先看患者、脉搏与按压反馈；电击后立即: This description corresponds to 'CPR and Shock Artifact': During CPR, first check the patient, pulse, and compression feedback; resume compressions immediately after a shock and reassess the rhythm after about 2 seconds; do not be misled by artifact.
该描述对应《CRT 双室起搏》：CRT 同时起搏右室与左室（经冠状静脉窦），使心: This description corresponds to CRT biventricular pacing: CRT paces the right and left ventricles simultaneously (via the coronary sinus) to produce synchronous ventricular contraction; the ECG QRS may narrow, and the post-spike morphology differs from single-chamber pacing.
该描述对应《ICD 与起搏功能》：ICD 可起搏、抗心动过速起搏（ATP）与除颤: This description corresponds to ICD and Pacing Functions: ICD can pace, provide antitachycardia pacing (ATP), and defibrillate; the ECG may show pacing spikes, rapid ATP stimulation, or a brief pause after defibrillation.
该描述对应《NSTEMI 与缺血性 ST-T》：NSTEMI 常表现为 ST 段: This description corresponds to 'NSTEMI and Ischemic ST-T': NSTEMI often presents with horizontal/downsloping ST depression, T-wave inversion, or dynamic changes; diagnosis requires troponin and clinical context.
该描述对应《WPW 危险分层》：高危线索：房颤时最短 RR <250 ms、多旁: This description corresponds to “WPW Risk Stratification”: high-risk clues: shortest RR during AF <250 ms, multiple accessory pathways, syncope, family history of sudden death; asymptomatic pre-excitation requires assessment of occupational/sports risk.

该描述对应《三环类抗抑郁药过量心电图》：aVR R 波 ≥3 mm、QRS >1: This description corresponds to Tricyclic Antidepressant Overdose ECG: aVR R wave ≥3 mm and QRS >100 ms suggest severe toxicity; hypotension, arrhythmias, and seizures are danger signs.
该描述对应《低钾血症》：T 波低平、ST 压低、U 波突出、QT(U) 延长；严: This description corresponds to “Hypokalemia”: flattened T waves, ST depression, prominent U waves, prolonged QT(U); severe cases may develop ventricular arrhythmias.
该描述对应《儿茶酚胺敏感性多形性室速》：运动试验诱发双向性室速（QRS 轴逐搏交: This description corresponds to 'Catecholaminergic Polymorphic Ventricular Tachycardia': exercise testing induces bidirectional VT (QRS axis alternates beat-to-beat) or polymorphic VT; resting QTc is normal; family history of syncope/sudden death.
该描述对应《可穿戴心电设备》：常见为单导联 I 或类似导联，P 波可能不明显；房: This description corresponds to Wearable ECG Devices: commonly a single lead I or similar lead, with P waves possibly indistinct; AF detection relies on irregular RR intervals and absent P waves.

该描述对应《完全性左束支传导阻滞》：QRS ≥0.12 s，I、V5、V6 出现: This description corresponds to Complete Left Bundle Branch Block: QRS ≥0.12 s, broad slurred R in I, V5, V6 with no q wave, deep S in V1, ST-T opposite to the main QRS deflection.
该描述对应《室性并行心律》：室早联律间期不固定、异位间期有公约数、融合波；异位频: This description corresponds to 'Ventricular Parasystole': PVC coupling intervals are not fixed, ectopic intervals have a common denominator, and fusion beats are present; the ectopic rate is usually 20–40 beats/min.
该描述对应《室性期前收缩》：提前出现、宽大畸形的 QRS，前无 P 波，T 波与: This description corresponds to 'Premature Ventricular Contraction': premature, wide and bizarre QRS, no preceding P wave, T wave opposite to the main QRS direction, and a fully compensatory pause.
该描述对应《宽 QRS 心动过速鉴别》：宽 QRS 心动过速先按室速处理；Bru: This description corresponds to 'Wide QRS Tachycardia Differentiation': treat wide QRS tachycardia as ventricular tachycardia first; the Brugada four-step method helps distinguish ventricular tachycardia from supraventricular tachycardia with aberrancy.
该描述对应《寒战伪差》：寒战产生持续高频肌电噪声，常见于术后、发热/降温、输血反: This description corresponds to 'Shivering Artifact': Shivering produces continuous high-frequency EMG noise, commonly seen after surgery, with fever/cooling, and in transfusion reactions; it can obscure P waves and the ST segment.
该描述对应《导线与通道错接》：监护仪导线/通道错接可造成导联“互换”，出现假性电: This description corresponds to “Lead and Channel Misconnection”: monitor lead/channel misconnection can cause lead “swapping,” producing false axis deviation, ST changes, or rhythm misjudgment.
该描述对应《小儿心率正常范围》：小儿心率随年龄下降：新生儿 120–160、婴儿: This description corresponds to Normal Pediatric Heart Rate Range: pediatric heart rate decreases with age: newborn 120–160, infant 100–150, toddler 90–140, preschool 80–120, school-age 70–110, adolescent 60–100 beats/min.
该描述对应《小儿长 QT 综合征》：小儿长 QT 可表现为晕厥、抽搐、猝死，常被: This description corresponds to Pediatric Long QT Syndrome: pediatric long QT can present as syncope, seizures, and sudden death, and is often misdiagnosed as epilepsy; prolonged QTc, abnormal T-wave morphology, and family history are key.
该描述对应《川崎病心电图》：发热 >5 天、结膜充血、皮疹、口唇皲裂、淋巴结肿大: This description corresponds to Kawasaki disease ECG: fever >5 days, conjunctival injection, rash, cracked lips, lymphadenopathy; ECG abnormalities suggest coronary involvement.
该描述对应《左心室肥厚电压标准》：Sokolow-Lyon：SV1 + RV5/: This description corresponds to “Left Ventricular Hypertrophy Voltage Criteria”: Sokolow-Lyon: SV1 + RV5/V6 ≥3.5 mV; Cornell: RaVL + SV3 >2.8 mV (men)/2.0 mV (women).
该描述对应《心室颤动》：最具特异性的是“完全无组织的混沌波形，无法辨认 P、QR: This description corresponds to 'Ventricular Fibrillation': the most specific finding is 'a completely disorganized chaotic waveform, with P, QRS, and T impossible to identify, and the patient is pulseless'; ventricular flutter may show a regular sine wave but is also managed as a shockable cardiac arrest.

该描述对应《心房颤动》：P 波消失、基线细颤、RR 绝对不规则；最常见的心律失常: This description corresponds to 'Atrial Fibrillation': absent P waves, fine fibrillatory baseline, absolutely irregular RR; one of the most common arrhythmias.
该描述对应《心电图危急值》：危急值需要立即报告并启动相应流程；报告内容包含心律、: This description corresponds to 'ECG Critical Values': critical values require immediate reporting and initiation of the appropriate process; the report includes rhythm, rate, key changes, patient status, and measures taken.
该描述对应《心电轴快速判断》：最具特异性的是“I 与 aVF 导联 QRS 主波: This description corresponds to 'Rapid ECG Axis Determination': the most specific is the combination of QRS main wave direction in leads I and aVF: I positive and aVF positive is normal; I positive, aVF negative, and II negative is left axis deviation; I negative is right axis deviation.
该描述对应《心肌缺血与 ST 段压低》：相邻两个导联出现水平型或下斜型 ST 压: This description corresponds to Myocardial Ischemia and ST-Segment Depression: horizontal or downsloping ST depression ≥1 mm (0.1 mV) in two contiguous leads is more specific than upsloping depression; widespread ST depression (≥6 leads) with aVR elevation ≥1 mm strongly suggests left main or three-vessel disease.
该描述对应《房颤负荷与监测》：房颤负荷指监测期内房颤时间占比；负荷与卒中风险、症: This description corresponds to Atrial Fibrillation Burden and Monitoring: AF burden refers to the proportion of time in atrial fibrillation during the monitoring period; burden is associated with stroke risk, symptoms, and rhythm-treatment decisions, but cannot alone replace CHA₂DS₂-VASc.

该描述对应《起搏 AV 间期与优化》：DDD 起搏心电图可见 A 钉—P—V 钉: This description corresponds to Pacing AV Interval and Optimization: DDD pacing ECG shows A spike—P—V spike—QRS; the AV interval is set by programming and requires optimization with echocardiography and clinical findings.
该描述对应《起搏器/ICD 远程监测》：远程监测可传输起搏器/ICD 的事件、阻: This description corresponds to “Pacemaker/ICD Remote Monitoring”: remote monitoring can transmit pacemaker/ICD event, impedance, battery, and arrhythmia data, enabling earlier detection of device malfunction and clinical events.

按本站课程，以下描述最符合哪个主题？Brugada 四步法报告敏感性约 98.7: According to the site's course, which topic does the following description best fit? 按本站课程，以下描述最符合哪个主题？DDD 可起搏/感知心房与心室，并按房室顺序: According to this site's course, which topic best matches the following description? DDD can pace/sense the atrium and ventricle and pace in AV sequential order to maintain AV synchrony; ECG shows atrial spike-P and ventricular spike-QRS.
按本站课程，以下描述最符合哪个主题？Holter 连续记录 24–72 小时心电: According to the course on this site, which topic does the following description best match? Holter continuously records ECG for 24–72 hours to capture paroxysmal arrhythmias and assess burden and ST trends; it cannot replace 12-lead diagnosis.
按本站课程，以下描述最符合哪个主题？ICD 的起搏功能类似起搏器；ATP 时可见: According to the course on this site, which topic does the following description best match? 按本站课程，以下描述最符合哪个主题？QRS ≥0.12 s 加 I、V5、V6: According to this site's course, which topic does the following description best fit? QRS ≥0.12 s plus broad, slurred, or notched R waves in I, V5, V6 with no q wave in the same leads, and R peak time in V5/V6 >60 ms; when combined with myocardial infarction, the Sgarbossa criterion 'ST elevation ≥1 mm in leads with positive QRS' or the modified criterion ST/R ratio ≤−0.25 is most specific.
按本站课程，以下描述最符合哪个主题？QTc <340 ms（部分标准 <360: According to the site's course, which topic best matches the following description? QTc <340 ms (some criteria <360 ms), tall peaked T waves, absent ST segment; history of syncope/family sudden death/ventricular fibrillation supports the diagnosis.
按本站课程，以下描述最符合哪个主题？QTc >460–480 ms、T 波切迹/: According to this site's course, which topic does the following description best match? QTc >460–480 ms, T-wave notching/bifid T waves, syncope/family history of sudden death; triggers by exercise/sound/sleep vary by subtype.
按本站课程，以下描述最符合哪个主题？ST 段缩短、QT 间期缩短，T 波可正常；: According to this site's course, which topic does the following description best fit? Shortened ST segment and shortened QT interval, with T waves possibly normal; in severe cases, bradycardia and conduction block.
按本站课程，以下描述最符合哪个主题？V1 R/S>1、RV1 ≥0.7 mV、电: According to this site's course, which topic does the following description best match? V1 R/S>1, RV1 ≥0.7 mV, right axis deviation >+90°, deep S in V5/V6; may be accompanied by right atrial enlargement and ST depression in right precordial leads.
按本站课程，以下描述最符合哪个主题？一个窦性搏动后跟一个室早，周而复始；成对出现: According to this site's course, which topic does the following description best match? One sinus beat followed by one PVC, repeating; when they occur in pairs, auscultation may resemble a “two-tone rhythm.”
按本站课程，以下描述最符合哪个主题？低通/高通滤波、基线校正与自动增益可改变 S: According to this site's course, which topic does the following description best match? 按本站课程，以下描述最符合哪个主题？判断小儿心动过速/过缓必须按年龄；成人 60: According to this site's course, which topic does the following description best match? Judging pediatric tachycardia/bradycardia must be age-based; the adult 60–100 standard does not apply to newborns.
按本站课程，以下描述最符合哪个主题？双室起搏时 QRS 常较单腔右室起搏窄；V1: According to this site's course, which topic best matches the following description? 按本站课程，以下描述最符合哪个主题？噪声广泛、与寒战同步；保暖、镇静/镇痛后改善: According to this site’s course, which topic best fits the following description? Widespread noise synchronized with shivering; improves after warming, sedation/analgesia; true QRS can still be identified.
按本站课程，以下描述最符合哪个主题？图形与解剖不符、aVR P 波直立、I 导联: According to this site's course, which topic does the following description best match? The tracing does not match anatomy, upright P wave in aVR, inverted lead I, abnormal precordial R-wave progression; it resolves after reconnection.
按本站课程，以下描述最符合哪个主题？小儿心肌炎可表现为窦速、低电压、ST-T 改: According to this site's course, which topic does the following description best match? 按本站课程，以下描述最符合哪个主题？左室肥厚伴劳损表现为侧壁导联 ST 段压低、: According to this site's course, which topic does the following description best match? LVH with strain manifests as ST-segment depression and T-wave inversion in lateral leads, often asymmetric and downsloping; corresponding right precordial leads may show ST elevation.
按本站课程，以下描述最符合哪个主题？常见报警：导线阻抗异常、电池耗竭、房颤负荷增: According to the site's course, which topic best matches the following description? Common alerts: abnormal lead impedance, battery depletion, increased AF burden, ICD shocks, and changes in heart failure metrics; requires clinical follow-up.
按本站课程，以下描述最符合哪个主题？干扰性房室分离指心房与心室各自独立活动，但不: According to this site's course, which topic does the following description best match? Interference AV dissociation means the atria and ventricles act independently, but it is not third-degree AVB: the ventricular rate is usually faster than the atrial rate, and P waves fall in the refractory period and cannot conduct.
按本站课程，以下描述最符合哪个主题？心室肥厚常伴继发性复极异常：ST 段与 T: According to this site's course, which topic does the following description best match? 按本站课程，以下描述最符合哪个主题？心电成像通过体表多导联重建心脏电活动，探索心: According to the course on this site, which topic best matches the following description? ECG imaging reconstructs cardiac electrical activity from multiple body-surface leads and explores arrhythmia origins and ventricular activation sequence; it is currently mostly used in research.
按本站课程，以下描述最符合哪个主题？提前出现的窄 QRS，前面没有窦性 P；逆行: According to this site's course, which topic does the following description best match? A premature narrow QRS with no preceding sinus P; a retrograde P can be hidden in the QRS or appear after it.
按本站课程，以下描述最符合哪个主题？早期复极综合征指下壁/侧壁 J 点抬高、ST: According to the site's course, which topic best matches the following description? 按本站课程，以下描述最符合哪个主题？最具特异性的是“T 波低平/倒置 + 明显: According to this site's course, which topic does the following description best fit? 按本站课程，以下描述最符合哪个主题？最具特异性的是“原有窦性 P 波突然消失的长: According to this site's lesson, which topic best matches the following description? 按本站课程，以下描述最符合哪个主题？最具特异性的是“提前的宽 QRS（≥0.12: According to this site's course, which topic does the following description best match? 按本站课程，以下描述最符合哪个主题？最具特异性的是“无 P 波 + RR 绝对不: According to this site's course, which topic does the following description best fit? 按本站课程，以下描述最符合哪个主题？最具特异性的是“短 PR + delta 波: According to this site's course, which topic best matches the following description? 按本站课程，以下描述最符合哪个主题？相邻导联 ST 压低 ≥0.05–0.1 m: According to this site's course, which topic best matches the following description? ST depression ≥0.05–0.1 mV in contiguous leads, T-wave inversion, dynamic changes; aVR ST elevation suggests left main/multivessel disease.
按本站课程，以下描述最符合哪个主题？相邻导联 ST 抬高定位梗死区域：V1–V4: According to the site's course, which topic does the following description best fit? ST elevation in adjacent leads localizes the infarct region: V1–V4 anterior, II/III/aVF inferior, I/aVL/V5/V6 lateral.
按本站课程，以下描述最符合哪个主题？睡眠呼吸暂停可导致夜间窦性心动过缓/停搏、房: According to the course on this site, which topic does the following description best match? Sleep apnea can cause nocturnal sinus bradycardia/pauses, AF, PVCs, and hypoxia-related ST changes; ECG abnormalities often appear with respiratory events.
按本站课程，以下描述最符合哪个主题？突发突止、规则、窄 QRS、频率 150–2: According to this site's course, which topic does the following description best fit? Abrupt onset and termination, regular, narrow QRS, rate 150–250 beats/min, P wave often hidden; most commonly AVNRT.
按本站课程，以下描述最符合哪个主题？窦性 P 波规则出现，但心室率 <60 次/: According to this site's lesson, which topic best matches the following description? Sinus P waves appear regularly, but ventricular rate is <60 beats/min; first ask 'Are there symptoms?', then ask 'Why is it slow?'
按本站课程，以下描述最符合哪个主题？窦房结停摆时交界区接班：窄 QRS、40–6: According to this site's course, which topic does the following description best match? When the sinus node stops, the junctional area takes over: narrow QRS, 40–60 beats/min, absent or retrograde P waves; the key is to find “why it is slow.”
按本站课程，以下描述最符合哪个主题？等频性房室分离指心房与心室频率几乎相同但无固: According to this site’s course, which topic best fits the following description? 按本站课程，以下描述最符合哪个主题？胸痛患者首份心电图应在 10 分钟内完成；S: According to this site's course, which topic best matches the following description? 按本站课程，以下描述最符合哪个主题？自律性是起搏细胞在无外部刺激下自动产生动作电: According to the site's course, which topic does the following description best fit? Automaticity is the ability of pacemaker cells to spontaneously generate action potentials without external stimulation; when a higher pacemaker fails or conduction is interrupted, a lower pacemaker takes over at a slower rate, forming an escape beat.

Typical cases show 4:3 or 3:2 conduction; the QRS is mostly narrow, and it is mostly intra-AV nodal block, often related to increased vagal tone or drugs.
《交界性期前收缩》诊断标准：提前出现的 QRS 波群，形态与窦性 QRS 相同或: Premature Junctional Contraction diagnostic criterion: a premature QRS complex with morphology identical or similar to the sinus QRS (narrow).

《低钙血症》危险信号：手足抽搐、喉痉挛、癫痫或意识改变。: Hypocalcemia danger signs: tetany, laryngospasm, seizures, or altered consciousness.

《低钾血症》与《洋地黄效应》的鉴别点：洋地黄效应呈勺状 ST 压低、QT 缩短，: Distinguishing Hypokalemia from Digoxin Effect: digoxin effect shows scooped ST depression and shortened QT, with a history of digoxin use.

《加速性室性自主心律》处理原则：血流动力学稳定者以观察为主，治疗原发病：完成再灌: Accelerated Idioventricular Rhythm management principles: for hemodynamically stable patients, observation is primary, and treat the underlying cause: complete reperfusion, correct electrolytes, discontinue triggers; most are short-lived and self-limited.
《加速性室性自主心律》属于“逸搏与缓慢性心律”板块。: Accelerated Idioventricular Rhythm belongs to the 'Escape and Bradyarrhythmias' section.

《多导联可穿戴与远程监护》关键点：多导联可穿戴提高检测能力。: Key point for 'Multi-lead Wearables and Remote Monitoring': multi-lead wearables improve detection capability.
《多导联可穿戴与远程监护》的最具特异性的线索：多导联比单导联更能识别 P 波与: Most specific clue for 'Multi-lead Wearables and Remote Monitoring': multi-lead is better than single-lead at identifying P waves and ST changes; however, wear adherence, data volume, and alarm management are challenges.

《完全性右束支传导阻滞》诊断标准：QRS 时限 ≥0.12 s，V1 或 V2: Diagnostic criteria for Complete right bundle branch block: QRS duration ≥0.12 s, rsR′ or rSR′ in V1 or V2, and R′ taller than the initial r wave.

《室性心动过速》危险信号：无脉、低血压、意识丧失、胸痛、心衰——立即 CPR/电: Ventricular Tachycardia red flags: pulselessness, hypotension, loss of consciousness, chest pain, heart failure—immediate CPR/cardioversion.
《室性心动过速》的定义：室性心动过速是起源于希氏束分叉以下的心室快速节律，连续: “Ventricular Tachycardia” definition: ventricular tachycardia is a rapid ventricular rhythm originating below the His bundle bifurcation, with 3 or more consecutive ventricular beats, rate usually >100 bpm; lasting ≥30 seconds or with hemodynamic compromise is sustained VT.
《室性早搏二联律》的一句话描述：一个窦性搏动后跟一个室早，周而复始；成对出现时听: One-sentence description of Ventricular Bigeminy: one sinus beat followed by one PVC, repeating continuously; when paired, auscultation may resemble a “two-tone rhythm.”

《室性逸搏心律》判读步骤：确认 QRS 宽 ≥0.12 s，且其前没有固定 PR: Ventricular Escape Rhythm interpretation steps: confirm QRS width ≥0.12 s and no preceding P wave with a fixed PR interval.

《宽 QRS 心动过速鉴别》与《阵发性室上性心动过速》的鉴别点：SVT 伴差异性: Differentiation point between "Differential Diagnosis of Wide QRS Tachycardia" and "Paroxysmal Supraventricular Tachycardia": SVT with aberrant conduction can be wide, and prior ECGs need to be compared.
《宽 QRS 心动过速鉴别》发生机制：室速起源于心室，QRS 宽大；室上速伴束支: "Differential Diagnosis of Wide QRS Tachycardia" mechanism: VT originates in the ventricles, with a wide QRS; SVT with bundle branch block or aberrant conduction can also be wide.
《寒战伪差》教学要点：骨骼肌不自主收缩产生高频电信号；低体温与术后寒战常见。: Shivering Artifact teaching point: Involuntary skeletal muscle contraction produces high-frequency electrical signals; hypothermia and postoperative shivering are common.
《寒战伪差》的一句话描述：寒战产生持续高频肌电噪声，常见于术后、发热/降温、输血: Shivering Artifact one-sentence description: Shivering produces continuous high-frequency EMG noise, commonly seen after surgery, with fever/cooling, and in transfusion reactions; it can mask P waves and the ST segment.
《导线与通道错接》教学要点：通道与电极不匹配使不同导联信号被错标；多导联同时出现: 'Lead Wire and Channel Misconnection' teaching point: channel-electrode mismatch causes signals from different leads to be mislabeled; simultaneous 'unreasonable' patterns in multiple leads are a clue.

《小儿心率正常范围》的一句话描述：小儿心率随年龄下降：新生儿 120–160、婴: One-sentence description of 'Normal Pediatric Heart Rate Range': pediatric heart rate decreases with age: newborn 120–160, infant 100–150, toddler 90–140, preschool 80–120, school-age 70–110, adolescent 60–100 bpm.

《小儿长 QT 综合征》的一句话描述：小儿长 QT 可表现为晕厥、抽搐、猝死，常: One-sentence description of "Pediatric Long QT Syndrome": pediatric long QT can present with syncope, convulsions, sudden death, and is often misdiagnosed as epilepsy; prolonged QTc, abnormal T-wave morphology, and family history are key.

《左心房增大》教学要点：左房除极向量向后向左，体表表现为 P 波时间延长；V1: Left Atrial Enlargement teaching points: the left atrial depolarization vector is posterior and leftward, manifesting on the surface ECG as prolonged P wave duration; V1 is located on the right chest and can record the terminal negative component of posterior left atrial depolarization.

《心房颤动》与《窦性心律不齐》的鉴别点：窦性心律不齐有清晰 P 波，RR 变化渐: Differentiation between “Atrial Fibrillation” and “Sinus Arrhythmia”: sinus arrhythmia has clear P waves and gradual RR changes.
《心房颤动》发生机制：肺静脉口附近的异位电活动触发心房多发微折返，心房电活动变得: “Atrial Fibrillation” mechanism: ectopic electrical activity near the pulmonary vein ostia triggers multiple atrial microreentries; atrial electrical activity becomes rapid and chaotic, losing effective mechanical contraction.

《心电图测量与定标》的定义：心电图测量包括纸速、增益、心率、PR、QRS、QT/: Definition of 'ECG Measurement and Calibration': ECG measurement includes paper speed, gain, heart rate, PR, QRS, QT/QTc, axis, and amplitude. At standard paper speed 25 mm/s, one small box is 0.04 s and one large box is 0.20 s; at standard gain 10 mm/mV, 10 mm represents 1 mV.
《心电图研究方法入门》属于“进阶与前沿”板块。: 'Introduction to ECG Research Methods' belongs to the 'Advanced and Frontiers' section.
《心电成像与高级标测》学习目标：心电成像=体表逆问题。: Learning objective of 'ECG Imaging and Advanced Mapping': ECG imaging = body surface inverse problem.
《心电成像与高级标测》属于“进阶与前沿”板块。: 'ECG Imaging and Advanced Mapping' belongs to the 'Advanced and Frontiers' section.
《心电轴快速判断》易错点：只看 I 导联就判断电轴，忽略 aVF 与 II。: "Rapid ECG Axis Determination" pitfall: determining the axis by looking only at lead I while ignoring aVF and II.

《心肌动作电位与离子通道》的最具特异性的线索：动作电位时程与形态决定 QT、T: 'Myocardial Action Potential and Ion Channels' most specific clue: Action potential duration and morphology determine QT, T waves, and drug responses; changes in potassium, calcium, and sodium channels are directly reflected in ST-T and QRS.

《急性下壁 ST 段抬高型心肌梗死》处理原则：再灌注：直接 PCI 为首选，目标: 《Acute Inferior ST-Segment Elevation Myocardial Infarction》 management principles: reperfusion: direct PCI is preferred, target ≤120 minutes; if timely PCI is unavailable and there are no contraindications, thrombolysis within 30 minutes.
《急性下壁 ST 段抬高型心肌梗死》属于“缺血、梗死与 ST-T”板块。: “Acute Inferior ST-Segment Elevation Myocardial Infarction” belongs to the “Ischemia, Infarction, and ST-T” section.
《急性前壁 ST 段抬高型心肌梗死》处理原则：立即启动导管室：首选直接 PCI，: 《Acute Anterior ST-Segment Elevation Myocardial Infarction》 management principles: activate the cath lab immediately: direct PCI is preferred, target first medical contact-to-wire crossing ≤120 minutes; if timely PCI is unavailable and there are no contraindications, thrombolysis within 30 minutes, followed by transfer for PCI.
《急性心包炎》危险信号：发热 >38°C、亚急性起病、免疫抑制或近期外伤手术：警: 《Acute Pericarditis》 danger signals: fever >38°C, subacute onset, immunosuppression, or recent trauma/surgery: be alert to purulent, tuberculous, or neoplastic pericarditis.
《急性心包炎》的定义：急性心包炎是心包脏层与壁层的急性炎症，常由病毒、结核、自身: 《Acute Pericarditis》 definition: acute pericarditis is acute inflammation of the visceral and parietal pericardium, often caused by viruses, tuberculosis, autoimmune disease, uremia, or tumors. Inflammation involves the subepicardial myocardium, producing diffuse injury current; on ECG it manifests as concave ST elevation in multiple leads and PR-segment depression, and clinically it is often accompanied by chest pain and a pericardial friction rub.
《房室结与希氏-浦肯野系统》教学要点：房室结细胞动作电位上升支依赖 L 型钙电流: 'AV Node and His-Purkinje System' teaching point: The upstroke of the AV node cell action potential depends on L-type calcium current and conducts slowly, forming the PR segment. This delay allows the atria to complete filling before ventricular contraction.
《房性心动过速》处理原则：不稳定：同步电复律（窄 QRS 不规则/房速可 50–: “Atrial Tachycardia” management principles: unstable: synchronized cardioversion (for irregular narrow QRS/atrial tachycardia, start at 50–100 J; adjust by device and clinical response); sedate conscious patients first.
《房性期前收缩》易错点：P′ 常隐藏在前的 T 波中，只看 QRS 会把房早误判: Premature Atrial Contraction pitfall: P′ is often hidden in the preceding T wave; looking only at the QRS can misjudge a PAC as sinus arrhythmia.
《房性期前收缩》需与《室性期前收缩》鉴别：室早无提前 P′, QRS 宽大畸形，: Premature Atrial Contraction must be differentiated from Premature Ventricular Contraction: PVCs have no premature P′, a wide and bizarre QRS, and a fully compensatory pause.
《房颤负荷与监测》教学要点：持续监测提高无症状房颤检出率；负荷越高，血栓风险与症: Teaching points for 'AF Burden and Monitoring': Continuous monitoring improves detection of asymptomatic AF; higher burden generally means greater thromboembolic risk and symptom burden.
《房颤负荷与监测》的一句话描述：房颤负荷指监测期内房颤时间占比；负荷与卒中风险、: One-sentence description for 'AF Burden and Monitoring': AF burden is the proportion of time in AF during the monitoring period; burden is associated with stroke risk, symptoms, and rhythm-treatment decisions, but cannot replace CHA₂DS₂-VASc alone.
《早期复极综合征》学习目标：早期复极多数良性。: "Early Repolarization Syndrome" learning objective: early repolarization is mostly benign.
《晕厥：心电图红线》关键点：晕厥先查心电图红线。: Key point of Syncope: ECG Red Flags: for syncope, check ECG red flags first.

《正常窦性心律》关键数值：60–100次/分（心率）: Key value for “Normal Sinus Rhythm”: 60–100 beats/min (heart rate)

《洋地黄效应》需与《心肌缺血与 ST 段压低》鉴别：缺血性 ST 压低多为水平/: Digitalis Effect must be differentiated from Myocardial Ischemia and ST-Segment Depression: ischemic ST depression is mostly horizontal/downsloping, with dynamic changes and symptoms.
《洋地黄效应与中毒》学习目标：洋地黄效应≠中毒。: 'Digoxin Effect and Toxicity' learning objective: digoxin effect ≠ toxicity.
《滤波设置与假性 ST 改变》学习目标：滤波可改变 ST/QRS。: 'Filter Settings and Pseudo-ST Changes' learning objective: filtering can alter ST/QRS.
《电偶、向量与心电向量环》关键点：体表波形 = 心电向量在导联轴上的投影。: 'Dipole, Vectors, and ECG Vector Loops' key point: surface waveform = projection of the ECG vector onto the lead axis.

《窦性停搏 / 窦性静止》易错点：把未下传的房性早搏误认为窦性停搏：仔细看前一个: Error-prone point of "Sinus Arrest / Sinus Standstill": mistaking a nonconducted atrial premature beat for sinus arrest: carefully look at whether the preceding T wave is deformed.

《窦性心动过速》处理原则：以治疗病因为主：退热、镇痛、补液、纠正贫血/缺氧、处理: Management principles of "Sinus Tachycardia": mainly treat the cause: antipyretics, analgesia, fluid replacement, correction of anemia/hypoxia, management of hyperthyroidism or pulmonary embolism.

《肺栓塞（S1Q3T3）》诊断标准：窦性心动过速最常见（约 40–50%），也可: Pulmonary Embolism (S1Q3T3) diagnostic criteria: sinus tachycardia is most common (about 40–50%), atrial fibrillation may also occur.

《起搏钉的识别》学习目标：钉 + P/QRS=夺获；只有钉=失夺获。: 'Identification of Pacing Spikes' learning objective: spike + P/QRS = capture; spike alone = loss of capture.
《运动负荷心电图适应证》关键点：运动试验用于冠心病与运动性心律失常。: Key point of 'Indications for Exercise Stress ECG': exercise testing is used for coronary artery disease and exercise-induced arrhythmias.
《运动负荷心电图适应证》的最具特异性的线索：适应证：胸痛评估、已知冠心病风险分层: Most specific clue for 'Indications for Exercise Stress ECG': indications: chest pain evaluation, risk stratification in known coronary artery disease, exercise-induced arrhythmias; contraindications: acute ACS, severe aortic stenosis, uncontrolled heart failure/hypertension.
《逸搏-夺获心律》关键点：逸搏-夺获=高度 AVB 背景下的偶发下传。: Key point of Escape-Capture Rhythm: escape-capture = occasional conduction in the setting of high-grade AVB.
《逸搏-夺获心律》的最具特异性的线索：宽 QRS 逸搏背景下出现提前的窄 QRS: Most specific clue of Escape-Capture Rhythm: a premature narrow QRS (preceded by P wave and appropriate PR) in the setting of wide QRS escape beats suggests capture; capture beats indicate AV conduction is not completely interrupted.

《长 QT 综合征 1 型》学习目标：LQT1：运动诱发，T 波宽大。: Learning objectives for Long QT Syndrome Type 1: LQT1: exercise-induced, broad T waves.

《高钙血症》发生机制：高钙缩短动作电位平台期，复极加快，QT 间期缩短。: Mechanism of 'Hypercalcemia': high calcium shortens the action potential plateau phase, accelerates repolarization, and shortens the QT interval.

该描述对应《数字孪生与电生理模拟》：数字孪生用患者影像/电生理数据构建心脏电活动: This description corresponds to "Digital Twin and Electrophysiological Simulation": digital twins use patient imaging/electrophysiological data to build cardiac electrical activity models and simulate arrhythmias and treatment responses; currently mostly used in research.
该描述对应《新生儿心律失常》：新生儿可出现房早、室上速、房扑、房颤、室早；多数为: This description corresponds to 'Neonatal Arrhythmias': neonates may have premature atrial contractions, supraventricular tachycardia, atrial flutter, atrial fibrillation, and premature ventricular contractions; most are benign, but sustained SVT can lead to heart failure/shock.
该描述对应《正常窦性心律》：最具特异性的是“窦性 P 波电轴（I、II、aVF: This description corresponds to "Normal Sinus Rhythm": the most specific is "sinus P wave axis (upright in I, II, aVF; inverted in aVR) + QRS with fixed PR after every P"; P wave morphology remains consistent within the same lead.

该描述对应《肺栓塞心电图》：肺栓塞心电图可正常，也可出现窦速、S1Q3T3、右束: This description corresponds to 'Pulmonary Embolism ECG': The ECG in pulmonary embolism may be normal or show sinus tachycardia, S1Q3T3, right bundle branch block, right precordial T-wave inversion, and right axis deviation; ECG cannot be used to exclude it.

该描述对应《胎儿心电图与孕期监测》：胎儿心率基线 110–160 次/分；变异、: This description corresponds to Fetal ECG and Pregnancy Monitoring: fetal heart rate baseline 110–160 beats/min; variability, acceleration, and deceleration patterns are more important than a single heart rate; needs to be combined with uterine contractions and fetal movement.
该描述对应《融合波》：融合波是室上性冲动与室性异位/起搏冲动同时激动心室，QRS: This description corresponds to 'Fusion beat': a fusion beat occurs when a supraventricular impulse and a ventricular ectopic/paced impulse simultaneously activate the ventricles, with QRS morphology intermediate between the two; supports VT or pacing.
该描述对应《起搏器 NBG 代码》：NBG 代码用 5 个位置描述起搏心腔、感知: This description corresponds to 'Pacemaker NBG Code': the NBG code uses 5 positions to describe paced chamber, sensed chamber, response mode, rate adaptation, and multisite pacing; e.g., VVI, DDD, CRT.
该描述对应《起搏器感知过度》：感知过度指起搏器把肌肉电、电磁干扰、T 波或远场信: This description corresponds to 'Pacemaker Oversensing': oversensing means the pacemaker mistakes muscle potentials, electromagnetic interference, T waves, or far-field signals for intrinsic electrical activity, causing inappropriate inhibition of pacing.
该描述对应《起搏失夺获》：起搏钉后无 P/QRS；自身逸搏可能很慢；患者可晕厥、: This description corresponds to 'Pacemaker Loss of Capture': no P/QRS after the pacing spike; intrinsic escape beats may be very slow; the patient may have syncope and hypotension; pacemaker programming shows high threshold or abnormal lead impedance.
该描述对应《起搏钉伪差与过感知》：起搏钉可能被监护仪误计为 QRS，或起搏器把监: This description corresponds to 'Pacemaker Spike Artifact and Oversensing': pacemaker spikes may be mistakenly counted as QRS by the monitor, or the pacemaker may mistakenly sense monitor/electromagnetic signals; both cause 'pseudoarrhythmia'.
该描述对应《运动试验阳性标准》：运动试验阳性通常指运动中或运动后出现 ≥0.1: This description corresponds to 'Positive Exercise Test Criteria': a positive exercise test usually means ≥0.1 mV horizontal/downsloping ST depression during or after exercise, typical chest pain, blood pressure drop, or severe arrhythmia.
该描述对应《遗传性心律失常与基因检测》：基因结果需结合表型、家族史与变异解读；意: This description corresponds to "Inherited Arrhythmias and Genetic Testing": genetic results must be interpreted together with phenotype, family history, and variant interpretation; variants of uncertain significance cannot be diagnosed alone.
该描述对应《长 QT 综合征 2 型》：QTc 延长、T 波低平或有切迹；情绪/: This description corresponds to 'Long QT Syndrome Type 2': QTc prolongation, flat or notched T waves; emotion/sound-induced syncope; increased risk postpartum.
该描述对应《阵发性室上性心动过速》：最具特异性的是“突发突止的规则窄 QRS 心: This description corresponds to 'Paroxysmal Supraventricular Tachycardia': the most specific is 'paroxysmal, regular narrow QRS tachycardia, with P waves often buried in or after the QRS (retrograde P)'; AVNRT commonly shows a pseudo-r′ (V1) or pseudo-s (II, III, aVF), while the retrograde P in AVRT is often located farther after the QRS.
该描述对应《高钙血症》：最具特异性的是“QT 间期缩短、ST 段缩短”；T 波通: This description corresponds to 'Hypercalcemia': the most specific findings are 'shortened QT interval and shortened ST segment'; T waves usually show no obvious changes. The degree of QT shortening is roughly correlated with elevated serum calcium, but not in an exact linear relationship.
该描述对应《高钾血症》：最具特异性的是“高尖、对称、基底窄的 T 波，尤其在 V: This description corresponds to 'Hyperkalemia': the most specific finding is 'tall, symmetric, narrow-based T waves, especially in V2–V4'; QRS widening, flattened P waves, and sine waves suggest severe hyperkalemia. ECG and serum potassium are not linearly correlated; hyperkalemia cannot be ruled out by ECG.

《CPR 与电击伪差》学习目标：CPR 伪差高幅、节律性。: Learning objective for 'CPR and Shock Artifact': CPR artifact is high-amplitude and rhythmic.

《STEMI 导联定位与罪犯血管》的最具特异性的线索：最具特异性的是“相邻导联新: 'STEMI Lead Localization and Culprit Vessel' most specific clue: the most specific is 'new ST elevation in adjacent leads + reciprocal depression in corresponding leads'; localization requires lead grouping, but culprit vessel and anatomic variants require coronary angiography confirmation.
《WPW 危险分层》学习目标：WPW 风险看旁路前传不应期。: Learning objective of 'WPW Risk Stratification': WPW risk depends on the antegrade refractory period of the accessory pathway.
《一度房室传导阻滞》的一句话描述：每个 P 波都下传，但 PR 恒定 >0.20: One-sentence description of First-Degree Atrioventricular Block: every P wave is conducted, but PR is constantly >0.20 s; most are asymptomatic, focus on finding the cause and monitoring for progression.
《一度房室传导阻滞》记忆点：一度阻滞 = PR 延长但“一个都不少”。: “First-Degree AV Block” memory point: first-degree block = PR prolongation but “no dropped beats.”
《三度房室传导阻滞》易错点：把三度阻滞的 P 波误认为未下传房早或窦性停搏。: “Third-Degree AV Block” pitfall: mistaking P waves in third-degree block for non-conducted atrial premature beats or sinus arrest.
《三度房室传导阻滞》需与《二度 II 型房室传导阻滞》鉴别：二度 II 型仍有固: “Third-Degree AV Block” must be differentiated from “Second-Degree Type II AV Block”: Type II still has conducted beats with fixed PR; in third-degree block, P and QRS are completely dissociated.
《三环类抗抑郁药过量心电图》学习目标：TCA：QRS 宽 + aVR R 高。: Learning objectives for “Tricyclic Antidepressant Overdose ECG”: TCA: wide QRS + tall R in aVR.
《二度 II 型房室传导阻滞》危险信号：晕厥、黑矇、心室率 <40 次/分或长间: “Second-Degree Type II AV Block” danger signs: syncope, amaurosis, ventricular rate <40 beats/min, or long pause >3 s.
《二度 I 型房室传导阻滞》处理原则：无症状且诱因可逆者：纠正病因，停用减慢房室: “Second-Degree Type I AV Block” management principle: asymptomatic patients with reversible triggers: correct the cause, discontinue drugs that slow AV node conduction, and continue monitoring.
《交界性期前收缩》判读步骤：确认提前的 QRS 形态是否与窦性一致。: Interpretation step for “Premature Junctional Contraction”: confirm whether the early QRS morphology is consistent with sinus.
《交界性逸搏心律》发生机制：窦房结自律性下降、窦性停搏或窦房传导阻滞时，交界区作: Mechanism of Junctional Escape Rhythm: when sinus node automaticity decreases, sinus arrest or sinoatrial block occurs, the junctional area acts as a secondary pacemaker and escapes passively to prevent ventricular asystole.
《交界性逸搏心律》的最具特异性的线索：窄 QRS 的缓慢节律中找不到直立的窦性: Most specific clue for Junctional Escape Rhythm: in a slow rhythm with narrow QRS, no upright sinus P wave is found; if a P wave is seen, it is inverted in II, III, aVF and upright in aVR, and when preceding the QRS, PR <0.12 s—this is the most localizing clue for junctional origin.
《低钙血症》处理原则：有症状或严重低钙：静脉葡萄糖酸钙（如 10% 葡萄糖酸钙: 'Hypocalcemia' management principles: symptomatic or severe hypocalcemia: slow IV injection of calcium gluconate (e.g., 10% calcium gluconate 10–20 mL) with continuous ECG monitoring.

《加速性室性自主心律》易错点：把 AIVR 误当室速而使用抗心律失常药，抑制逸搏: Common pitfall of Accelerated Idioventricular Rhythm: mistaking AIVR for VT and using antiarrhythmic drugs, which suppresses the escape rhythm and causes long pauses or asystole.
《加速性室性自主心律》需与《室性心动过速》鉴别：室速频率多 >100 次/分，节: Accelerated Idioventricular Rhythm must be differentiated from Ventricular Tachycardia: VT rate is mostly >100 bpm and rhythm is more unstable; AIVR is 50–110 bpm, often short-lived and self-limiting with fusion beats.
《动态心电图（Holter）适应证》教学要点：延长记录时间提高阵发性事件检出率；: Holter Indications teaching points: longer recording time improves detection of paroxysmal events; patient logs and symptom timestamps are key to interpretation.
《动态心电图（Holter）适应证》的一句话描述：Holter 连续记录 24–: Holter Indications one-sentence description: Holter continuously records ECG for 24–72 hours to capture paroxysmal arrhythmias and assess burden and ST trends; it cannot replace 12-lead diagnosis.
《可穿戴心电设备》学习目标：可穿戴适合筛查，不替代诊断。: Wearable ECG Devices learning objective: wearables are suitable for screening, not as a substitute for diagnosis.
《右心室肥厚》关键点：RVH：V1 高 R + 电轴右偏 + 右胸劳损。: 'Right Ventricular Hypertrophy' key point: RVH: tall R in V1 + right axis deviation + right precordial strain.
《右心室肥厚》的最具特异性的线索：V1 R/S>1、RV1 ≥0.7 mV、电轴: 'Right Ventricular Hypertrophy' most specific clues: V1 R/S>1, RV1 ≥0.7 mV, right axis deviation >+90°, deep S in V5/V6; may be accompanied by right atrial enlargement and ST depression in right precordial leads.
《多源性房性心动过速》学习目标：MAT：多形 P + 心率快。: Multifocal Atrial Tachycardia Learning Objective: MAT: polymorphic P waves + fast rate.
《完全性右束支传导阻滞》与《Brugada 综合征（结构异常与综合征）》的鉴别点: Difference between “Complete Right Bundle Branch Block” and “Brugada Syndrome (structural abnormalities and syndromes)”: coved-type ST elevation with RBBB-like pattern, but ST morphology and history of syncope are more specific.

《室性并行心律》学习目标：室性并行：联律间期多变 + 公约数。: Learning objective for 'Ventricular Parasystole': ventricular parasystole: variable coupling interval + common denominator.
《室性心动过速》处理原则：无脉性 VT：按心脏骤停处理，立即 CPR + 非同步: Management principles of Ventricular Tachycardia: Pulseless VT: manage as cardiac arrest, immediate CPR + unsynchronized defibrillation (biphasic 120–200 J), epinephrine 1 mg every 3–5 minutes, add amiodarone 300 mg for refractory cases.
《室性早搏二联律》判读步骤：先确认“正常-异常”交替的模式是否持续存在。: Interpretation step for “Ventricular Bigeminy”: first confirm whether the “normal–abnormal” alternating pattern persists.
《室性早搏二联律》属于“期前收缩”板块。: 《Ventricular Premature Beat Bigeminy》 belongs to the “Premature Contractions” section.
